tei:div.tei:p: can zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig lasaḥ rje btsun 'phags ma ta re la brten pa'i gsol 'debs bar chad g.yul bzlog thugs rje'i lcags kyu bzhugs soḥ

pas na mo artswa ta re shrī ye: sna tsha da 4 rwa rtsi rgyal ba kun lum 'gro ba'i mgon gdul dka' ma lus thabs kyis bdul byams dang snying rje' lcags kyu can 'phags ma yum la phyag 'chal loḥbadag 'dra pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis gdams pa snyang dang 'dra ba yi zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thag bstanaḥ sa ma yuḥ de yang dad mosadrag po dang ldan pa'i sgo sems dngas ba yi mdun mkhar 'phags ma gsal gdab nas gsol ba gdab pa'i rim pa ni e ma hoḥ skye med chos dbyings 'dus ma byas pa nas rgyal kun dgyes bskyed chos sku yum chen la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol byin gyis rlobs shig tshe bsod nyams rtogs spelaX 'gags med 'od gsal gnyug ma'i pho brang nasaḥ mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag longs sku tā re la:gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: byin gyis rlobs shig tshe bsod nyams rtogs spel: 'khrul med rtsol bral ye shes pho brang nas: 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig rje btsun sgrol ma la gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol byin gyis rlobs shig tshe bsod nyams rtogs spel: spros bral chos dbyings dag pa'i pho brang nas: gti mug rnam

gas dag sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro la gsol ba 'debs so phye nang bar chad sol: byen rgyas rlebs sheg tsho bsod nyams rtogs spel gsal dag mi 'a nga ltabu'i pho brang nas zhe sdang rang grol rdo rje mkha' 'gro la gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: byin gyis rlobs shig tshe bsod nyams rtogs spel 'khor 'das dag mnyam rol ba'i pho brang nas: nga rgyal rnam dag rin chen mkha' 'gro la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: byin gyis rlobs shig tshe bsod nyams rtogs spel:gsal khyab sor rtog dbang gi pho brang nas 'dod chags rang grol pad+ma mkha' 'gro laḥ gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: byin gyis rlobs shig tshe bsod nyams rtogs spel:rang grol bya ba grub pa'i pho brang nasaḥ phrag dog rnam dag garma mkha' 'gro la gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: byin gyis rlobs shig tshe bsod nyams rtogs spel chos dbyings dbus mtha' bral ba'i pho brang nas: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol byin gyis rlobs shig tshe

bsod nyams rtogs stel gnasayul dur khrod he ru'i pho brang nasaḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsam mi khyab pa la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: byin gyis rlobs shig tshe bsod nyams rtogs spel: rang snang zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo nas rgyal yum mtsho rgyal ma dang mkha' 'gro laX gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: byin gyis rlobs shig tshe bsod nyams rtogs spel: spyogatsug bdochen dag pa'i pho brang nas rtsa rgyud bla ma bka' drin can rnams la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol byin gyis rlobs shig tshe bsod nyams rtogs spel: rang lus rtsa khams dag pa'i pho brang nas yi dam zhi khro rgyal ba rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol:byin gyis rlobs shig tshe bsod nyams rtogs spel: bka' dang dam tshog gnyan po'i pho brang nas: bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho 'khor bcas la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol byin gyis rlobs shig tshe bsod nyams rtogs spel: deltar gsol ba btab pa'i gzi byan gyis 'jig rten dus kyi rgud pa mtha' dag sol bod yul bkra mi shis pa 'a nyer 'tshe bzlog

pas mtha' mi'i byad phur dmag dpung dzos spyor gzhesas rgya 'dre me zhen 'byung po rlung zhen thul du ru ka ya gzengs pa mtha' dag sol phyogs lasarnam rgyal bkra shas snang ba stsol thugs dam ma g.yel sngon gyi dam bca' dgongs dman pa'i 'gro rnamasa'akhor ba'i 'dam las sgrol las ngan duḥkha'i 'jigs tshogs bsal ba dang chos kyi sgron mes khams gsum yongs khyab pa 'i ma rig rmongs pa 'i blo dang bral byas te phyam ga ga rang snang galu lo bkod pa'i zhing ngo mtshar rmad byung dag pa' pho brang der skyabs mchog rje btsun 'phags ma' zhabs drung du ma 'bral tshom bu gcig tu sangs rgyas shog de ltar dad mos lngan pa yis rtag par gsol ba btab pa na phyi nang bar chad zha ba dang nyams dang rtogs pa' yon tan spel tshe dpal bsod nams rgyas pa dang dus kya rgud pa mtha' dag bzlog phan bde'i lang tsho rgyas par byed byin rlabs rno nus khyad pa ra 'pha gas man ngag snying dang 'dra ba 'di ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus kyi tshe rgud gso nga sprul rig 'dzin mchog nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas chos bdag dpa' bo dpa' mor spel 'gro don lho da byang nas 'byung gdul bya 'bum phrag smin grol byed the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' bka' gsang srungs shig dam can rnams snyang gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya gsang rgya gu rgya lha ces ba 'di'ang chos kya bdag po pad+ma rags kyi dpa'

bo pad+ma chosa'aphelargya mtshos pang mang bskul ba dang chos bdag dpa' mo rat+na sa ra dang slob bu chos gsal gyis brisagazhi dang bcas yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda risalas shas bshus te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel sarba ma lam/

pas zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs theg las: rje btsun 'phags ma'igasel 'debs gab don sprad pa'e rem pa grub gnyas gartar ma11da bzhugs roX tsan na mo dz+nyā na tā re dṛ ye: rgan za yi dad dang mos gusadrag po yis gsol ba 'debs pa'i rim pa na rnam dag g.yu 'o bkod pa'i pho brang nas: rgyal ba kun yum myur ma dpa' mo la: gsol ba 'debs so 'jigs brgyad g.yul ngo bzlog: byin gyis rlobs shig las ngan sakha sol: ma chags dre ma bral ba'i pho brang nas mkhyen gnyis dbang po swā ra swā bye la: gsol ba 'debs so ma rig dri bral nas: byin gyis rlobs shig blo gros spob pa stsol: 'dod 'byung rat+na 'bar ba'i pho brang nasaX phan bde'i 'byung gnas bsod nams mchog ster la: gsol ba 'debs so bde stong ye shes bskyed: byin gyis rlobs shig nyams rtogs yon tan sbor 'ami med rdo rje lta bu'i pho brang nas: tshe la dbang thob gtsug tor rnam rgyal la: gsol ba 'debs so nad gdon rkyen gegs sol: byin gyis rlobs shig 'chi med tshe dbang bskur ma chags bde ba

chen po'i pho brang nas:khams gsum dbang sdud ku ru kul+le la:gsol ba 'debs so 'dod rgu'i char chen phob:byin gyis rlobs shig mos bzhi dbang du bsdus:gzhes bral rdo rje 'bar ba'i pho brang nas:gdug pa tshar gcod 'jigs byed lha mo la:gsol ba 'debs so gdug sems 'chang ba bzlog:byin gyis rlobs shig bar chad g.yul ngo gzhom:bde chen lhun grub sra brtan pho brang nas:bar chad tshar gcod gzhan gyis mi thub la:gsol ba 'debs so 'jigs brgyad gzhesas par mdzod:byin gyis rlobs shig rbod gtong zhi gyur cig mi shig 'pho 'gyur bral ba'i pho brang nas:ma rung 'dul mdzad gzhan las rab rgyal mar:gsol ba 'debs so ngan gtong mtha' dmag gzhoms byin gyis rlobs shig gdul dka' 'dul bar mdzod bsil ldan bdob chen po'i pho brang nas:rig sngags tshar gcod nags kyi sgrol ma la:gsol ba 'debs so kla kle'i rdzas sbyor bzlog byin gyis rlobs shig phra min sbyor ba thul:dug gsum rang sar grol ba'i pho brang nas:'gro ba'i skyabs gcig 'jig rten gsum rgyal la

ga gsol ba 'debs so gdon bgegs 'byung po thul: byen gyes rlobs sheg dus 'khrug nad yam bzlog longs spyod char 'bebs gter gye pho brang nas:dgos 'dod 'byung gnas 'phags ma nor rgyun lhar: gsol ba 'debs so zas nor longs spyod stsol: byin gyis rlobs shig phan bde'i lang tsho bskyed: dus gsum dge legs dpal 'phel pho brang nas 'gro ba'i skyabs mchog bkra shis don byed mar gsol ba 'debs so rten 'brel nyes tshogs bzlog: byin gyis rlobs shig bde legs yon tan bskyed gdug pa tshar gcod rngams pa'i pho brang nas: log rtog 'phrang sgrol dgra dpung 'joms ma la: gsol ba 'debs so mi 'dod nyes kun gzhoms: byin gyis rlobs shig bdud bgegs 'tshe ba sgol tshad med ye shes chen po'i pho brang nas: mi mthun rkyen bzlog khro gnyer can ma la: gsol ba 'debs so log 'dren 'byug po thul:byin gyis rlobs shig gzung 'dzin dbu mar sgrol: zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang nas mi mthun rgol rnams rab tu zhi mdzad la: gsol ba 'debs so las nyon 'dam

rdzab sbyongs:byen gyis rlobs shig sdang zhen dag par mdzod she rab rang gsal 'od 'bar pho brang nas:ma rig blo bral 'bar ba'i 'od can la:gsol ba 'debs so ma rig rmongs tshogs bsregs:byin gyis rlobs shig ye shes sgron me sbor:gzung 'dzin bdud bzhi tshar gcod pho brang nas 'gro ba 'dren mdzad dpag med gnon ma la gsol ba 'debs so log rtog 'khrul 'khor gzhoms:byin gyis rlobs shig bdud bzhi ming med mdzod:'gro 'dul nyon mongs dug 'joms pho brang nas:skyon bral lha mo rma bya chen mo la gsol ba 'debs so nyon 'khrul dri ma bral:byin gyis rlobs shig chags sdang rmang nas bsgyil:bde stong spros dang bral ba'i pho brang nas:'gro ba'i mgon po mi pham rgyal mo la:gsol ba 'debs so bar chad bdud 'dul zhing:byin gyis rlobs shig ma rig sangs bar re ga:nad rim rgol ba rab 'joms pho brang nas:dus kyi 'tshubs ma gzhoms mdzad ri khrod mar:gsol ba 'debs so dug lnga'i nad yam bzlog byin gyis rlobs shig ye shes rtogs par mdzod:dgra bgegs tshar gcod drag

gan po'i pho brang nas logs rtog tshar gartsad 'od zar can ma la: gsol ba 'debs so dgra ye dpung tshogs tshoms: byen rgyas rlobs sheg log rtog 'joms par mdzod bde stong spros bral mchog gi pho brang nas 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags ma nyer gcig la: gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol: byin gyis rlobs shig lto/gas pa 11nga dza/la marnge/da de ltar gsol ba btab pa' tshig gel sgrub yin na shā lo ka re re bzhin du gdags par bya phyi sgrub yan na yongs rdzogs sam mjug gi shā lo ka gcig brjod byin rlabs rno nus khyad par 'phags bden rdzun lag tu long dang gsal shin tu zab pa man ngag mchog nga sprul nga dang dbyer med pa nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas chos bdag dpa' bo dpa' mo la bstan nas don gnyis 'grub par 'gyur gdul bya 'bum phrag bde la bkod zab gsang srung shig bstan srung tshogs sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gu rgya lha ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag popod+ma chosa'ashel rgya mtshosa'agyur mid rgya mcheng chos bdag rasne sar slob bu chos bdag rnams kyis yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dradapa' nge nusaldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phabs pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba make lam/

gas zab gsang mkha' 'a1 'i thugs theg las/ dkar gtor 'bul ba bdud ci'i rgya mcho bzhugs so:ga na mo dz+nyā na ḍasko ni ye: rta11rtan rteng rgyal ba kun yum 'gro ba'i mgon 'ari gas pa brgyad skyob tā re ma rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab pa la mthon mthing ral pa sa btud de 'dud 'phags ma sgrub pa' rnal 'byor la nyer mkho' cha lag zab mo bstan rang nyid lha mo'i rgyal gyis dkar skyems bas sbyangs byin rlabs nas dril bu 'brol la 'di skad do hūṃ hrī: sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen bsrung mdzad pa'i: bka' dam la gnas dkar phyogs skyongs ba'i tshogs: ma thogs gnas 'dir sbyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mnga' ri skor gsum dbus gtsang ru bzhi dang:mdo khams sgang drug yul gzhi skyongs ba'i rigs: mtho ba nam mkha' yangs pa bar snang khams: dma' ba sa gzhi stong gsum srid pa'i bdag: yul lha gzhi bdag dkar phyogs skyongs ba rnams: gtsang sbyar gser skyems gtor ma 'di bzhes la rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi sdong grogs mdzod: dbang chen sa 'jin sa yi lha mo dang: sa bdag lto

'bye lo zla zhag dus bdag gnyan gtod klu dang sa bdag rigs rnams kyi: gtsang sbyar gser skyems gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byer las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod rin chen sa 'di bdag la stsol ba dang: gsang spyod zab mo sgrub la ru nga spongs: dgra dang bgegs kyis 'tshe ba kun gzhoms nas: mthun rkyen legs tshogs gong nas gong 'phel mdzod: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: sgo bhu mi pa ti pri the snyi sa pa ri wa rat+na e dam bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan bdun gyis phul gtor skyem sa mchod gas bcol phrin las gegs med 'grub phyi nang nyer 'tshe'i g.yul las rgyal legs yon gong 'phel bsam pa 'grub the tshom med do sa ma mā shin tu zab pa'i bka' rgya can nga sprul nga dang dbyer med pa nus ldan rdo rje'i dpa la du shog zab bcud srungs shig klu bdud btsan skal med lag tu ma shor cig sa ma shā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi ces kyang 'di lta bu'i kha bskang zhig dgos zhes chos bdag dharma dang ye shesagrogs rat+na sa ras yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nubaldan rdo rjesa'adros phug mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling nas dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam/

gas zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs theg las: dmar gtor 'bul ba phrin las lhun grub zhes bya ba bzhugs so:pas na 31 dz+nyā ḍasko ni ye nyirnasherngo 1slo dus ban snyegs ma'i rgud sel dpal rje btsun 'phags ma rta re ni rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab pa la sgo gsum gus pa sa phyag 'tshal lo ma 'ongs las ldan sgrub pa po'i phrin las gegs med 'grub pa'i phyir gtor ma 'bul ba'i rim pa ni phran las lhun grub zhes bya bstan sa ma yā rin chen sgod du dmar gtor bshams ra nyid 'phags ma' nga rgyal gyas bsangs sbyangasabyin gyis brlabs nas slar snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do hūṃ hrī sngon tshe rgyal ba'i bka' dam la gnas pa'i: dregs pa sde brgyad zo dor bdag po ni: dkar po lha dang rngam pa gshin rje dang: sngags srung ma mo yak+ka gnod sbyin sde: myur mgyogs btsan rgyal gdug byed ra tsa dang: stobs ldan bdud dang gtum pa klu yi tshogs: drang sgong gza' dang dam can rdo rje legs: sprul 'khor yang g.yog bsam mi khyab pa rnams ma thogs gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol bdud rtsi gser skyems dmar gtor mchod 'bul bzhes:

zab gsang bstan pa gnyan po bsrung du gsol: khyad par yul 'di skyong ba'i sde brgyad rigs pha ri tshu ri g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab la: dbang byed dregs tshogs dmar la dgyes pa rnams: 'dir gshegs dmar gyi gtor skyems mchod 'bul bzhes gnod cing gdug pa'i bsam pa dang bral nas: zhi zhing byams pa'i gnas 'gron dam tshig gis rtag par dge ba'i sdong grogs mdzad du gsol: phyi nang nyer 'tshe'i dri ma kun bcom zhing: mthun rkyen 'dod don bsam pa kun bsgrub nas: tshe gcig sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i lam 11gas mdzod bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: cesabarjod gtor skyemasagatsang sar gshegs gang bcol phrin las thogasamed 'grub phyi nang bar chad bdud rigasazhi tshe bsod nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas ze tshem med do sam shā shin tu zab pa thug zig gi cha lag sngon gtor 'bul ba 'di snying gi bu dang 'phrad gyur nas bsgrub pa'i rkyen snang zhi gyur cig bka' 'di srungs shig klu bdud btsan skal med lag tu ma shor cig nusaldan rdo rje'i dpal du shog sam mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi cesapa 'di'ang chosal dbang ba'i ratā sa ras bskul ngoranu ldanardo rjesa'abrosaphug mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling nas dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam/

gas zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las 'phags ma 'jigs byed lha mo dang: 'brel ba'i bgegs gtong ba'e rem pa bar chad rkyen sel zab mo bzhugs so:ga sa na mo ār+ya tā re gro ye: rnari1 41 rgyal kun dgyesapa bskyed byed cing phron las lha ru bsngags pa yi rje btsun 'phags ma' dkyil 'khor la gus pas bayid de snying nas 'dud ma 'ongasalas ldan pho mo yis bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa'i tshe bar chad bgegs tshogs ba na bskrad thabs phrin las gegs med 'grub phyir bstan sa ma shā de yang rin chen snod kyi nang 'bras chan brgyan pa 'i glud gtor bshams ranganyid lha ya nga rgyal gyis bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs pa na o su bha was sbyangs la: cha las rin chen po yi sgod nang du: kho las byung ba'i glud kyi gtor ma ni: kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs: 'dod yon ma tshang med pa'i gter du gyur skyirngo āḥ/ lan gsum brjod la bgegs 'gugs mi na mo: mchog gsum rtsa gsum sku gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bka' bden pa dang: don dam chos nyid gdod nas dag cing chos can rgyu 'bras 'aslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang: rnal 'byor pa bdag gi lha sngags phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyi bka'

bdan pa dang: khyad par dus ngan 'jeg skyobs kye lha bdud 'dul ke la ya'e bka' byen rlabs gter mdzod ma hā gu ru'i bka' bden pa dang: bar chad g.yul bzlog bdud 'dul chen tho'i bka' bden pa dang: snying rje'i dbang phyug thugs rje chen po'i bka' bden pa dang 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs rje btsun 'phags ma nyer gcig rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab pa'i bka' bden pa dang: bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas: deng 'dir bsnyen sgrub zab mo'i gzhung bsrang zhing dkyil 'khor gnyan po bsgom pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs tshogs 'o ga par 'dren pa gang dag ci yod pa thams cad mtho ba nam mkha': yan sa pa bar snang: dma' ba sa gzhi stong gsum srid pa'i khams gang na gnas kyang skad cig da lta nyid du glud gtor len phyir 'dir 'dus shig: tshog sarba bisnye a gar+sha ya dza: dzaḥ/ baṃ ho lan gsum brjod la bgegs tshogs bkug saṃ bha ra dang a ka ros glud gtor rgya chen spel bar bya de nas bka' bsgo gzhu bzhin gto slar yang glud gtor bsngo ba ni glud gtor 'dod yon lnga ldan 'di: bgegs gyi rigs gyur kun la bsngo:

pas dga' zheng mgu la tshams gyur nas: gnad 'tsho 'e bsam spyor dang bral nas: rang rang gnas su 'gro bar rgyas deng ge darkyal 'khar gnyan rba ye: lha sngags phyag rgyar ma rngam shig: rnal 'byor tshe la ma re zhig: rol mo'i sgra la ma chags shig: bdud rtsi'i bcud zab ma 'jib cig rak+ta'i mdangs la ma rngam shig: gtor ma'i dpal la ma zhen zhig: mar me'i mdangs bzang ma 'phrog cig: sgrub mchog bka' las ma 'da' bar: rgya mtsho chen po'i pha mthar dengs: gal te gnod cing tshe byed na ngang nyid dpal chen thugs khros nas: rdo rje mtshon cha'i char phab nas: khyed rnams sgog dang bral ta re: de phyir sdog par ma byed cig: sarba bisnye gats+tsha gtsā bden stobs brjod cing bgegs tshogs bskrad rol mo' sgra sbir thun gyis brab bsrung ba' 'khor lo rim brgyad bskor gnas kyis bar chad g.yul ngo zha sa ma yuḥmem rgyal dbang pad+ma zad phreng ngas bstan dang 'gro la phan sems kyis thugs zig gdams zab rmad byung na rin chen sa yi gter du sbas las byed pho nyar gter byang gtad ma 'ong snyigs ma lnga yi dus nga sprul nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel chos bdag dpa' bo dpa' mo la

rang skal gdams pa sbyin byas nas gdul bya 'bum phrag smin grol byed 'gro don rgya chen 'byung bar 'gyur the tshom med do sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim lha ces pa 'di'ang brda don legs par ma mthong ba bsnyen sgrub zab mo'i bskul nas ji bzhin pa'i bkod tshul bdag 'dra nuX ldan rdo rjes dpal ldan brag lha mgon po'i gnas mdun nas spel ba dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo lam/

gas zab gsang mkha' 'gre'o thugs theg las: rje btsun 'phags ma nyer gcig gi byen 'bebs bdud rtse'e char rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so:ga na mo ar+ya tā re bṛ ye: rna1spyo 43 rje 14) dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi phrin las gcig bsdus 'gro ba' mgon rje btsun 'phags ma tā re la gus pas bayid de snyang nas 'dud sa ma pā de yi cha lag thabs zab mo byin chen dbab pa'i rim pa la sha chen gsur dud zhun me sbar dar tshon g.yab cing rol mo sgrogs snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad do hūṃ hūṃ sa: rang snang mi ro ga bde chen dag pa'i zhing g.yu lo can nas rgyal yum tā re ma: gdung bas bskul zhing 'o dod 'bod lags na: bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dag mnyam byin phob cig:lhub chub bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas: rgyal ba bskyed pa'i myur ma dpa' mo yang: mos pas bskul zhing 'o dod 'bod lags na: bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dag mnyam byin phob cig dre bral gsal dag rol ba chen po nas: chags thogs bral ba'i sgra dbyangs lha mo nyid snyan pa'i tshig gis bskul zhing 'bod lags na: bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dag mnyam byin

phob cig 'dod 'byung rasgo'i gter kyi da la nas:dpal spel bsod nams mchog ster lha mo yang:gdung bas bskul zhing 'o dod 'bod lags na:bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dag mnyam byin phob cig:'chi med tshe la dbang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas:tshe dbang gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma yang mos gus gdung shugs drag pos bskul lags na bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dag mnyam byin phob cig:chags bral sor rtog dbang gi pho brang nas:khams gsum dbang sdud ku ru kul+le ma snying nas bskul zhing gdung bas 'bod lags na:bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dag mnyam byin phob cig:bdud 'dul dpa' brdzid 'jigs bral pho brang nas:gdug pa tshar gcod 'jigs byed lha mo yang:gdung shugs drag pos 'bod cing bskul lags na:bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dag mnyam byin phob cig:sra brtan 'gyur mod rdo rje'i pho brang nas:'dul mdzad lha mo gzhan gyisami thub ma:snying nas bskul zhing yang yang 'bod lags na:bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dag mnyam byin phob cig rang grol rol pa bde chen pho brang nas:pha rol g.yul

can las rab rgyal lha rma yang dad dang rmas gus drag pos 'arbad bskul na: bsgrub pa' gnas 'dar dag mnyam rgyan phob tsag:bsal ldan bdo ba tshan po'i po brang nas: 'gro 'dul lha mo nags kyi sgrol ma yang: bdag gi dad pa drag pos 'bod bskul na: bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dag mnyam byin phob cig:bde stsole spre sa pa bral ba'i pho brang nas: 'jig rten gsum rgyal bde ba'i lha mo yang: snying nas bskul zhing ya yang 'bod bskul na: bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dag mnyam byin phob cig:dgos rgu lhun grub rat+na'i da la nas bsod nams gter spel nor rgyun lha mo yang: thugs rje thabs kyis yang yang bskul lags na: bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dag mnyam byin phob cig: yid bzhin char 'bebs bde ba'i pho brang nas 'phags ma lha mo bkra shis don byed ma:rnal 'byor gdung shugs drag pos bskul lags na: bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dag mnyam byin phob cig sra brtan rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas bdud 'dul lha mo dgra dpung 'joms ma yang sgrub mchog snying nas 'bod cing bskul lags na:

bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dag mnyam byin phob cig drag po me ri 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas:gzhan snang zil gnon khro gnyer can ma yang:rtse gcig gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'bod bskul na bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dag mnyam byin phob cig:phun tshogasarten 'brel bzang po'i da la nas:mi mthun phyogs rnams rab tu zhi mdzad ma:dad cing mos pas yang yang 'bod bskul na:bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dag mnyam byin phob cig:gtum drag 'jigasarung bde chen brtsegs pa nas:'gro khams dong sprugs 'bar ba'i 'od can ma:gdung shugs drag pos 'bod cing bskul lags na bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dag mnyam byin phob cig:'og min mkha' spyod bde ba chen po nas:'gro ba rnam 'dren dpag med gnon ma yang:dam tshig gsang ba'i gnas 'dir 'bod bskul na:bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dag mnyam byin phob cig:'gro 'dul nyon mongabadug 'joms pho brang nas:brtse chen lha mo rma bya chen mo yang:rnal 'byor gdung shugs drag pos 'bod bskul na:bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dag mnyam byin phob cig:bde stong

pas spros mtha' bral ba'e pho brang nas: thugs rje'e dbang phyug ma pham rgyal rma nyad: sgrub mtshog bu yes 'bod tsang bskul lags na gsang ba'e gnas 'der dag mnyam byin phob cig:tshad med thugs rje 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: nad yam kun 'dul ri khrod lha mo yang: yang yang bsnyen cing gdung bas bskul lags na:'o/ga spyor tshar gcod rngam pa'i pho brang nas dgra yi dpung 'joms 'od zer can ma nyid: dad mos gdung ba drag pos 'bod lags na: bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dag mnyam byin phob cig:gnas mchog g.yu lo can gyi bkod pa ru zhing dang gnas 'di byin gyis brlabs du gsol:rje btsun 'phags ma lha mo'i rnam pa sa sgrub pa po rnams byin gyis brlabs du gsol:bkod pa rab rdzogs bde ba'i da la rtsadakyil 'khor 'di nyid myong grol 'che med ye shes bdud rtsi phudam rdzas sna tshogs byin gyis brlabs du gsol grags stong ma 'gags sngags kyi rol ba na phyi nang sgra rnams byin gyis brlabs du gsol:ma rig mun sel ye shes sgron me cha snang gsal sna tshogs byin gyis brlabs du

gsol: tshos nyed rol ba chen po'i sgra skad du rol mo'i skad gsang byin gyis brlabs du gsol: stong nyid snying dze+echen po'i rol pa rtsa 'gyu 'phro'i rtog tshogs byen gyis brlabs du gsol: nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas yul bkod pa na rnal 'byor phung khams sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba chen po ru rtsa rlung thig le byin gyis brlabs du gsol:grub pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma bzang po ston: nyams rtogs yon tan yar ngos zla ltar spel: tshe sgrub mthar phyin gzhon nu bum sku'i sbubs: dang po'i gzhi thog pheb par byin gyis rlobs snyen artswa tā re sarba sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: a we ya a ā: zhes brjod lha tshogs kha ba bu yug ba zhan 'khrubs nas bdag gnas yo byad kun la bstams la sngags chos sku myong grol chen po sa dag smin rdzogs pa' dmags 'dun yang yang bya rol mo snyan pa'i sgra yas byin kyang dbab gnad des rtags mtshan khyad 'phags 'byung bar 'gyur bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsa' sa ma yā e ma rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnasakyis snying gi yang zab gdam pa'i skor las ldan bu yi bgo skal du zab mo gter du gtams te bzhag ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus skabs su dpa' bo nus lda na rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan

pas 'gro'i phan bde spel chosabadag dpa' bo dpa' rma la gtad nas 'bum phrag sman grol byed 'gro rdan bsam ma khyab pa 'byung the tsham mid rda sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda tham sgro tsas pa 'do yang brda don legs par ma mthong ba bsnyen sgrub zab mos bskul nas ji bzhan bkod tshul bdag 'dra nus ldan rdo rjes dpal ldan brag lha mgon po'i gnas mdun nas spel ba dge legs 'phel/ sabo ma lam/
can zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: 'phags ma tā re'i dkyil 'khor dang: bskul ba'i rig 'dzin gnad bskul zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

pas naḥ( ār+ya tware bṛ ye: larisher raba'abyamasargyal ba thams cad kyi phrin las gcig bsdus 'gro ba'i skyabs rje btsun 'pha gas ma rta re la gus pa sa btud de snying nas 'dud lase ཿldan rnal 'byor pho mo yas 'phags ma'i bsnyen sgrub lhur len tshe rtags mtshan khyad 'phags 'byung ba'i phyir rig 'dzin gnad bskul 'di la brtson sa ma wā de yang dri zham sbos dud btang snang gsal sbar la mda' dar g.yab rol mo snyan pa'i sbra sbir zhing sgrub mchog mosagus dang ldan pas shā: yulanipad+ma brtsegs pa yi: chags bral pad+ma'i dal steng nas: 'gro ba'i mgon po snang mtha' yas: gsang ba ye shes yum dang bcas: ma g.yel ma 'khyang da tshur byon: mos pa bu la dbang bzhi bskur: skye 'chi med pa'i byin phob cig: yul niribo gru 'dzin nas: zhing khams dri ma bral ba'i klong thugs rje'i gter mdzod chen po nas: 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs: pad+ma gar dbang yum dang bcas: ma g.yel ma 'gyang da tshur byon: mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskur: byams dang snying rje'i byin phob cig: yul rgornga yab pad+ma 'od: zangs mdog dpal gyis ri bo nas: 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig pad+ma 'byung: dgyes bskyed me

gas tog man+ta ra:rje 'bangs lo paṇa tshom bu bcas:ma g.yel ma 'gyang da tshur byen:rmas pa' bu la dbang bzha bskur thugs rjes 'gro 'dul yul na dhe wa rka ṭa ya:dur khrod gsal byed nyi zla brtsegs:slob dpon ming ni 'jam dpal bṛ:drang sgong phur bu rdzu 'phrul thob:lha mo gser gyi thod gdengs can 'phags ma dbyangs can dpal lha mo:mkha' grub brtes pa'i ston 'khor bcas:ma g.yel ma 'gyang da tshur byon:mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskur:thams cad mkhyen pa'i byin phob cig yul ni dza lan dha ra nas:dur khrod 'og min mkha' la spyod:slob dpon ming ni sa man+ta:drang sgong rigs sngags 'chang ba bhi:lha mo dung gi gdu bu can 'phags ma lha mo gtsug dor rgyal:rdo rje'i rigs grub ston 'khor bcas:ma g.yel ma 'gyang da tshur phyon mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskur:'chi med tshe yi byin phob cig:yul gyi ming ni pul+le ra:dur khrod che ba'i dbang phyug 'bar slob dpon mi ni kun dga' grub dra sgong gser 'dab chu snying 'dzin lha mo rma bya'i thul ba can:'phags ma bsod nams mchog ster

grags: dbang phyug mthu thob ston 'khor bcas ma g.yel ma 'khyang da tshur byon mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskur dpal 'byor stobs kyi byin phob cig: yul gyi ming ni ka liṅga: dur khrod dbang byed chags bral rtse: slob dpon nā gar dzu shrī ya: drang sgong pad+ma spyod zhes grags: lha mo ku mud 'thor sdud byed: 'phags ma ku ru kuspe yum dbang sdud grub pa'i ston 'khor bcas: ma g.yel ma 'gyang da tshur byon mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskur: khams gsum dbang sdud byin phob cig yul ni o ḍi pā ma yā dur khrod rngam 'jigs ha he bzhad: slob dpon bde byed smra ra can drang srong sha mi rat+na'i gos: lha mo g.yu yi lan char can 'phags ma 'jigs byed chen mor grags: log rtog 'dul mdzad ston 'khor bcas: ma g.yel ma 'gyang da tshur pyon: mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskur: chos min 'dul ba'i byin phob cig: yul ni bde 'bar a rbu ra: dur khrod ku la ka sha na slob dpon bdud 'dul nag po spyod: drang sgong rdo rje'i go cha can lha mo lcags kyi thod gdeng can: 'phags ma gzhan gyis mi thub ma: pha rol rgol

can 'jams ston 'khar bcas: ma g.yil ma 'gyang da tshur byen rmas pa' bu la dbang bzha bskur: lta dman 'jams pa' byan phob tsag: yul ne ke sa laste shrī: dur khrod 'jigs byed ma ru rtse: slob dpon ma hā gdong drug la: drang sgong gser gyi phub 'dzin pa lha mo dar gyi 'phan yab 'chang: 'phags ma gzhan las rab rgyal ma phra min gdon 'dul ston 'khor bcas: ma g.yel ma 'gyang da tshur pyon mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskur: mu stegs 'dul ba'i byin phob cig yul ni ko dha chu lan skyes:dur khrod sa mi nan dho grags: slob dpon kun 'dul ro langs zhon: drang sgong mthu stobs gser gyi gos: lha mo shing lo'i thul ba can 'phags ma seng sdeng nags kyi sgrol:bsil ldan bde ba'i ston 'khor rnams: ma g.yel ma 'khyang da tshur phyon mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskur: 'gro 'dul phan bde'i byin phob cig:yul ni ra me shā ra ya: dur khrod shin tu 'bar ba'i tshal: slob dpon dī wa shā bzang po: drang sgong mun pa bsal byed dpalaX lha mo thod pa'i phreng ba can 'phags ma 'jig rten gsum rgyal ma: khams

gsum zil gnon ston 'khor bcas ma g.yel ma 'gyang da tshur byon mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskur: 'khor ba dbyings sgrol byin phob cig: yul ni lam pa ka yi ljongs:dur khrod gter gyi yang mdzod nas: slob dpon mi g.yo mgon po grags: drang srong bde ba 'od 'bar dang lha mo 'dod 'byung bum pa 'dzan: 'phags ma nor ster dngul rgyun 'babs: dbul sel dgos 'byung ston 'khor bcas: ma g.yel ma 'khyang da tshur byon: mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskur: 'dod pa kun 'byung byin phob cig: yul ni ma la wa brgyad grang: dur khrod kun dga' man+ta'i tshal slob dpon lhun po ltar 'phags dang drang srong chu yi snying po 'dzin lha mo pad+ma'i phreng ba can: 'phags ma bkra shis don byed ma: dge legs yon tan ston 'khor bcas: ma g.yel ma 'khyang da tshur byon: mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskur: bsam pa kun 'grub byin phob cig: yul ni ka ma gam khung la dur khrod mig ldan gzugs brnyan bkraX sgob dpon rngam byed gdon 'dul rgyal: drang sgong rdo rje'i go cha can: lha mo rtse gar bro la dgyes 'phags ma lha mo dgra

can dpung 'joms: log 'dren tshar gartsad ston 'khar bcas: ma g.yel ma 'khyang da tshur byen rmas pa'e bu la dbang bzhe bskur: bstan dgra tshar gcod byen phob cig: yul ni ka ma ru pa gaṇa: dur khrod rab 'bar rngam pa'i tshal: slob dpon rdo rje be con 'dzin: drang sgong mkha' ldeng gshog shugs ldan: lha mo khrus chab me tog 'dzin: 'phags pa khro gnyer can zhes grags: pha rol zil gnon ston 'khor bcas: ma g.yel ma 'gyang da tshur byon: mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskur: gdon 'joms stobs kyi byin phob cig: yul ni o ṭi ya zhes grags: dur khrod ha la durnye nas slob dpon rab khros rdo rje'i gdong: drang srong rten 'brel legs mdzad dang: lha mo rā ga'i thod gdengs can 'phags ma rab tu zhi mar grags: legs tshogs 'byung gnas ston 'khor bcas: ma g.yel ma 'gyang da tshur byon: mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskur: nyes pa kun 'joms byin phob cig: yul ni dri sha ku na'i zhing: dur khrod dzu la na shā ya: slob dpon khyung khyon me yi phreng: drang srong zil gnon nus stobs 'bar lha mo g.yu yi ga'u

can 'phags ma 'bar ba'e 'od can grags: 'bar ba chen po ston 'khor bcas: ma g.yel ma 'khyang da tshur byon mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskur: rab 'bar bde ba'i byin phob cig: yul ni sirnyi gna'i grong: dur khrod gar sham ya la sham: slob dpon rdo rje thog rgod rtsal: drang sgong 'byung khams dbang bsgyur ba: lha mo me tog mdangs 'dzin ma: 'phags ma dpag med gnon mdzad grags: zil gnon che ba'i ston 'khor bcas: ma g.yel ma 'khyang da tshur byon: mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskur: bdud 'dul dpal gyi byin phob cig: yul ni su war dhi pa: dur khrod ro myag puṣ+ṭa'i tshal: slob dpon bdud 'joms bzhad pa rtsal: drang srong gdon 'dul ro langs zhen: lha mo spod kyi bsil chab 'bebs 'phags ma rma bya chen modang: dug 'joms bde spyod ston 'khor bcas: ma g.yel ma 'gyang da tshur byon: mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskur: rdzu 'phrul gar gyi byin phob cig: yul ni na ga ra zhes grags dur khrod chos 'byung brtsegs pa nas: slob dpon tshangs rigs dmar ser dang: drang sgong mun sel mdog nag rngam lha

pa/ mo bkod pa mdzes ldan dpal: 'phags ma me pham rgyal mo dang: 'byar ldan smra mkhas ston 'khar bcas: ma g.yel ma 'gyang da tshur pyon rmas pa'e bu la dbang bzhi bskur yon tan mthu thob byin phob cig: yul ni pre ta pu ri'i zhings: dur khrod ro myag bde hal brtsegs: slob dpon ḍom bhi gam bha la: drang sgong sman byed thod rgyan can: lha mo gser gyi ral gri thogs: 'phags ma lha mo lo ma gyon myag 'dam tshar gcod ston 'khor bcas: ma g.yel ma 'khyang da tshur byon mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskur 'khor ba dbyings sgrol byin phob cig: yul na ṣ+ṭṛ ha dhe wa'i zhing: dur khrod brtsegs shing ra ba can: slob dpon 'jam dpal dregs 'dul dang drang srong pad+ma las skyes dpal: lha mo dril g.yer chun 'phyang can: 'phags ma 'od zer can mdzad dang: bstan dgra 'dul mdzad ston 'khor bcas ma g.yel ma 'khyang da tshur byon: mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskur: dgra bgegs kun 'joms byin phob cig yul ni gnyi ka yi grong dur khrod shang shang re bde tshal slob dpon chos kyi dbang phyug dang: drang sgong so

phreng nye zla brgyan lha mo sman gyi char chen 'bebs: 'phags ma myur dpal chen mo dang: bde stong 'od 'byed ston 'khor bcas: ma g.yel ma 'khyang da tshur byon: mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskur: nyams rtogs rtsal 'bar byin phob cig: yul ni ma ro brla ran+d+ra: dur khrod so shing thang chen dpal: slob dpon pad+ma ye shes snying: drang sgong mi shig gzhon nu dga' lha mo gser gyi lo bcud 'bebs: myur ma dbang ga 'khor lo dang: thams cad 'gugs byed ston 'khor bcas: ma g.yel ma 'khyang da tshur byon: mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskur mos bzhi dbang sdud byin phob cig yul ni ra me shwa ra ya: dur khrod shin tu dga' ba'i tshal: slob dpon rdo rje tshe mchog brtes: drang srong ye shis gzhon nu rgyal: lha mo gang ga chu la skyes 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dang: 'chi med tshe yi ston 'khor bcas ma g.yel ma 'khyang da tshur byon mos pa'i bu la dbang bzhi bskur: 'chi med tshe yi byin phob cig: yul ni g.yu lo can gyi zhing dur khrod pad+ma'i snying po can: sgob dpon mtsho skyes pad+ma rtsal: drang srong dri med pad dkar 'chang: lha mo

pas sna tshogs 'jo ma mardzas 'bar: 'phags ma nye shu rtsa gtsag dang: yang sprul bye ba sa ya 'bum: ma g.yil ma 'gyang da tshur byen: rmas pa' bu la dbang bzhe bskur rtogs pa spar ba'i byin phob cig: byin rlabs sprin dpung thibs se zib: dngos grub sbrang char nyi li li: 'chi med na bun thu lu lu: nyams rtogs yon tan ban ma bun:gnas 'dir byin phob bdag dbang bskur: lus la sku yi byin chen phob: ngag la gsung gi byin chen phob cig: yid la thugs kyi byin chen phob yon tan re skong byin chen phob: phrin las 'gro 'dul byin chen phob: snang grags lha sngags chos nyid kyi: rol pa chen por dag smin rdzogs: lha dang snang ba dbyer med 'dres g.yu lo can du 'ub chub 31ga: sgo artswa tā re sarba sa ma ya hrīng hrīng dza dza a we sha ya a ā ces brjod rol ma'i sgra dang ni mos gus gdu ba drag po yis chu la char zim ri bzhin du byin chen yang yang dbab par bya gnad kyis rtags mtshan khyad 'phags 'byung the tshom med do sa ma yā ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pa d+ma ngas thugs thig gdams zab rmad byung ba 'drog rmi lo tsā khyod la sbyin mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rdzo nga ༷ gab ma 'ongs snyags ma lnga yi dus nga

sprul nusaldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas dpa' bo dpa' mor spel 'gro don bsam gyisami khyab 'byung gdul bya 'bum phrag smin grol byed the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi cesapa 'di'ang nang bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin gyis bskul ba dang phyi nye gnas ye shes zhes bya ba'i kyang sgrub pa'i kha bskang du 'di 'dra zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra nu ldan rdo rjes dpal ldan brag lha mgon po'i gnasamadun nas dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel sarba ma lam/
sku zab gsang mkha' 'angos gas thig las:je btsun 'phags ma nyer gartsig la brten pami las gzhung zab donasnying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

gas na mo artswa tā re shrī sarba ti ho thebabyu 41rta— dusagasum rgyal bkun gyi yum snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig ma rje btsun sgrol ma nyer gcig la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo sa ma yu bdag 'dra pad+ma mibha pa'i ma 'o sa 'gro la brtse sems kyis snyigs ma'i gdul dka' 'dul ba'i phyir phrin las zab don snying po bstan sa ma yā de yang sbyor dngos rjes dang gsum dang po las ram bcu yi bstan da la phya nang gsang mchod sogs mdzes shing yid du 'ong bar bya sgrub pa'i dam rgya sdom pa dang dben pa'i gnas su bag yangs bya dad pa tang 'dzin dam tshig dag 'gro don mngon zhugs theg chen lam yang dag don dang ldan pa yis dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni na mo dus gsum rgyal ba 'dus pa'i sku: 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs gcig pu rje btsun 'phags ma tā re la: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi lan gsum gnyis pa sems bskyed bsgom pa ni ho mtha' med 'khor ba'i btson khang du: dbang med sdug bsngal spyod pa'i 'gro bde mchog lam la 'god pa'i phyir:byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa na na mo: rje btsun 'phags ma sgol ma dang phyog bcu'i skyabs gnas thams cad la: gus pa'i yid kyis phyag

can 'tshal lo snang sred kun bzang mtshod pa 'bul mi dge sdeg sdeg mthol lo bshags: 'gro ba'e dge la rjes ye rang: theg pa rgya mtsho'e ches 'khar bskor:mya ngan mi 'da' brtan par bzhugs: dge tshogs 'khor gsum dag par bsngo phyam gcig kun bzang sa thob shog: lan gsum bzhi pa maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba na t+t+waṃ rin chen mjes pa'i maṇ+ḍal ni: 'dod yon phyi nang gsang mchod sprin: ngo mtshar rmad byung bkod pa rdzogs: rje btsun 'phags ma'i lha la 'bul: 'gro kun tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang: don 'grub sku gnyis mngon gyur shog tre gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal pu tsi te a ྅: lnga pa bgegs tshogs bskrad pa na hrī gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba'i rgyus bskyed pa'i: ma rig log rtog 'khrul ba'i gdon rang grol glud gtor 'di khyer la: spros bral dbu ma'i dbyings su phaṭa: hū bzhi' sngags brjod thun gyis brab drug pa bsrung ba'i 'bar lo ni hūṃ hrī snang srid thams cad dag pa'i zhing: sgod bcud dkyil 'khor gsum gyi ngang: bar chad 'khrul ba'i gdon las grol: 'pho 'gyur bral ba'i bsrung 'khor sgom: slo badz+ra rto na rak+ṣa rak+ta hūṃ: bdun pa byin pho 'bebs pa ni

hūṃ sdi rang snang mi shig dag pa'i zhing: bde chen g.yu lo bkod pa nas: rgyal yum 'phags ma gtso 'khor bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byen phob cig: o artswa tā re sarba sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza a we sha ya a ā brgyad pa mchod rdzas byin rlabasani o.ā sa: dngos por 'dzin pa'i chos rnams kun: dag mnyam ye shes rol pa'i gter: rmad byung kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin: dpag yas nam mkha'i khams gang gyuraḥ ma ma hā puñca pu tsa ho dgu pa dam 4'a bzung ba ni ā: rang rig 'gags med gnyug ma'i zhal: gdod nas dkyil 'khor gsum gyis ngang: ma bcos ye grol mkha' 'gro'i dal: srog gi phyir yang mi gtong sgrub: o badz+ra sa ma ya bi shudhe u ba pa bshags pa bya ba ni ho rgyal yum 'phags ma'i lha tshogs dgongs: bdag ni ma rig dbang gyur te: rtsa ba yan lag dam nyams pa gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems kyis bshags o badz+ra sa ma ya bi shuste sa sngon 'gro'i las rimazhwagargya skal med lag tu ma shor cig sa ma shā rgya rgya rgya gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i las rim la rnam pa bcu yi yongs su bstan dang po lha bskyed rang gzhung ltar gnyis pa spyan 'dren bya ba ni hūṃ hrī 'og

gan min gnas dang bde chen zhing po ṭa la dang g.yu lo bkod: dag pa'e zheng khams thams cad nas: rgyal yum 'phags ma gartsa 'khor bcas: gnas 'der spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: snyen artswa tā re sarba sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma yā dza dza: gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba na hrī gdod nas rnam dag lhun grub zhing: gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor du: dbyings nas spyan drangs ye shes pa: dam ye ro gcig brtan par bzhugs: cha artswa tā re dz+nyā na sa ma tiṣ+ṭha lhan: bzhi pa phyag 'tshal bya ba ni na moḥ ka dag skye ba med pa'i klong: lhun grub mtshan dpe rdzogs pa'i gar: rgyal yum 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor la: dad pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: ma ār+ya tā re bṛ na mo na ma ho: lnga pa phyi mchod 'bul ba ni trī: rje btsun 'phags ma'i lha tshogs la: dgyes bskang mchod sprin spro ba ni: mdzes pa'i me tog dbu la 'bul dri zhim bdug spos shangs la 'bul gsal byed mar me spyan la 'bul: bde ba'i dri chab sku la 'bul: ro ldan zhal zas ljags la 'bul: grags stong rol mo snyan la 'bul: dgyes bzhes tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa ṭ+wā :

mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: o badz+ra a pakyi sogs shabha pu tsa ho: drug pa nang mchod 'bul ba ni trī: rje btsun 'phagasama'i lha tshogs rnams: dgyes bskyed mchod pa 'bul ba ni: gzugs snang rnam dag ā dar+sha: sgra grags rang grol haṃ bu ra: dri snang 'gags med bdug pa spos: ro 'dzin dbyings grol ra sa ya: lus sems bde bskyed pañca li: mkha' dbyings 'gyur med rnam dag e: ma lus lha mo'i gar bsgyur bcas: rje btsun 'phags ma'i lha la 'bul: dgyes bzhes tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol oṃ badz+ra du sogs dharma dhartu sarba pu tsa ho: bdun pa gsang mchod 'bul ba na hrī: rmad byung ye shes rol pa lasaḥ shar ba'i dgyes bskyed mchod pa niḥgasang ba'i rig ma rnam pa lngas rmad byung mchod pa'i sprin dpung thogs: rdo rje'i glu dang gar bsgyur bcas: rje btsun 'phags ma'i lha la 'bul dgyes bzhes tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: 4 badz+ra wā sgyu mā le girti nirti rkarma mu tra sarba pu tsa ho: brgyad pa sman raka gtor mchod ni trī: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar a dṛ ta:

mo/ chags pa bsgral ba'i rak+ta dang: ro brgyad nus ldan ba leng ta: 'dad don lha rma'i bro gar bcas: rje btsun 'phags ma'e lha la 'bul: dargyas bzhes tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsolaḥ o ma hā sarba pañca rak+ta ba ling ta kha kha ram khā hi: dgu pa bstod dbyangs bya ba ni trī: ka dag skye ba med pa las lhun grub mtshan dang dpe rdzogs gar: thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dul mdzad pa'i: 'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal bstod ma rig dri bral shel bzhin dkar: byams dang snying rje'i grub char 'bebs: phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas dpal: rje btsun sgrol mar phyag 'tshal bstod gang zhig las nyon dug lngas gzir chags sdang ngang gnas bdag sogs 'gro:brtse ba chen pos skyobs pa'i phyir: che ge ma la phyag 'tshal bstod bstod 'os 'phags ma'i lha tshogs la: zhing rdul grangs dang mnyam pa yi: lus btud gus pas gsol gdab bcas: brtse ba'i ma ma khyod la 'dud: btu pa thams cad bskul ba ni hrī ye shes gsang ba'i klong mdzod las: rgyal yum 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig ma: rje btsun tā re gtso

'khor bcas dbyengs las gzugs kye phyag rgyar bzhengs: phaṭaḥkyi spros pas stong khams gang: 'gro drug 'khor ba'i gnas stong zheng: nad mug mtshon 'khrug rgud pa bsal:bsdus pas dran rdzogs snying por bstim: 'khor 'das dkyil 'khor gsum gyi ngang: ma gsal bar du bskyed cing sgom: ma 'grub bar du mi gtong ngo: bzlos sngags 'dzab dmigs rang dgo ltar bsnyen sgrub las sbyor dmigs pas phye gsal ba ting 'dzin rdo ldan pa sa 'bru 'bum lnga 'bum sum 'bum sogs grangs bsnyen bzlas pa tshad 'khyol na rtag dang mtshan ma phun sum tshogs 'grub pa'i ltasabazang mngon du gyur bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal dkon mod rgyal khams 'grams da mthong the tshom med do sa ma yu dngos gzhi'i las rim3 /rgya skal med lag tu ma shor cig sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gsum pa rje kyi las ramasnyirgya rnam pa bco lnga'i sgo nas bstan dang po bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs 'dod yon ci 'byor ma lus bsags spos dang snang gsal rgya chen sbar byan gyis brlabs pa 'i rim pa ni a rang byung dum gcig bhasnyo nas 'dod yon bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs: sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rol ba nas 'bru gsum nus pas sbyangs spel bsgyur: o ā shā: lan gsum gnyis pa spyan 'dren bya ba ni hūṃ

can sdi: rnam dag rang byung bkod pa'i zhing: g.yu lo can gye pho brang nas: rgyal yum 'phags pa gtso 'khor bcas: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: o abyu tā re sarba sa ma ya dza dza: gsum pa tshogs phud 'bul ba na oṃ u( tshogs rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: myong grol ye shes bcud chen po rmad byung ga ṇa tsakra'i gter: 'phags ma 'khor bcas dgyes phyir 'bul: o ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pu tsa la khā hi: bzhi pa bshags pa bya ba ni hoḥ dpang gyur rje btsun 'phags ma ni: gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs dgongs su gsol: bdag ni ma rig dbang gyur te: rtsa ba yan lag dam nyams pa: mi 'chab mi zed 'gyod pas bshags: dag cing tshangs par mdzad du gsol ma badz+ra sa ma ya bhi shud+dhi zhwa lnga pa bsgral las bya ba ni hūṃ ma g.yel dam tshig las la dgongs: brnag pa'i bstan bshig bdud sde rnams: dmigs pa'i rten la bstem pa de: she rab mtshon chas bsgral bar bya o sarba du tra pra we sha ya phaṭa: drug pa bstab pa' rim pa na /: phyes shig phyes shig zhal phyes shig: thugs nyid zhi ba'i ngang nyid las: ma rung 'dul phyir khros pa'i zhalaX

rab 'jigs e yi klong du bstabs o sarba du tra dz+wa la ram khā sa:bdun pa bskang ba'i ram pa ni hūṃ trī:ka dag dbyings su mngon sangs rgyas:chos sku yum chen thugs dam bskangs lhun grub 'gags med mtshan rdzogs dpal:longs sku 'phags ma'i thugs dam bskangs rtsol med 'gro 'dul mkhyen brtse'i bdag:rje btsun sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskangs 'pho med don gyi rdo rje che: badz+ra ḍak+ki'i dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas:rin chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs:ma chags dri ma bral ba'i dbyings pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs:brin las ma lus lhun grub dpal:karma mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs ma chags dri ma kun bral ba'i sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskangs:'jigs pa brgyad skyobs 'gro ba 'dul myur ma dpa' mo'i thugs dam bskang:yangan gang sku ston kha'i zla zhal mdangs dbyangs can lha mo'i thugs dam bskangs:yang na dgos 'dod char 'bebs gser gyi mdog:bsod nams mchog ster thugs dam bskangs:rgyal ba'i gtsug tor las byung zhing:tshe dbang

gas rnam rgyal thugs dam bskangs pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs 'dzin pa'i: dbang sdud dmar mo'i thugs dam bskangs:gdon dang bgegs tshogs dran pas 'joms 'jigs byed lha mo'i thugs dam bskangs:khams gsum rbod gtong g.yul las rgyal: gzhan gyis mi thub thugs dam bskangs:srid pa'i gdon tshogs ming med brlag:gzhan las rab rgyal thugs dam bskangs:'gro la thugs rje bsil chen 'bebs: nags kyi lha mo'i thugs dam bskangs:'byung po ro langs dam sri 'dul: 'jig rten gsum rgyal thugs dam bskangs dgos 'dod longs spyod char rgyun 'bebs:nor ster lha mo'i thugs dam bskangs:phan bde'i 'bras bu rab rgyas ba'i bkra shis don byed thugs dam bskangs mtha' mi kla klo skad cig rlog: dgra dpung 'joms ma'i thugs dam bskangs:ma rung bdud la khro tshul ston:khro gnyer can gyi thugs dam bskangs 'jigs tshogs ma lus dag par byed: rab tu zhi ma'i thugs dam bskangs log rtog sbur ma me bzhin bsregs: 'bar ba'i 'od can thugs dam bskangs srid gsum

'khor ba'i sgo 'phar gnon: dpag med gnon ma'i thugs dam bskangs 'byung ba'i dug dang la yog bzlog rma bya chen mo'i thugs dam bskangs: rgyal ba kun gyi dgyes bskyed dpal: mi pham rgyal mo'i thugs dam bskangs nad mam rim gdon zhi mdzad dpal ri khrod lha mo'i thugs dam bskangs dgra yidapung tshogs 'joms mdzad dpal:'od zer can ma'i thugs dam bskangs smon lam dam bca' mthu btsan pa'i: 'phags ma 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs: phyimachod dngos 'dzin dag pas bskangs: nang mchod nyon mongs dag pas bskangs: gsang mchod rlung sems dag pas bskangs rmad byung ga ṇa tsakras bskangs bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol skabs 'dir tshogs bsdus spyi ltar gtong brgyad pa lhag ma 'bul ba ni phertsi lhag la dbang ba'i pho nya ni: bka' nyan ma sring king lang rnams: 'dir byon lhag ma'i mchod pa bzhes: rnal 'byor phrin las rabs 'byams sgrubs phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad bzlog: dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: sa ma ma hrīng hrīng ba lidha kha kha khā hi khā hi dgu pa bskul ba' rim pa ni hūṃ hrī ngo bo gdod

can nasasangs rgyas kyang: thugs rje chags pa'e rnam rol gyes gdul dka' 'dul ba'i dpal du bzhengs me mthun dus kye rgud pa sol: phyogs las rnams rgyal snang ba stsol: bka' dam ma g.yel sa ma yā: ces brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar gshegs bcu pa chad mdo gtong ba ni sto: sngon tshe bar dngatha ma la spyi dpal pad 'byung rig 'dzin gyis: spyan sngar khas bla dam bcas pa'i: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu dang: phyi nang gsang ba'i bstan srung rnams 'dir byon dmar gyi gtor ma bzhes sdang ba'i dgra la cho 'phrul ston gnod pa'i bgegs la drag las mdzod: bka' 'di'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyongs: sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mchis pa dang: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las stsol:ma g.yel ma 'khyangs dam tshig can bcu gnyig bstan ma skyongs ba ni sbyoḥ dpal gnas ma dngayang dag shes: kod btsun de mo g.yu bun skyongs lha mo gzi 'bar gzugs legs ma bde skyong bstan ma gtso 'khor bcas: ma thogs gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: 'dod yon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: sgrub pa'i rkyen bzlog bsam pa sgrubs rnal

'byor 'dod pa'i don rnams spel: ma g.yel ma 'khyangs dam tshig can: o la laḥ le le: rta rta: te teḥ kha rakla ma ma sring 'gro ma e dam bha ling ta kha kha khā twe khā hi r+sā gnyis rta dro bya ba ni nyu: rang bzhin 'bar ba e yi klong0 gru gsum gshin rje'i lto ba phu grub po las ngan dam sri'i tshogs: nam yang ldang bar ma byed cig: yo sanyu swā hā s+t+waṃ bha ya nan nan bcu gsum dngos grub len pa ni shā hrī: gdod nas ma bcosaspros mtha' bralaḥ ka dag zang thal chos kyi dbyings: lhun grub bde ba chen po nas: 'phags ma 'khor bcas thugs rgyud bskulaX bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i dam tshig them rdo rje srin po'i nam yang langs: dngos grub stsol len dus la bab: mchog thun sidhi pha la (༷ rtsa sngags mthar kā ya wākatsit+ta sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ āX brgya gzhi bsngo ba smon lam ni ho: dus gsum kun tu bsags pa yi: zag dang zag med dge rtsa kun: ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la bsngo: phyam gcig kun bzang sa thob shog lan gsum bco lnga bsdu ldang shis brjod na ā snang cha thabs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams: shes rab stong pa'i dbyings su u slar yang sgyu ma lta bu yis: spyod

can lam rgyun gye rnal 'byar bya'o: a ā0 phaṭa phaṭaḥ na me sgron grol dbang dang byen rlabs mdzad: reg 'dzan bla ma'i bkra shes shog: mtshog thun dngos grub 'byung ba'i gzhi: yi dam lha tshogs bkra shis shog: bar chad sel zhing phrin las sgrub: rje btsun 'phags ma'i bkra shis shog: sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen yid bzhin stsol dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis re ga yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde spel ba'i: zab gsang mchog gi bkra shis shog de ltar shas brjod mtha' rgyas bya bsngo ba smon lam 'ga' ston spel gnad des tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang don 'grub sku gnyisamangon du 'gyur the tshom med do sa ma yā bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal rjes kya ram pa3nargya skal med lag tu ma shor cig sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang popad+ma ngas ma 'ongasa'agro la brtse sems kyis snying dang 'dra ba'i mag ngag bcud grub dbang khye'u dbang khyod la gtad da lta spel ba'i dus ma yin mdo khams phyogs su dgongs pra thob ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga brgya'i dus rtsub 'gyur dus kyi gzug slong rdol mi 'tshams sna dgu'i sbyor ba 'tshubs mkha' la nad spran dmar nag g.yo mtshon cha sa rdo'i char rgyun 'bebs skye bo' chas gos bsgyur ba dang bud med sdag la rngam sems che sngags pa'i dug

lnga rang khar spyod btsun pa gri ri shi ba dang btsun ma lusargyas nal gsod dang dge 'dun rdo rje'i nang 'khrug byed phu nu dme 'thab nye ba rtsod mtha' mi dbus su phyur ba yi mi ru bkra mi shesapa'i ltas mtshan ma ngan pa 'byung ba'i tshe rgud gso nga sprul rig 'dzin mchog nu ldan rdo rje zhes bya 'byung skyes bu de dang 'phrad gyur cig las ldan chos bdag dpa' bo bdun dpa 'a mo gsum la dar rgyas spel gdul bya 'bum phrag grol bar byed 'gro don lho dang byang nas 'byung skal med lag tu ma shor cag thub par srung shig klu bdud btsan sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya lha ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag po lung zan dpa' bopad+ma chosa'aphel rgya mtsho dang chosabadag dpa' mo rat+na sa ra dang dad ldan slob bu chos rgyal gyis bri gzhe shog sdeb stong dang bcas nas yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bonusaldan rdo rjesamakha' 'gro gsang ba' brda ris las zhal bshubashate dag par phab pa dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ legs so/ sarba masko lam/

gas zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: gter gyi srung ma sgrub pa'i las rim phren las lhun grub zhes bya ba bzhugs so:ga sa na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye snyen midza ri(16 bdag 'dra pad+ma saṃ bha las bstan srung sbu gri mched gsum gya gsang sgrub phrin las lhun grub bstan zab gsang bsrung phyir nyams su longs sa ma shāḥ de nas bharnya yangs pa ru bdud bgos nag po snying gis brgyan btsan gtor dmar gcus sha yis mdzes klu bgos khra bo pad+ma'i mtshan rang 'dra gtor chung brgyad res bskor rnam lnga nyer spyod yo byad bkram rang nyid 'phags ma'i nga ma gyis o swā bha wa sogs nya: rang mdun dug rlangs nad sprin sngo dmar klong: du las bdud 'dul yak+ka ru ma ṇa: sngo nag khram shing bdud zhags mkha' la gdengs: zhe sdang stag gi pags pa'i thul ba gsol: myur 'gyogs rlung gshegag nag po chibs su bcibs: mgo phreng sbrul do sna tshogs rgyan cha mdzes dmar ser ral pa gyen brdzes rdo rjes brgyan: rang 'dra bdud 'khor mched bgyed skar ltar bkra: g.yas phyogs me dang glog zhags 'khrigs pa'i dbus: phulas btsan dmar me yi phreng

dmar po rlung gi shugasa'achang zhen: las byed 'bar ba mched brgyad 'khor gyis bskor: g.yon ngos 'ja' sprin khu sbrang 'bebs pa'i dbus: nālas klu rgyal nor ster dzam bha la: sku mdog ljang sngon nor bu sbrul zhags bsnams dar gyi la thod radzi rgyan cha mdzes: lwa'u dkar gsal nor bu'i do shal 'phyangs: chu rta sngo nag spu ris g.yas 'khyil bcibs: sprul pa klu chen rang 'dra brgyad kyis bskor sangs rgyas bstan la mos shing sgrub pa por brtse gdung chags pa'i rnam 'gyur ldan par bskyed rang srog rnams las 'od 'phros gar bzhugs kyi gnas nas spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstims: denas spyan 'dren bya ba ni hūṃ sbyo:pho brang mkha' spyod tsa ra'i gzhal yas nas bdud 'dul yak+ka ru na gshegs su gsol: brag dmar tsit+ta gnam 'phyong 'bar ba'i gnas: btsan rgyal me yi phreng ba gshegs su gsol: dbang chen rgya mtsho'i 'o dkar 'byil ba nas: klu

gas rgyal nor ster dzam lha gshegs su gsol: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung mdzad pa'e: mched 'khor sum brgya sum cu gshegs su gso/la: zab gsang bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba'i phyir dpon g.yog 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol:a du:ru na: sarba sa ma ya dza dza: de nas bams gsol ni hūṃ hūṃ gtor tshogs mchod rdzas dag la bzhugs su gsol bla rdo sgog 'khor rten la bzhugs su gsol: g.yab dar gsang ba'i rdzas la bzhugs su gsol: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhugs su gsol: 37 du:rnga na sarba sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas phyag 'tshal ni na mo sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung mdzad pa'i: dug gsum rtsad gcod klu bdud btsan gsum la:lha phyag 'tshal lo brtse bas rgyang ma ring: slo du:phun: sarba a ti pu ho: pra ti dza ho: denas dam bsgrag ni hūṃ bh+yo sngon tshe kun bzang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: dpal gyi bsam yas lhun grub pho brang dbus zab gsang thugs thig bstan pa gtad pa'i tshe rgyal bstan rin chen g.yel med bsrung ba dang: dgra bgegs dam sri ming

med rdul brlag ceng rnal 'byor lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs pa dang: phyi nang sri bdud g.yul ngo bzlog pa sogs: gang 'dod phrin las gnyan po sgrub pa yi: dam tshig gnyer gtad zab mo 'di min nam: g.yel na mthu ldan khyed rnams nyams par 'gyur: dam las ma 'da' badz+ra sa ma yā: badz+ra rakru si hūṃ na ra gaṇa de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni hūṃ hrī dgyes bskyed mchod pa'i dam rdzas rmad byung ba: bya nag rta nag khyi nag g.yag nag lug: sha khrag bsgos nag 'bar ba'i dam rdzas dang: nyer spyod 'dod don sman gtor rak+ta yis: bdud 'dul yaka nag po 'khor bcas mchod: bya dmar rta dmar khyi dmar ra lug dmar dmar gtor sha khrag tsit+ta'i rgyan can dang nam mkha' mda' mdung ral gri go khrab kyis btsan rgyal me phreng 'khor bcas gsol zhing mchod bya sngon rta sngon khyi sngon g.yag lug sngo: klu sman bzang drug nya sbrul sbal gcong dang dum zas dum nor shel tshig 'dod yon gyi klu rgyal dzam lha 'khor bcas gsol lo mchod: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dgyes pa bskangs: rnal 'byor phyi nang nyer 'che'i rigs rnams

sa/ bzlog: tshe dpal 'byor ba nyams rtogs yon tan bskyed: o du:ru nā sarba sa pa re wā ra ma hā arnya shabha ru pa dharma ma hā pañca rak+ta bā sweng kha hūṃX dam nyams pa'i dgra gdon bgegs tshogs che 'dre chung sri pho mo sogs chos srid nor la bar du gcod pa'i 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa'i tshogs rnams mngon spyod drag po'i las kyis tshar chod la gnod byed de dag rnams kyi me sa rak+ta tsit+ta ko ro tsa na king ni ri ti ba su ta la kha ram khā 'i: denas bstod pa ni hūṃ bh+yo bskal ba'i dug rlung 'tshubs ma'i klong dkyil nas smon lam stobs kyis sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung: zhing bcu'i dgra sod bgegs 'dul khro bo'i rgyal: bdud 'dul yak+ka nag por phyag 'tshal bstod: tsha bsregs 'bar ba me yi klong dkyil nas: pad+ma'i tha tshig la gnas dregs pa'i gtso: myur mgyog drag rtsal rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab btsan rgyal me phreng 'khor dang bcas la bstod bdud rtsi'i 'o mcho 'khyil ba'i klong dkyil nas: rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i grogs byed bstan pa srung: zas nor longs spyod 'dod rgu'i gru char 'bebs: klu rgyal ram̐ lha

'khor dang bcas la bstod: bdag dang bdag gi nye 'khor rtsa lag dang: chos srid bsrung la bsam pa'i don rnams sgrubs: bstan pa'i dgra sde thal bar brlag pa dang: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yu: de nas 'dzab bzlas ni bdag yi dam gyithugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros dregs can sde gsum la phog: sngon gyi bka' tha tshig dran nas rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i phrin las rabs 'byams thogs med du bsgrub par bsam la: ma du ru nā sarba sa ma ya trīng trīng phe dza: 'bod rtags ma byung bar du bzla de nas bod sngags ni snyes du ru nā:sarba sa ma ya dgra la rbad: rtags mtshan ma byung bar du bzla de nas bsad sngags ni snyen du:dza nā: sarba sa ma ya dgra bgegs gnod byed nyung thum chadad bdun phrag re bsgrub rtags mtshan gsal the tshom med do sa ma yu de nas gsol mchod bya ba na sha khrag ja chang skyems phud bshams bsang sa sbyang byin gyis brlabs nas slar rol mo'i sgra bcas 'di skad do hūṃ bh+yo pho brang mkha' spyod tsa ri nas: bdud 'dul nag po gshegs su gsol: pha 'ong long bu'i sku mkhar nas: btsan dmar me phreng gshegs su gsol: dngas gsal 'o

can mtsho rol ba nas: klu yi rgyal po gshegs su gsol bla rdo srog 'khor rten la bzhugs: khyed rnams dgyes pa'e dam rdzas rna: nyer spyod bdun dang 'dod yon lnga sman gtor rak+ta ga ṇa tshogs bza' bca' btung ba ldag gzhib zas: gos dar ras phrug snam ther dang: ri dwags g.yung dwags chu gnas bya: gcan gzan sna tshogs go khrab mtshon: ja chang skyems phud bdud rtsi'i mamo 'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod chen pos bdud 'dul nag po gsol zhing mchod: gtum po mched brgyad gsol zhing mchod:btsan dmar me phreng gsol zhing mchod: las btsan mched brgyad gsol zhing mchod: klu rgyal dzam lha gsol zhing mchod: nor ster mched brgyad gsol zhing mchod: 'khor dang bcas pa gsol zhing mchod gsol zhing mchod pa'i byin rlabs kyis: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bskangs: nyams chags 'gal 'khrul nongs pa bshags: bzod gsol tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: rnal 'byor dben khrod 'grims pa'i pa'i tshe: 'tsho ba sbyor la 'khor slob bsdus: 'gro ba'i rlung sems snang ba bsgyur: bdag gi dbang

gyur chos la gzud: phyir mi sdog pa'i sa la sbyor: bar chad dgra 'dre gdon gsum bzlog: nad mug mtshon chas gzeng pa thul: rdzogs ldan lang tsho mdzes pa yis: 'dzam gling khyab pa'i phrin las mdzod bka' dang dam tshig gnyan po srungs: ma g.yel ma 'byu1ngas sa ma yā: ces pa ci nus grangs bsogs shing gtor skyems gtsang par mchod pa na phrin las gegs med yid bzhin 'grub the tshom med do sam yā ye ma rgyaladabang pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis snying dang 'dra ba'i man ngag mchog rin chen brda yi ris su btab grub dbang khye'u chung khyod la gtad da dung spel ba'i dus ma yin ma 'ongs snyigasam lnga yi dus nad mug mtshon chas gzengs langs tshe sprul nga dang dbyer med pas nu ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan pa'i ba dan phyogs su bsgrengs chosabadag dpa' bo bdun dang ni dpa' mo gsum gyi skal bar bsngags rang skal nyams su blang bas dge ral na mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'byung de phyar snying las gces par zungs skal med lag tu ma shor cig snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu h+ya brda thim snyi ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtshos dar bcas bskul ba dang chos la dbang ba'i ratā sa ra chos bdag rang rig slob

sa bu ye shes dad ldan chos gsal rnams kyis yang yang bskul ngor/ bdag 'dra dpa' bodus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshugate 'brosaphug mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling nas dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel sarba ma lam/can gter srung gsol 'asdus gra sa bsogs na phud gams bā ling rgya go spungs hūṃ snro: dad dang dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyis 'bod do las mdzad klu bdud btsan gsum po 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul bstan dgra drung 'byin zab gsang phyogs bcur spel chos mthun bsam pa 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: ces brjod grangs ldan bskyar byas te: gtor skyems gtsang sar mchod gyur na: rnam bzhi'i phrin las gegs med 'grub the tshom med do sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya ces kyang chosabadag dharmās bskul ngor nus ldan pas bris pa dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga lam/

gas zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: bshags pa sgrib bral shel gyi me long bzhugs so:ga na mo gu ru padh+wa ka ra ye rko sha mirterje 'jags pa brgyad skyobs 'gro ba 'dul dus 'khrug mtshon cha' gzengs ba gzhom rdzogs ldan lang tsho dar mdzad dpal 'phags ma yum la gus phyag 'tshal bdag 'dra pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis dam tshag nyam chags sbyang ba'i phyir bshags pa shel gya me lo bstan sa ma yu dad dang mos gus drag po yis mdun mkhar rgyal ba gras bcas gsal dmigs pa gzhan du ma yengs par phyag 'tshal bya ba'i ram pa na e ma ho: phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i skyabs gnas ma lus pa: mkhyen brtse nus stobs gzi 'od ldan pa yis:mdun mkhar pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol: nyams chags nyes lhung sbyangs phyir phyag mchod bzhes: mnyam med bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: ka dag chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo lhun grub longs spyod rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i klong la phyag 'tshal lo: mngon par byang chub

sku la phyag 'tshal lo zhe ba bzhe bcu gnyes la phyag 'tshal lo: khrag 'thung lnga bcu brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: sgrub sde dgu yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo: de ltar rgyal ba zhi khro rabs 'byams lha: gang gi mtshan thos gus pas phyag 'tshal na dam tshig nyams chags ma lus kun byang nas: mi dge mtshams med lnga yi sdig kyang dag: na raka dmyal ba'i gnas kyang dong sprugs te: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du rnam par grags las kyi rnam par smin pa'i skyon byung nas: ngag tu mthol la yid kyis bshags par bya: smre sngags bton la gdung ba drag pos sbyangs mos pas thal mo snying gar sbyar nas su: dad pas brkyang phyag bsdab te btsal bar bya: zhi khro lha tshogs mtshan nas brjod par bya: rjes su las lnga tshigs bcas bag phab ste: bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' spyi bor sgoms na rag dong sprugs yang snying bzla bar bya: sa badz+ra sa twa sa ma yā:sogs sa 'a da nyid dus gcig ma yengs par sems dpa' la dmigs brgya rtsa brgyad bzlasan rdo rje sems dpa' dang dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras su 'gyur ho rgyal ba zhi 〈sna rabs 'byams dgongs su gsol bde bar gshegs pa'i bka'

ben dang bla ma'i lung: ji bzhin ma sbyad 'gal 'khrul nongs dbang gis:bka' drin mnyam med rdo rje'i bla ma la:gshe zheng bskur ba btab dang lta ba log:gsang ba'i gzung ma mched dang lcam dral la:ngan sems 'chang zhing chags sdang tshig rtsub smras:brdeg btsog gnod pa'i bya ba dngos su bskyal rtsa ba'i sngags dang rkyen sngags las sngags g.yel:dam tshig ye shes las kyi phyag rgya dang:phyag rgya chen po ral ba la sogs pas:sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags:yi dam lha yi phyag rgya ma gsal zhing:sngags kyi bsnyen pa grang las 'das pa dang:bsnyen sgrub bskang ba bka' ltar ma bgyis pas:gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol bla ma man ngag thugs kyi bcud zab gnang gsang mtshams ral nas g.yel zhing stor ba dang:gsang bcu gnyer gtad dam bca' bsdams na yang kun la bsgrags shing dam rdzas bstan pa sogs:thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol shes bya'i dam chig rigs lngar ma shes logaX mi spang dam tshig ma rig dug lnga gol dang blang dam tshig gtsang smer bltas te spyad:

bsgrub bya'i dam tshog rang gnas ma shes 'khrul:spyad byalidam tshog dbye gsal ma byas rmongs: yan lag dam tshig nyams pa mthol bsgrub cing bsnyen pa'i ting 'dzin g.yel ba dang nya stong dus drug tshogs mchod chag pa dang: le lo rnam g.yeng gnyid rmugs dbang gyur rmongs: bsog 'jog ser snas mchod sbyin rgyu rkyen chung: tshogs kyi spyang ku kha tshar shor ba dang: phud lhag nyams shing bag med spyod pa rtsing: tshor dang ma tshor nyam chags nyes pa'i skyon: mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i spyan sngar bshags: yid kyi dam nyams lta ba'i klong du bshags: deyang kun gni byang chub sems kyi gshis: yin pa med pa'i lta ba mkha' ltar dag: min pa med pa'i sgom pa mnyam nyid dang yin min med pa'i spyod pa kun bzang rtogs: re dogs med pa byang chub sems kyi klong: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig thams cad kyis chag nyams ral sogs ma byung ma skyes te bshags bya bshags byed gnyis su med par grol de nas lta ba'i klong bshags ni lo1 chos kyidabyeras nyid spros pa med pa la: yod med gnyis su lta ba thang re chad: dngos po mtshan mar

pa/ 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: spros med bde chen klong du bshags par bgye: kun tu bzang po bzang ngan med pa la: gtsang dang dme bar lta ba thang re chad bzang ngan gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: kun bzang bde chen klong du bshags par bgyi: mnyam pa nyid la che chung med pa la: bdag dang gzhan du lta ba thang re chad: che chung gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs mnyam nyid bde chen klong du bshags par bgyi: byang chub sems la skye shi med pa la: 'di dang phyi mar lta ba thang re chad: skye shi gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: 'chi med g.yang drung klong du bshags par bgyi: thig le chen po grwa zur med pa la: gzugs dang rdzas su lta ba thang re chad: grwa zur dbyibs su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs: kun zlum thig le'i klong du bshags par bgyi: dus gsum 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang nyid la: thog ma tha mar lta ba thang re chad: 'pho 'gyur gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs dus gsum 'gyur med klong du bshags par bgyi: rang byung ye shes rtsol sgrub bral ba la: rgyu 'bras gnyis su lta ba thang re chad: rtsol sgrub gnyis su 'dzin pa

nyon re mongs: rang byung rtsol med klong du bshags par bgye reg pa ye shes rtag chad bral ba la: gzung 'dzin gnyis su lta ba thang re chad: rtag chad gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs rig pa ye shes klong du bshags par bgyi: chos nyid rnam dag spros pa med pa la: zug rngu gnyis su lta ba thang re chad: mtha' dbus gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs chos nyid rnam dag sang du bshags par bgyi: gzhal yas khang la yongs dog med pa la phyi dang nang du lta ba thang re chad yang dog gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs:gzhal yas mnyam nyid klong du bshags par bgyi: yum gyi mkha' la mtho dman med pa la: steng dang 'og tu lta ba thang re chad mtho dman gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs bha ga 'ub chub klong du bshags par bgyi: chos kyi sku la gnyis su med pa la: phyi dang nang du lta ba thang re chad: snod bcud gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs chos sku 'gyur med klong du bshags par bgyi: ci mdzad ci spyod yab kyi rang bzhin la: ma rtog log par lta ba thang re chad: gnyis med gnyis su 'dzin pa nyon re mongs rol pa 'dzin med

can klong du bshags par bgye: ma reg 'khrul ba'e sems can snyeng re rje: gzugs med chos la dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin gang zag 'khrul ba'i sems ni mgo re 'khor: skye med chos la nga dang bdag tu bzung: snang srid bden med yin par ma shes te zang zing nor la sems kyis chags pa skyes: 'khor ba rang bzhin med par ma shes pas: gnyen bshes 'khrul ba'i grogs la rtags par bzungs: mi shes skye bo'i blo 'di yongs re gol: bden pa'i don bor mi dge'i las la brtson: ston pa'i bka' bor mi chos g.yeng bas bslu rang rig don bor g.yeng ba'i las la brtson: 'di 'dra'i don med sems can snying re rje: dbye bsri med pa'i 1nga du bshags par bgyi: snang srid med pa chos dbyings byang chub sems mnyam brdal 'ub chub rang rig gcig gi 1nga: bar med 'khrul bral ro mnyam phyal ba che thams cad sku dang ye shes lhun grub ngang: rnam par rtogs na bshags pa'i rgyal po che: kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa mngon gyur regag de ltar smon pas dam tshigs nyams chags byang lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa kun dang bral

tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag sku gnyis mngon du 'gyur the tshoms med do rdo rje rgyal po' bka' sa ma shā stem rgyal ba'idabang po pad+ma ngas ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse semasakyis snying dang 'dra ba'i chos skor rnams rin chen brda la bkod nus nas grub dbang khye'u chung lo tsār gtad da dung spel ba'i dus ma yin ma 'ongasasnyags ma lnga yi dus nad mug mtshon chasagazengs lang tshe nga sprul nusaldan rdo rje yis rnyed nagachos bdag bu la 'doms 'gro don lho da byang nas 'byung gdul bya 'bum phrag rnam par 'dren the tshom med do sa ma mā zab ba da srungs shig klu bdud btsan skal med lag tu ma shor cig snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sa ma shāḥ rgya rgya rgya gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi ces pa 'di'ang chos rkya bdag popad+ma tsha 'phel rgya mtsho dang chosabadagarasne pas ra chos bdagarang reg rdo rdo slob buyishagadad lnganatshagagasal rnams kyis yang yang bskul ngorabadag 'dra dpa' bo nusaldan rdo rjes 'brosabug mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling nas gsang brda dag par phab dge legs 'phel sarba ma lam/

can zab gsang mkha' 'gre'i thugs thig las rdzas bskang tshogs chen rab rdzogs bzhugs so pa/ na mo gu dzag pad+mā ka ra ye: risgo/ rgyal ba' dbang po pad+ma ngas ma 'ongs las lan don chen du rdzas bskang byin rlabs bcud bsdu ba cho ga' yan lag zab mo bstan sa ma māḥ.o u(ཿ bde skyongs bhasnyo ka pā la yi nang: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar dza gad skyems kyis bkang: yid 'ong rdo rje'i rig ma'i gar bsgyur bcas: rje btsun 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor bskang phyir 'bul: ghirti dmar mo'i mkha' las byung ba'i khrag: rgyu yi khrag dang rang byung rtsi bcud khrag: gu h+ya mu la thogs pa'i lha mo yis: rje btsun 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor bskang phyir 'bul: phyi nang snod bcud phung khams skye mched kyis: chos kyi dbyings nyid bkang ba'i bā lidha 'dod yon lha mo'i rol gar dang bcas nas: rje btsun 'phags ma'i bde chen chos dbyings gsal ba'i rkongs bu phu lhun rdzogs rig pa rang byung mar me sbar: ye shes dag pa'i lha mo'i 'phrul rtsed bcas: rang grol

'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor bskang phyir 'bul: khams gsum 'khor ba dbyings su dag pa'i phyir: a la la ste dgyes pa chen por bzhes: bdag cag tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa kun dag nas: rmad byung kun tu bzang por sangs rgyas regag: de ltar brjod pa sa tshogs gnyis rdzogs sgrab dag sku gnyis mngon du 'byur the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' zab gas thugs zig chos kya bcud thub par srungs shig klu bdud btsan dam nyamasalag tu ma shor cig nga sprul nusaldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan pa'i gsos su 'gyur chos bdag dpa 'a bo dpa 'a mo yang tshogs smon las 'gro dag pa sa 'dzoms zab gsang 'dzin skyongs spel bar byed gdul bya 'bum phrag mngon sangs rgyas bslu ba bral lo sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya brda zim snyi ces pa 'da'ang chosakya bdag popad+ma chosa'aphelargya mtsho dang chosal dbang ba' rat+na sar chosabadag rang rag slob bu ye shesadad ldan masagasal rnams kya yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' po nus ldan rdo rjes 'bros phug mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling nas gsang brda dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sabo ma lam/

gas zab gsang mkha' 'a14re thugs thig las gnas yul bsrung ma'i bskang ba bzhugs so:gas na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye: mi 17 44rteshā rang ṛg pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs las ldan don ched du zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las 'phags ma'i chos sde zab mo bstan sa ma yu de yang ga ṇa tsakra'i skabs gnas yul srung ma bskang 'dod na skyems tshogs bshams la spro shugs bskyed snyan pa 'a dbyangs kyis 'di skad do hūṃ bye rnam dag ma ga min 31sa dbyings gnas:dhu ma tha la mkha' 'gro'i grong: pad+ma brtsegs sogs dur khrod brgyad: tshan+dho nye ba'i tshan+dho sogs: he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang: dza lan dha ra pul+li ra: lam pa ka sogs nyi shu bzhi:gsang ba brda shod pad+ma spungs shwa tri sa la sum cu gnyis: mnga' ri skor gsum dbu gtsang gi: ru bzhi mdo khams sgang drug gnas: tsa ri pad ri pad+ma 'od: bkra shis rdzong chen la brten pa'i: dpa' bo dang ni dpa' mo'i tshogs: rdo rje'i bka' nyan dam can rnams: glu dbyangs tshig gis 'bod do byon: rol mo'i sgra la dgyes pa ra dgongs

dpa' bo stabs kyi gar la rol: 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs mchod bzhes: sha khrag dmar gyi tshogs mchod bzhes: zag med bdud rtsi'i tshogs mchod bzhes dgyes bskang gzi 'od bkrag mdangs 'bar: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang: dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang bstod dge 'dun bzhed pa phun sum tshogs: lta ba logs pa'i bdud sde sgrol: nad mug mtshon 'khrug ru 'dzing bzlog: bod khams bkra mi shis pa yi: nyer 'tshe ma lus bzlog tu gsol khyad par mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig gi:bstan pa phyogs bcu'i pha mthar spel: 'jig rten bde skyid ldan pa yi: brin las sgrub la rog ldan mdzod: pha nor zab gter bdud rtsi'i bcud: dus su rig ldan bu la sbyin:bstan 'a11re 17na chen 'byung bar mdzod dam la ma 'da' sa ma yu: ces brjod phud skyems gtsang sar gshegs smon pa'i re 'bras yid bzhan 'grub the tshom med do sa ma yu snying dang 'dra ba'i man ngag skor nga sprul nga dang dbyer med pa bdud 'joms gling pa dang 'phrad nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen 'byung chos bdag dpa' bo dpa' mo dang 'phrad nas bstan pa 'dzin skyongs spel dus kyi ru 'dzing ngan pa 'aro mas the

can tshom med do sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya lha ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chosa'aphel rgya mtsho dang grogs mo rat+na sar slob bu the shesarnams kyas yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te 'bros phug mkha' 'khro'i 'du glang nas dag par pha ba pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma lam/ga sa tshogs bsdus gra sa bsogs na yo bshad ci 'byor tshad bsags la yis kun khyab rig pa'i dga' ston gyis: 'khor ba las sgrol tā re bskangs: 'jigs brgyad ngan 'gro'i 'phrang las skyobs: 'phags ma'i zhabs drung 'khod par de ga: grangs ldan phul tshe mkho ba'i phyir nus ldan rdo rjes bris pa dge masgo lam de nas drangs ba len pa ni kyi gzigs shig rdo rje slob dpon dang: mched lcam 'dus pa rgya mtsho' tshogs: ro mnyam bde ba'i rdzas la rol: spyod cig ga ṇa kraku ho: a ho ma hā su kho: ces pa sa tsham pa drug ldan ngang r+ṣa med rang grol chen po spyod gnad des nyams rtogs yon tan 'bar the tshom med do sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya ces pa 'di'ang nus ldan rdo rjes bris pa dge legs 'phe la sabo pe lam/

gas zab gsang mkha' 'grele thugs theg las: 'phags ma nyer ga ga gi phyag rgya 'dod 'aro'i bum bzang bzhugs so pa gabatsun 'phags ma mdun gyi nam mkhar gsal bdag dang bsrung bya thams cad kyas mos gus dang blos 'di skad brjod phya ga 'tshal bsrung ba'i gur tshud bsam yis ma ste rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las ma: ye shes skur gyur 'phags ma yum: rje btsun myur dpal dbyangs can ma: bsod nams mchog ster gtsug tor rgyal rigs byed 'jigs byed gzhan mi thub: gzhan las rgyal dang nags kyi sgol: 'jig rten gsum rgyal nor rgyun ma bkra shis don byed dgra dpung 'joms: khro gnyer can dang rab zhi ma: 'bar ba'i 'od dang dpag med gnon: rma bya chen mo mi pham rgyal: ri khrod lha mo 'od zer can nyer gcig 'khor dang bcas pa la: gsol ba 'debs so 'jigs tshogs zhi rtags tu thugs rje brtse bas skyongs: 'od zer rdo rje go cha'i gur: bdag dang 'grung bya kun la stsol phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol: nad gdon las rkyen sgrib pa kun: ming tsam
'gas zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: rje btsun myur dpal lha moliphyag rgya phrin las lhun grub bzhugs so:

gas na mo gu dzag pad+ma ka ra ye ga chend/cas10 rang byung pad+ma se bha was snyigs ma'i gdul bya sems can rnams 'jigs pa brgyad las skyobs pa'i phyir sgrol ma nyer gcig phyag rgya bstan sa ma mā de yang myur dpal lha mo la brten nas gsang sgrub zab mo ni sngon 'gro ba don snying po ltar de nas dngos gzhi'i 'khrul 'khor la snang gragasalha skur brdal ba ni ming dzadas kun mi dmigs gzhi rtsa bral:rang rig byang chub sems kyi ngang rgyu ni skye med zig ler 'phos: 'phros 'dus snod bcud chos skur sad: de yi ngang las skad cig gis: rang byung ldon bzang rgyas pa'i khar:chags med pad+ma 'dab stong bzhad: de steng shes rab nyi dkyil klong: thabs mchog zla ba'i dal steng du: rig pa trī:yig 'phro 'du las yongs gyur ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: rje btsun myur dpal lha mo ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi zhing 'dzum: dar dang rin po che yis spras: g.yas pas mchog sbyin tshe bum bsnams: g.yon pas pad+ma'i yu bar 'dzin: 'dab ma snyan thad gyes pa'i khar dgos 'dod kun 'byung nor bu ljang dbu sgra thor cog glegs bam bcing: dar sna lnga yis rgya chings gdab zar bu thul 'phyings

gan sgrub la brtse nu 'bur gsang ba'i bha ga rgyas: zhabs gnyis phyed pa'i skyil krung gis rdzu 'phrul g.yu 'brug steng na 'byeng: ye shes 'ja' 'od klong du bskyed: gnas gsum las ni 'od 'phros pas: rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang bcas: 'phags ma lha mo'i rnam pa dza spyan drangs dam ye ro gcig gyur: thugs 〈snang nyi zla kha sbyor sbubs rig pahrī la sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas 'jigs brgyad dbyings su zhi: tshe bsod dpal 'byer don rnams rgyas: khams gsum srid gsum 'khor la dbang snang grags lha sngags chos sku'i ngang: hrī:tā reto swā hā: bskyed rjogs dmigs pa'i gnad smin pas bye ba gcag gi dngosagrub zob skabs su nye ba'i snying po ni tā re: 'bru 'bum re re'i tshad du skyol de ya mchog thun dngosagrub thob skabs su las sbyor sngags rim ni trī tā retswa hūṃ 'jig pa brgyad dang bcu drug shirnye ku ru swā hā: 'bum ther gcig gi rkyen snang zhi hrī:tā re to hūṃ tshe bsod dpal 'byor puṣ+ṭi ku ru hūṃ: 'bum ther gcig gis tshe bsod rgyas hrī tā rerta (: khams gsum srid gsum wa shaṃ ku ru s+t+waṃ: 'bum ther gcig gis zas nor dbang hrī:tā re to sa: gdug pa

can mā ra ya phaṭa: 'bum ther gcig gis rkyen snang byang skabs su las sbyor rim pa ni 'jigs brgyad srung ba'i 'khor lo la rin chen gtsang ma' sman shog ngor ste bar mu khyud rim bdun pa'i dbugasu sku gzugs de' phyi rim 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad shar rim nas seng ge'i gnod pa zhi bar gyur cig lhor glang chen gyis gnod pa zhe nub tu me yis 'jigasapa zhi byang du sprul gyas 'jigs pa shar lhor chems rkun gyis sbyor ba lho nub lcags sgrogs gas sbyor ba nub bya rgya mtsho'i gnod pa zhi byang shar du sha za 'dre mos rgol ba zhi ces bra phya rim pad+ma 'dab brgyad la shar dra za'i gdug /ba zhi bar gyur cig ltor gshan rje'i gnod pa zhi nub chu lhas 'tshe ba byang gnod sbyi gyis bsam sbyor zhi shar sto me lha'i gnod pa zha lho nub sran pos dug g.yosazhi nub byang rlung lhas rgol ba zha byang shar dbang ldan gyi 'khrul 'khor zhi de yi phyi rim 'khor lo brgyad shar zab// lhor 1bka nub nya byang shāsman shar lho spyo— sto nub shāka nub byang rnam byang shar nodi de yi phyi rim 'di bzhin bri 'chang ba po'i lus ngag yid gsum la steng gdon bar gdon 'og gdon rgyal 'gong dam sri mo gdon 'gong po bse rag dbul sri the'u rang gis gnod pa thams cad zhi zha zhag zhig phyes phyes khrol khrol swā sna de yi phyi rim 'di bzhin bkod 'chang ba po'i lusangag yid gsum la nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzha rlung

sa las gyur pa mkhres pa las gyur pa tsha ba las gyur pa pad gan las gyur pa 'dus pa las gyur pa thams cad zha bar gyur cag gdon stong phrag brgyad cu' rgol ba thams cad zha sra nye shu rtsa lnga'i sbyor ba thams cad zhi gra ming sring bco brgyad kyis rgol ba thams cad zhi bar 'dre khas zhan dbang chu gi gnod pa thams cad zhi bar sarba pa pa sharnye ku ru swā snya de yi phyi ram dbyangs gsal byed rten snying su pra tiji bra bzang drug bdud rtsi chos sman byugs rang sngags khri yis rab tu gnas 'bral med lus la bcing pa yis bar chad rkyen byang the tshom med sa ma wā de nas rjes kyi ram pa la tshogs rdzas yo byad sbungs byas te bsangs sbyangs sngon du 'gro byas nas 'bul ba'i ram pa 'di lta ste hrī: bde stong zag bral dam pa'i rdzas: gsang ba bla med tshogs chen pos: gu ru rtsa gsum rgya mtsho dang khyad par myur ma lha mo yi: sku gsung thugs la dgyes mchod 'bul dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: gzung 'dzin dgra bgegs dbyings su sgrol: sku gsum mnyam nyid klong du bstabs 'od gsal chos sku'i rang zhal sprod: dgongs pa mi 'gyur dngos grub stsol: mthar thug kun tu 'od kyi sar: mngon gyur rdzogs sangs rgyas par shog: dge ba bsngo smon rgya yis gdab

bkra shis mtha' brten dag gis brgyan des ni tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs zung 'jug dam pa sku gnyis 'thob: ze tshom med do sa ma yu tshem rgyal b.lidabang po pa d+ma ngas snying thig gdam pa zab mo'i skor rjesalajug gdul bya'i ched du bstan gsang ba o rgyan 'phrul yig bkod rin chen shel gya sgrom bur btsud bka' rtags mi 'gyur phyag rgyas btab mdo khams tsā ri'i sku yi gnas brag khra gla chen 'gying ba 'dra'i gzhu 'dom bco brgyad 'tshams su sbas sgo mtshams byang nas shar du blta de ru bka' gsang zab mo sbas nga sprul bdud 'joms gling pa yi rded nas bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub chos bdag dpa' bo bdun dang ni dpa' mo gsum gyi skal bar bsngags gnad ldan 'gro don bya nas 'byung gdul bya brgya phrag dpa la ri 'drongs log dman ska' ngan 'di ma ster skal ba can gya dpa la du shog 'jang 'dur mi be+e sob rdzun mkhan sngags mkhan grub pa'i skal bar bsngags sa mi mtha' 'khob dbus 'byur tshe phrin las lha 'di myur zhing zab pad+ma nga yi snying thig chos srog ltar bsrungs ba dam tshig yi drug la dus mchod rgyun mi gcod slob ma dam las nyams pa ni bdud kyi dbang du song ba yin rgya bod chos mang slog chub kyang grol ma thub pa tha tshig yin bdud la bdud tshag brjod pa sba phyogs bzhar bdud 'dul 'khor lo bskor bar snang khams la dam rtags bcing sa mdor nges pa'i 'grim khang bca'
