gas de ni bdud 'dul pha bu'i gtam mo btsun 'ga' re bdud la chas gcod yul spyo rgyud zab mos zhi pha mchog zla ba thabs kyis bzhu ma dbyings shes rab mi mos bskul gnyis med ro mnyam dpa 'a bos myong sal rlung ga rgyas 'debs tshe me la nam mkha' dbab pa gnad gcig 'dzan kha chems tshul du snang rgyal po 'i sras mo sa le sman logs pa bdud kyis ma bslad na kun bzang dgo sa pa skyongs la cha mi mo mtsho rgyal gsung ga gar the tshom blo yis ma bslus tshe rang 'bras brtul zhugs mngon du gyur sa ma yā bka' gsang zab mo' snying bcud chos gdams pa pha phog dam pa' skor gter srung klu bdud bcan gsum da 'aka' gter shan pa ra hu la'i thub par bsrungs shig sa ma yu 'dod sred can la 'di ma shor skal ba can kyi dpa la du shog sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gtad rgya gnyan rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gter rgya brda zim gu rgya snyi ces pa 'di yang chos kyi bdag po thabs grogs rig bzang bār+ya'i ming gis yang yang bskul ngor sngags kyi rnal 'byor ba bdud 'jomasardo rjesagri pa dge zhing bkra shas par gyur cig sarba ma lam/ dza yan tu/

1 (3nagayo zab gsang mkha' 'dza'i thugs thig las 'phags ma bsod nams mchog ster gyi zab grub 'dod 'byung nor bu bzhugs so:pa na mo gu 〈co pad+ma kā ra ye: //gonardo 11 rang rig pad+ma saṃ bha was snyigs ma'i 'gro la brtse sems kyis dbul phongs rgud pa sel ba' phyir: 'phags ma nyer gcig phyag rgya bstan sa ma pā de yang bsod nams mchog ster la bsten nas gsang sgrub sgom 'dod tshe sngon 'gro zab don snying po ltar dngos gzhi thu ga rgya gsal ba ni yis chos rnams ka dag spros mtha' bral: rang gsal byang chub sems kyi mdangs: thabs shes sa bon yi ge trī de las 'phros 'dus sgod bcud rnams: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dal du rdzogs: de dbus rang gsal pho brang dbus ma chags pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: gnyis 'thung thal dkar khri yi khar: nyibab yongs su gyur pa las: bdag snang bsod nams mchog ster sku: dmar ser 'char ga'i mdog

'dzin cing: zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum mjes bzhad: dar dang rat+na'i rgyan cha rdzogs: rin po che yi prog zhwa mdzes: phyag g.yas rat+na mig drug bsnams: 'gro ba'i phongs rgud dbul ba sel: g.yon pa gter gyi bum pa 'dzin: sgrub pa po yi re ba skongs: zhabs gnyis gar gyis khri la rol 'ja' 'od thig le 'khrigs pa'i slong: stong gsal sgyu ma'i phung por bskyed: gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas: khyad par 'phags ma'i lha tshogs rnams: spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstem spyan 'dren la sogs gzhung tshang bar zab don snying po ltar du shes de nas 'dzab bzlas bya ba ni hrī: rang nyid 'phags ma'i thugs sang du nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor sbubs: rig pa nyil sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas: nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan 'phel: nad yams mtshon 'khrug ming med gyur: snang grags rig gsum bde ba che: lha sngags phyag rgya chos sku'i ngang: hrī: ār+ya pukhye ma hā sarba rat+na bā su kha dhe na na sidhi pha la hūṃ aḥ bskyed rdzogs tang 'dzan ldan pa yis bye ba gcig bzlas daro sa grub thob nyams dang

gas rtogs pa'i yon tan rgyas nad gdon rkyen snang zhi bar 'gyur sgrub dang las sbyor dmigs pas phye bzlas tshad them tshe rtags mtshan 'byung the tshom med do sa ma yu de las lasal sbyor ba ni rin chen gter bum sgrum pa la shel lam rdza bum ras khug brtsam 'bru sna sman sna ran chen rigs mar khus brlan cang snod rnams gangs dbus su mthang gi shog gu la ran chen gser gyis 'di bzhin bri tsāmi/thatharte/rnasgogargagaskorgasgazha)nargargargamigamithachosasacho gagug lhagagalog116ste ces bri snying por gzhug par bya kha chings sna lnga rgya dang bcas thu ga rgya lnga yi ri mos mdzes de nas da la' dbus su gzhugs rnam lnga nyer spyod dag gis bskor rmang sra bkar zhing khrus gsol bya g.yang bsang gtong la yad 'ongs byed de nas lha bskyed bya ba ni yin ma hā shu bye ta sogs che sa rnams mi dmigs stong ba'i ngang: lhun grub ye shes chen po'i rtsal: snod bcud rnam dag zhing bkod rdzogs: rin chen mdzes pa'i sa gzhi ni: mnan nem btegs la spar tshul can: sman kyi spang ri ngad pa ldan: ku mud sna tshogs sel ma bkram: yan lag brgyad ldan rdzing bu dang gser gyi phye ma g.yu'i ne'u seng: bya rigs 'phur lding chos sgra 'ur: ri dwags gar bsgyur rtse

'jo byed dpag bsam sheng dang 'dod 'jo'i ba: ma rmos lo tog gter gye bum lha klu mi yi dpal 'byor dang: longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus: 'dod 'byung gter gyi bum pa ni: yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel gyur: dmar ser 'char ga'i lang tsho bkra: 'od dang 'od zer dpag med 'phro: 'khor 'das dngas bcud dpal yon bstim: de dbus pad+ma nyi zla'i khar: mdun bskyedabasod nams mchog ster sku: dmar ser 'char ga'i lang tsho bkra sogs med par bstim thugs dalihrīsams 'od 'phros pas 'khor 'das lha 'dre mi gsum gyi: tshe bsod dpal yon dngas bcud stobs: phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub rnams: kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin: spyan drangs sgrub pa'i rdzas la bstim: 'dod rgu'i mer mer ting ting gang: sgrub pa po yi re smon 'grub: rnam rgyal lha yi dpal 'byor la: skal ldan ma lus spyod par dmigs: slo sar+ya gredan dzi ni gini sarba rat+na si si mi ni mi ni mi a lak+ṣa ya ma na ye swā hā: tabya thā su mu su mu tsan+ta tsan+ta: tsa ra tsa ra: ka ra ka ra: ki li ki li ku ru ku na mu ru mu rba tsu ru tsu

sa/ dra san+ta pa ye: at+pa na nyid tan an dha ra dhu ra swā hā: mi nor zas gsum dhi shra ma ṇa ye he sa rat+na sirnyi pha la khug skyol: brgya rtsa la sogs gang 'os bskyar de nas g.yang 'bod bya ba ni bsangs dud spro zhing dar dkar g.yab snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do e: phun chegos bkra shis nyi ma la: lha bzhi mdzes pa'i da la dza g.yang gi mdzod sgo 'bar ba phyes: lha klu mi yi dkor nor gyis: mer mer gang zhing phyur phyur gtibs: deng sang snyigs ma lnga yi dus: nad mug mtshon chas gzengs pa lang: skye rgu mi 'dod nyes pas gzir: dbul phongs nyam thag gyur rnams la: brtse chen lcags kyus ma bzod nas: rtsa gsum lha la snyan gsan phab: chos skyong srung mar phrin las bcol: ye shes mkha' 'gror gsol gdab na: 'chi med tshe yi phywa g.yang stsol: 'dzad med nor gyi phywa g.yang stsol: dbang thang bu yi phywa g.yang stsol: che drag stobs kyi phywa g.yang stsol: snyan grags mthu yi phywa g.yang stsol: nyams rtogs rgyas pa'i phywa g.yang stsol: bkra shis mtha' btsan bcud ldan zas kyi yid 'ong rdzas kyi lha yi phywa g.yang char bzhin phob mi yi phywa g.yang

sprin bzhin bsdus: sa gzhi'i phywa g.yang gangs ltar chags: klu yi phywa g.yang nyi ltar gsal: 'dir khug sgrub pa'i rdzas mchog dang: gnyis su med par ro gcig gyur 'jig rten 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khams: dpal 'dredar bde bas gang bar dmigs: snyen swā sti sirnyi maṅga lam: ces brjod me tog dor bar bya rab tu gnas shi brtan pa ra bzhugs zhag bdun la sogs ci rig bsgrub de nas gter sded bya ba la sa phyogs yad 'ong chu dpal 'dzoms der phyin sa sko tshad them bya gnas yid du 'ong zhing bkra shis pa'i sa la sa yi lha mo byon par bsam la: gtoram 'bul bar bya ba ni tra: rin chen sgod du gtor ma dkar gsum las: grub pa'i mchod sdong ngo mtshar yid 'ong gnas: kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs: bla med gsang ba'i dam rdzas chen po 'di: dbang chen sa yi lha mo khyod la 'bul: dgyes bzhes 'gro ba'i dbul ba sel bar mdzod: sa pre gide wi sarba lo ka e dam bā lirnyi kha kha khā hi khā hi lan bdun gyis phul lo de nas bum gter sba ba ni trī: dbang chen sa yi lha mo'i mkha' slong yangs: mi 'byur thig le 'dzin pa'i da la phu 'dod 'byung rat+na 'bar ba'i gter sbed do

gas de'i mthus phyi ru rgyal khams bde ba dang: nad mug mtshon 'khrug meng ge lhag mar gyur: legs tshogs rdzogs ldan gsar bas mdzes gyur ceg: nang du rnal 'byor chos mthun bsam pa 'grub: nyams rtogs yon tan yar ngos zla ltar bskyed: brin las ma g.yel dbang chen sa yi bdag: nag phyogs mgo 'phang bcom la dpa' skongs shing: rgyal bstan nub med dar ba'i phrin las mdzod: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni hūṃ hrī: dbang chen sa 'jen thub pa'i bstan pa srung stong gsum gzhi bdag la ma srin gyi srog: 'gro ba'i bde spel sa gsum sman gcig ma: sa yi lha mo bstan mar phyag 'tshal bstod: ces brjod tshes yi lha mo phyag byas nas rnal 'byor ba khyed kyis ri ltar bsgo ba'i phrin las grub par bya'o zhes khas blangs nasas la thim pa ra bsam de nas bkra shis ni je: phan bde'i ma 'dab rgyas pa'i dpag bsam shing: zad med 'gro ba'i re skong yid bzhin nor: yangs pa'i rgyal khams bde ba thug rje'i char: deng 'dir sgrub mchog rnams la stsal du gsol: de nas smon lam gdab pa na na me bsod nams gter chen bzhengs pa'i 'bras bu ni: rgyal

khams spyi dang bye brag gangs chen bod: rtsub 'gyur ru 'dzing rgud pa ngan las grol: bde skyid chos kyis 'tsho ba'i rgyur gyur cig lan gsum gzhan yang bsngo smon mtha' rgyas bya gnad des sa bcud dpal 'phel zhing bsam pa'i don rnams geg med 'grub tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur ze tshom med rdo sa ma pā de na dbang thang dpal bskyed kyi bsrung 'khor las la bcing 'dod na shog dkar dra ma bral kha gang ngor mu khyud rim pa lnga ru bskor lte bar nor bu mig drug bri de rgyab mu khyud gnyas pa la 'chang ba po'i dbang thang bskyed cig rtsa dkar khrol cig de rgyab mu khyud gsum pa la 'chang ba po'i lus ngag yid gsum srungasashig rag dbang thang bskyed cig rtsa dkar khrol cig de rgyab mu khyud bzha pa la dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po bra de rgyab mu khyud lnga pa la nor 'dzan pa tra bri bar bya rdzas ni bzang drug chos sman byug 'bral med lus la bcing ba yis dbang thang dpal kha bskyed par 'gyur the tshom med do sa ma mā de nas rjes rim tshogs mchod ni rgyas par 'dod na zab snying ltar bsdu na tshogs rdzas yo byad spungs bsangs sbyangs byin gyis rlabs nas slar 'bul bshags bstabs pa'i ram pa na hrī: rmad byung ka pā la yi nang: dam dzos sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: ga ṇa tsakra'i bcud chen po gu ru rtsa gsum rgya mtsho dang: 'phags ma

gas bsod nams mchog ster gyis: sku gsung thugs la mchod pa 'bul: ma rig rmongs 'khrul dam nyams bshags: gzung 'dzin log zhabrul kun bsgral te ye shes gsang ba'i klong du bstabs: gdug tshogs drungs 'byin ming med mdzod: mi 'dod nyes tshogs zhi ba dang: phyogs las rnam rgyal dngos grub stsol: bdag dang bdag la 'brel ba'i 'gro: kun bzang bla ma'i sa thob 31ga: dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab bkra shas mtha' rten rgyas par bya gnad desatshogs rdzogasasgrib pa dag sku gnyis mngon du 'gyur bar nges the tshom med do sa ma shā mim rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma ngas snying gi yang bcud zab pa'i gter gsang ba brda yi ris su btab las ldan ma 'o sa don du brtsams mdo khams tsā ri'i shar du sbas klu bdud btsan la gnyer kha bcol ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga yi dus nad mug mtshon chas gzeng lang tshe nga sprulabadud 'jom gling pa yis rted nas bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub chos bdag dpa' bo bdun dang ni dpa 'a mo gsum gyi skal bar bsngags legs par brten na bde skyid 'bar ral na mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'byung phongs 'among sanus pa rin chen gter gces pa' srog las btsa' shes mdzod skal med lag tu ma shor zhig 'dod sred can la a tham rgya yi lo 'brasasman gyisabargyan pa yis

tsa bsil ba'i yang khrod na mdangasaldan rma bya'i zlosagar rgyur dug la spyod cing 'od brgya 'bar tong khong g.yu 'byug 'khyil ba ru a mo li ga'i byi chung brtse skad snyan lho mon rgyal mo lding ku mud sna tshogs rgyan du che jing bu.āt+pal tshal chen la 'dab ldanangang mo brgya stong gnas rtsi bcud dpal la rnam par da khrung khrung snyan pa'igru re spro gser ldan sbo la ri dwagasabartse dung brag dkar mor rgyang gragasasnyan zangasakyi pad+ma mtshal rtagasacan g.yu yi khyi mo dung sgomadzes 'dan dkar dri za'i ba mo ngoms smra mkha' ni tsos chosasmra 'gyed mdzesapa rma bya'i gar gyis bslu rgya stag ngar ma'i mche ba bdor 'brong gi ru bzhi brdar bar srid de 'joms g.yo po ku ma ra dbang drag shan pa nga po 'dul rje btsun myur ma dpa' mo yis byin rlabasarno nu khyad par 'phags rten 'brel gsal ba'i snang ba mngon sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugasabacud 'di snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya brda zim lha cesapa 'di'ang chosakyi bdag po pad+ma chosa'aphel rgya mtshosadar dang bri gzhi bcasabaskul ba dang /chosabadag rang rig lam la dbang ba'i grog mo rat+na sar slob bu ye she dad ldan chosagasal rnam kyi yang yang bskulangor bdag 'dra dpa' bos ldan rdo gsamakha' 'gro gsang ba' brda ris lasazhal bshu te 'apro phug mkha' 'gro'i 'dugleng na dag par phab pa dge legasa'aphel/sarba ma lam/

(4)pas zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las 'phags ma rigs byed lha mo'izab sgrub khams gsum myur 'gugs bzhugs so:ca na na 37 gu ru pad+ma kwa ra ye: nyartenanacanathag rang reg pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ong 'gro la brtse sems gyis khams gsum dab du sdud pa'i phyir sgrol ma nyer gcig phyag rgya bstan sa ma yu de yang rag byed lha mo la brten pa'i zab sgrub brten nus na sngon 'gro zab snyang ltar du bya dngos gzhir 'jug pa'i rim pa ni u 'de ra 'das chos kun gzhi rtsa bral: gsal stong rig pa byang chub sems: thabs shes sa bon trī:yig las: 'od zer 'phro 'du'i sgod bcud rnams ye shes lnga ldan yum lnga'i klong: lhun grub rang gsal pho brang dbus: ma chags pad+ma nyi zla'i steng me khyung dmar po'i khri yi khar rang rig hrī:bab zhu ba las: bdag snang regs byed lha mo'i sku: dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: khro 'dzum spyan gsum chags

nyams rgyas:mche ba bzhi gtsigs smin ma 'bar dar dpyangs rus pa'i rgyan drug dang:zod rkam dbu rgyan dar sna'i 'phan:me tog phreng ba rat+na'i brgyan:phyag g.yas pad+ma'i lcags kyu bsnams:khams gsum srid gsum blo yid 'gugs:phyag gasku na ku mud mda' gzhu 'gengs thabs mkhas thugs rje dbang sdud byed:zhabs gnyis gar gyis khri la rol:'ja' 'od me dpung 'khrigs pa'i klong:rang gsal sgyu ma'i sku ru bskyed:gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas:khyad par 'phags ma'i lha tshogs rnams:spyan drangasaganyisasu med par bstims sbyan 'dren la sogs gzhung tshang bar zab don snying po ltar du shes de nas 'dzab bzlas bya ba ni:hrī:rang nyid 'phags ma'i thugs klong du:thabs shes nyi zla kha sbyor dbus:rig pa trī la sngags kyis bskor:bzlas pa'i khams gsum srid pa gsum lha 'dre klu dang mi rnams kyis:zas nor longs spyod phywa g.yang kun:khab len rdo yis lcags bsdud bzhin:rang dbang med par bkugs par dmigs dpal yon 'byor ba rab rgyas shing:snang grags rig gsum bde ba che

ga lha sngags phyag rgya chos sku'i ngang:sdi ār+ya ku ru kul+le hā:a dz+nya tra na a ra ya dza:sarba rat+na bā su kha dhe na ma sedhe bsdus bsdus pa shaṃ ku ru s+t+waṃ bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i bcing bar med bye ba gcag bzlas tshe rtag dang mtshan ma rabs tu gsal dab byin dngos grub ma lus 'thob the tshom med do sa ma shā skabasasu la la sbyor ba na dge 'dun dbang sdud 'khor lo bstan dbang sha shug mar leb ngos bu bzang drug sirnyi ra byugs te mtsha' gyis 'di ba bri bar bya oṃ kuru kuspe trī phyogs ba 'a khams nas dge 'dun bla ser dam tshag can rnams kyis blo bsdus bsdus yid 'gugs 'gugs sems 'dud 'dud tsit+ta myos myos sarba wa sham ku ru ye swā snyaces bras brten bzhugs rab du gnas sna ser dang bcas rlung la bskor de yis 'khor du sdad par nges the tshom med do sa ma mā snye pa pho smo dbang sdud thabs dmigs bya'i chu shul sa blangs nas che ge'i gzugs bcas snyi ka ru gagasamadzathatoja'irnashabazu yodārtagizhegateṅgāgashethad+nghahaṃ rgorgadiyagragajun/'inyurgorganadraṅgāzhezarlajadruthasonagrican ces pa mtshal gyis bris nas gzhung rang nyad la mo' nga rgyal ngang thugs ga'i 'od kyis lcags kyu yis dmigs bya dbang med sdud par bsam hrī che ge mog na ya bsdus bsdus pa shaṃ ku ru ste

brgya sto la sogs brjod pa dang ril bu la byang semasadakar dmar dbang lag gi wa rtsa lcags kyu ma ra gsum gyis sprel mchan bsngags byin pa'i 'gugs the tshom med do sa ma yu zas nor dbang du byed 'dod na sman shog ngos su mtshan gyi ni oṃ ku ru kul+le trīng hrīng sarba rat+na bā su kha dhe sa ma ya bsdus bsdus pā shaṃ ku ru sirnyi pha la hūṃ hūṃ ces pa dbu can tshag med bkod bsnyen pa'i skabs su 'dzab dbye 'dogs hūṃ dza rang nyid lha mo'i thugs ka nas: 'od dmar lcags kyu lta bur 'phros: lha 'dre mi gsum zas nor dang: ma ngas spyod phywa g.yang dngas bcas bsdus: bdag nyid dpal 'byer rgyas par bsam: rtsa sngags sham bur 'di bzhin 'dogs a:n+ni trichos tha'i ya sabo rat+na bā su kha dhe sirnyi bsdus bsdus pa shaṃ ku ru hūṃ: ca 'grub bzlos pa' 'dod rgya' char sgrub pa po la 'bebs par 'gyur de nas 'bru sna' rigs byed dang me tog rnam pa sna tshogs rnams mar gyis brlan la snod du gtams sngags da phyag rgya'i byin gyisarlabs de nas thab kyi me nyid ni la ru bskyed pa 'di ltar ro skyong re dz+wa la re rang gi thugs ga nas 'od zer ram̐ yig gi rnam pa chad de thab kyi me la thim: ye shes lnga ldan gyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su: 'phags ma rigs byed lha mo sku mdog dmar

ga gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa: smen ma las me 'bar ba thod rkam lnga ye dbu brgyan dar sna'i cod paṇa 'phur ma nyi zla'i snyan cha byas shing dbu sgra dmar sel gyen du 'khyil ba: rus pa'i rgyan drug dang stag lpags gi sham thabs byas pa: zhabs gnyis gar stabs su bzhugs pa: phyag g.yas pad+ma'i lcags kyu dang g.yon pa ku mud gyi mda' gzhu 'geng ba: thugs rje chags pa'i gzi brjid 'bar bar bskyed do:de'i ljags kyi 'od zer sbu gu can gyis bsreg rdzas lha yi bdud rtsi'i bcud drangs te gsol ba'i dgyes pa bskangs bar bsam: chags pa chen po'i 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i gzi 'od kyis khams gsum srid gsum zas nor longs spyod 'dod rgu'i phywa g.yang rnams bsdus te bdag gi mnga' 'og tu tshud par bsam la: rtsasngags mthar pañca a mṛ ta kha hi: sarba rat+na ba su kha dhe na na aḥdri tri:a ga ya bsdus bsdus sirnyi pha la sto: brgya stong khra 'bum la sogs bskyal mthar lha mo 'od dmar gyi thig le zhig tu gyur nas rang gi snying gar thim pa'i dbang gi dngos grub thob par bsam

mo: de nas dbang gi lcags klu yis phywa g.yang 'bod pa'i lcags ye ma deng ge gnas mchog dam pa 'dir rnal 'byor bdag cag sgrub pa po'i: 'dod yon sna tshogs mchod pa yes:dbang gi lha mo'i dgyes pa bskangs chags pa chen po'i 'od zer ni: lcags kyu'i dbyibs can dpag med 'phros: 'khor lo brgyur ba'i rgyal po dang: blod pon 'khor g.yog dpung dang bcas: bla btsun dge 'dun 'dus sde dang: mos pa'i skye 'gro che ge mo: lha 'dre mi gsum phywa dang g.yang: zas nor longs spyod 'dod rgu'i char: lho sprin bzhin du me re re: rgya mtsho bzhin du kyi li li: chu klung bzhin du 'u ru ra 'dir khug rnal 'byor bdag cag la: nub pa med par stsal du gsol: sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen yid bzhin nor: ma bsam bzhin du sbung la rol: chos mthun bsam pa kun 'grub pa'i: phan bde'i lang tsho bskyed du gsol: sā sti sidhi maṅga lam: de ltar ldan pa'i sgrub pa po: zas dang khyams la bcud chags shing dbul phong 'byor rgud sel ba dang khyad pa ra khams gsum srid gsum gya zas nor longs spyod tswa g.yang kun ma lus bdag ga dbang gyur nas 'khor 'das spyo dpal chen por gyur the tshom med do sa ma yu

gas rjes ma tshogasakyi 'khor lo ni rgyasapar 'dod na zab snying ltar bsdu bar mos na 'di ltar ro bza' bca' btung ba ldag ga ba zas ma lus bsags nas re ltar spungs 'dzad med yed bzhen mdzod kyi gter 'byu gsum nus pa' sbyangs spel brgyur lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar gsal 'bul bshags bstab pa'i rim pa ni hrī: yi las bhan+ta yangs pa'i nang: tshogs rdzas 'dod sku na lnga yi gter: ye shes bdud rtsi brgyur ba 'dis: gu ru rtsa gsum rgya mtsho dang: khyad par 'phags ma rigs byed ma'i: dkyil 'khor lha la mchod pa 'bul: las nyon rtog sgrib dbyings su bshags: kun rtog 'khrul ba rang sar bsgral: rtog bral chos sku mkha' la bstabs: sor rtog ye shes dngos grub stsol: khams gsum srid gsum phywa g.yang rgyas: lha 'dre mi gsum mnga' dbang thob: bdag dang 'gro ba sems can rnams: tshe gcig kun tu 'od kyi sar: lhun grub mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas re ga: bkra shis bsngo smon mthar rgyas bya bkra shis de yis tshogs rdzogs sgrab pa byang zung 'jug sku gnyis maro na du gyur the tshom med do sa ma wā ye ma rgyal dbang pad+ma sa bha wa gu ru rdo rje zod phreng ngas snyigs ma'i 'gro la thugs brtse ba'i mtha' dbus thams cad

gter gyis bkang khyad par lnga brgya snyigs ma'i dus log lta mu rtegs mgo 'phang mtho dme 'khrugasanang mkhon phu nu 'thor nad yam dal kha gcan gzan rgyu dgra jag tshom rkun mgo 'phang drag mi 'dod 'tshubs ma sprin ltar 'khrigs de tshe yang tig zab mo 'di phan par bya ba'i gso sman du gsang ba 'phrul gyis yi ger bkod mardo khams tsā ri'i shar du sbas klu bdud btsan la gnyer ka bcol ma 'ong nga sprul bdud 'aro mas gling gang ga rted nas bstan don 'grub chos bdag dpa' bo bdun dang ni dpa' mo gsum gyi bskal bar bsngags bka' bzhin brten na phan bde rgyas ral na mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'byung phong 'tsheng nus pa rin chen gter gces pa' srog las btsa' shes mdzod 'gro don byang nas ram bzhin 'byung gdul bya bsam yas dag par 'god byin rlabs rno nus khyad 'phags 'di log lta can la kha tham sa rgya skal med rnams la gsang rgya sdoms i shar phyog gril bum ku mud de glo bur srin bya'i ma 'phrog na snyan pa'i chos dung dkar bo' sgra phyogs rnams kun la khyab par skad seng ldeng lo 'bras rgyas steng nas stobs ldan bya rgyal khyu chen gyi sgro gshog rlung gi ma bskyod na sra brtan dpal gyis gdug pa 'dul brag dkar ba gam mtho steng nas ne+e tso gsung snyan gyer ba la phyogs gyis sabha ma 'khrin ba dan dkar po yongs su brdal ma/ dros mtsho la rten bcas pa 'i klu dbang gser sbrul ser po ste grong

gas khams lce yis ma bslus na 'ad phye' nya ma 'od stong 'bar de ba garta mkha' 'gro' brda sngagasapa' rta bdun gsal ba' phyar gud sbas rdo rje 'bar ba' rdzongs 'chol 'khyes bde chen rgyal mor brtson grib bzlog dme bar brtsegs pa bsgra sa lasabasgrub he chen dha na mchod dgra bgegs sha za'i rno la dro sa myu gu'i tsasgobashad pa 'i phyir ma hā gu ru rin po che drag po rab 'bar te ru ka seng ta mu kha dmar po'i rno sri bzlog 'khor lo 'bar ba' dbal tshe yas ljon shing gud sbas gso ku mud bkrag 'od 'khyug pa 'i phyir gu ru zhi ba khro bo lod phag mo mtsho rgyal masto ra byad bzlog seng gdong gtsug tor rgyal ratā'i thugs dam gong 'og dang gud sbas gso zhija 'khor 'bar 'bad gsang ba'i pad+mo bzhad pa'i phyir pad+ma rgyal po saṃ bha wa thugs rjes rang bzhin pad dkar 'chang rje btsun myur ma tā re brten rkyen bzlog cakra bcu gsum dang rig 'dzin brgyud pa 'i gsol gdab bskyal de yis rkyen snang ma lus byang the tshom med do rdo rje' bka' sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya dpa' bo mkha' 'gre'i thugs bcud 'ad snying ga bu dang 'phrad par shog gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu h+ye brda thim snyi ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chas 'phel lasadar dang bra gzhi bcas bskul ba dang / chos bdag rang rag jes shog dkar dri ma med pa dang / chos la dab ba'i grogs mo rat+na sa ra dang sgob bu yi shesadad
ldan chosagasal rnams kyis yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nu ldan rdo rje 'apros phug mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling nas brda lag chad med par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma lam/

khedacan zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: 'phags mgazhan las rgyal ma'i zab sgrub pha rol dpung 'joms zhes bya ba bzhugs so:ga sa na ཿ1 gu na padh+wa ka ra ye gartenatharwa/:tshe rang rig pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis snyigs ma'i 'gro la snying brtse bas pha rol g.yul 'joms rkyen sel phyir 'phags ma nyer gcig phyag rgya bstan sa ma yu de yang gawa las rgyal ma yis zab sgrub nyams su len 'dod na sngon 'gro zab don snying po ltar dngos gzhi la bskyed bya ba ni 〉 rtog bral mi dmigs de bzhin nyid: kun khyab rang grol snying rje'i mdangs: thabs shes sa bon gsal ba las: 'od zer 'phro 'dus snod bcud rnams: yum chen lnga dang ldan pa'i klong: lhun grub rang gsal pho brang dbus: ma chags pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: gangs seng dkar mo'i khri yi khar: hrī bab yongs su gyur pa las: bdag snang gzhan las rab rgyal sku: dmar smrag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: spran

gsum mche ba bzhi gtsigs shing:dar dpyangs rat+na'i rgyan cha dang:'ja' rkang rus rgyan thod skam lnga'i:dbu rgyan pad+ma'i do shal 'phyangs phyag g.yas tho chen 'bar ba btegs:byad ma'i lus sems 'thag par byed:gasku na pas mchod rten thugs gar bkan:srid gsum g.yul las rnam par rgyal:zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur khri la rol 'ja' 'od me dpung 'khrigs pa'i klong gsal stong sgyu ma'i phung por bskyed:gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las:'od 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas:khyad par 'phags ma'i lha tshogs rnams:spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstim:spyan 'dren la sogs gzhung tshang bar zab don snyang po ltar du shes de nas 'dzab bzlas bya ba ni hrī:rang nyid 'phags ma'i thugs klong du:nyi zla'i ga'u kha spyor sbubs rig pa trī la sngags kyis bskor:bzlas pas pha rol rbod gtong gi:sbyor ba ngan pa zhi zhing stongs:tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams rtogs rgyas:snang grags rig gsum phyag rgya che:lha sngags chos sku'i rol par blta:hrī:sarba bi dza ya na ār+ya tā re shra sarba sidhi pha la hūṃ bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin gdengs ldan pas bye ba

pas gcag bzlas dngos grub thob nyams dang rtags pa 'a yon tan rgyas pha rngal darnga da spyor zha bar 'gyur sgrub dang las sbyor dmags pas bye bzlas tshad them tsha rtags mtshan 'byung the tshom med do sa ma yu de nas lasal sbyor ba ni byad ma 'bum bzlog srung 'khor bstan de yang shog dkar tha ga ngor mu khyud rim pa bcu gsum bskor lte bar gdugs dkar sku gzugs bri srog rten ཿsmo hūṃ gsum 'god de rgyab mu khyud gnyis pa la 'khor lo rtsibs lnga'i mdun nas brtsam hūṃ ma ma ཿ ni swā hā 'chang ba po'i lus — ga yid gsum srungs shig rak+ṣa rasnya ces pa rim bzhin g.yas bskor ro de rgyab mu khyud gsum pa laḥ 'cha ba po 'i lus ngag yad gsum bcing phyes phyes phrol phrol ban byad bon byad zhung zhung gi byad mi nag gas dmod byad skye bo' yos byad la klu mi ya byad wa srin ste brgyad kyi byad mtha' mi kla sgo'i rgya da nam mkha' la 'khor lo bskor ba'i byad sa la mnan pa'i byad me hom la bsregs pa'i byad rlung 'khor bskor ba'i byad chu la gtad du bcug pa'i byad mdor na bkra mi shes pa'i phyogs ris na pa thams cad las rnam pa kun tu bsrung du gsol kā ya wāk+ka tsat+ta rak+ṣa rasta sbyo de rgyab mu khyud bzhi pa la 'khor rtsib rim pa bcu gsum bkod tsakra re bsgrags sham bu ni 'chang ba po' lus ga yid gsum sru sa shig rashā rashā de rgyab mu khyud lnga pa la rgyud las byung ba'i gdug dkar mo yag ma / na bstan g.yon

bskor bre de rgyab mu khyur drug pa la rgyud las byung ba'i phyer bzlog ni ngan sngags chen mo de ltar bri de rgyab mu khyud bdun pa la gshin rje 'bar ba'i e ring sngags gdags bya'i sham bu 'di ltar ro byad bur rngodagatongangosasbyor ngan pa bzlog tu gsol ces pa dbu can tshag med du sngags ni grangs tshar bcu gsum bri de rgyab mu khyud brgyad pa la dbyangs gsal rten snying lan gsum bri de rgyab mu khyud dgu pa la rdor phreng 'od thag thig le bcas de rgyab mu khyud bcu pa la lcags zhags sgrog dril dag gis bskor de rgyab mu khyud bcu gcag par sa chu me rlung ru mo bri de rgyab mu khyud bcu gnyis par phur bu brgya dang rtsa brgyad bri de rgyab mu khyud bcu gsum pa me ri pa tras bskor ba'o rdzas ni ser nag dgu sbyor dang drag sbyor bco brgyad byug par bya sku la bzang drug chos sman phye snyang po seng ldeng phur pa ni sor gsum tog na g.yu byang bya tsardo ral gra sor gsum pa' yu ba byu ru ma ga gsum mdzes bla rdo pha wang long bu la ya smo shāsgyu rak+ṣa bri drug ching mchod rten ris su phab dar dmar gyis dril dkyil 'khor dbus gzhug la rnam lnga nyer spyod bkram lasagazhung bstang la zhag bdun sgrub rab tu gnas shing byan rlabs ni de nas zangs kyi ga'ur gzhugs 'bral med lus la bcang ba na byad ma 'bum gyis dmod bzlog las rnam pa ra rgyal 'gyur the tshom med sa ma mā de nas bzlas ram bya ba 'di ltar ro bya( swā snya

5/ wa sogs rto3nya: bdag snang mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las: shāthag 'phro 'dus 'khor 'das dngas bcud bstim yongs gyur skad cig rdo rje gtsug tor can: sku mdog dkar mo gangs la nyi shar 'dra: mdun zhal nyis brgya zhi la chags tshul can: g.yas zhal nyisabargya ser la rngam tshul ldan rgyab zhal nyis brgya mar la sgegs tshul can: g.yon zhal nyis brgya ljang la khro tshul ldan: steng zhal nyes brgya mthing la gtum rngam khro smin ma me 'bar srid gsum gzhob thul bsregs: shangs nas rlung g.yos byad phur rbod gtong gtor spyan gsum sdang mig khrag dang glog ltar g.yo: ya so sa:las khro bo sprin ltar 'khrigs: ma so hrīlas khro mo rdul ltar 'bebs: lce ni bsam gcod ral gris byad ma gtub: g.yas phyag stong gis byad bzlog 'khor lo bsnams: ban non byad ma'i nus mthu byad mar zlog: g.yon phyag stong gis byad ma'i tsit+ta bsnams 'byung po dam sri'i lus srog phral bar byed: zhabs rnams bsgrad pas bdud dang dam sri gnon: dar dpyangs stag sham rus rgyan mchog phreng bsnams ye shes me

'bar srid gsum bag chags bsreg snang stong 'dzin med sgyu ma'i sku ru bsgom: gnas gsum 'od kyis rgyal ba sras bcas dang bcom ldan gdugs dkar rnam par spyan drangs nas dam tshig bskyed pa'i lha la sib sib bstim: thugs dkar snol rang sngagasasnying pos bskor bzlas pas byad phur rbod gtong ngan pa bsreg: snang grags rig gsum bde ba chen por sad yengs med ting nge 'dzin la rtag tu gnas: rgyas par mos na rgyud las byung ba yi gdugs dkar bzla zhing yang na snya nga po ni tadu thā: tso a na legs na le: snyi sha dhe bhi sha dhe: be+e ra be+e ra: badz+ra dha ra ni: bhan+ta bhan+ta ni badz+ra pā ṇi phaṭa ( hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā: shā hūṃ bhan+ta bhan+ta phaṭa swā hā: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la rak+ṣa rak+ta swā hā:lus ngag yid gsum bcing pa phyes phyes khrol khrol: ces pa brgya stong la sogs bskyal de nas nye ba'i snying po ni hūṃ mam hūṃ ni swā hā: brgya stong khri 'bum bzlas pa yis ting 'dzin dmigs pa'i rno ldan na byad phur rbod gtong g.yul las rgyal ze tshom med do rdo rjes bka' sa ma yā de nas rjes rim tshogs mchod na rgyas par 'dod na zab snyang ltar bsdu bar mos na tshogs rdzas spungs bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas

gas slar 'bul bshags bstab pa'i rim pa ni hūṃ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i rdzas: bla med mchog gi mchod pa yis: gu ru rtsa gsum rgya mtsho dang: 'phags ma gzhan las rab rgyal ma'i: sku gsung thugs la mchod pa 'bul: mi dge sdig pa'i las kun bshags: log rtog rū tra kun bsgral nas: bde ba chen po'i 1nga du bstabs: mi mthun pha rol rgol ba zhi: phyogs las rnal rgyal dngos grub stsol: bdag dang bdag la 'brel thog kun: bde ba chen por sangs rgyas 31ga dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab bkra shis mtha' rten rgyas par bya gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag sku gnyis mngonadu 'thur bar nges the tshom med do sa ma yā glem rgyal ba' dbang po pa d+ma ngas snyeng tig zab pa 'i bcud phyung ba gsang ba bdor bkod tsa tir sbas klu bdud btsan la gnyer byang gtad snyigs ma'i gzugs slong g.yo ba'i tshe nga sprul nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel chos bdag dpa' be dpa 'a mo yi bsgo skar chul bzhin brten nus na 'di phyir phan 'de'i nya ma 'khrungs ral na mi 'dod sna dgu 'bebs de phyir gces par zung la bsgom yid bzhin nor bus dbul ba sel skal med la ga tu ma shor zhag 'dzad sred can la i tha rgya ye ya kai mkha' la dug mda' 'bebs

rgya stag rngam pa'i so bar 'chor me bde' 'khrug slong ya ma brla dpa' bo shud pu dpal seng gis 'joms par skad do sa ma mā brag ri dkar po gnam la 'phyong 'phur rtsal ldan pa' bya rgod chags 'ug chung leb mo'i rtsal 'khrum zer phan thabasamakhye' phyag na gda': pe ru zhwa yi lha khang nas re 'byams dug 'gyed sa la bab ngad pa grong khams bdun la bab bzlog mtshan sur+ya'i mtshan 'chang ngo a mi rgyal po ku ku'i rna mi 'dod gcan spyong ha la dang blo stobasacho 'phrul du ma 'gyed re ba'i sbubs su 'thum pa' tshe gar dbang he rus bzlog srid do seng lding lo 'bras ma 'thor na sman gyi gsos char 'gro la 'bebs bde ba'i myu gu rnam par 'khrungs mi baspu ba de mkha' 'gro'i brda sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugs zigs 'di snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya brda thim dzi ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag popad+ma chosa'aphel rgya margyasadar dang bri gzhi bcas bskul ba dang / grogs mo rat+na sa ras nan gyi bskul ba dang / chos bdag rang reg slob bu ye shesadad ldan chosagasal rnamasakyi ya yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa 'a bo nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris la zhal bshus te 'bros phug mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling nasadag par phab dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam/

r+ṣanags zab gsang mkha' 'dza'i thugs thig las 'phags mnags che da lha mo'i zab sgrub nyes pa kun sel bzhugs so pa na 31 gu dzag pad+mā ka ra ye: 5)gasnyarna nas rang rig pad+ma saṃ bha was snyigs ma'i 'gro la brtse sems kyis mi 'tshams nyes pa kun sel phyir 'phags ma nyer gcig phyag rgya bstan sa ma mā de yang nags khrod lha mo yi gsang sgrub sh+kagasu len 'dod na sngon 'gro zab don snying po ltar dngos gzhi bsgom par bya ba ni a: smra bsam brjod bral chos sku che: so ma rang grol byang chub sems ma 'gags rgyu yi sa bon trī: de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus zhu snod bcud dag mnyam yum lnga'i klong: rang gsal lhun grub gzhal med dbus ma chags pad+ma nyi zla'i steng:rngams pa sha za'i khri yi khar: rang rig hrī:yig zhu ba las bdag snanganags khrod lha molisku: mthing gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: spyan gsum zhi 'dzum khro gnyer

sgegs dar dang rat+na rus pas brgyan nyi zla'i do shal mjes pa 'phyangs: phyag g.yas bkra shis shing lo bsnams: 'gro la thugs rje'i bsil char 'bebs: g.yon na gri gug dku la brten bag chags 'khor ba'i 'khrul rgyun gcod: zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur khri la rol 'ja' 'od thig le 'khrigs pa'i klong: gsal stong sgyu ma'i sku ru bsgom gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las 'od 'phrosargyal ba sras dang bcas: khyad par 'phags ma'i lha tshogs rnams: spyan drangasaganyis su med par bstim spyan 'dren la sog gzhung tshang bar zab don snying po ltar du shes de naga'adzab bzlasabya ba ni hrī rang nyid 'phags ma'i thugs 1nga du: nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor sbubs: srog snying phyil sngags kyis bskor bzlasapas mi 'dod nyes pa'i tshogs: sbur ma med dang 'phrad pa bzhin ming tsam med par bsreg pa dang: tshe bsod nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas: snang grags rig gsum chos sku che lha sngags phyag rgya chen po'i ngang trī: ār+ya bi shā ra de wi ma hā sarba sirnyi pha la 〉ཿ dmigs pa ting 'dzan brtan po yis bye ba gcig bzlas dngos grub thob nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel zhing rgyas mi mthun

gas nyer 'che'i phyog rnamasazhi sgrub da la sbyor dmagasapa bye bzlas tshad them tsho rtags mtshan 'byung the tshom med da sa ma shā de nas lasal sbyor ba na btagasagral bre thabs sman shog ngor mu khyud rim pa bcu ru bkod lte bar rdo rje rtse lnga ser kun zlum dbus su bdakar bri de rgyab mu khyud gnyas pa la pad+ma 'dab drug bris pa yi shar nas rim par g.yas bskor du (khasgos (blo 77 (617 /thog sha 1 de rgyab mu khyud gsum pa la 'ja' zig bzhi bcu rtsa gnyas pa'i shar du hūṃ dang de rgyab mu de nas hūṃ dang bayig nas rim bzhin g.yas bskor tshul du ni a la nyi dza hrī tre swā māṃ wa hrī mu la a bye dra dre hrī ཿ sna34 hrī bltakyegrogyiñcak+ṣeye sno snosnosnopaṃsnohode rgyab mu khyud bzhi pa la 'od thig drug cu tham pa'i klong 57 rtsa zu ju 13 byu zang ltasnyanyanyaltanyaltanyanyihonyinyihohonyihodza snob ho spyospyospyospyoskyosmyospyo spyospyospyosgrosgrospyo spyospyosgrospyospyosmospyo sgrobh+yo spyo spyosmyospyospyode rgyabamu khyud lnga pa la o a li ka la tswa na pañca sa twa kro ta mu ne+e ye swā snya.oṃ sto dha tsit+ta ma hā su kha tswa na dhartu a oṃ ru lu ru lu hūṃ spyo hūṃ a badz+ra sa twa sa ma yu ma nu pā la ya badz+ra sa twa twe no pa ta ḍa ོ/ me bha wa su toskyo me bha wa a nu rak+to me bha wa su po〉 me bha wa sabo sirnyi

spe pra yas sarba garmā su tsa me tsiste shrī ya ku ru hūṃ ha ha ha ha ho bha ga wan sarba ta thā ga ta trī da ya badz+ra mā me muthu badz+ra bha wa ma hā sa ma mā sa twa yas de rgyab mu khyud drug pa la dbyangs dang gsal byed rten snyang bra las bzha'i sham bu gdags par bya de rgyab mu khyud 'dun pa la 'chang ba po'i lusangag yid gsum la rgyal ba zha khro rab 'byams kyi sku gsung thugs chags par gyur cig srog brtan par gyur cig ye shes kyi bcud gnas par gyur cig 'gyur ba med pa rdo rje ltar gnas shing nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cag mi dge ba' las dang dam tshag nyams chags 'gal 'khrul nyes lhung thams cad kun bzang yangs pa chen po'i klong du bskangs nas 'chang ba po la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol ma hā su kha sa hūṃ de rgyab mu khyud brgyad pa la rdo rje thag le zer phreng bra de rgyab mu khyud dgu pa la bkra shas rdzas rtags rgyal srad bdun de rgyab mu khyud bcu pa la nor 'dzin pa tra bri bar bya dzos ni bzang drug chos sman byug dal gzhug zhi khro'i bskyed bzlas da rab gnas nan du bya ba'o de nas zla tshes bzang po la mgul du btags pas nyams chags byang sngar byas sdig sgrib dag par 'gyur dge ba gang bsags 'bum 'gyur ro sdig pa' grangs ya de star ro gzab pa 'i 'jug ldog gnad la brtson 'chi tshe gdung da ring bsrel 'byung sgra 'od zer gsum rtags la mngo na de phyir btags

gas grol zhes su grags ze tshom med do sa ma shā e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma ngas snying gi ya tig zab pa'i bcud gsang ba brda yi ris su btab las can rjes lajug don du bkod mdo khams tsā ri'i shar du sbas klu bdud btsan la gnyer kha bcol ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga ya dus dus 'khrugs mtshon chas gze sa lang tshe nga sprul bdud 'joms glang pa yis rted nas bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub chos bdag dpa' bo bdun dang ni dpa' mo gsum gyi skal bar bsngags gtsug gis brgyud na dpa sa grub 'bebs sa la stor na bka' chad 'ong phongs 'tshengs nus pa zab mo'i gter rang srog las kyang gces par zungs skal med lag tu ma shor zhag 'dod sred can la a thams rgya i sa pa tra yisangar gdong la 'ug sha li ba'i kha skad 'doms lcang lo'i pukhye' ya ka na sman gyi khur khyams dha ma dhi ra rta lo sha' mjug ma de rdzo sa bzang mkhar ba' phyogs la 'gro rta la rwa rtse gnyis su snang mchog ga me tog lo ma gsum wa yi cod paṇa rlung gis bskyod a la skyab der sabha'i 'ji gnubs la ser ba'i zal dngar 'bebs dug gi ngad pa phyogs su gyes stag gi sman gcig rtsang la 'gro rtsang ga rje bo sasta'i bslu gnubs la ser ba'i zil dngar 'bebs dug gi ngad pa phyogs su gyes stag gi sman gcig rtsang la 'gro rtsang gi rje bo sabha'i bslu rngams pa 'i — mas bstabs khrag la bsre la yi chu mda' stod la 'phyo

a grags dkar mo byang na snyan sngo la sngon po g.yu tshang bca' dar stod sabha'i grong tsho chags rnga mgo 'thab ba'i dus zhig mchis myo na smad kyi dug mtsho khol 'ur zings sna tshogs cha ma mchis pho rog sha yis brgyag na yang thang dkar rgod kyisargyang bskor byed 'ol ba'i steg rgyug nyam re thag bzlog bsgyur mkha' 'gro'i brda lung bzhin brten na dge mtshan snye ma 'char the tshom med do rdo rjes bka' sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya mkha' 'gro 'bum gya srog tig 'di snying ga bu dang 'phrad par shog gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gas rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi ces pa 'da'ang chos kyi bdag po pa d+ma chos 'phel rgya mtshos dar da bri gzhi bcas bskul ba dang / chos bdag rang rig grogs mo rat+na sa ra slob bu ye shes dad ldan chos gsal rnams kyas bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes 'bros phug mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling nas dag pa ra pha ba pa dge legs 'phel sarba masgo lam/

sa na 31 gu ru padh+wa ka ra ye bstegatsāshāka ma bdag 'dra pad+ma saṃ bha was snyigs ma'i 'gro la brtse sems kyis gdug pa'i rkyen rnams 'joms pa'i phyor 'phags ma nyer gcig phyag rgya bstan sa ma mā de yang 'jig rten gsum rgyal la brten pa'i zab sgrub bsgom 'dod na sngon 'gro zab don snying po ltar dngos gzhi lha bskyed bya ba ni bablo 'das dgongs pa de bzhin nyid:rang gsal snying rje chen po'i mdangs:rgyu yi sa bon hrī:yig las 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas:tshur 'dus sgod bcud dag mnyam klong rang gsal pho brang mdzes pa'i dbus:ma chags pad+ma nyi zla'i steng:ka la pang ga'i khri yi khar:hrī bab yong gyur skad cig gis:bdag snang 'jig rten gsum rgyal sku dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa:spyan gsum 'dzum mdzes cung zad khro:dar dang rat+na rgyan rnams dang:ut+pa la yi do shal 'phyangs:phyag g.yas be con mkha' la phyar:bdud bgegs 'byung po rdul brlag byed:g.yon pas 'gyur med rgyal mtshan 'dzin:sgrub mchog tshe sgog brtan par byed:zhabs gnyis gar gyis khri la rol:'ja' 'od thig le 'khrigs pa'i klong:snang stong gnyis

pa su med par bsgom: gnas gsum rdo rje' sa rban las: 'id 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas khyad par 'phags ma' lha tshags rnams: spyan drangs gnyas su med par bstim: spyan 'dren la sogs gzhung sgos bar zab don snying po ltar du shes de nas 'dzab bzlas bya ba ni hrī rang nyid 'phags ma'i thugs klong du: nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor sbubs: srog snying hrī:la sngags kyis bskor bzlas pas bar chad nyer 'tshe'i rigs: sbur ma me dang 'phrad pa bzhin: ming tsam med par zhi ba dang: nyams rtogs yon tan 'byer ba rgyas:snang grags rig gsum bde ba che: lha sngags phyag rgya chos sku'i ngang: o ār+ya lo ka de wi bi dza ya sarba sidhi pha la hūṃ bskyed rdzogs tang 'dzin rno ldan pas bye ba gcag bzlas dngos grub thob tshe bsod dpal dang 'byor ba rgyas nyer 'tshe'i phyogs rnams zhi bar 'gyur sgrub dang las sbyor dmigs pas bye bzlas tshad them tshe rtags mtshan 'byung the tshom med do sa ma yu de na la lasbyor ba ni thog bsrung bya ba'i 'di ltar ro mthing shog ngos su mtshal dang ni bzang drug bsres la 'ad bzhin bri 'chang ba po la zabag gshā ga31na 'jigs pa zhi bar gyur cig ni nā ga tsa murnyi hūṃ phaṭa aḥ masu rusag na sarbasdatshon phaṭa

ces bri dbu can tshag med do dzos ni dgu sbyor gri lcags dang thog lcags sngags pa'i phur dpal drag byug la mjug nas yar dril zhing sna lnga'i bkris la la ca'i g.yog dal gzhug ra sngags snying po dang rten snying mjug tu 'khor lo' sngags gdags pa stong gis rab tu gnas 'bral med mgul btags bar chad zhi the tshom med do sa ma phu de nasanor nad bsrung ba'i thabs shog dmar dbus su rgya snag gis mu khyud rim pa lnga ru bskor lte bar sdigs pa ra tsa bri mgo la nan pa yi ge' gzugs na ste rgyab nas bcing ba yi ge'i gzugs ces gagaglud+ma/ro/gru(rngogatham — de rgyab mu khyud gnas pa la 'chang ba po la rgyu gzer rten bshal ba can gyis gnod pa bsrungs shig rak+ṣa ralta de rgyab mu khyud gsum pa la rten snyang mjug tu 'di bzhin gdag 'chang ba po la hon gyasasbyor ba ngan pa zhi zha zhig zhag shar+ghaṃ ku ru ye swā hā de rgyab mu khyud bzhi pa la sbrul gzug bra zhing mjes par bskor mu khyud lnga par me ri bri jos ni khyung lnga ri bong sha phag sha ra nag tshal gyis byug rgya lnga bsdo la dal dbus gzhug rnam lnga nyer spyod bkram nas su sgrub pa' gzhung bsrengs rab tu gnas bsrung bya la btang ton las rgyal the tshom med do sa ma mā de nas grib khrus bya ba la bum pa da la'i dbus su gzhug rnam lnga nyer spyod bkram byas la bum lha bskyed pa'i rim pa ni snyed ma hā do/ bye ta sogs ma ྅nya bum pa

mas mi dmigasastong pa'i ngang: mtshan nyed yongs rdzogs gzhal yas dbus: rbalas dngas gsal rgya tsho'i dbus: pad+ma'i sdong po gyes pa'i khar: bum lha 'jig rten gsum rgyal ma: ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: g.yas pa khrus kyi bum pa 'dzin: g.yon na dngul dkar dril bu bsnams: zhabs gnyis phyed pa'i skyil dpyong bzhugs: dar dang rat+na rus pas brgyan: 'ja' 'od thig le 'khrigs pa'i klong: snang stong sgyu ma'i sku ru bskyed: gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas bstim thugs gar nyi zla kha sbyor sbubs rig pa ༷ la sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas grib dang mi gtsang rigs: sbyangs bkru byed pa'i nus ldan gyur: 37 bhukho cirte bhi ma na a ā swā hā: brgya stong la sogs ci 'grub bskyal de nas las sbyor rim pa ni sa dz+nyā na ḍak+ki ni e: ye baṃ le paṃsarba bisno shirnye ku ru ye shudhe shud+dhi a ā swā hā: brgya rtsa brjod cang mchod bstod bya de nas bzhu btul bya ba ni lha nyid kyang 'od du zhu nas bum chu da 'dres par gyur de nas slob ma gral 'dod nas khrus kyis sbyangs bkru bya ba ni ྅: bde gtogags rgyal ba'i byin rlabs chu ye shes

bdud rtse 'bar ba yes: skal ldan bu la khrus bgye pas: lus ngag yid sgrib dag gyur cig:sarba pa dz+wa shidz+nya ku ru ye swā ྅ sa chos dbyings ye shes bum pa phu burnya regs kyi byin rlabs chus skal ldan bu la khrus bgyi pas gti mug nam mkha'i grib rnams kun: bkru zhing byab po dag gyur cig: 31 bhukho tsi bhi ma le bi na se a ā e:ga ga na e ho shudhe shudhe swā hā: kaka ka long ye shesabum pa na/rdo rje rigs kyi byin rlabs chus: skal ldan bu la khrus bgyi pas: zhe sdang chu khams grib rnams kun: bkru zhing byab po dag gyur cig:ma cakhri tsadza bi ma le bi na se a āḥ baṃḥn na khaṃ baṃ ho shudhe shuste swā hā hūṃ mnyam nyid ye shes bum pa ru rin chen rigs kyi byin skal ldan bu la khrus bgyi pas nga rgyal sa khams grib bkru zhing byab po dag gyur cig:sa bhukhri uleḥbhu mi pa ti: le:ho bud+dhi sa: sor rtog ye shes ye shes bum pa ru pad+ma rigs kyi skal ldan bu la khrus bgyi pas: 'dod chags me khams grib bkru zhing byab po dag gyur cig: sa bhukhaṃ sogs ram̐:dz+wa la ram̐: ram̐ he shud+dhi sa: bya grub ye shes bum pa dza las rab

gas rigs kyi byin skal ldan bu la khrus bgyi pas: phrag dog rlung khams greb bkru zheng byab so dag gyur ceg: o :rde sogs ye: wa yale: ye:heshukhye sa:bde chen ye shes bum pha rol phyin drug chu yis bkang: skal ldan bu la khrus bgyi pas: dug lnga ser sna'i grib rnams kun: bkru zhing byab po oṃ bhurde eḥye baṃḥlo re:phaṭa shud+dhishukhye swā hā: ces bkru de nas byab pa ni sa: dug gis dug 'joms rma bya'i mdangs: lha mo chen mo'i gzi 'od kyis skal ldan bu yi lus byab pas: nad gdon grib rnams phyi bar bgyi: skyes byukhaṃ tsirte sogs e ye ram̐:baṃ:le:kwa ya wāka cit+ta bcing pa phyes phyes khrol khrol a pa na ye swā hā: de nas bsrung ba' rgyas 'deb ni lha: nad gdon grib kyi g.yul ngo las: bsrung bya skal ldan ma lus rgyal: 'gyur med bsrung ba'i gur du tshud: mi shig rdo rjes rgyas gdab po: ma dz+nyā na badz+ra rak+ta rak+ta: de nas shis pa brjod pa ni hrī: gsang sngags bzlas brjod bden pa yis skal ldan nad med lang tsho dar: bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa yi: bkra shis dam pa stsal du gsol: ma su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā snya gnad des mi gtsang

grob lasargyal the tshom mid do sam mā de nasarjes ma tshogs mchod be+e rgyas par mos ne zab snyeng ltar bsdu bar 'dod na tshogs dzos spungs bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas slar 'bul bshagasabastab pa' ram pa ni trī: gsang chen rmad du byung ba'i rdzas bla med mchog gi mchod pa ni: ga ṇa tsakra'i gter chen po: gu ru rtsa gsum rgya mtsho dang khyad par 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi: sku gsung thugs la mchod pa 'bul sor byang sngags sdom nyams pa bshags: log 'khrul dam sri kun bsgral nas ye shes gsang ba'i klong du bstabs nyer 'che'i rkyen snang kun bral zhing: phyogs las rnam rgyal dngos grub stsol: bdag dang 'brel thog ma lus pa: tshom bu gcig tu sangs rgyas 31ga: dge ba bsngo zhang smon lam gdab bkra shis mtha' brten rgyas par bya gnad desatshogasardzogs sgrib pa dag sku gnyis mngon du 'gyur bar nges ze tshom med do sa ma yu e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma ngas snying gi yang thig zab pa'i bcud gsang ba brda yi ris su btab lasaldan rjes 'jug don du brtsams mdo khams tsa ri'i shar du sbas klu bdud btsan la gnyer kha bcol ma 'ong sa snyigs ma lnga yi dus dus 'khrug mtshon chas gzengs lang tshe sprul bdud 'joms gling pa yis rted nas bstan

ga 'gro'i don chen 'grub chosabadag dpa' bo bdun dang ni dpa' mo gsum gyi skal bar bsngags brten mchod shes na phan bde 'bar ral bar gyur na phung bar nges phu 'tshengs nusapa zab pa 'a gter gces pa 'i srog las btsa' shes mdzod skal med lag tu ma shor cag 'dod sred can la a tham rgya 'u tshug mkhan la rlung ma bsgrags e gsang chen gangs ri rab dkar na ma rmos bzhin tu nor bu 'khrung yar sding rab mdzes brag dkar na dpag bsam shing gi lo 'bras spud gser nya 'gros ba 'i ba gam la 'ja' 'od stong gi pad tshal 'khrung rta bdun rnal ma'i 'od khyims nang bkra shis lha dung dkar po 'khyil ku mud tshal chen g.yo ba ru bde ba' ut+pal la lha yis bsnams rigs ldan skyes bu dharma'i ming pad+ma 'od gsal snyang por sad rig ldan skyes bu mkhyen rab ming pad+ma tshul khrims bkod par rdzogs rig ldan skyes bu sems nyid ming pad+ma bsod nams nyid la 'dus 'khrul zhig ngag dbang phrin la de sngags pa'i khyims na sur+ya'i ming las 'joms pad+ma bkra shis de gnubs rigs dz+nyā na'i gzugs su 'phos bcu pa zlo ba bzang po de ba 'i khyims la kame'i mang de sogs las smon rten 'brel gyis dus su rnam par 'tshogs 'gyur ro the tshom mi mnga' rdo rjes bka' sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi snyang khrag 'di thugs kya sras dang 'phrad par shog gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya

gsang rgya gu rgya brda tham lha ces pa 'da'ang pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtshos dar dang bri gzhi bcas bskul ba dang chos bdag rang rig slob dpon ye shes grogs rat+na sa ra dad lngan chos rgyal rnams kyas bskul rngar bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes 'dros phug mkha' 'gro'i 'du glang nasadag par phab pa'o sarba maṅga lam/
khoskags zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: 'phags mnor rgyun lha mo'izab sgrub nor gyi gter mdzod bzhugs so:

gas na lnga gu na pad+mā ka ra ye: zanadenasgo/40rta / bdag 'dra pad+ma bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis dbul phung 'byor rgud skyob pa'i phyir 'phags ma nyer gcig phyag rgya bstan sam yu de yang nor rgyun lha mo la brten nas zab sgrub bsgom 'dod na sngon 'gro zab don snying po ltar dngos gzhi lha bskyed bya ba ni yi chosakun midamigs spros mtha' bral: rang gsal snying rje chen po'i mdangs: rgyu yi sa bon nyiyig las: 'od zer 'phro 'dus snod bcud rnams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dal du rdzogs de dbus lhun grub pho brang dbus ma chags pad+ma nyi zla'i steng 'dod 'jo'i ba dkar khri yi khar: rig pa nyibab yongs gyur las: bdag snanganor ster lha mo' sku: gser mdog zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma 'dzum gnyer zhi tshul chags pa'i nyams: dar snang rat+na'i rgyan chas dang nor bu'i do shal mdzes pas brgyan phyag g.yas 'bral kyi snye ma bsnams: dad ldan gdul bya'i lo tog smin g.yon pa gter gyi bum pa bsnams: 'gro ba'i re skong char ba 'bebs: zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur khri la rol: 'ja' dang 'od phung 'khrigs pa'i 1nga: rang gsal sgyu ma'i sku

gan ru bskyed gnas gsum rdo rje'is bon las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas: khyad par 'phags ma'e lha tshogs rnams: kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin:spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstim spyan 'dren la sogs gzhung tshang bar zab don snying po ltar du shes de nas 'dzab bzlas bya ba ni hrī: rang nyid 'phags ma'i thugs klong du nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor sbubs: srog snying trī75 sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas 'khor 'das dngas bcud rnams: bsdus te rnal 'byor bdag la bstim: tshe bsod dpal yon 'byor rgyas bsam: snang grags rig gsum bde ba che lha sngags phyag rgya chen po'i ngang trī:ma ma bā su dha ri shrī sarba rat+na bā su kha dhe na na sirnyi pha la hūṃ sa: bskyed rdzogs dmags bsgom ldan pa yis bye ba gcig bzlas dngos grub thob nyams dang rtogs pa' yon tan rgyas dpal dang 'byor ba phun sum tshogs sgrub dang las sbyor dmigs pa sa dbye bzlas tshad song tshe rtags mtshan 'byung the tshom med do sa ma wā de nas lasal sbyor ban gza' skar 'phrod sbyor phun tshogs nyin da la gru bzhi mda' gang dpag g.ya rgye rat+na'i rnam pa can 'byu sna rin chen phye ma phyur jor gyi snying ro yi ge gzhug g.yang bshos pa d+ma zhal dkar dang rnam lnga

nyer spyod dag gis bskor mkho ba'i chas rnams yongs su bsags bsangs khrus 'gong po bkar byas la g.yang sgrub bya ba 'di ltar ro rnal 'byor blo sems dwangs ba yis snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad do snyenaswā bha sogs shukhro3nya mi dmigs chos dbyings ngang nyid las: lhun grub rang gsal zhing bkod ni: gnyis 'thung thal dkar mche ba can: cang shes gser gyi rgyan cha can:'dod 'jo'i ba mo 'o rgyun 'bebs: kun kyang gser kyi phye ma dang: g.yu yi ne'u seng tshal na rtse: rdzing bu yan lag brgyad ldan las: nor bu rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun: rlab las rnam par 'phro zhing ngoms dpag bsam shing gi thog bu ni 'dod yon ro brgya nus ldan 'phyangs: bya rigs snyan pa'i glu len cing: ri dwags rtse 'jo bro gar bsgyur ma rmos lo tog 'bras bu ldan: gter gyis bum pa longs spyod mdzod: lha klu mi yi rgyan bkod rdzogs: de dbus rat+na lnga ldan gyis: pho brang yid du 'ong ba'i dbus: 'dod 'byung gnod sbyin bang mdzod ni: nor bu bsam 'phel dbyibs dang ldan 'ja' dang 'od kyi gur khar 'khrigs: longs spyod nor gyis phyur ba'i dbus: pad+ma gter gyi bum pa'i

gas steng:g.yang gi lha thonor rgyun ma sku mdog ser mo gser gyi mdog:phyag g.yas 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams:'byu sman zas kyi char ba 'bebs:g.yon pa gter gyi bum pa bsnams 'dod rgu'i longs spyod char ltar 'bebs:longs sku'i rgyan chas bcu gsum spras:nor bu ku mud dpyangs pa 'phur:mdzes 'dzum lang tsho chog mi shes sgrub pa po la brtse sems ldan zhabs ni phyed pa'i skyil krung bzhugs:snang stong 'od kyi sku ru gsal:spyi bor sangs rgyasarin chen rgyal mtha' 'khor 'phags ma nyi shu gcig pad+ma'i lcags kyu mda' dar 'dzin:gar bsgyur lang tsho ma nges par phywa g.yang sdud cing dngos grub 'bebs gnas gsum rdo rje'is bon las:'od 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas:nor rgyun lha mo'i rnam pa na kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa bzhin spyan drangs bskyed pa'i lha la thim gnyis med du ma ro gcig gyur:rdzas la bcud chags rnam rgyal lha'i dkor nor dag las khyad par 'phags mkha' las bdud rtsi'i char ba 'bebs:bar snang phywa g.yang longs spyod 'tshubs:sa gzhir zas nor bcud kyis bkang:

tshur 'dus sgrub pa po la bstem: bang mdzod gter la dbang thob bsam: yo ār+ya bā sudha ri ma ma sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ na mo rat+na tra ya yā: na mo be+e shra ma ṇa: ma hā ra dza ya:taduthā: si mi si mi tsan+ta tsasto tsa ra tsa ra ka ra ka ra: ki li ki li: ku ru ku ru mu ru mu ru tsu ru tsu ru san+ta pa ye: at+pa rna7sted dan: e dha ra dhu ru swā hā na mo be+e shra ma ṇa ye swā sna dha na dha ye swā hā: na mo rat+na pa ri swā hā: mi nor zas gsum 'dod rgu'i longs spyod thams cad dhi shra ma ṇa he par+ṇa rat+na sarba sirnyi bsdus bsdus pa shaṃ ku ru khug skyol brgya stong la sogs gang skabasabashe da de nas g.yang 'gug bya ba ni dar dkar g.yab cing bsang dud spro rol mo snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas 'ad nyid brangs ldan bskyal bar bya e phun cesags bkra shis dge ba'i lha: sngon smon thugs bskyed dag pa yis: g.yang gi lha mo dpal chen mo: rje btsun 'phags ma nyi shu dang: sgrol dmar khams gsum dbang sdud dpal: tā re yid bzhin 'khor lo rnams rnal 'byor gdung ba'i tshig gis 'bod: deng sang snyigs ma lnga yi dus: nad mug mtshon chas gzengs pa lang skye rgu mi 'dod nyes pas gzir khyad par

can sgrub mchog bdag cag rnams: chos la mos shing dben par spro: 'du 'dzi spangs nas yang dag gi: bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed mos kyang 'tsho ba zas gos dbul bas na: g.yang gi lha mor snyan gsan phab: dar dkar g.yab mo bsangs dud bcas: rol mo'i sgra yis spyan 'dren na ma thogs gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol:dkar gsum mngar gsum sman phud dang: g.yang nga61sa nor bus mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bskangs: nyams chags 'gal 'khrul nong pa bshags:lha yi mnga' thang longs spyod stsol: tshe ring nad med bde ldan shog: mi yi zas nor phywa g.yang stsal: mthun rkyen 'byor ba phun tshogs shog: klu yi dgos 'dod char ba stsol: mi zad gter la spyod par shog che drag stobs kyi dngos grub stsol khams gsum mnga' 'og sdud par shog: gdul bya 'bangs 'khor dngos grub stsol: thams cad chos kyis 'tsho bar shog: tshe ring nad med dngos grub stsol: sgrub pa mtha' ru phyin par shog rnal 'byor 'di bde phyi skyid kyi bkra shis nyi ma 'char bar shog: yangs pa'i rgyal khams

ma lus la: 'dod yon char rgyun 'bebs par shog: 'brel ba'i sems can ma lus pa g.yu lo can du phyin par shog: sa sā ste sidhi maṅga lam: ces pa ci 'grub brjod pa dang gtor ma phul la 'dod gsol gdab sgrub pa' rdzas la brtan par bzhugs mthar ni dngosagrub tshul du len de yis phyi nang nyer 'tshe zhi longs spyod 'byor rgyasatshe dpal ldan the tshom med do sa ma yā de nas rjes rim tshogs mchod ni rgyas par mosan zab snying ltar bsdu na tshogasadzos yo byad spungs bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas slar 'bul bshags bstabs pa'i rim pa ni:hrī: rnam dag kun bzang rol pa'i rdzas: rmad byung ga ṇa tsakra'i gter: ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud chen pos: gu ru rtsa gsum rgya mtsho dang: 'phags ma nor ster lha mo yi: sku gsung thugs la mchod pa 'bul: sdom gsum bslab pa nyams pa bshags: ma rtog log 'khrul kun bsgral nas: ye shes gsang ba'i klong du bstabs: mi mthun nyer 'tshe zhi ba dang: 'dod rgu'i longs spyod gru char 'bebs: phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub stsol: bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus pa: kun tu bzang po'i sa thob 31ga: dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrob pa dag sku

ga gnyis mngon du 'gyur bar nges the tshom med do sa ma yā tshem rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma ngas snying tig zab pa'i bcud phyung ba gsang ba brda yi ris su btab ma 'ongs skal ldan don du bkod mdo khams tsā ri'i shar du sbas klu bdud btsan la gnyer kha bcol ma 'ongs snyags ma lnga yi dus nad mug mtshon chas gzengs lang tshe nga sprul bdud 'joms gling ba yas rnyed nas bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub chos bdag dpa' bo bdun dang ni dpa' mo gsum gyi skal bar bsngags legs par brten na 'ad phyar dge ral na mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'ong phung 'tsheng nus pa rin chen gter srog las gces par btsa' shes mdzod skal med lag tu ma shor cig 'u tshug mkhan la a tham rgya yi ya kolcagasakyi ri bo la phra men stag zhag 'byang ngo shar stag ga 'dzum la chas pa'i tshe mche ba'i bar du 'chor nyan gda' pha ka brag la re 'byams ru blo 'phrul 'ug nag kha ros 'doms brgyud na dug lce'i reg nyis gda' zug rngu mi bzod snang ba mngon na ki shing chen yal 'dab 'og brten pa'i rnga mong rtsed mo byed ma mthong rig dga' nye gyur na than 'gyed 'byung ngo ya ma brla ma ki rgya mtsho 'khyal ba'i klong gser mig 'dzum pa'i lang tsho ston dga' ba'i ltad mo rab byas na chu srin gdug pa'i la nye yod stod na spug po'i gzhi ma la nor gyi bang mdzod khyad par 'phags brten na chos brgyad nam mkhar mnyam phya

mar sems can der ma gnas lho na nagasatshal 'thibasapa'i khrod gdul bya longs spyod bsam mi khyab brten na nyon mongs 'dam dzob rgyang dbyings la ltos shig chosasku'i rtsal nub na ku mud mang po'i tshal 'dab ldan ge sar lnga brgya yod brten na tshom bu pha khyims 'gro ngo mtshar skyid pa der gnas 'tshal byang na ru sbal mkhal 'og snya ral khur 'dus sde khro ma 'bum brten na kun gyisagatsug na spud sgrib bral nyi rgyasarten 'brel yod brten mi bca' legs shol ngo snang shel gyi bum bzang sgod kyi nang bdud rtsi 'chi gso bcud kyisagatams da nas rang gis nan du btung gzhan la yang yang 'dem par zhu rten 'brel sna kha ma 'chug na yang dag phun tshogs nyi ma shar kairti ka ri e ma ho sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya mkha' 'gro 'bum gya srog tog 'di snying ga bu dang 'phrad par shog gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya brda zim snyi ces pa 'di'ang chosakyi bdag po pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtshos dar dang bri gzha bcas bskul ba dang / chos bdag rang rig gi grog mo rat+na sar slob bu ye shesadad ldan chos gsal rnams kyas bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nusaldan rdo rjesa'abros phug mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling nas ḍagi'i brda risadag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam/
khozhepa sa zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: 'phags ma bkra shis don byed gyi zab sgrub bdud rtsi'i bum bcud bzhugs so:

gas na mo gu dzag padha ka ra ye: gichenartags shā1— bdag 'dra pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis bsam pa'i don rnams lhun grub phyir 'phags ma nyer gcig phyag rgya bstan sa ma phu de yang bkra shis don byed mar brten nas gsang sgrub bsgom 'dod na sngon 'gro zab don snying po ltar dngos gzhi lha bskyed bya ba ni gis chos kun mi dmigs spros mtha' bral rang gsal byang chub sems kyi mdangs thabs shes sa bon rig pa hrī: 'od zer 'phro 'dus snod bcud rnams: dag pa yum chen lnga yi klong: de dbus 'gyur med pho brang dbus: ma chags pad+ma nyi zla'i steng rtsal ldan cang shes khri yi khar: hrī bab yongs su gyur pa las bdag snang bkra shis don byed sku: dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: mdzes 'dzum lta bas chog mi shes dar dang rat+na'i rgyan rnams rdzogs: man+ta ra ba'i do shal 'phyangs: phyag g.yas pad+ma'i char chen 'bebs: sgrub pa po la bkra shis byed g.yon pas chos dung dkar po bsnams grags pa'i dbyar rnga phyogs bcur sgrogs zhabs gnyis gar gyis khri la rol: 'ja' 'od thig le 'khrigs pa'i klong stong gsal sgyu ma'i sku ru

can bskyed gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas: khyad par 'phags ma'e lha tshogs rnams: spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstim spyan 'dren la sogs gzhung tshang bar zab don snying po ltar du shes de nas 'dzab bzlas bya ba ni hrī: rang nyid 'phags ma'i thugs klong du: nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor sbubs rig pa ༷ la sngags kyi bskor: bzlas pas chos mthun bsam pa dang: mdzad spyod gang brtsam lhun gyis grub bkra shis dge ba'i lang tsho bskyed: phyi nang nyer 'tshe zhi ba dang: tshe bsod dpal 'byer nyams rtogs rgyas: snang grags rig gsum bde ba che: lha sngags phyag rgya chos sku'i ngang 37 ār+ya maṅga lam sarba ma hā sirnyi pha la hūṃ a bskyed rdzogs ti 'dzin rno ldan pas bye ba gcig bzlas dngo sa grub thob nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rgyas bkra shis mdzad pa mthar phyin 'gyur sgrub dang las sbyor dmigs pas phye rtags mtshan yon tan dus su smin the tshom med do sa ma yu de nas las la sbyor ba na sman shog gtsang mar bzang drug byug gser ram mtshal gyis 'di bzhan dgod mu khyud rim pa bcu ru bya lte bar sme 'khor dbus dgu spug kha dog bsgyur tshul nor mi bya mu khyud gnyis par spar kha brgyad

phyag rgya'i tshul bkod kha dog bsgyur mu khyud gsum par gza' brgyad kyi phyag rgya kha dog mdzes par bya mu khyud bzha par 'di bzhin bri ho tsā ma lawa ra ya 'chang ba po yi chos mthun gyi bya ba mthar phyin zhing bkra shisaphun sum tshogs pa'i las rnams grub pa dang nyams rtogs yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol maṅga lam sirnyi badz+ra mu khyud lnga par pad 'dab brgyad shar nas rim par g.yas skor du mkhyen rab dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo chags zog bral ba'i she rab phun sum tshogs pa stsal du gsol dra med snying rje' mnga' bdag la phyag 'tshal lo stong nyid snying rje 'khrungs bar mdzad du gsol mthu stobs mnga' bdag badz+ra pa ṇi la phyag 'tshal lo mi mthun nyer 'tshe zhi bar mdzad du gsol sems dpa' sa yi snyang po la phyag 'tshal lo 'jag rten dge ba'i lasarnams 'phel bar mdzad du gsol sgrib bral thugs rje'i mnga' bdag la phyag 'tshal lo gzung 'dzin ma rig pa'i dri ma dang bral du gsol 'dzags bral nam mkha'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo bkra shas phan bde'i lang tsho bskyed du gsol 'gro 'dren byamasapa mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo skye rgu chos kyis 'tsho bar mdzad du gsol skye med kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal khams gsum 'od skur grol bar byin gyis rlobs mu khyud drug pa ra rten snyang dang rnal 'byor pa bdag gi chos mthun gyi bya ba brtsam pa la nye bar 'tshe ba'i rkyen snang zhi ba dang legs pa'i yon tan gong

pa nasagong du 'phel la don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis kyi snang ba stsal du gsol ma lam su sto sirnyi e me mu khyud bdun par dbyangs gsal byed lasabazhi'i shams bcas bri bar bya mu khyud brgyad par rtags brgyad bri mu khyud dgu par rdzas sna bdun mu khyud bcu par nor 'dzin bri rdzas na bdud rtsi chos sman byug rgya lnga bsdams la dar gyis dral da la'i dbus gzhug rnam lngas bskor las gzhung bsreng ma zhag bdun bar sgrub nas 'bral med lus la bcing bkra shis dge ba'i bya ba rnams mthar phyin 'gyur ba gdon mi za sa ma yā de nas thal mo sbyar byas la dad mos gdung ba drag po yis rgyal ba sras bcas mdun mkhar gsal bkra shis brtsegs pa 'di nyid bskyar snyed bde legs su gyur cig: phyogs bcu rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams na: bzhugs pa'i phun tshogasabakra shis dge ba'i lha: mnyam med ston pa bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong lung rtogs dam chos sde snod bsam mi khyab: tshogs mchog dam pa 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la: rab tu gus pa'i blo yis phyag 'tshal lo: bkra shis phan bde'i snang ba rgyas gyur cig bla med bla ma gu ru pad+ma 'byung lhag pa'i lha mchog badz+ra ku ma ra: 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs rje btsun sgrol ma dang: thugs bskyed rmad byung

bkra shis don byed mar:rab tu gus pa'i blo yis phyag 'tshal lo:bkra shis phan bde'i snang ba rgyas gyur cig:sangs rgyas sgron me'i rgyal po rtsal ldan dpal:bde gshegs byams pa'i rgyan dpal dam pa'i tog:sangs rgyas nor brtsegs dpal gyi dam pa dang:bde gshegs rnam gzigs kun la dgongs pa can:sangs rgyas mthu thob gzigs pa mtha' yas dpal:bde gshegs mi g.yo lhun po beḍūr mdog:sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul zla med rtsal chen grags:bde gshegs yid tshams mtshan thos bkra shis la:rab tu gus pa'i blo yis phyag 'tshal lo:bkra shis phan bde'i snang ba rgyas gyur cig:mkhyen rab dbang phyug snying rje'i gter mdzod 'chang:mthu stobs rmad byung sems dpa' sa yi snying sgrib pa rnam sel 'jigs bral nam mkha'i dbang:'gro mgon byams pa kun tu bzang po la:rab tu gus pa'i blo yis phyag 'tshal lo:bkra shis phan bde'i snang ba rgyas gyur cig:skyob pa gser gdug bkra shis rat+na'i nya:kun zlam bum pa chags bral ka ma la:rgyang grags dung dkar phun tshogs da pal bes dbang bsgyur 'khor lo mi

mo/ nub rgyal mtshan la: rab tu gus pa'i blo yis phyag 'tshal lo: bkra shis phan bde'i snang ba rgyas gyur cig: sgeg mo phreng thogs rin chen glu gar ma: bdug pa me tog mar me dri chab dang: byang chub thugs bskyed byang chub sems ma'i sku: 'gro rnams bde stong lam la 'god mdzad la: rab tu gus pa'i blo yis phyag 'tshal lo: bkra shis phan bde'i snang ba rgyas gyur cig: tshangs pa stobs chen bde 'byung sred med bu: lha dbang brgya phyin rgyal chen yul 'khor bsrung: 'phags skyes bu dang spyan mi bzang po dang rnam thos sras rnams phyag mtshan sna tshogs 'dzin: rab tu gus pa'i blo yis phyag 'tshal lo bkra shis phan bde'i snang ba rgyas gyur cig ye nas bkra shis chos dbyings nams mkha' che: yongs su bkra shis nyi zla gza' skar tshogs: kun la bkra shis rdzogs ldan snang ba yis: 'dzam gling tha gru ma lus khyab gyur cig: bdag cag mos ldan skye bo thams cad kyis: bkra shis dge ba'i lha la gsol gdab na: chos mthun bsam pa lus 'grub pa dang: gang brtsam bya ba 'dod don mthar phyin cing: bkra shis snang bas

sa gas ma khyab sdomar ceg: de ltar smon pas re 'bras 'grub phyi nang nyer 'tshe zha ba dang bkra shis dge ba'i lang tsho rgyas the tshom med do sa ma pā de nas rjes rim tshogasamachod na rgyas par mos na zab snyang ltar bsdu na tshogs dzos po byad spungs bsangs sbyangs byan gyis brlabs nas slar 'bul bshags bstabs pa'i rim pa na hrī bde chenang gsang sngags bla med rdzas: rmad byung ga ṇa tsakra'i gter: ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud chen po: gu ru rtsa gsum rgya mtsho dang khyad par bkra shis don byed ma'i sku gsung thugs la mchod pa 'bul dam tshig nyams chags 'gal 'khrul bshags: ma rig log rtog dam sri bsgral: ye shes gsang ba'i 1nga du bstabs: rnal 'byor 'dod don phun sum tshogs bkra shis dge ba'i dngos grub stsol: bdag sogs 'gro ba ma ba/sa pa: gdod ma'i gzhi la sangs rgyas regag: dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdam bkra shisamatha' rten rgyas par bya gnad des tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang sgrib dag sku gnyis mngon du 'gyur the tshom med do sa ma yu ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma ngas snying tig zab pa' bcud byung ba gsang ba brda ya ris su btab phyi rabs skal ldan don du bkod mdo khams tsā ri'i shar du sbas klu bdud btsan la gnyer kha bcol ma 'ongs

gas snyigs ma lnga yi dus nad mug mtshon chas gzengs lang tshe nga sprul nus ldan rdo rje yis rnyed nas bstan 'gro'i don chen 'byung chos bdag dpa' bo bdun da ni dpa 'a mo gsum gya skal bar bsngags legs par brten na 'di phyar dge ral bar gyur na phongs bar 'gyur phongs 'tshengs nus pa rin chen gter gces pa'i srog bzhan btsa' shes mdzod skal med lag tu ma shor cig 'u tshug can la a tham rgya ye shar nasarma byamizlos gar bsgyur g.yu sgra' sprul ba burnya dṛ zab gsang phyag rdor bka' bab yin lho nas stag gi 'phyong rtsal can ldan ma'i sprul ba jor bu'i ming gu ru drag po'i chos bdag po nub na gdo lnga'i g.yu ral sprugs lha dpal sprul ba badz+ra ming thugs sgrub rnam gsum bka' bab yin byang nas spre'u'i rol gar bsgyur dran nam sprul ba me tri'i ming 'jam dpal gshin rje'i bka' bab legs shar lho mas bu'i rtse 'jo byed rgyal mchog sprul ba masgo'i ming rta mgran dmar po'i bka' bab yin lho nub g.yu 'byugs gsung dbyangs sgrogs lu hi'i sprul pa su kha'i ming brtul zhugs sngags kyi bka' yang bab nub byang gser mdog sbrul la rol g.yu lu dpal bzang ma hā'i mang thugs rje chen po' chos bdag legs byang shar cang shes zhen pa'i bu sprel chung sprul pa su r+ya' mtshan mdzod rgyal sgrub sde'i bka' bab ste brgyad kyang tshogs smon las 'phro yis dus su 'dzom par ze ma tshom dpa 'a

bo chen po'i thab kyis zungs bstan 'gro'i don 'byung ye ma ho sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugs bcud 'di snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya bdo tham lha ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtshos dar dang bri gzhi bcas yang yang bskul ba dang / chos bdag rang rig dang grogs mo rat+na sa ra slob bu ye shesadad ldan chos gsal rnams kyas yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje 'brosaphug mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling nas brda lhag chad med par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma lam/ dza yan+tu/
khoshepas zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las:'phags ma dgra dpung 'joms ma'i zab sgrub dgra bgegs g.yul 'joms bzhugs so:

pas na re gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye za denarga'o/sa / bdag 'dra pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis mtha' dmag rdul du brlag pa'i phyir 'phags ma nyer gcig phyag rgya bstan sa ma wā de mang dgra dbung 'joms ma la brten nas gsang sgrub bsgom 'dod na sngon 'gro zab don snying po ltar dngos gzhi lha bskyed bya ba ni yi chos rnams mi dmigs gzhi rtsa bral: rang gsal ma 'gags snying rje'i mdangs: rig pa nyiyig shar ba las 'od zer 'phro 'dus snod bcud rnams yum chen lnga yi rol bar rdzogs: de dbus lhun grub pho brang dbus ma chags pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: rngams pa gzigs gi khri yi khar: rgyu yi sa bon zhu ba las: bdag snangadagra dbung 'jomasama'i sku: nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: spyan gsum mche gcigs khro gakhum rngam: dar dang rat+na rus pas brgyan: gzigs gi sham thabs mgo phreng spras: phyag g.yas rdul brlag thob btegs: kla klo gdug pa'i tshogs rnams 'dul g.yon pa'i gnam lcags phur pa gzir: rgya 'dre'i sgog dbug drungs nas 'byin zhabs gnyis gar gyis khri la rol 'ja' 'od thig le lnga yi klong: gsal stong

ga 'dzin med 'od skur bskyed: gnasagasum rdo rje'is bon las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas: khyad par 'phags ma'i lha tshogs rnams: spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstim spyan 'dren la sogs gzhung tshang bar zab don snying po ltar du shes de nas 'dzab bzlas bya ba ni trī: rang nyid 'phags ma'i thugs klong du nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor sbubs rig pa rdi la sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas mtha' mi kla klo dang: 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus pa: sbur ma me dang 'phrad pa bzhin: ming tsam med par bsreg pa dang: tshe bsod dpal yon 'byer ba rgyas snang grags rig gsum bde ba che: lha sngags phyag rgya chos sku'i ngang: yin a ya ma duṣ+ṭan dṛ tri sha hūṃ mā ra ya pāṭa swā hā bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzan ldan pa yis bye ba gcig bzlas dngos grub thob nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rgyas bar chad bstan dgra kla kle'i tshogs ra zhing byer gyur gdon mi za sgrub dang las sbyor dmags pas phye rtags mtshan yon tan khyad 'pha gas 'byung ze tshom med do sa ma yu donas lasal sbyor ba ni drug cu sum cu nyi shu pa dang po zan gyi gtor ma ni ser po gru gang zung lajug ldan zhal rto me ri dag gas mdzes rtsang mtshe dug nyung drwa ba bya de nas bskyed bzlas bya

ba ni rang nyid 'phagasama'i nga rgyal gyis e swā bha wa so sogs ): stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las dpal gyi gtor chen 'bar ba las 'od zer 'phros: dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus te yongs su gyur pa las 'jig byed nā ga rak+ta sku mdog ser nag: dbu dgu khro la gshe zhing gtum pa sbyan gsum sdang mig glog ltar 'khyug pa: mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs shing zhal rnams rab du gdengs ba: smrar smin las me yi tshwa tshwa tho ro ro 'phro ba: shangs nas (ཿsgra 'brug ltar ldir ba: dmar ser ral ba gyen du 'khyil ba'i khrod nas khro chung me yi tsha tsha ltar 'phro ba: phyag g.yas sa dgu yis spu gri bsnams nas bstan dgra'i phung khams dum bur gtub pa: g.yon pa dgu yis bhasnyo dmar gyis bkang ba bsnams pas dgra bo'i skye rgyun gcod pa: dpal dang dur khrod kyi chas rdzogs pa: rab 'jigs srin po khros pa'i rnam 'gyur can: lto bar zhal gyi ho bung rab tu gdangs ba: dug dang rlangs pa ngad pa 'thul ba: sku smad sbrul mjug g.yas su 'khyil ba: ye shes kyi me dang dud sprin rlung char na bun 'khrigs pa'i glong du bskyed

pa do: gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros dbyings nas rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs nas dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par bstim: sngar las rngam brjid bltar mi bzod pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma dang ldan par gyur: thugs dkar srog snying ya:dmar ser la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsgom: bzlas pa tsam gyis bstan pa'i dgra sde thal bar brlag cing ming med du gyur bar bsam la: snyen dza ya man+ta ka ya ma ra tsa yaka ka la rū pa hūṃ phaṭa: brgya stong khra 'bum la sogs bskyal ting 'dzin dmigs pa'i rno ngar bskyed de nas brngan mchod 'bul ba ni lcags snod liṅga drug cu bshams gser skyems mchod cing gzu dpang bskyed ling bskyed bden brdar bya ba na phaṭa: bdag mdun gyi thugs ka nas yig ge e gcig chad pa las gru gsum las kyi gshin rje'i kha: sde brgyad kyi 'du ra: gza' bdud rā hu la'i gdong rna: srin po mi zan gyi so bar dug dang nad kyi rlangs pa thul ba:rims dang yam gyi ngad pa g.yo ba: kha dog la gting yangs pa: dug lnga'i rang 'od 'tshubs pa: shin tu skyi g.ya' zhing ya nga ba'i nang du:dṛ tri:yongs su gyur pa las bstan pa'i

dgra bo: mtha' mi kla klo rnams kyi du sa kha ngu ba: mig shi mig: lag pa mya ngan gyi phyag rgya can: rkang lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa: bu ga dgu nas khrag rnag 'dzag pa:mgon med skyabs dang bral ba 'dar phri li li byed pa bye'u chung khra yis ded pa bzhin du gyur gzhan yang gnod byed pho mo'i sa bon dṛ tri las 'od 'phros pas dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad rang dbang med par bsdus nas gzugs la yang yang bstim mo: yang bdag mdun gyi sku yi cha thams cad nas pho nya lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu can grangs med pa spros nas dgra bgegs thams cad rang dbang med par bkug nas ling ga la bstem mo na mo: rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang: sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang chos kyi bka' bden dge 'dun gyi bka' phrin las lha lnga'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang gsang sngags dang rigs sngags dang snying po dang: phyag rgya dang: ting nge 'dzin rnams gyi bka' bden pa dang kun rdzob rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i bka' bden pa

gan dang: don dam chos nyid ngo bo gdod nas rnam par dag pa'i bka' bden pa dang: bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs byin gyis brlabs pa la brten nas: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa'i lag dmar: dam pa'i chos khrims bshig pa'i dam nyams dge 'dun gyi 'du sgo 'phrog pa'i bdud sde: chos byang chub sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa:nyams ting nge 'dzin la bar du gcod pa: sa lam gyi yon tan la bar du gcod pa: tshe bsod dpal 'byor chos srid bde skyid la bar du gcod par byed pa'i mtha' mi kla slo 'jing 'dur stod hor gdug pa can rnams dang: rgya 'dre srin po'i rigs su gtogs pa thams cad skad cig rang dbang med par gzugs liṅga 'di dang gnyis med par khug cig: bstim cig dza hūṃ baṃ ho 'gugs pa liṅga'i grangs bzhin brjod de nas 'gugs 'ching sdom myos ni rtsa sngags mthar dṛḥtri badz+ra ad+ku ja dza: rtsasngags mthar: a dṛḥdrag rak+ka ma ra ya phyes phyes: ma ma drag rakru ma ra ya phyes phyes: dgra bo skyobs byed kyi lha dang phyes phyes: badz+ra pra we sha ya phaṭa: rat+na pa sha hūṃ: rtsasngags mthar dṛ:tri badz+ra ching ching: thum ri li li bhasno

bhan+ta bai: badz+ra sbo ḍa baṃ: rtsa sngags mthar dṛ:tri dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa pa ya myos myos shag thum dam rbad dza ya: karma garnye ho: de nas 'bul bar bya ba ni / las kyi gshin rje ya man+ta ka yi: lto ba zhal ho mun pa dgu rim klong bstan bshig lag dmar mtha' mi kla klo rnams bstabs so ma shor chems chems krum krum rol: rtsasngags mtharaḥ bstan palidagra bgegs mtha' mi kla 1 rnams kyi sha khrag rus gsum rngub rngub: e chub ya kha kha khā hi khā hi: chems chems krum krum sarba sha hūṃ khā tī: ces pa brjod bzhi lid+ma re bstab tshe kru kla'i phu pe khams rkang mthal skya lhag gis gsol bsam bstab pa'i dgra sde stongs par bsgom ho: 'jigs byed nā ga rakū'i zhal du bstan bshig dgra bo'i phung khams skye mched rnams bstabs pas bar chad 'byung po'i 'khrul 'khor stong nas bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: re re bsnyo 'dod gsol gdab de nas phrin las bcol ba na hūṃ sbyo gdod nas ma skyes chos kyi dbyings nyid las: lhun grub rol ba 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: stong gsum sgog la mnga' mdzad khro bo' rgyal: mthu stobs rmad byung na ga rakru la: dgyes bskyed

pa bstan dgra kla kle'i phung khams bstabs: rngam pa'i hab hub skan sgra dang bcas gsol dgyes pa bskangs la tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i re 'bras bcol ba ni: sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen bsrung ba dang: dkon mchog dbu bstod dge 'dun 'dus sde spel: rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas dang: bod khams bkra mi shes pa'i nyer 'che'i bdag: mtha' mi kla 1 dmag 'khrug g.yul 'gyed mkhan: sems can bde skyid bcos pa'i bdud sde rnams: ming tsam med par dam sri'i 'khor lo stongs: rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i lang tshos 'jig rten khams: bde skyid phun sum tshogs par mdzad du gsol: nad yam gdon rgod nyer 'che'i rigs mtha' dag: zhi zhing gzhom pa'i mthu rtsal ma g.yel cig: rgya 'dre me zhon 'byung po rlung zhon sogs: log 'khrul dam sri'i sbyor ba tshar gcod mdzod: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul dbang gyur pa'i gdon bgegs rnams: zhen med rang byung rgyal sar phyin par shog dmus long log 'khrul 'khor ba'i skye 'gro rnams: thugs rjes ma dor ye shes lcags kyus

zungs dbang med sred pa'i bcan khang las bsgral nas kun tu bzang po'i rgyal sar phyir par 31ga: dgos gal che na gtor kha bstan drag las bya zhing dmod mo bor ral ba sprugs la thal mo sdeb gnad des dgra dpung rdul brlag 'gyur sam pā gnyis pa zan gyi gtor ma ni dmar po gru gang zung 'jug ldan rtse rgyan me ri dag gisamadzes rtse mtshe dug nyung dag gis brgyan bskyed bzlas bya ba'i rim pa ni rang nyid 'phags ma'i nga rgyal gyis o ma hā shu bye sogs ko3 haṃ stong pa nyid du gyur stong pa'i ngang las yi ge /:dmar nag tsha la rtsub pa gcig tu bsgom: de las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum gyi gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus te yongs su gyur pa las: drag po dmar nag me yi phreng ba can sku mdog dmar nag zhal cig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa: smra smin las me yi tsha tsha 'apro ba khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs pa phyag g.yas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa nam mkha' la phyar bas bdud dang dam sri'i mgo bo 'gem pa: g.yon pas lcags sdigs nag po'i snying nas gtser bas rgyal 'gong pho mo'i srog snying lhung bar byed pa thod rkam dbu rgyan dang dar

mo/ sna'i cod pan 'phur ba: nyi zla'i snyan cha mdzes: sku stod la glang chen gyi go rlon dang: rked par mi lngags g.yang bzhis spras pa: sku smad lcags phur zur gsum me yi tsha tsha 'phro ba: kla klo'i dam sri'i snying gar zug cing tsit+ta'i khrag dmar sob sob khol bar bsam ye shes kyi me dang 'od phung rab tu 'khrigs pa'i klong du bskyed do:de yi gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dpag tu med pa 'phros pas rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus shing lus pa med par spyan drangs nas bskyed pa'i lha la sib sib thim: gnyis su med par 'dres nas bkrag mdangs gzi 'od rab tu 'bar dmigs: thugs gar srog yiga3:dmar nag la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor bar bsgomaX bzlas pa tsam gyis bstan pa'i dgra bgegs bar chad dam sri 'byung po thams cad tshar bcad rdul du brlag na sa ming tsam yang mi gnas par bsam:khyad par du snang ba lha yi rang bzhin: sgra grags sngags kyi rol ba: 'gyur 'phro ye shes chen po'i rol bar migs la sa/ pha( artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra ki li kai la

hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa: a hū hū phaṭa: ting 'dzin dmigs gnad ldan pa yis bye ba gcag bzlas rtags mtshan 'byung de nas brngan mchod 'bul ba ni lcags snod lisgo sum cu bshams gser skyems mchod cang gzu dpang bskyed ling bskyed bden brdar brgya bzhi sogs gong ltar grub par bya ba'o de nas bstab par bya ba ni sa: drag po chen po brtul zhugs can: dmar nag me 'phreng zhal ho du: bstan bshig dgra bgegs a mu ga'i: phung khams skye mched ma lus bstabs: 'ur 'ur chems chems krum krum rolaḥ log 'khrul mtsho mo skems pa dngaḥ gsang sngags bstan pa rgyas gyur cig rtsa sngags mthar bstan pa'i du tra a mu ga'i sha rus khrag gsum la rngub rngub: e chub ya kha kha kha tī kha tī: 'ur 'ur chem chem krum krum rol: ces brjod sngags re li re 'dod gsol re bsgrags bstab pa 'i tshe bstan bshig dgra bo'i bung po khams rkang mthal skya lag gis gsol bsam bstan pa 'i dgra sde stongs par dmags 'dod gsol go bzhin zor las ni hūṃ bye : chos dbyings mkha' ltar dag mod kyang log 'khrul bstan dgra 'dul ba'i phyir: dmar nag me 'breng skur bzhengs shig: drag po'i zor la rngam shugs bskyed: las byed pho nya'i 'du 'phro 'khrigs:

can thun mtshon sna tshogs skar ltar 'tshubs: me rlung dug gi na bun 'phro ye shes 'bar ba'i gtor zor 'di: lha klu gnyan la mi 'phang ngo: sdang byed dgra bo'i 11ga la 'phen: gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs la 'phen: bar chad dam sri'i sde la 'phen: byad ma lha srung bcas la 'phen: bdag rtog 'khor ba'i brag la 'phen dmigs pa'i yul rnams shor ra re pho rgyud thog mda'i rno la drongs mo rnams lcug phran brngas bzhin rlog byis pa me tog bcom ltar mdzod: dgra bo'i lus sgog dmar nyil gtub:bgegs tshogs byed mkhar bcom ltar rlog: dam sri ming tsam med par mdzod: gsang sngags che ba'i khyad chos ston: thugs dam ma g.yel dus la bab mthu rtsal ston cig sa ma yā: ces brjod gtor zor dgra la 'phen pha lam yin kyang rdul brlag 'gyur the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' mi bslu zab pa 'i khyad chos yod sa ma shā phrin las bcol ba gong bzhin no lag len zeb par bya bar mdzod sa ma yā gsum pa zan gya gtor ma ni nag po gru ga zung 'jug ldan rtse rgyan me ri dud rlung mdzes stsang mtshe dug zu sa dag gis brgyan bskyed bzlas bya ba'i rim pa ni snyen sā bha wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs:
