snyeng pa'e ngang lasaye ge khrom mtheng nag las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros gnod byed rgyal bsen klu gnyan gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad: tshur 'dus te yongs su gyur ba las: ye shes kyi bya khyung gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mchu sder can khro chu'i lus po la me yi tshwa tsha 'phro ba spyan mig g.yas pa nyi ma'i rang bzhin las gser chu 'khyil ba: g.yon pa zla ba'i rang bzhin la dngul chu 'beb pa sna nas na bun dmar nag 'khrigs pa: lcags ra nag po las du ba phyu ru ru 'phro bas bstan dgra'i lus sems rmug par byed pa: lcags kyi ral ba sprugs pa las dug char dang ser ba 'bebs pa: kha nas sbrul rigs lnga 'dzin cing sa bdag klu gnyan gyi snying khrag lhung bar byed pa: lcags kyi sder mo bsgrad pas rgyal bsen dam sri kla kle'i snying rtsa 'dren par byed pa ye shes kyi me dang dung sprin rab tu 'khrigs pa'i klong du bskyed do: gnas gsum las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas rang bzhin kyi gnas dang: ri rab 'bar ba ri yi rtse mo dang dpag bsam rgyas pa shing gi yal steng nas ye shes kyi bya khyung dpag tu med pa spyan

gan drangs nas bstim mo: gnyis su med par gyur: slar yang thugs gar khro mtheng nag la sngags kyis bskor bar dmegs: bzlas pa tsam gyes nad yams mtshon 'khrugs lha klu sa bdag gnyan gtod gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad: 'khor 'das kyi byin rlabs nus pa thams cad bsdus te bstims: sgod bcud dkyil 'khor gsum gyi rol ba chen por sad par bsam la: 37 dza ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le sarba bisne sha hūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa rtsa sngags bye ba gcag bzla zhing bskyed rdzogs dmigs gnad gzer thob na grub pa'i rtags mtshan khyad par 'phags bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal sa ma yu de nas brngan mchod 'bul ba na lcags snod lisgo nya shu bshams gser skyems mchod cing gzu dpa nga bskyed lang bskyed 'gugs gzhugs rgya bzha sogs gong ltar legs par bya ba'o de nasa'abul bstab bya ba ni hūṃ bye khre rgyal chen btsan rngam pa'i hūṃ sgra can: zangs khrab gsol zhing mdung dmar thog nas su ba dan rtse gsum phyogs bcur g.yab pa yis dgra bgegs mtha' dmag bzlog pa'i brtul zhugs can: khyod la dgyes bskyed dgra bgegs phung khams bstabs lhag ma med par chems

chem krum krum rol: bar chad bdu kyi 'khor lo stongs pa dang phyi nang 'byung ba'i la yog ngan pa dang: dus kyi 'brugs slong ltas ngan sna dgu sogs: zhi bzlog gzhom pa'i phrin las dus la bab: ma g.yel sngon gyi dam ldan ga ru ṭa: rtsasngags mthar bstan pa'i du tra klu gnyan gdug pa'i sha khrag rus gsum la rngub rngub: e chub ya kha khā hi /shā hi:sdo ra sdogar chems chem dza/ma dza/ma 11la ces brjod sngags re liṅga re 'dod gsol re bsgrags bstab pa'i tshe bstan bshig dgra bo'i phu po khams rka mthil rkya lhag gis gsol bas bstan pa' dgra sde stongs par dmags 'dod gsol brin bcol gong bzhin no dgos gal che na gtor kha bstan drag las dī zhang dmod mo bor gnod des dgra dpung rdul brlag 'gyur the tshom med do sa ma shā de nas rjes rim tshogs mchod ni rgyas par mos na zab snyang ltar bsdu na tshogs rdzas yo byad spungs bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas slar 'bul bshags bstab pa'i rim pa na trī: gsang chen gnyis ldan bla med rdzas: rmad byung ga ṇa tsakra'i gter: ye shes bdud rtsi'i rol ba yis gu ru rtsa gsum rgya mtsho dang: khyad par dgra dpung 'joms ma yi: sku gsung thugs la mchod pa 'bul: dam tshig chags nyams ral

sa/ ba bshags: 'khrul snang 'khor ba'i rū tra bsgral: ye shes gsang ba'e klong du bstabs: bar chad bdud dpung 'joms pa dang: phyogs las rnam rgyal dngos grub ༄65: bdag dang 'a11 ba sems can rnams: kun bzang bla ma'i sa thob thegag dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab bkra shis mtha' brten rgyas pa ra bya gnad de'i tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma yu e ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma ngas snying tig zab pa'i bcud byung ba gsang ba brda yi ras su btab ma 'ongs skal ldan don du bkod mdo khams tsā ri'i shar du sbas klu bdud btsan la gnyer kha bcol ma 'ongs snyags ma lnga yi dus nad mug mtshon chas gzengs langs tshe nga sprulabadud 'joms gleng pa yis rted nas bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grubaḥ chos bdagadapa' bo bdun dang ni dpa' mo gsum gyi bskal bar bsngags legs par brten na 'di phyir dge ral bar gyur na bka' chad 'ongs phongs 'tshengs nus pa rin chen gter rang gi srog la bca' shes mdzod skal med lag tu ma shor cig 'u tshug can la a tham rgya mdzes pa ri bong lang tsho bzhad gser gyi ku mud tshal bzang po g.yu yi bu ma'i lag na bsnams g.yu 'thug dung gi sgra bzang de spre'u'i lag nas 'doms par byed gdong lnga'i dab po' lang tsho de mdzes 'dzum rma bya'i dpal gyis bskyed

bkra shis chos dung dkar bo de dbyangs snyan nirnyi'i phyag na bsnams seng ldeng lo 'bras spud pa can shar gyi rta mchog khri la brten g.yas kyi rta bdun 'bar ba ni g.yu 'byug nor bu'i tog ldan pa g.yon gyi lha gtsang ma ni dom bu'i gtsug na ku mud bzhad rgyab kyi rten phur 'bar ba ni stag la kun bzang rtag mdzes pa mdun gyi 'dab bzang lang tsho ni dom bu rwa ldan thig le zungs shar gyi gdong lnga g.yu yas mdzes lho yi g.yu 'brug rig pa'i rgyan nub kyi rma bya gragasapa'i tog byang gi ru sbal stobs dang ldan shar lho'i ba dan 'gyur ba med lho nub gser nya dbang dang ldan nub byang bum pa lasakyi gtams byang shar ral gri chos kyis mdzes de 'dra de dag las kyis smin rtags da rten 'brel phun sum 'tshogs sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi snying khrag 'di snyi gi bu dang 'phrad par shog gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi cesapa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chosa'aphel rgya mtshosashog dkar bcas nas bskul ba dang chos bdag rang rig lam la dbang ba'i grogs rat+na sar slob bu ye shes chos la dad mos che ba chos gsal rnams kyis yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nuthabaldanapas 'bros phug mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling nas dag par phab pa dge leg 'phel/ sarba ma lam/

74na1 pas zab gsang mkha' 'dza'i thugs thig las 'phags ma che gnyer can ma'i zab sgrub gdug pa tshar gcod bzhugs so:pa na 31 gu na pad+mā ka ra ye: na/gnashā 11 rang reg pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis bar chad g.yul ngo bzlog pa 'i phyir 'phags ma nyer gcig phyag rgya bstan sa ma yā de yang khro gnyer can ma la brten nas zab sgrub bsgom 'dod na sngon 'gro zab don snying po ltar dngos gzhi bsgom par bya ba ni yis chos kun mi dmigs bsam brjod bral: rang gsal byang chub sems kyi mdangs thabs dang shes rab sa bon las: 'od zer 'phro 'dus snod bcud rnams: ye shes lnga ldan yum lnga'i slong: lhun grub bde chen pho brang dbus: ma chags pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: gtum po dom gyi khri yi khar: rang rig trī:bab zhu ba las: bdag snangaste gnyer can ma'i sku: ljang nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: spyan gsum rab bsgrad mche ba

gtsogs: dar dang rat+na rus pas brgyan: stag ge lpags pa'i sham thabs spras: phyag g.yas thod dbyug mkha' la phyar sde brgyad 'byung po 'dul bar byed gapon pas bhan+ta bdud rtsi brten: bu la mchog thun dngos grub 'bebs: zhabs gnyis gar gyis khri la rol 'ja' 'od thig le 'khrigs pa/'i slong ye shes sgyu ma'i sku ru bskyed: gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas: khyad par 'phags ma'i lha tshogs rnams: spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstim: spyan 'dren la sogs gzhung tshang bar zab don snyang po ltar du shes de nas 'dzab bzlas bya ba ni hrī rang nyid 'phags ma'i thugs klong du: nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor sbubs rig pa nyil sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas rgyal 'gong dam sri rnams sbur ma me dang 'phrad pa bzhin: ming tsam med par bsreg pa dang: tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams rtogs rgyas: snang grags rig gsum bde ba che lha sngags phyag rgya chos sku'i ngang: hrī: ār+ya kro ti dz+nyā na de wi sarba duṣ+ṭaṇa mā ra ya phaṭa: bskyed da rdzogs pa ting 'dzin go ldan pas bye ba gcag bzlas na dbang dang dngos grub thob par 'gyur nyams

pa / rtog yon tan gong 'phel rgyas rgyal 'gong dam sri'i sbyor ba ni sgrub dang las sbyor dmigs pa sa phye 'grub rtags bzlas tshad rdzogs tshe 'byung ze tshoms med do sa ma yu de nas las la sbyor ba ni rgyal 'gong brngan ba 'i glud mdos bstan gzhi ma 'jam la dwangasaba'i ngor re mig dgu ru bskor bar bya dbus su mkhar thabs bang rim gsum tsit+ta'i tog dang ldan par bya re mig brgyad la mkhar thabs brgyad zhing khrags dag gi tog phyar ro sats+tsha mi mgo' tog ldan dgu bsgos bu dgu dang khrag rkong dgu ting lo dgu dang glu 'brang dgu len chagasatheb skyu dgu re dang pho tang mo tang bal brgya dgu nam mkha' rgya zhal nag po dgu 'dod rdzas rnam pa sna tshogs bsags sha khrag 'bras chan rgya chen bkram de nas rnal 'byor dam pa rnams gu ru drag po' tang 'dzin gya gser skyems mchod la 'ad skad do kyiḥ bye na cig snang zhing srid pa'i khams: 11ga dbugs mnga' mdzad ra tsa sde: de ring srid pa'i mdos ra bshams: rnam rgyal lha yi dkor mdzod bkra: ma tshang med pa mig 'phrul gter: rgyu gtsang spus legs zad pa med ye shes rol bas byin rlabs nas nam mkha' mdzod du sprul gyur na: 'jig rten yongs kyi glud du che: skye 'gro rnams kyi tshe srog glud: mi bas glud bzang ya mtshan can:

dkor bas glud lhag ngo mtshar gnas: skye 'gags bral ba'i ngang las 'phrul: dmigs med ye shes rtsal las snang: gzung 'dzin lha 'dre'i yid spyod bskang: chags 'dzin gnod pa'i bsam pa spongs: dad mos drag po'i shugs bskyed dang: bden pa chen po'i sna la zin: de nas spyan 'dren bya ba ri kye grong khyer 'ja' tshon lta bu la: med bzhin yod par bzung ba'i 'khrul: log spyod 'gro ba'i srog la rgol: 'khrul ba dug lnga'i rjes su 'brang: mtho be dkar rgyal po man chad dang: dma' ba the'u rgyal phran yan chad kun:srid pa'i mdos la da tshur byon: gcod pa 'drer 'dzin che zhing 'khrul: log spyod 'gro ba'i sgog la rgol 'khrul bas dug lnga a 'thas log par spyod: 'khrul pa brte la sogs pa: srid pa'i mdos la da tshur byon: btsun pa re dogs che ba yi: blang dor rmongs shing rgyu 'bras 'chol chags sred bsod nams snyan grags sogs: srid pa'i mdos la da tshur byon: bdag 'dzin rang khar 'chor ba'i 'dre: smon log rkyen gyi dbang gyur ba: rdo rje kun bzang la sogs rnams: srid pa'i mdos la da tshur byon: 'jig rten

can srog la dbang za zhing log pa'i rgol ba sna tshogs ston: gsal byed zla ba la sogs rnams: sred pa'i mdos la da tshur byon gnod cing phan pa sna tshogs byed: legs nyes ri mo gsal ba yi: rgyal chen sku lnga yab yum dang: blon po dpung 'khor 'bum 'bum bcas: srid pa'i mdos la da tshur byon: gnod pa'i bsam pa bral bar gyis: phan pa'i sems dang ldan bzhin du: 'dod yon rdzas la dgyes bzhin du: dam tshig gsang ba'i rdzas la bzhugs: sgo badz+ra ra tsa tri du du sa ma ya dza dza: de nas 'dod rdzas mdos kyis brngan pa ni hūṃ rgyal chen sku lnga yab yum dang: gsal byed zla ba la sogs pa'i: srog dbug tshe bsod len pa yi: ra tsa'i rigs su gyur pa ni: dpon g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa la: nam mkha' rgya zhal nag po dang: shug gu rting dkar bal gyis brgyan: snyug ldem dar tshon 'phan yab btags: mda' ni dpa' bo stag chas can:'phang ni dpa' mo zhub chas mdzes: thabs kyi rang bzhin pho tang dang: she rab rang bzhin mo tang brgya: khrab rmog tshem tshem bem dang phub mda' gzhu mdung dang ral gri dang:

dug mda' me mda' mda' bo che: gri dang shang lang dgra zor dang: rno ba'i mtshon cha sna tshogs dang: dar stags gcan gzan sna tshogs lpags: mgo phreng snying gi se ral kha:'bras bu sman sna shing thogs rigs mig mang ris dang 'khyog po'i ris: rgur bo'i ris dang 'ja' tshon ris: me tog ris dang 'byung lnga'i ris: gser dngul ris dang pa tra ris: mdor na gang mos yid spyod dang: mthun pa'i 'dod don nam mkha' mdzod: mig 'phrul lta bu'i gter du spel: rā tsa 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: mtshan 'dzin lha 'dre'i rtog tshogs grol: gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bsam spyor bral: zag med snying rjes rgyud brlan gyur: de nas chang bu bsngo ba ni hūṃ skye med klong las glud phrul ba: 'gag med 'dod don bkod pa rdzogs khyer cig ra tsa'i sde 'khor bcas: zhen chags 'dzin pa bral gyis la: drag po chen po'i bka' bzhin tu: 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis sa ra yis bsngo bar bya de nas lam bstan bya ba ni sa: nyon cig ra tsa 'khor dang bcas: 'dod yon mchod pa'i rdzas khyer la: rang rang so so'i gnas su deng: phyin chad 'khor 'dir

pas gnod ma byed gal te bka' las 'da' 'gyur na: bdag nyad pad+ma 'byung gnas sku: drag po chen po' tshul bzung nas: khyed rnams lus sreg thal bar brlag: ming tsam med par rdul phran bzhin bcom par 'gyur ba gdon mi za de bas da ltar phyir dengs shig: deng bzung gnas 'di ye shes kyi bsrung ba'i rwa gur cher gyur nas: phag sdigs khro khyung 'du 'phro 'khrigs: gdon byed 'da' ba'i gnas med do: ces brjod mdos dor bgegs tshogs bskrad bsru ba'i 'khor lo rim brgyad bstor gnad des bar chad g.yul las rgyal ze tshom med do sa mā yu de nas rjes rim tshogs mchod ni rgyas pa ra mos na zab snyi ltar bsdu na tshogs rdzas yo byad sbungs bas sbyang sa byin gyis brlabs nas slaraḥ 'bul bshags bstabs pa 'i rim pa na hrīḥ bde stong bharnya 'bar ba'i bcud: sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyis: gu ru rtsa gsum rgya mtsho dang khyad par khro gnyer can ma yi: sku gsung thugs la mchod pa 'bul sgo gsum ma rig dbang gyur bshags log 'khrul dam sri kun bsgral nas: chos dbyings mi 'gyur e klong bstabs: bsgrub pa'i nyer 'tshe kun zhi nas: dbang dang byin rlabs

dngos grub (55: bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa: kun bzang bla ma'i sa zob regag: dge ba bsngo zhang smon lam gdab bkra shis mtha' rten rgyas pa bya gnad des tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang sgrib dag sku gnyis mngon du 'gyur ze tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma mā ye ma rgyalaba'i dbang po pad+ma ngas snying tag zab pa'i bcud byung ba gsang ba brda ya ris su btab ma 'ongs las ldan don du bkod mdo khams tsa ri' shar du sbas klu bdud btsan la gnyer kha bcol ma 'ongs snyags ma lnga yi dus nad mug mtshon gzug gzengs la tshe nga sprul bdud 'joms glang pa yis rnyed nas bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub chos bdag dpa' bo bdun dang ni dpa' mo gsum gyi skal bar bsngags legs par brten na phun sum tshogs ral bar gyur na mi 'dod 'khrug phung 'tsheng nus pa rin chen gnyer rang gi sgog ltar btsa' shes mdzod skal med lag tu ma shor cig 'dod sred can la a tham rgya ske gzhi gser mag 'khyil ba'i klong rgya bya cod paṇa can rnams 'tshogs ka la ping ga'i rgyang glu gyer ne tsho'i kha nas grul bum sgras bya tshogs mang po 'gug dus srid cang shes rgyal po 'gros stabs kyis gangs la stabs kyas 'dzegs pa ra 'gyur dri za'i bu mo'i rnam 'gyur gyis ne tso' bzhad mo drug drug sgrogs brag la rgod kyis tshang bcas nas rkang drug bung ma nya shu lnga 'ja' zer 'od stong dpal la brtse gcan

pas spyang sngon mo'i hab sgra sgrogs nag kyi bye'u bdun nyul nas 'phyong rtsal ru sbal stobs dag gis rma bya'i lang tsho rnam par bkra ya ya'i dri za lha mo' skad wa waṃ nu pa ru pa'i khyims zhi sha paṇ+ḍi sha sar mar gyi nyi ma lho ru 'gro lho yi ljon bzang bya la chas nub kyi khra ta'i lce gnyis 'doms byang gi 'brong nag gnam la lding g.yu 'brug mkha' las sa la bab dung ga skad po phyogs su sgrogs haṃ bu ra ni lha yis bsnams gnod sbyin rgyal po'i dar ma spyar nub kyi dzam bha la yi nor bar 'tshams sdigs pa'i lag nas 'doms rno gnyen lcag kyu'i ngar la 'drongs 'byor ba phun tshogs e ma ho rtags dang rten 'brel yongs su dge the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi snying brag 'di snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya snyi ces pa 'da'ang chos kyi bdag popad+ma tshas 'apel rgya mtshos dar dang bri gzhi bcas bskul ba dang / gogasam rat+na sar chosabadag rang rig slob bu ye shes dad banon chosagasal rnams kyis nan tu bskul ro ra bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes 'bros phug mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling nas dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel sarba masgo lam/
1 khyezheshes zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: 'phags ma rab tu zhi ma'i zab sgrub nyes tshogs kun 'joms bzhugs so:

pa stemi na mogu na pad+mā ka ra ye: gogenarnamanas rang rig pad+ma dasaṃ bha wa'i snyigs ma'i 'gro la brtse sems kyis rten 'brel nyes tshogs 'joms pa'i phyir 'phags ma nyer cig phyag rgya bstan sa ma mā de yang rab tu zha ma la brten nas zab sgrub bsgom 'dod na sngon 'gro zab don snying po ltar dngos gzhi bsgom par bya ba ni sa gzhi med rtsa bral chos sku'i klong: rang gsal ye shes snying rje'i mdangs: thabs shes sa bon shar ba las: 'od zer 'phro 'dus snod bcud rnams: ye shes lnga ldan yum lnga'i 1nga: rang gsal lhun grub pho brang dbus: ma chags pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: ri dwags sgegs bzang khri yi khar: rang rig trīḥbab zhu ba las: bdag snang rab tu zhi ma'i sku: dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: zhi 'dzum chags pa'i lang tsho bkra: dar dang rat+na pad phreng spras phyag g.yas pad+ma'i lcags kyu 'dzin 'gro blo dbang sdud thar lam gzud: g.yon pas pad+ma dkar po bsnams: rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi bar byed: zhabs gnyis gar gyis khri la rol: 'ja' dang 'od phung 'a gas pa'i klong: snang la rang bzhin med par bsgom gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od

pas 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas: khyad par 'phags ma'i lha tshogs rnams: spyan drangs gnyes su med par bstems: spyan 'dren la sogs gzhu tshang bar zab don snying po ltar du shes de nas 'dzab bzlas bya ba ni hrī rang nyid 'phags ma'i thugs klong du nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor sbubs rig pa hrī la sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pa'i rten 'brel nyes tshogs rnams: ming tsam med par zhi ba dang: tshe bsod nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas: snang grags rig gsum bde ba che: lha sngags phyag rgya chos sku'i ngang: sdi ār+ya sarba shirnyi ku ru sa: rten 'brel nyes pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar gyur cig: bskyed rdzogs ting nge 'dzan ldan pa sa bye ba gcag bzlas dngos grub thob nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel zhing rgyas rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi bar gyur sgrub dang las sbyor dmigs pa sa phye rtags mtshan yon tan dus su smin the tshom mi dgos rdo rje'i bka' sa ma yu de nas las la sbyor ba na tho rang mal nas lda nga ma thag bya rog skad ma 'byin pa'i gong rlung ro dgu 'byung bum can 'dzan bsreg blugs 'bar 'dzag bsgom pa ra bya de nas mdun gyi nam mkha' ru skyabs yul bskyed par bya ba ni yis rang sa/mdun gyi nam mkha' na 'ja' dang 'od phung 'khrigs pa'i

klong: ches sku kun bzang yab yum dang rgyal ba shakya thub pa la: dus gsum sangs rgyas 'khor gyes bskor: bdag la mkhyen brtse nus pas dgongs: rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi bar dmigs oṃ sa〉: dmigs med kun bzang yab yum la: gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang: legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po la: gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang: legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol sangs rgyas ri yi dbang po la: gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang: legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol: sangs rgyas spos kyi glang po la:gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang: legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol: sangs rgyas spob pa mtha' yas la: gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang: legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol: sangs rgyas chu yi snying po la: gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: rten 'brel

pas nyes tshogs zhi ba dang:legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol:sangs rgyas nyen mo snang byed la: gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mcha rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol:sangs rgyas 'od zer mtha' yas la gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi:rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang:legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol:sangs rgyas mtha' yas 'od dpal la gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi:rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang:legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol:sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs dpa' brjid la:gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi:rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang:legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol:sangs rgyas gze brjed go cha la gus pas phyag 'chal skyabs su mchi:rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang:legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol:sangs rgyas mi 'gyur dpa' brtan la:gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi:rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang:legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol:sangs rgyas bkra shis zla dbang la:

gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mche: rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhe ba dang: legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol sangasargyas 'jam dpal bzang po la: gus pas rten 'brel legs yon sangs rgyas btson 'grus mthu thob la: gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang: legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol:sang rgyas tsan dan dpal mnga' la:gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi:rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang:legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol:sangasargyasami shig dpal bzang la: gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol:sangasargyasagazhen nu gtsug phud la gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol sangasargyasabakra shis don byed la: gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol:sangs rgyas ye shes snying po la: gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi:

gas rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang: legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol: sangs rgyas sgrib pa rnam sel la: gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang: legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol: sangs rgyas dpal gyi dbyangs snyan la: gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang: legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol: sangs rgyas sman byed 'od stong la gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang: legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol: sangs rgyas spros bral don rgyal la: gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol: sangs rgyas rgyal ba rgya mtsho la: gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang: legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol: sangs rgyas zhi byed dbang po la: gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang: legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol: sangs rgyas chos kyimadzod 'chang la

gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mche: rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhe ba dang: legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol: sangs rgyas rab tu zhe ma la: gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang: legs yon gong 'phel mdzad du gsol: 3 badz+ra sa man+ta bha tra tshe: sa mu ne+e mu ne ma hā mu ne swā hā: tshe brnya kwa ya sarba na ma a ā:oṃ dhu ru ru dza ya mu khe swā hā: rten 'brel nyes pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing legs pa'i yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel zhi rgyas par mdzad du gsol: brgya stong la sogs gang 'os bskyar dad mos ldan pas bzlas gyur na nyams dang rtogs pa 'i yon tan rgyas rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi bar 'gyur the tshom med do sa ma yu de nas nyes sel bsrung 'khor ni mtshal dang bzang drug bsre byas la skabs 'dir 'khor lo dpe'u ris ltar rdzas ni bzang drug chos sman byug rgya lnga gdab la dar gyas dril dkyil 'khor dbus gzhug bdun phrag sgrub 'bral med mgul du btags pa yis rten 'brel nyes pa'i phyogs rnams 'joms the tshom med do sa ma yā de nas sa rim tshogs mchod ni rgyas par 'dod na zab snyi ltar bsdu na tshogs dzos po byad spungs bsang sbyang sa byin gyis brlabs nas slar 'bul bshags bstabs pa' rim pa ni hrī: khyad

gas par rmad du byung ba ye: tshogs rdzas zag mid nam mkha' gter gu ru rtsa gsum rgya mtsha dang: 'phags ma rab zhe chen rma yi: sku gsung thugs la mtshod pa 'bul: sdom gsum bslab dam nyams pa bshags: gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rū tra bsgral mi 'gyur e yi klong du bstabs rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi ba dang: phyogs las rnam rgyal dngos grub ༄6pa: 'bum phrag tshom bu dang bcas nas: kun tu bzang po'i sa thob 31ga: dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab bkra shis mtha' rten rgyas par bya gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag sku gnyis mngon du gyur bar nges the tshom med do sa ma yu:ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma ngas snying gi yang tig zab pa'i bcudaḥ gsang ba brda yi ris su btab las ldan rjes lajug don du brtsam: mdo khams tsa ri'i shar du sbas klu bdud btsan la gnyer kha bcol ma 'ongs snyags ma lnga yas dus nad mug mtshon gsum kha dar tshe nga sprul bdud 'joms gling yis rnyed nas bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub chos bdag dpa' bo bdun da ni dpa' mo gsum gyi skal bar bsngags legs par 'dud na dge bar 'gyur g.yel na ḍak+ki'i chad pas mnar phong 'tsheng nus pa rin chen gter rang srog bzhin du btsa' shes mdzod skal med lag tu ma shor cig 'dod sred

can la a tham rgya e shar na dung ge re bo bshad de la brten nas nyi ma shar legs pa'i rim 'gror brtson nus na grangs tshad bdun du rnam par dge lto na nags tshal 'thug po'i khrod zhe sdang sbrul dang sdeg tshang 'khrugs yid du mi 'ong dmar las 'byed bsrung rim dmag mdos brgya rtsa gal nub tu sman snod dug gas bkang rta bdun 'od brgya go las bsu rang khyims bzung nas 'ur zings slong dus su mi bde la sti ke bzlob rgyur glang chen rab 'bogs 'bum byang nas khra ta 'ur ba dang zhe sdang stag la 'dzang thabs ngoms slong brgyad mi bde'i 'ur mo gzangs cho 'phrul lcags kyi 'khor lo 'doms mi snyan dug gi sgra skad ni bcu phrag gsum la grags par 'gyur kun kyang rten 'brel nyes sel dang snyigs dus skyobs pa'i lha lnga'i 'dul lho nub 'od thag dkar po la rten nas rta bdun ya mtshan can grong 'khor rnams kyi mchod bstod dang bkur sti phu dud gsol gdab dang zag med bdud rtsi ster la spyod ngan sgrogs 'ur mo ha la'i sgra nan du bsgrang na rta bdun yang ḍaske rigs lnga'i dar thag gis gdong nas rak+ṣa'i yul gyi rtse mi min mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gling a tsadu na'i sku yi drung rje 'bangs lo paṇa rgya mtsho'i gral tshom bu gcig du 'khod nas 'gro de phyir gzab cing yang dag brtson phan pa'i sman la rtag spyod na rten 'brel dge ba'i lang tsho bkra the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sam ku rgya rgya rgya mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi snying

pas khrag 'di snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog gter rgya gtad rgya sba rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya snyi ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag popad+ma chosa'aphel rgya mtshosadar dang bri gzhi bcas bskul ba dang grogs mo rat+na sa ra chosabadag rang reg slob bu yeshes dad btsan chos gsal rnams kyis nan du bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bonas ldan rdo rjes 'bros phug mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling nas dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sabo masgo lam/
stengagadonalhadangagaza'askaragyiganodapathams danag gabaragadonadregasapasdebargyadagyiganodapathamasacadag414
/ khonags zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: 'phags ma 'bar ba'i 'od can ma'i zab sgrub sdig sgrib gun bsregs bzhugs so:

pa / na mo gu ru pad+mā ka ra ye: shā/shāgs zabashāka: rang rig pad+ma sa bha was snyigs ma'i 'gro la brtse sems kyis gzung 'dzin las nyon bsreg bya'i phyir 'phags ma nyer gcig phyag rgya bstan sa ma yā de yang 'bar ba'i 'od can ma brten nas gsang sgrub bsgom 'dod tshe sngon 'gro zab don snying po ltar dngos gzhi bsgom par bya ba ni yis chos rnams mi dmigs gzhi rtsa bral: stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug mdangs: rig pa hrīḥyig shar ba las: 'od zer 'phro 'dus snod bcud rnams: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dal du rdzogs: rang gsal lhun grub pho brang dbus ma chags pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: rab mdzes chu srin khri yi khar: rang rig ༷tshoyig zhu ba las: bdag snang 'bar ba'i 'od can sku: dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: spyan gsum khro 'dzum sgeg nyams chags: dar dang rat+na mgo phreng spras phyag g.yas 'bar ba'i me dpung bsnams: gzung 'dzin dri ma bsreg par byed: g.yon pas tshad med zhags pa 'dzin: 'gro ba thabs kyis 'dzin cing sdom: zhabs gnyis gar gyis khri la rol: 'ja' dang 'od phung 'khrigs pa'i 1nga: ye shes sgyu ma'i sku ru bskyed: gnas

gsacha gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas khyad par 'phags ma'i lha tshogs rnams spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstim: spyan 'dren la sogs gzhung yongs rdzogs zab don snying po ltar du shes de nas 'dzab bzlas bya ba ni hrī: rang nyid 'phags ma'i thugs klong du: nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor sbubs rig pahrīX la sngags kyis skor:bzlas pas gzung 'dzin dri ma kun: sbur ma me dang 'phrad pa bzhin: ming tsam med par 'asreg pa dang: tshe bsod nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas: snang grags rig gsum bde ba che: lha sngags phyag rgya chen bo'i ngang: trī: dz+nyā na dz+wa la ram sukhya sarba pā paṃ shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā: bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin brtan po yis bye ba gcig bzlas dngos grub thob nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rgyas ma rig lasanyon dag par 'byur sgrub dang las sbyor dmags pas phye dus su rtagasadang mtshan ma 'byung the tshom med do sa ma mā de nas lasal spyor ba ni sdig sgrib sbyangs pa' bsreg blugs bstan sa gdan pad+ma 'dab brgyad steng zhi shing ba mu'i hom drug brtsags sor brgyad rtse mo pad 'dab drug: 'bar me rlung ltar tshang bar bya khyad par bsregs dzos mar khu dang ril ni rgya chen spungs byas la dang po byin gyis brlabs pa ni /hrī:

thabs dang shes rab sbyir ba las: byung ba' bsreg rdzas 'ardad yin gtar: nam mkha'i khyen dang mnyam gyur tsag: yo āḥhū swā hā dz+nyā na pathu ngagarnya ku ru hū: lan bdun gyis ni byin rlabs de nas me hom sbar ba ni hūṃ hrī: tsha zhing bsreg par byed pa'i mes gzung 'dzin las nyon dri ma dang khams gsum 'khor ba'i bag chags rnams: 'bar ba chen pos dz+wa la ram: ma badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ ram̐ hūṃ phaṭa de nas thab khung bskyed pa ni o swā bha was stong par sbyang: mi dmigs ngang las ram̐ dmar ser: 'phro 'dus ye shes me dpung 'bar: 'ja' 'od thig le 'khrigs pa'i klong: thabs dang she rab nyi zla'i steng: 'phags ma 'bar ba'i 'od can sku: dmar gsal sogs bstim spyan 'dren la sogs phyag 'tshal bar zab don snying po ltar du shes de nas byon skyems 'bul ba ni hūṃ trī: 'bru bcud snying po mar khu ni: ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur ba yi: 'bar ba'i 'od can dgyes pa bskangs: brtse ba chen po'i dgongs su gathegal: rtsasngags mthar pañca.adṛ ta khā twe nyer gcig dag gis phul bar bya de nas gzhung gi mchod pa 'bul slar yang bsregs dzos 'bul ba ni hūṃ hrī: rnal 'byu1ra bdag cag sgrub pa po gzung

gas 'dzin las nyon dri ma dang: sdom gsum dam tshog nyams pa sogs las nyon ma rig rmongs pa'i sgrib: thams cad ma lus dag bya'i byir: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs la: 'bru mchog snying po'i bsregs blugs 'bul: tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag pa dang dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub stsol: rtsasngags mthar sarba pā paṃ da ha na ye swā hā: brgya stong khri 'bum bsogs la bskyar skabs 'dod gsol gdab pa ni ho: lha gcig 'phags ma 'bar ba'i 'od can ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams dgyes pa'i phyir du zhal zas bsreg blugs kyis mchod pa rgya chen po 'bul ba'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas rnal 'byor pa bdag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib gzung 'dzin las nyon dam tshig nyam chags nyes ltung thams cad byang zhing dag pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: ḍa dral rol mo'i mchod ro' bya bstod pa bskang bshags tshogs mchod rnams zab don snying po ltar du shes gtang rag mchod bstod bya ba dang de nas gshegs skyems 'bul ba na hrī: zhun mar 'bru bcud bdud rtsi yis 'phags ma lha mo'i dgyes pa bskangs: brin las lhun gyis grub pa'i byir: zag med

skyems kyas mched pa 'bul: rtsasngags mthar pañca asro ta khā hūṃ: nyer gcig dag gis phul bar bya de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni a ka ro byan gyis brlabs hā rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma rna:'dod yon lnga yi bkod pa rdzogs: ye shes mchog gi mchod pa yis: 'phags ma'i sku gsung thugs mchog bskangs: mchog thun dngos grub stsol ba dang las bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar: sarba rat+na e dam bha ling ta khā hi: lan bdun gyis ni phul bar bya de nas dngos grub len pa na snyed sa shā: skye 'gagasabral ba ye shes dbyings rtsol len bral ba gnyug ma'i mdzod: gsang gsum byin rlabs zab mo'i gter: rnal 'byor bdag la stsol du gsol: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya sirnyi tshe: wāk+ka sirnyi ā cisti sirnyi sa:sarba sidhi trī: de nas spyogs pa bya ba ni ho: dpang gyur ye shes mkha' 'gro dgongs: bdag ni ma rig dbang gyur te: dam tshig nyams chags gang song yang: gnong 'gyod drag po'i sems kyis bshags: sa ma ya shukhye yis yi ge brgya pa lan gsum bya de nas bsdu ram bya ba ni gi 'bar ba me yi 1nga brten pa'i: 'phags ma lha mo'i dkyil 'khor la: chos kyi

gas dbyengs su badz+ra thu: slar yang 'dod pa rtsal du gsol: ye shes pa chosakya dbyi sa su gshegs dam tshig pa ra ga snying gar bsdu de nas bsngo ba smon lam ni ho: dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba ni: bsdus te mar gyur 'gro la bsngo: phyam gcig gdod ma'i ye gzhi'i klong: kun tu bzang po' sa thob sgo ga: lan gsum de nas bkra shis bya ba ni hūṃ hrī: mi 'gyur yangs pa'i nam mkha' la: rang gsal thugs rje'i nyi ma shar: sgrub mchog blo yi pad+mo phye: phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis re ga bkra shas bsngo smon rgya chen bya tshogs rdzogs sgrab dag don gnyis 'grub the tshom med do sa ma yu de nas rjes rim tshogs mchod ni rgyas par mos na zab snyi ltar bsdu na tshogs rdzas yo byad sa sa bsangs sbyangs byin gyis rlabs nas slar 'bul bshags bstabs pa'i rim pa ni hrī bde dang stong pa'i rang bzhin las byung ba'i ga ṇa tsakra'i gter gu ru rtsa gsum rgya mtsho dang: 'phags ma 'bar ba'i 'od can ma'i: sku gsung thugs la mchod pa 'bul sgo gsum ma rig dam nyams bshags bdag rtogs 'khrul ba'i dam sri bsgral chos dbyings e yi klong du bstabs gzung 'dzin las nyon zhi ba dang phyogs

las rnam rgyal dngos sdo/ba (55: 'brel ba'e tshom bu 'bum phrag bcas: gdod ma'e gzhe la sangs rgyas regag dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab bkra shis mtha' rten rgyas par bya gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag sku gnyis mngon du 'gyur bar nges ze tshom med do sa ma yu: ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pa d+ma sa snying gi yang tig zab pa'i bcud gsang ba brda yi ris su btab las ldan rjesalajug don du brtsam mdo khams tsa ri'i shar du sbas klu bdud btsan la gnyer kha bcol ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga ya dus nad mug mtshon cha'i gzengs la tsha sprul bdud 'joms gling pa yis rnyed nas bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub chos bdag dpa' bo bdun dang ni dpa' mo gsum gyi skal bar bsngags legs par bsgrub na 'tshengs bar 'gyur ral bar gyur na bka' chad 'ong phung 'tsheng nus pa rin chen gter gces pa'i srog las btsa' shes mdzod skal med lag tu ma shor cig 'dod sred can la a tham rgya me gsu yi sman ldong bzang po la brten pa'i lha lnga khu byugs lding gsung snyan chos rkya snang ba mngon g.yu yi sbrang chung brtse ba las zhim mngar sman gyi char ba 'bebs skang drug gar gya lang tsho yis phyogs kyi sbyang rtsi len par skad 'ur ba'i khu ta grags pa yis ma snyan tshig gi snang ba mngon pho rog rdo rje'i 'gros stabs kyis mdur yang saṃrta'i gzengs pa 'khrug rgya stag dmar po' — ro yis

sa 〉 shar gyi ka ba g.yu 'byug la grangs bdun na nye zho ston lha 'di'i thugasarje skyob par 'gyur ha la ri da pa'i zil ba yis sto yi birnyar rlangs pa phog grangs tshad rnam pa bcu ye dus lha 'de'i thugasarje skyob par 'gyur sked med dkyus tang mig41ma mas nub kyi dmo bu bsku zer skad grangs tshad rnam pa bdun gyi dus lha 'di' thugs rje skyob par 'gyur yal 'dab brten ba 'i 'phur rtsal can gtsan spyang ngar mas bskru brid ston byang gi ka ba 'gyil snyen gda' lha 'di'i thugs rje skyob par 'gyur sgrub dang las rnams ma g.yel na rtags dang rten 'brel yongs su dge the tshom mi mnga' rdo rje'i tshig sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi snying khrag 'di snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu h+ye bdo zim snyi ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag popad+ma chosa'athel rgya mtshosadar dang bri gzhi bcas bskul ba dang / chosabadag rang rag chos bdag 'gyur rgyam sgob bu ye shesagrogs mo ratā sa ra slob bu dad ldan chos gsal rnams kyis yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dradapa' bo nusaldan rdo rjes 'bros phug mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling gi sgo 'gram gzum chung rat+na'i rdzong gi bsil phyims nas mkha' 'gro'i brda byang dag par phab pa dge'o/ dge'o/ dgerme / legs so sarba maṅga lam/

shā7)pa sa zab gsang mkha' 'a114thugs thig las: 'phags mdapag med gnan ma'izab sgrub byin rlabs 'byung gnas bzhugs so:pa/ naḥd gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: shā kesgo rdo gru rang reg pad+ma sa bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis blo brtse las su rung ba'i phyir 'phags ma nyer gcig phyag rgya bstan sa ma yā de yang dpag med gnon ma yi gsang bsgrub bsgom pa ra bya ba la sngon 'gro brga snying bltar dngos gzhi bsgom par bya ba na u gzhomed rtsa bral chos sku'i ngang: lhun grub 'gag med snying rje'i mdangs thabs shes sa bon shar ba las: 'od zer 'phro 'dus snod bcud rnams: ye shes lnga ldan yum lnga'i klong: rang gsal lhun grub pho brang dbus: ma chags pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: stobs ldan shang shang khri yi khar: rig pa hrī yig zhu ba las: bdag snangadapag med gnon ma sku: smug por zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: spyan gsum rab zlum khro

gnyar chags: dar dang ren tshan rgyan rnams rdogs: phyag g.yas rdo rje rgya gram phyar: smyo 'dre 'byung po zhe zheng bzlog: g.yon pa ba dan khra bo bsnams: bar chad dam sre bzlog par byed: zhabs gnyis gar gyis khri la rol: 'ja' dang 'od phu 'khrigs pa'i klong: 'dzin med sgyu ma'i sku ru bskyed gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas khyad par 'phags ma'i lha tshogs rnams spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstim: spyan 'dren la sogs gzhung tshang bar zab don snyang po ltar du shes de nas 'dzab bzlas bya ba ni hrī: rang nyid 'phags ma'i thugs klong du nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor sbubs sgog snying hrī la sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas spyo 'dre 'byung po rnams: sbur ma me dang 'phrad pa bzhin: ming tsam med par bsregs pa dang: tshe bsod nyams rtogs yon tan rgyas snang grags rigs gsum bde ba che: lha sngags phyag rgya chen po'i ngang: hrī dz+nyā na bṛ wa na bisnan sarba sha hūṃ ma ra ya phaṭa swā hā: bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzan brtan po yis bye ba gcig bzlas dngos grub thob nyams dang rtog pa'i yon tan rgyas spyo 'dre 'byung po gzhes par 'gyur sgrub dang las sbyor

gsacha dmigs pas phye rtags mtshan yon tan dus su smin the tshom med do sa ma yu de nas lasal spyor ba ni spyo 'drezhe bamibasrung 'khor bstan de yang mu khyud rim pa lnga'i lte bar bdud 'dul mchod rten bri bum par snying 'dar nan dang ni snyi 'phar nan dang snying 'dre nan zhes bri de rgyab mu khyud la pad+ma 'dab bzhi bris pa yi lte bar shar nas g.yas bskor du rgyal po' gnod pas snying 'dar nan bse mo'i gnod pas snying 'phar nan dam sri'i gnod pa sasnying 'dre nan yul 'dre'i gnod pas snying dgur nan de rgyab mu khyud gsum pa la 'chang ba po la rgyal bsen dam sri sde brgyad the'u 'gong 'byung po yul 'dre rnams kyis gnod pas sto 'dre gdug pa can zhi zhi zhig zhig khrol khrol rak+ta rasnya swā snya de rgyab mu khyud bzha pa la dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po' mthar snying 'dre zhi bar gyur cig snying sra zhing brtan par gyur cig snying mi g.yo bar dbang du gyur cag snying la ma rung ba'i bsam sbyor ngan pa choms cig shirnye pus wa shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa swā 1 dergyab mu khyud lnga pa la miri pa tra bri bar bya dzos ni snyang gi zho sha dang gla rtsa gu gul shu dag dang gza' sdum bong nag zhab btag byug chid lnga bsdam la rab gnas bya bdun phrag bar sgrub 'bral med bcing spyo 'dre 'byung po mi tshugs so denas rdzas bsrung bya ba la mu zi nag po gu gul nag gla nag rtsi dang bong nag dang spang sposangad can rnams pa lnga zhib btang sman gya rnams

par bya de nas sngags 'di 'bum bzla gdab oṃ pa marnya ka rgya snyi wa badz+ra pa ṇi khrom ga ru ṭa nag po ti pa ra tsa mā ra ya phaṭa snying 'dar nan snying 'phar nan snying 'dre nan yasmo rasmo shā na mo ra tsa dam sri' gdug rtsub zhi zhi zhig zhag sarba sha hūṃ mā ra ya bod sod sod mi tshag mi bsre nan du bzlo me lce'i 'khor lo mchod par bya dra tshol ba yis skyen las rgyal the tshom med do sa ma pā gzhan yang las su ma rung ba'i sems kyi g.yengs ba bsrung ba'i thabs mthing shog sor do' zhang can la mtshal dang bzang drug zho sha bsre 'di ltar po lhag med par bkod mgabagag gagasoguska she she kyispyong zhe mi ba korgagisgonargargag gnargami— griska gathagargagusgothathagacadagargobagasgogugugugagagagathayog ces bri rdzasani dgu sbyor byung rang sngags 'bum brjod rab tu gnas 'bral med mgul cha nyer 'tshe zha ze pho med do sa ma yu denas rang bzung ril bu ni spru nag dgu pa khyung chen lnga zhib btang ril bu sran ma tsam sdong ros dag gis dril bar bya rin chen sgod gzhug da la'i dbus bkod cing rnam lnga nyer spyod bkram sgrub pa'i khog phub zhag bdun bar rang sngags dag gis 'phro 'dus brlabs de nas drag sngags me lce yis byin rlabs rab tu gnasapar bya btung bas cham yam gdug pa 'joms bsreg pas spyo 'dre 'dul ba dang bsam pa ma lus na gyis grub the tshom med do

pas sam shā de nas rjes rim tshogs mchod ni rgyas par 'dod na zab snying ltar bsdu na tshogasardzas yo byad sbungs bsangs sbyangs byan gyas rlabs nas slar 'bul bshags bstab pa'i rim pa ni tswa gsang chen bla na med pa'i rdzas: rmad byung ga ṇa tsakra'i gter ye shes 'od zer 'phro ba 'di: gu ru rtsa gsum rgya mtsho dang 'phags ma dpag med gnon ma yi sku gsung thugs la mchod pa 'bul: sdom gsum dam tshig nyams pa bshags log 'khrul dam sri 'byung po bsgral: mi 'gyur gsang ba'i klong du bstabs: las su ma rung spyo 'dre zhi:phyogs las rnam rgyal dngos grub stsol: khams gsum sems can ma lus pa: gdod ma'i rgyal sar phyin par regag: dge ba bsngo zhi smon lam gdab bkra shis mtha' rten rgyas par bya gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrab pa dag zung 'jug sku gnyis mngon du 'gyur the tshom med do sa ma rwa ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pa d+ma ngas snying gi yang tag zab pa' bcud gsang ba brda yi ras su btab las ldan rje 'jug don du brtsam mdo khams tsa ri'i shar du sbas klu bdud btsan la gnyer kha bcol ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga yi dus nad mug mtshon chas gzengs lang tshe nga sprulabadud 'jems gleng pa yis rnyed nas bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub

chos bdag dpa' bo bdun dang ni dpa' mo gsum gyi skal bar bsngags legs par brten na nyi ma 'byung ral bar gyur na mun pa 'tshubs phung 'tshengasanus pa rin chen gter gces pa'i grog las btsa' shesamadzod skal med lag tu ma shor cig 'dod sred can la a tham rgya ske jing bu kumud tshal kya klong yad bzhan nor bu 'od stong 'bar rted na legs pa'i lang tsho bkra ma mthong dbul ba dag la sel chags pa bral ba'i rdo rje de g.yu 'byug phyag na bsnamasanas su gser gyi smad du 'doms pa na legs pa'i nyi ma zhig 'khrung skad rat+na 'bar ba' be con de sngags skye khyi ye phyag na bsnams log 'dren dus bzhi' 'tshubs ma bzlog gser gye mar me rang 'bar 'gyur pad+ma 'bar ba'i sdong po de ngang mo ku ku'i phyag na bsnams phyogs dang phyogs su ba dan gzeng man shel 'od kyis mun pa sel ral gri rno ba' ngar can de glang gi rwa la btags byas na yar stod phyogs su bstan pa rgyas ri 'ong 'dzin pas mun pa sel snang ba'i 'ja' lnga ra la brten sprel ser stag gi 'phyong rtsal byed brang ba'i rtsa'i bcud shor na glen pa'i go na bde legs rgyas mkhas pas she rab mig rnon 'byed 'ur ba'i bye'u chung 'bum 'bum yal pad+ma'i sbubs nas ya mtshan rgyas med byung rtags dang rten 'brel dge the tshom med do sa ma yā mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi snying khrag 'ad snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog rgya rgya rgya gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya

gas zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya brda thi ñcā ces pa 'di'ang chos rkya bdag po pad+ma chosa'aphelargya mtshos shog dkar dang bcas bskul ba dang / chos bdag rang rig sgob buye shesagrogs mo rat+na sa ra dad ldan chos rgyal rnams kyisayang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nusaldan rdo rje 'bros phug mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling nas dag pa ra phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma lam/
tsho khoshecas zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: 'phags ma lha mo rma bya chen mo'i zab sgrub grib gdon kun 'joms bzhugs so:

sa / na 31 gu dzan pad+ma kā ra ye: ba gasgo/rten)/1 bdag 'dra pad+ma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis grib gdon drungs nas 'byen pa'i phyir 'phags ma nyer gcig phyag rgya bstan sa ma ga de yang rma bya chen mo la brten nas gsang sgrub bsgom pa la sngon 'gro ba don snyeng po ltar dngos gzhi lha skyed bya ba ni yi chos kun mi dmigs ka dag ngang lhun grub rang gsal snying rje'i mdangs: rig pa hrī:yig shar ba las 'od zer 'phro 'dus snod bcud rnams: dag pa yum chen lnga yi klong: de 'bus rang gsal pho brang nang: ma chags pad+ma nyi zla'i steng:'dzes pa rma bya'i khri yi khar: srog snying sa bon zhu ba las: bdag snang rma bya chen mo'i sku: dmar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: mdzes 'dzum lang tsho'i dpal gyis 'khyud:rma bya'i thul ba rat+nas brgyan longs sku'i chas rgyan bcu gsum spras: phyag g.yas rin chen bum pa bsnams: sgrub pa po yi lus sems bsrung: g.yon pas gsung snyan dril bu 'dzin: 'gro la chos kyis char chen 'bebs: zhabs gnyis bsgyur bas khri la rol 'ja' 'od thig le lnga yi 1nga: rang gsal sgyu ma'i sku ru bskyed gnas gsum rdo rje'o sa

cas〉 bon las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas: khyad par 'phags ma'i lha tshogs rnams: sbyan drangs gnyis su med par bstim spyan 'dren la sogs gzhung tshang bar zabaton snyingapo ltar du shes de nas 'dzab bzlas bya ba ni trī: rang nyid 'phags ma'i thugs klong du: nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor sbubs: thugs sgog hrī:la sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas mi gtsang grib rigs rnams: sbur ma me dang 'phrad pa bzhin: ming tsam med par bsreg pa dang tshe bsod dpal yon 'byor ba rgyas: snang grags rig gsum bde ba che: lha sngags phyag rgya chos sku'i ngang: sdi:dhe haṃ ya he sarba sirnyi sa:sarba 17 ga shirnye ku ru ye swā hā: bskyed rdzogs dmigs bsgom gdengasaldan pas bye ba gcig bzlas dngos grub thob nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rgyas grib dang mi gtsang dri ma zhi sgrub dang las spyor dmigs pas phye rtags mtshan yon tan khyad par 'phags the tshom med do sa ma pā de nas las la sbyor ba ni gza' grib bsrung ba 'di lta ste shog dkar ngos su sbrul gzugs bri khog par yi ge 'di bzhin no oṃbadz+rapaṇi hūṃ badz+ra phaṭa ra hu la'i grib gdon zhi zhi zhig zhig shirnye ku ru ye swā sna 'chang ba po la raku rab ces bri snyugs ma' zu gu' steng mjug nas yar dral rdzas na gces mgo

dgu pa dang ngad pa can phyi rim la ca'i na bza' la mig mang ru mo bri bar bya dal gzhug badz+ra pa ṇi yi rang sngags 'bum gyisarab tu gnas 'bral med mgul btags gza' grib las rnam par rgyal lo sa ma mā de nasargyal gribabasrung ba la mazi shog gla rtsi byug pa'i ngor mtshal gyi mu khyud bdun du bskor dbus su rdo rje rgya gram nyid ste bar la ni 'di bzhin no ra dza dum bur gtub 'chang ba po la rasta rak+ṣa de rgyab mu khyud gnyis pa la oṃ badz+ra ma ha gu ru khro bo lod kro dha ra dza artsig ni ga na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra kai la ka la ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ pāṭa pāṭa pāṭa ra tsa 'khu na dum bur shig nan phaṭa de rgyab mu khyud gsum pa la 'chang ba po la rgyal 'gong dam sri gdug can rgyas mi tshug par bsrungs shig rak+ṣa rak+ṣe yashā tsat+ta dung dung dza rbad ra tsa na na dum bur shig shig bzlog na ra tsa'i tsat+ta phyung phyung 'da' na ra tsa'i tsat+ta rbad rbad ya tri ya ya tri ya ya tri ya ya tri ya ma zhung tri ya ma zhu tra ya ra tsa tri dza shag rbad sarba duṣ+ṭan phaṭa badz+ra rasnya hūṃ de rgyab mu khyud bzhi pa la yom ཿཿyayaḥthanasaḥrasnya paḥs nitshogaḥ2 yin par sems dri ka na aḥspyoḥdzaḥdzaḥ a wāk+ka tsarnya sto bha ya nan nan a shig shig phyung phyung khrol khrol swā 1gnod byed rgyal 'gong phye ma 'phur ma dṛ kra mā ra ya bzlog bzlog gnod byed ra tsa'i srog rtsa dmar po la mā ra ya rbad rbad 'chang ba po la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa de rgyab mu khyud lnga pa la dbyangs dang gsal byed rten snying mthar ra tsa'i

pa gnod pa zhi bar gyur cig shidhe gas wa shaṃ ma ra ya phaṭa de rgyab mu khyud drug pa la gu ru drag po'i sku gzugs bri dergyab ku khyud bdun pa la me ra pa tra bri ba dang rdzas ni gu gul yungs dkar nag ar nag sngags pa'i phur dbal drag tsher nag rnams ni legs par byug sku la bzang po drug ldan sbyar snying po byu ru mig gsum pa ming lde phur ba'i rtse la 'dzug rgya lnga bsdam la dar gyis dril za sa kya ga'ur btsud byas te drag po'i sngags ni 'bum gyis bsgrub 'bral med bcing bas bar chad sel the tshom med do sa ma yā dinasagrib bsrung spyi khyab ni ren chen shog dkar dra bral ngor gur gum bza drug bsres nas byug mtshal gyas mu khyud rim bdun bskor mthing ga'i dbus su rgya gram bri lte b.rabadz+ra rak+ṣa spyo dorgyab mu khyud gnyis pa la 'chang ba po la steng lha yi grib bar sde brgyad kyi grib 'jigarten mi yi grib ro bag mna' zan gyi grib mdze yug dme po'i grab dam sdom nyams pa'i grib rgyal bsen dam sri'i grib g.yem skams thugs pa'i grib 'og klu yi grib sa bdag gnyan gyi grib mi dang mi min gya grab la sogs pas mdor na gnod cing 'tsha bar byed pa'i grib rnams kyis mi tshug par bsrungs shig rasnya rak+ta de rgyab mu khyud gsum pa la cha tha141gargyagagatsho masgogagagu6)rgazoshegag༄ gagashatshadarga —40thagagagasmagrugagagutshanagag

lan gsum bres la lhag chad spangs de rgyab mu khyud bzhe pa la dbyangs dang gsal byed rten snyeng mthar las bzhen sham bu bcas te bkod de rgyab mu khyud lnga pa la rdo rje'i phreng ba bar med bya de rgyab mu khyud drug pa la dme bar brtsegs pa'i sku gzugs bra de rgyab mu khyud bdun pa la me ra pa tra bcas te bkod rdzas ni ser po dgu sbyor dang bzang drug dug sel dgu po byug rgya lnga bsdam nas dar mthang bgo dal gzhug bdun phrag bar du bsgrub me tog dor la bar tu gnas de yis grib rnams kun 'joms 'gyur byin rlabs rno nus khyad par 'phags bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal sa ma mā de nas rjes ram tshogs mchod ni rgyas par mos na ba snying ltar bsdu na tshogs dzosam byad spungs bsang sbyangs byin rgyas brlabs nas slar 'bul bshags bstabs pa' ram pa ni hrī bla med gsang ba sngags kyi rdzas: rmad byung ga ṇa tsakra'i gter: gu dzan rtsa gab/ma rgya mtsho dang: 'phags ma rma bya chen mo yi: sku gsung thugs la mchod pa 'bul: dam tshig nyams chags 'gal 'khrul bshags: 'o ga rtog ma rig dam sri bsgral: ye shes gsang ba'i klong du bstabs: mi mthun nyer 'che'i zhi ba dang: rnams par rgyal ba'i dngos grub stsol: bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus pa rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog: dge ba

pasacha baspyo zhing bye na lam gdab: bkra shis mtha' rten rgyas par bya gnad des tshogs gnyas rdzogs pa dang sgrib dag sku gnyis maro na du 'gyur the tshom med do sa ma shā ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma ngas snyang tag zab pa'i bcud byung ba gsang ba brda yi ris su btab ma 'ongs skal ldan don du bkod mdo khams tsā ri'i shar du sbas klu btsan bdud la gnyer kha bcol ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga yi dus dus 'khrugasamatshon chas gzeng lang tshe nga sprulabadud 'jomasagling pa yis rnyed nas bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub chos bdag dpa' bo bdun dang ni dpa' mo gsum gyi skal bar bsngags legs par brten na 'ad phyir dge ral bar gyur na chad pa 'ong phong 'tshengs nusapa ran chen gter srog las gces par btsa' shes mdzod skal med lag tu ma shor cig 'dod sred can la a tham rgya 'u tshugasamakhan la rlung ma bsgrags bsdams dang btsa' shes byed par zhu mi brag dkar ba gam mtho ba' gzhir khyung chen rgyal po'i 'dab gshog rgyas ljon bzang shing gi lo ma la brten bcas phru gu bcu gsum gda' sngar ma smin kyang da skabasasmin zal mo rgang la ne tso bab zab mo' glu dbyangs kyu ru ru mos ldan ngang mo brgya bcu pa rang srid bcu gsum phrag tsam pa' 'od kyi rtags mtshan khyad par 'phags glang ga rwa rtse brag la 'khrab mche ba'i dug zur 'bebs skabs mchis 'joms pa'i dpal 'dzan ngas nus ma

bzlog byed rgyal po 'byung po 'dul khyi yisangar zug gnam las 'byung lcags kyi spu gri brdar ba las sa mtshams sdig pa ra tsa'i bsad grong mkhar bcu gsum gtor la chas mkha' dbyings bdud rtsi 'bebs pa las sayi myu gu bcu gsum smin rtags dang ya mtshan e ma ho sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi snyi khrag 'di snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi ces pa 'di'ang chos kya bdag popad+ma chosa'aphelargya mtshos shog dkar dang bcas bskul ba da chos bdag ra rag gas bra gzha shog dkar dang bcas bskul ba dang slob buyeshe grogs morat+na ra slob bu chos gsal rnams kyis yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bonusaldan rdo rje 'dros phug mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling nas ḍak+ki' brda byang zab mo dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam/

3 khya9nagayo zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las:'phags ma mi pham rgyal mo'i zab sgrub gdug pa kun 'joms bzhugs so:pa sa na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: thanogordo khuyo rang byung pad+ma sa bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis bar chad g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phyir 'pha gas ma nyer gcag phyag rgya bstan sa ma yu de yang mi pham rgyal mo la brten pa'i gsang sgrub bsgom 'dod na sngon 'gro zab don snying po ltar dngos gzhi lha sku bskyed pa ni usmra bsam brjod bral chos sku'i ngang:lhun grub bde chen ye shes mdangs:thabs shes sa bon 'phros pa las 'od zer 'phro 'dus snod bcud rnams:dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yum lnga'i dal:rang gsal ye shes pho brang dbus ma chags pad+ma nyi zla'i steng:mdzes pa khyims bya'i khri yi khar trī bab yongs su gyur pa las:'phags ma mi pham rgyal mo ni:dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa:spyan gsum 'dzum sgeg

rnam 'gyur can dar dang ren chen pad phreng brgyan: phyag g.yas she rab ral gre phyar: gzung 'dzin rtsad nas gcod par byed: gapon pas 'dod 'byung bhan+ta brten: mcheg thun dngos grub stsol bar byed: zhabs gnyis gar gyis khri la rol 'ja' 'od thig le lnga ldan klong snang stong 'od kyi rol par bskyed: gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las:'od 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas: khyad par 'phags ma'i lha tshogs rnams: spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstem: spyan 'dren la sogs gzhu tshangs bar zab don snying po ltar du shes de nasa'adzab bzlasabya ba ni trī: rang nyid 'phags ma'i thugs klong du: nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor sbubs: rig pa hrī la sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas mi mthun phyogs rnams kun: sbur ma me dang 'phrang pa bzhin ming tsam med par bsregs pa dang: tshe bsod yon tan 'byor ba rgyas: snang grags rig gsum ye shes 1nga: lha sngags phyag rgya chos sku'i ngang: skyid ār+ya dza ya bi dza ma hā sarba sidhi sa: sarba duṣ+ṭan shrī hūṃ phaṭa bskyed rdzogs tang 'dzan brtan po yis bye ba gcig bzlas dngos grub zob nyams dang rtogs pa 'a yon tan rgyas: bar chad rkyen snang zhi bar 'gyur

g.yo sgrub dang las sbyor dmags pas phyeḥbazlas tshad rab smin yon tha sman the po mad do sa ma wā de nas lasal spyor ba na mtha' ma' byad phur — srung ba' tha sa seng lda phur ba mtho gang ba khro zhal rgya mdud 'chang zung ni rdo rje rtse dgu'i rnams pa can rgya mdud chu sran dbal zur gsum sgrul chun rnams pa gnyis dang bcas zu 'jug mthing shog gtsang ma la ran za gter kyis 'di ba wa bri ga a shagagagargags smagagagasamab nagagro2gagagagagagabagagak+ṣigam maspamadza slo gagorgasgogagagogagathomathasagugabasagagagagamimisgo sgor11gramigagrugla blasmathagagablagrunagagagagaglagagurgargargargasgargargosarga smagagu masmasgogasagagacigagagrirgagasgagasgogothasgogagyargagogyagagog smargagagagamagagagagagagasogagi migatsha gagagagatha mamimatshogagazagaglugrasgetsām rdzas na ser nag dgu sbyor byug bsrung rim rgyal pa 'i sngagasakyi sgrub 'bum ther bzla zhing me tog 'thor de nas 'bral mad sked pa ra bsten kla kle'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal phyi na — rkyen las rnams par grol the tshom med do sa ma yā da na tshwa tshwa nag po ni

r+sā gang mgo brgyad rten snyeng can ri sna 4 gsum sa rnamasal chu sna bcu gsum ma gyis sprus gzugs brten tshang bar gdab byasanas zung 'jug snag shog nag po la mtshal gyasa'adi ltar bri bar bya sogabagagagargyagathathagathamargagagurgab dgathatha tsanasgomazlo gagamagag smogathag ga go31 gagathagacasanarganagabagazha ma rgaspyordogagagathatshogabyug thagasamathathargagag gams gamatha thogam thargamasasgonabathargyusagagirgagathathayijigargamismragamā2gagagu josan ser nag dgu sbyor byug 'dul byed go po'i gzung ring ni 'bum gyis rab tu gnasapar bya de nasarang gi sbra khang gi ོ 'bram la bag ban bon ni 'bum gyi glagasami rted par 'gyur the mo med do sa ma yu denas 'khor lo yong ba la mthing shog ngosal ma྾ sbyar ni mu khyud rim pa lnga ru bskor lte bar rdo rje rwa gdengs bri kun klum dbus su 'di brtsam mo 4 4 de rgyab mu khyud gnyis pa la 44 ba yo lu ngag yid gsum la mtha' mi kla klo'i byad phur dzos sbyor ba pas mi tshug par srungs shig raku rak+ṣa de rgyab mu khyud gsum pa la 'amang ba po la mu stegs sprel lag can rgya byad bur bon po dmod zor mkhan gyi byad phur zhung zhu btso

pa /〉 zor mkhan gyi dug g.yos lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi cho 'phrul steng lha yi bka' chad bar gnyan gyi gdug rtsub 'og klu yi dug g.yos than rigs sum brgyad drug cu ltas ngan rbod zor ngan pa mthu gtad dmod sgrub rlung 'khor hom mnan sogs kyis mi tshug pa ra bsrung shig ratha rak+ṣa dmod zor nus mthu rags sngags thams cad byad ma kho rang la bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog rbad nan phaṭa de rgyab mu khyud bzhi pa la dbya sa gsal rten snying las bzhi'i sham de rgyab mu khyud lnga pa la me ri pa tra bri bar bya rdzas ni ser nag dgu sbyor byug dal gzhug zhag bdun bar du bsgrub rgya lnga bsdam la 'bral med bcang gnad des mtha' mi kla klo yi rdzas sbyor rbod gtong g.yul las rgyal byin rlabs rno nus khyad par 'phags bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal sa ma yu de nas rjes rim tshogs mchod ni rgyas par 'dod na zab snying ltar bsdu bar mos na tshogs rdzas dang yo byad ma lus bsags shing spungs bas sa sbyangs byin rlabs grub nas su 'bul bshags bsgral bstab rim pa na hrī lnga mtshar med du byung ba yi: bla med ga ṇa tsakra'i gter: gu dzag rtsa gadza/ma rgya ma37 dang:'phags ma mi pham rgyal mo yi sku gsung thugs la mchod pa 'bul: dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: log 'khrul dam sri 'byung po bsgral: bde ba chen po'i dbyings

su bstabs me mthun phyogs rnams zhe ba dang: rnam par rgyal ba'e dngos grub stsol: bzang ngan las kye 'brel ba' 'gro: tshom bu gtsag tu sangs rgyas shog: dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab bkra shis mtha' brten rgyas par bya gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag zung 'jug sku gnyis mngon du 'gyur the tshom med do sa ma yā ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po pad+ma ngas snyang tig zab pa' man ngag bcud gsang ba brda yi ris su btab las ldan rnams kyi don phyir brtsam mdo khams tsā ri' shar du sbas klu bdud btsan la gnyer kha bcopa ma 'ongasalhags ma lnga ya dus nad mug mtshon chas gzengs lang tshe nga sprul bdud 'joms gling pa yis rnyed nasabastan 'gro'i don chen 'grub chos bdag dpa' bo bdun dang na dpa' mo gsum gyi skal bar bsngags legs par brten na phan bde 'khrung g.yel bar gyur na mi 'dod 'tshubs phong 'tsheng nus pa rin chen gter rang gi srog ltar btsa' shesamadzod skal med lag tu ma shor cig 'dod sred can la a tham rgya mi 'ja' zer gur gyi bsil khang nas rma bya dmar po'i zlos gar bsgyur jing bu ku mud ches nang du ngang mo'i nya shu rtsa lnga rtse shar phyogasagangs la brten bcas pa'i gdong lnga g.yu ral ldan pa lnga sto phyogs nags kyi bsil khang la brten pa'i rgya stag dmar po gsum nub phyogs brag dkar gnam mtshong la brten pa' bya rgyal

pa / rgod po bcu byang phyogs g.yu yi na bun la brten bcas gsung snyan rnam pa gnyis dus dang dus su rnam par 'du si ga ṭa yi gzhi ma la leb byang ha la dug zer ldang sman gyis dri bsung 'thul ba yis bde legs dpal gyi myu gu 'khrung ne rtsa'i kha nas gtam gsar g.yo 'ja' lnga'i gdong nas rgya stag ngar stobs bzang glang po' zal gyi gnon phan bde'i nyi rma 'od stong 'bar the tshom med do sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi snying khrag 'ad snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chos 'apel rgya mchosashog dkar bcas bskul ba dang chos bdagarang rag slob bu ye shes dad ldan chos rgyal grogs mo rat+na sa ra rnams kyis bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' ponus ldan rdo rjesi 'bros phug mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling nas dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma lam/

1 (20)g.yo zab gsang mkha' 'grolithugs thig las:ri khrod lha tho lo gyon mali ba sgrub nad rims kun 'joms bzhugs so cas na 31 gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye:sgom31 (111 rang reg pad+ma sa bha was snyags ma'i 'gro la brtsa sems kyis nad yam drung nas 'byin pa'i phyir 'phags ma nyer gcig phyag rgya bstan sa ma wā deyang 4khrod lha mo la brten pa'i gsang sgrub bsgom pa na sngon 'gro zab don snying po ltar dngos gzhi sgom par bya ba ni 'chos kun gzhi med rtsa bral klong:ma 'gags zang thal ye shes mdangs:thabs shes sa bon gsal ba las:'od zer 'phro 'dus sgod bcud rnams:ye shes lnga ldan yum lnga'i klong:lhun grub rang gsal pho brang dbus ma chags pad+ma nyi zla'i steng:gsung snyan ne tso'i khri yi khar:rang rigahrī:yig zhu ba las:bdag snangare khrod lha mo'i sku:ljang ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma:zhi 'dzum chags pa'i rnam 'gyur ldan dar

dang rat+na'i rgyan gyes spras: pad+ma dkar po'i do shal 'phyangs: phyag g.yas rma bya'e sgro mdangs phyar: nad yam rems sogs zhe bar byed: g.yon pa g.yu ye ga'u 'ardzan: bsrung bya'i tshe sgog skyobs par byed: zhabs gnyis gar gyis khri la rol: 'ja' 'od thig le lnga ldan 1nga: gsal stong 'dzin bral chen por bskyed: gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas khyad par 'phags ma'i lha tshogs rnams: spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstim spyan 'dren la sogs gzhung tshang bar zab don snyeng po ltar du shes de nas 'dzab bzlas bya ba ni hrī rang nyid 'phags ma'i thugs klong du: nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor sbubs: sgog snying hrī:la sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas nad yam grib rigs rnams: sbur ma me dang 'phrad pa bzhin: ming tsam med par zhi ba dang: tshe bsod nyams rtogs sku na tan rgyas snang grags rig gsum chos sku che: lha sngags phyag rgya chen po'i ngang: hrī:bi sha tsi par+ṇa sha wa ri dz+wa ra pra sha ma ṇi swā hā: bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzan brtan po yas bye ba gcag bzlas daro sa grub thob nyams dang rtogs pa 'a yon tan rgyas nad gajon grib sogs zha bar 'gyur

gas sgrub dang lasasbyor dmigs pasaphye rtags mtshan yon tan dus su sman the tshom med do sa ma yu denasaril bu bsgrub pa ni spyang gu sre mong te lo' sha byi tshil nag po dgu sbyor rnams shad btagasaril bu sran ma tsam kha dog nag por bsgyur nas su rin chen shel gya bum par blugs rnam lnga nyer spyod dag gis bskor gzhung bzhin bsgrub cang bzlas pa 'bum gnad sman song tshe cang 'thus 'od 'khrug me rtag 'phro ba sogs rtags su 'byung tshe ras sngon gyis thum bur byas nas mgul du btags kha sna dag la byug pa ra bya gnad des nad yam brgya yi khrod nyal kyang rim kyis ma tshugs so the tshom med do sa ma wā denas 'khor len bcings thabs la shog dkar dri ba bral bas ngor mtshal gyis mu khyud bcu gsum bri lte bar 'phags ma'i sku gzugs la grog yag dang bcas bzang drug byug de nas mu khyud gnyis pa la sgom yisha rtse pa sha wa ri phaṭa sarba ro yin durme dz+wa ra gnyan gas pur nag po sum sbrel sarba shirnye ku ru ye swā sna 'chang ba po la rak+ṣa rasnya de rgyab mu khyud gsum pa la pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad bris pa'i shar nas rim par g.yas bskor gyis sarba bsno bgegasashirnye ku ru ye swā 1 sarba ro ga nad shirnye ku ru ye swā sna sarba du gdon sharnye ku ru ye swā 1 sarba dz+wa ra rim yams shirnya ku ru ye swā snya sarba dusab rma lam ngan pa shirnye ku ru ye swā ga sarba durmi ti ba de ma na pa shirnya ku ru ye swā snya sarba dus gdug pa can shirnye ku

ru ye swā snya sarba bhi sha le nag po sum sbrel shirnye ku ru ye swā 1 de rgyab mu khyud bzhi pa la 'chang ba po'i lus ngag yid gsum la rlung mkhris bad gan 'duthapa'i nad rims grib yam gdon bgegasargyal bsen 'byung po'i g.yul ngo las byung ba'i khrag bshal rgya 'byum sbos gas 'bog brgyal sogs nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi bgegs stong phrag brgyad cu'i gnod pa las bsrung shig rasnya rasnya kun la nag po dgu sbyor byug de rgyab mu khyud lnga pa la rdo rje'i phreng ba bri bar bya mtshamasasu nad pam bzung shig dang rak+ka rak+ka bri bar bya de rgyab mu khyud drug pa la phur bu phya bstor lnga bcu bri mtsham su dz+wa ra phaṭa zhes 'god de rgyab mu khyud bdun pa la yag mgo phyi ru bstan nas su yo paṃ sha tsa sno pa sha wa ri phaṭa khrom ga ru sno oṃ phe lang dza yak+ṣa dung dung bṛ rbad ra tsa bse mo'i sha la dza khrag la grub rusal rngub khrag bshal chod dze skom rgyu gzer dz+wa la ram rgya 'brum chu bur 'dug mig ram̐ ram̐ gnyan rims gsapur dza ye ye ram̐ dza tsi tsi haṃ shaṃ ta'i nag po sum sbrel dza sod ram ram rbad mkhris yam dug bshal skems sgrang mu ci li gnyan sagasarims sod dza sabo dz+wa ra sod sarba dz+wa ra skem sarba dz+wa ra nan sarba dz+wa ra rbad sabo dz+wa ra pāṭa sarba dz+wa ra thul phug phug sod phaṭa phaṭa sod ha la ha la phyung phyung hab phyung hub phyung nan nan sod sarba dur ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa shu ka la ru pa mā ra ya rbad sod rgya 'dre 'byung po'i nad gdon grib

pas yam rnams bzlog cig bdud pra ma ra ya rbad nan nan kha la dza ma ni rbad sod rā dza dun ling shag rbad nan shig shag dum dum rbad nan tshal pa tshal pa rbad nan khrom khrom bh+yo bh+yo rbad nan rmug thug rbad nan tir tir rbad nan tshal tshal rbad nan rims yam gdug pa can tshar chod cig drungs nas skems shag sarba du ca mā ra ya pāṭa de rnams kun la kun thub kyi ril bu byug par bya'o de rgyab mu khyud brgyad pa la dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po dang las bzhi'i sham bu gdags par bya rdzas na bdud rtsi chos sman byug de rgyab mu khyud dgu pa la 'byung ba sa yi ru mo bra de rgyab mu khyud bcu pa la rgya mtsho chu yi ru mo bri de rgyab mu khyud bcu gcig par 'bar ba me yi ru mo bri de rgyab mu khyud bcu gnyis par 'byung ba rlung gi ru mo bri rdzas ni dri bzang ba phyung byug de rgyab mu khyud bcu gsum par ru sbal gzung brten tshang bar bya sna lnga'i ching kyas rgyas gdab nas — da la'i dbus gzhug bdun phrag bar bsgrub nas zangs kyi ga'u gzhug 'bral med mchan khung g.yon du btags de nas nad yam brgya yi khrod nyal yang 'jigs pa'i mi tshugs ro byin rlabs rno nus khyad par 'phags bden rdzun lag tu longs dang gsal sa ma yā de nas rjes rim tshogs mchod ni rgyas par 'dod na zab snying ltar bsdu bar mos na tshogs rdzas dang yo byad ma lus bsags shing spungs bsangs sbyangs byin gyis rlabs nas slar

'bul bshags bstab pa'i rim pa ni rte gsang sngags mchog ge dam rdzas rna rmad byung ga ṇa tsakra'i gter: gu ru rtsa gsum rgya mtsho dang: 'phags ma re khrod lha mo ye: sku gsung thugs la mchod pa 'bul: sgo gsum ma rig dam nyams shags: gzung dang 'dzin pa'i dam sri bsgral: ye shes gsang ba'i klong du bstabs: nad gdon grib yam zhi ba dang phyogs las rnam rgyal dngos grub stsol: bzang ngan las kyi 'brel ba'i 'gro: gdod ma'i rgyal sa zin par re ga dge ba bsnga zhing smon lam gdab bkra shes mtha' brten rgyas par bya gnad des tshogs rdzogasasgrab pa dag sku gnyis mngon du 'gyur bar nges the tshom med do sa ma wā ye ma rgyal ba' dbang po pad+ma ngas snying gi ya tig zab ba'i bcud gsang ba brda yi ris su btab las ldan rjes 'jug don du brtsams mdo khams tsa ri'i shar du sbas klu bdud btsan la gnyer ka bcol ma 'ongs snyags ma lnga yi dus dus 'byugs mtshon cha'i gzengs lang tshe nga sprul bdud 'jomasagling pa yis rnyed nas bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub chos bdag dpa' bo bdun dang ni dpa' mo gsum gyis skal bar bsngags legs par bsgrub na 'tsheng bar 'gyur ral bar gyur na phong sa pa ra nge sa phongs 'tsheng nus pa rin chen gter ra srog bzhin du btsa' shes mdzod

pas〉 skal med lag tu ma shor cig 'dod sred can la a tham rgya 'u tshug mkhan der rlung ma bsgrags ma tsaston sman gyibasilakhrod du gsung snyan lho mon rgyal mo brtse lha bya ngang mo' 'phur lding 'khrugs shar phyogs zla rgyal 'phan po'i 'dabs gser gyi nyi ma 'od po che cang shes rgyal por brten nas chas sa rtag 'dzum la brtse ba'i skabs bde ba lcag kyu bzung byas nas bstan pa yar ngosaphyogs su spel bcu gsum rdo rje'i pho nya yis ba dan dkar po gnam la bsor 'bum phrag dag pa'i zhing la 'god ri nas dug sbrul rgyugs pa'i che'i ra ca can gyi snying la zhugs sku la mi 'tshams sna dgu ston legs nyes snang ba'i ru mo mngon 'joms byed pad+ma kā ra yi sgrub pa chen po ma g.yel cig de ldan rtags rten 'brel dge the tshom med do sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya mkha' 'gro'i 'bum gyi snying khrag 'di snying gi bu dang 'phrad pa ra shog gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya brda tham snyi cesapa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag popad+matshas 'phal rgya mtshos shog dkar dang bcas bskul ba dang / chos bdag rang rag slob bu ye shes grogs mo rat+na sar slob bu chos gsal rnams kyis yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bonusaldan dorjesa'abros phug mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling nas ḍak+ka'i brda byang dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam/

(21)ca na zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las lha mo 'od zer can ma'i zab sgrub gdug pa tshar gcod bzhugs so:pa ste na mo gu ru pad+ma kā ra ye: na slogazwa mi1 rang byung pad+ma sa bha was snyigs ma' 'gro ba skyobs pa'i gdug tshogs drungs nas 'byan pa 'a phyir 'pha gas ma nyar gcag phyag rgya bstan sa ma mā de pang 'od zer can ma la brten pa'i gsang sgrub zab mo ni sngon 'gro ba don snying po ltar dngos gzhi'i 'khrul 'khor bsgom pa na uchos rnams dmigs med gzhi rtsa bral rang gsal byang chub sems kyi mdangs:rgyu yi sa bon gsal ba las 'od zer 'phro 'dus sgod bcud rnams:dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dal du rdzogs:lhun grub gzhal med khang dbus su:rang byung pad nyi zla ba'i steng gser mdog phag gi khro yi khar rig pa trī:yig zhu ba las:bdag snang 'od zer can ma'i sku ser gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa khro 'dzum

chags pa'e nyams dang ldan: dar dang rat+na'e rgyan rnams dzogs: phyag g.yas brdung byed tho ba btegs: gapon pas mun sel nye ma bsnams: zhabs rna phyed skyel khre la rngal:'ja' 'od thig le 'khrigs pa'i klong: snang stong sgyu ma'i sku ru bskyed: gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od 'phros dbyings nas ye shes pa: kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa bzhin:spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstim spyan 'dren la sogs bstod pa yan zab don snying po ltar du shes thugs dam bskul rjes 'jab bzlas na hrī rang nyid 'phags ma'i thugs slong du: nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor sbubs: rig pa hrīsapa sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas dgra gdon bgegs kyi tshogs: mi dang mi min thams cad kyis: sbyor ngan 'jig tshogs zhi ba dang: tshe dang bsod nams 'phel zhing rgyas: snang grags rig gsum bde ba che: lha sngags phyag rgya chos sku'i ngang: hrī ār+ya ma ri bye rlu swā hā: bskyed rdzogs dmigs gnad ldan pa yis bye ba gcig bzlas dngos grub thob nyams rtogs yon tan zla ltar rgyas phyi nang dgra 'dre'i 'tshe ba zhi sgrub da las sbyor dmigs pa sa phye rang rtags yon tan dus su smin ze tshom med do sa ma yu de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni rje'u chung

ga sa brdung la 'di skad do hūṃ trī dmigs med mkha' dbyings dag pa'i zhing: g.yu lo can gyi pho brang nas: rje btsun 'phags ma gtso 'khor bcas: khyad par lha mo 'od zer can: ma thogs spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dam tshig gsang ba'i rten la bzhugs: ma badz+ra sa ma ja dza: dz+nyā na tiṣ+ṭha lhan: sa gyis rat+na yangs pa'i snod du: a las gtor ma 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi phung po: / gis mchod pa'i lha mo'i gar bsgyur dang bcas nas 'phags ma'i tshogs la bstabs pas dgyes pa bskang bar bsam la: snyen ār+ya ma ri bye sum̐ swā hā: sarba rat+na e de bā ling ta kha kha khā twe kha hi lan bdun gyi phul lo de nas phrin las bcol ba na hūṃ trī: 'a〈sna b.liskyabs gcig 'phags ma yul: 'od zer can ma brtse bas dgongs: deng sang snyigs ma lnga yi dus: log 'khrul bdud kyi rgol ba 'brug: nad mug mtshon chas gzengs pa lang: shi 'dre 'gong 'dre'i nyul ma 'tshubs: chos byed yongs la bar chad brtsam: skye 'gro sdug la sbyor ba'i skabs: khyed cag dam bca' ma g.yel bar: dus kyi rgud pa mtha' dag sol: sgrub pa po yi bar chad bzlog: rnal

'byor bdag ge bsam pa sgrubs 'jig rten bde skyed ldan pa dang phyogs las rnam rgyal snang ba bskyed: chos kye nye ma 'od po che 'dzam gleng kun khyab phrin las mdzod:thugs dam ma g.yel sa ma yā: ces brjod mchod bstod gzhung ltar bya gang bcol brin las thogs med 'grub sa ma mā de nas las la sbyor ba ni jag 'joms man ngag zab mo bstan de yang tshe zad glang ma yi byang bu sor mo gsum ma la dgra gzung ling ga bre bar bya srog la brten nas 'di ltar smon lag la brdar ba' dgra bo nan ces brtsam sasgro'i dbusasu gzhugs mdog nag bya ba rten 'og mnan 'gugs gzhugs bya zhig dgra bo yis bla yid sems gsum myos par bsam gzhan yang lcags khab sor bzhi do ba'i phyi rim dug shog gtsang ma la dug khrag sbyar bas 'di nyid bri lag la brdar ba' dgra bo'i bla brub tshe srog 'dus thar 'chor med par sdom ya ya zung zung chings changs na sha ya nan nan pāṭa ces pasadril na kha mig tso byad thod sngo dmar btagasapa yis yi ge ma mthong bar du sdoms dgra yad lus sems 'ching bar dmigs dpe ni rkun jag bsrung bar 'gyur the tshom med do sa ma shā de nas rjes rim tshogs mchod ni rgyas pa zab snyang ltar du shes bsdu na tshogs dzos yo byad spungs bsangs sbyangs sngon du 'gro ba yis 'bul bstabs bya ba'i rim pa ni hrī: dam

can rdzas med du byung ba ni: ga ṇa tsakra'i bcud chen pos gu ru rtsa gsum rgya mtsho dang: 'phags ma'od zer can ma ye: sku gsung thugs mchog bskang phyer 'bul sgo gsum dam 'gal dri ma bshags: ma rtogs log 'khrul dam sri bsgral chos nyid 'ub chub klong du bstabs: phyi nang nyer 'tshe zhi ba dang phyogs las rnam rgyal dngos grub rtsol: bdag gzhan 'a11 ba ma lus pa: kun bzang bla ma'i sa thob thagag: dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab bkra shis mtha' brten rgyas par bya gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag zung 'jug sku gnyis mngon du 'gyur the tshom med do sa ma yu yim rgyal b.lidabang po pad+ma ngas snying gi yang tig zab pa'i bcud sa lajug las ldan don du bkod gsang ba 'phrul gya yi ger bsdus mdo khams tsā ri'i shar du sbas ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga yi dus nga sprulabadud 'dzams gling pa yis rnyed nas bstan 'gro'i don chen 'grub chos bdag dpa' bo bdun da ni dpa' mo gsum gyi bsgo skal de legs pa'i nyams su bla gyur na rang gzhan kun la phan bde 'byung gdul bya 'bum phrag dpal rir 'god ral na tshe dang srog la bab ma 'tshams nyes pa sna dgu 'khrugs dug sbrul mgo yi nor bu bzhin zab mo'i gter 'di 'atsa' shes mdzod skal med rnams la a tham rgya

yi se pa tra yi 'od khyims la phyogs kyi nyul ma 'tshubs nas su rang byung rdo rje myo la 'gro: legs nyes snang ba'i ru mo mngo na rgya stag 'dzum la ma 'khri na zhe che'i gsung dbyangs slo bur 'byung: dar gya ba dan phyar ma snga 'gab 'dre' bslu ba yong re skad na la ri yi dus kyi skabs rta bdun bod mdangs rgyas zer skad chos kyi nyi ma 'od po che g.yu 'brug gsung ga sgrar chags nas phyogs nas phyogs su 'u ru ru ze tshom med do mkha' 'gro'i brda sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya mkha' 'gro'i 'bum gyi snying khrag 'di las can bu dang 'phrad par shog gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya snyi ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtsho da chos bdag razi sa ra las ldan dz+nyā na dad brtson ldan pa chos gsal rnams kyis bskul ro ra bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes 'bros phug mkha' 'gro'i 'du gli gzim chu pad+ma'i bsil khang nas mkha' 'gro'i brda bya zab mo dag ju pha ba pa dge'odage'o/ dge'o/ legs so sarba ma lam/
shes zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las rje btsun 'phags ma nyer gcig gi:zab sgrub dngos grub kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

gas na mo gu rbadz+nyā na ār+ya tā re shrī ye: spergo pa ri rgordo mi rnazhe rnam dag 'dusam byas pa'i dbyings ye shes rdo rje'i dkyil gcor mchog 'du 'bral med pa don gyi lhar 'dzin bral rig pas phyag 'tshal lo bdag 'dra pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis snying dang 'dra ba'i man ngag mchog zab lam mkha' 'gro'i thugs zig bstan sa ma mā de yi lasal rnam grangs mang 'dar ni zab sgrub bsdus pa yis rnal 'byor lam du bya ba la tshogs smon las 'dzom skyes bu rnams mi med dben pa'i gnasasu phyin sde brgyad tshogs la sa bslang zheng bgegs tshogs glud dang gtor ma brngan phyi nang bar chad dbyings su bskrad bsrung ba' 'khor lo rim brgyad bsgom maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi mda' gang ba mdzes shang yid du 'ong bar bya khrus dang gtsang sgra mnol bsang gtong bde ba'i stan la bag phab gnas sgrub gtor pad+ma'i drwa ba can bum pa dri bzang chu yis bkang bhasto dza gad gsang rdzas sbyar shel rdo srog gi 'khor lo bkod dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas maṇ+ḍal dang rnam lnga nyer spyod sman gtor raka bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun mdzes pa'i yo byad kun bsags nas spro ba' gnas rnams 'dzom par bya phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rgya sdom sdag can grogs dang dam nyams mo mdze yug khyi phag nye mi bya dam tshig sdom pa srog ltar 'dzin blong dor mi rmongs mkhas par bya

pas〉 sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa'o sa ma yu denasasgog 'khor bra ba'i thabs shog dkar dri ma bral ba'i ngor bzang drug bsres pas mthing nyid kyis mu khyud rim pa bcu gsum bsgor lte bar 'pha gas ma' sku gzugs bri snying po haṃ yag gsal bar bkod mu khyud gnyis par rtsa sngags ni rmimiminirje pa rngogasko rtse gsum par pad 'dab nyer gcig la shar nas rim par g.yas bskor du nor bu me long gter bu dang mda' gzhu pa d+ma' lcag kyu zhags ral gri tho ba ldon shing dang rgya gram 'bras snye 'khor lo dang sbu gri dbyug do 14gri shu 15la me dpu 16rdo rje 17phur bu 18da go cha 19shi lo 2 nyi ma 21rnams rang srog haṃ gyi mtshan par bya 'od lnga'i zlum skor bkram par bya mu khyud bzhi par 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug dag gi phyogs 'tshams su seng ge'i 'jigs pa zhi gyur cig glang po'i 'jigs pa me yi 'jigs sgrul gyi tshom rkun gyi gcan gzan gyi rgya mtsho'i sha za 'dre yi nad gyi gdon gyi 'jigs pa grib kyi rims kyi dug ga ro lang gi sri yi 'jigs byad phur gyi mu khyud lnga pa ra 'ad bzhin bkod o ār+ya twa re hū ma hā su kha sirnyi stu oṃ pā ra stu bye hūṃ bra dz+nyā dz+nyā na sasto s+t+waṃ oṃ ma hā pukhye na ma hūṃ sarba rat+na sarnyi s+t+waṃ oṃ dza ye bha dza shrī hū ma ma a yu tshe hūṃ ṇa dza sarnyi pha la sto oṃ ku ru kul+le hā a n+ni tra a ga〉 ya bsdus bsdus sa stu oṃ lo ka bhasne phaṭa hū sarba lo ka sirnyi sta oṃ

sa badz+ra a tsa la dz+nyā na sno sarba ma hā sirnyi sto oṃ sabo sti dza duṣ+ṭan ma ma hūṃ sarba duṣ+ṭan stisne phaṭa sirnyi sto oṃ kwa li tā re na ma (srid gsum gab cha sirnyi s+t+waṃ oṃ lo ka sarba sti dza dz+nyā na hūṃ khams gsum dpal 'byor rat+na sirnyi s+t+waṃ mo ma ma bā su dha ra hūṃ sabo rat+na bā su kha dhe sirnyi sto oṃ maṅga lam sabo de mi hūṃ sarba maṅga lam sirnyi sto oṃ sarba duṣ+ṭan sha hūṃ hūṃ du tra a mu ka sharnye ku ru pāṭa sto oṃ ar+ya kro ta ma hā ṭa sno log rtog 'dul zhang sarba sisnye stu oṃ ar+ya sharnye ma ma tā re sno sarba pā paṃ shirnye ku ru sto oṃ ār+ya dz+wa la sha hūṃ sarba sarnyi hūṃ log 'dren 'byung po kun 'dul ma hā sarba sarnyi sto oṃ ār+ya ma hā bha la duṣ+ṭan shā sarba sarnya hūṃ dpag med gdon 'dul rat+na (spyi sirnyi stu oṃ ar+ya tā re durmas sasnyo sarba sirnyi sno dug dang grib rigs zhi la ma hā sarba sasnyo pha la s+t+waṃ oṃ ār+ya tā re badz+ra phyo sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ srid gsum gdug can 'byu po'i tshogs las rnam par rgyal gyur cig sarba sirnyi sto oṃ ar+ya bi sha tsa par+ṇa sha wa ra hūṃ sarba ro ga sharnye ku ru sto oṃ ār+ya mā ri rnyi thu hūṃ sarba hṝ tri sha hūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa sirnyi pha la stu mu khyud drug par 'di bzhin bkod ho rgyal ba kun gyi yum chen rje btsun myur ma dpa 'a mo dbyangs can wa mo bsod nams mchog ster ma gtsug tor rnam rgyal rig byed lha mo 'jag byed ma gzhan gyi mi thub ma gzhan las rgyal ma seng ldeng nags kyi sgol ma 'jig rten gsum rgyal ma nor rgyun lha mo bkra shis don byed ma dgra dpung 'joms ma khro gnyer can mdzad ma rab tu zha ma 'bar

gas ba'i 'od can ma dpag med gnon pa rma bya chen mo mi pham rgyal mo rab tu zhi ma 'bar ba'i 'od can ma dpag med gnon pa rma bya chen mo mi pham rgyal mo ri khrod lha mo 'od zer can ma yab yum sprul 'khor bka' sdod dang bcasapa rnamasakyi sku gsung thugs rab tu brtan par gyur cig sgrub pa po la mchog thun mong gi dngosagrub rgya chen po rtsal du gsol ma hā su kha sarba sirnyi sno mu khyud bdun par 'di ltar bri dbyangs dang gsal byed legs par bkod de rjes rten 'brel snying po' mthar lasabazhi'i sham bu gdagasapar bya mu khyud brgyad par pad phreng bri dgu par rdo rje' phreng ba dang bcu par lcags shad sgrog dril brtsam bcu gcig 'byung bzhi'i ri mo dang bcu gnyis bkra shis rdzas rtagasabri bcu gsum nor 'dzin pa tra bskor jos ni bzang drug chosasman byug rgya lngas bsdams la dar gyis dkris da la'i dbus gzhug sgrub par bya rtags dang mtshan ma gsal bar 'byung the tshom med do sa ma mā de nas las la 'jug pa'i sgo sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum dang po zab don snying po ltar yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bar gtong gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i las rim ni yas dza sa kun mi dmigs gzhi rtsa bral: rang rig byang chub sems kyi ngang: thabs shes sa bonarta yig ljang gnyis med ye shes rol rtsal shar: rta:dz+nya na tsit+ta sa mā dhi hūṃ: hrī: rgyu yi sa nge na gsal ba

las:'od zer sna tshogs spros pa las:stong gsal nam mkha' rnam par dag 'gyur med rdo rje rgya gram rlung dngas gsal rgya mtsho rab 'bar 'khyil sra brtan dbang chen sa gzhi brjid rab 'bar me yis phyogs kun brdal:e ye baṃ le ram̐:dz+nyā sa ma ya /:hrī:'byung khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dal rin chen sa gzhi mnan na nem:bteg spar bde 'jam khod snyom yangs me tog sna tshogs sil ma bkram:yan lag brgyad ldan chu mtsho rdzings:gser kyi bye ma g.yu'i ne'u seng:mjes ldan ljon bzang 'dab stong ldan:dril g.yel chos kyi sgra snyan sbir:ri dwags rtse 'jo bya rigs lding:mdzes shing khod snyoms sa gzhi yi:bar snang 'ja' thig bsam yas klong: phyi nang mchod pa'i lha mo ni:rmad byung rdo rje'i gar bsgyur bcas dkyil gcor lha tshogs mchod par byed:mkha' dbyings 'ja' zer 'od stong gi:gdugs dang ba dan 'phan rgyal mtshan:gnam yol bla bre mdzes pas kheb:ngo mtshar bkod pa yid 'ong gyur:bla badz+ra dz+nyā na sarba sa ma ya (:hrī ru las spyo 'dza sa zhu ba las:lhun grub rang gsal gzhal

gas yas khang: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta bab bang rim khyud mo 'khor yug rdzogs: rat+na'i phreng ba drwa phyed dang mu tig rgyan 'phyang chos 'khor gdugs: rgyan dang bkod pa phun sum tshogs: de dbus rat+na'i khro yi khar: sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: two las bskyed pa'i rje btsun ma sngo ljang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: g.yas pa skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mdzad g.yon pas pad+ma thugs gar bkan: 'dab ma snyan thad gyes pa'i steng yin bzhin nor bu 'od stong 'bar: zhal 'dzum spyan dngas chags nyams rgyas dar dang rat+na'i rgyan gyis spras: longs sku'i chas rdzogs 'od kyi sku: zhabs gnyis phyed pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs: stong gsal 'dzin pa bral bar bskyed: rigs bdag sangs rgyas snang mtha' yas: dmar gsal mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugs: sprul sku' chas rdzogs 'od ltar bskyed: phyi rim pad+ma 'dab brgyad steng: shar du sgra dbyangs lha mo dkar:zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum mdzes bzhad: tam bu ra las chos sgra 'ur dar dpyangs smad dkris 'ja' sham dang: rat+na'i phreng ba do shal 'phyang: zhabs gnyis tsog pu
