bsnol mas bzhugs:snang stong gnyis su med par bskyed:lho ru bsod nams mchog ster ser:zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum mdzes sgeg:gcer bu rus rgyan pad phreng mdzes:lcag kyu gter bum phyag rgya 'chang zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur snang stong sku:gsal la 'dzin pa med par sgom:nub tu rigs byed lha mo dmar:zhal gcig phyag bzhi khro 'dzum sgeg:spyan gsum nam mkha'i dbyings la gzigs:zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs:thod skam dbu rgyan dar sna'i'aphan nyi zla'i snyan cha rus rgyan spras:stag sham dar dpyangs rin chen phreng:phyag bzhi dang po'i mda' gzhu 'geng:'og gnyis pad+ma'i lcags zhags 'dzin:zhabs gnyis gar stabs 'gying tshul can:snang stong 'od gsal phung por bskyed:byang du myur dpal lha mo ljang:zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum mdzes bzhad:dar dang rat+na'i rgyan rnams rdzogs:zhabs gnyis sems ma'i phyed skyil bzhugs:mchod sbyin ut+pal phyag rgya 'chang snang stong gnyis med chen por bskyed:shar lhor gtsug tor rnam rgyal dkar zhal gcig phyag bzhi 'dzum mdzes sgeg:

pas dang po gnyis kyis snang mtha' dang:rnam rgyal thugs kyi rten mchog bsnams:de 'og gnyis kyis mda' gzhu dang:'chi med tshe yi bum pa bsnams:longs sku'i rgyan chas bcu gsum spras:zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung gis bzhugs snang stong gnyis su med par bskyed:lto nub bkra shes don byed dkar:gcer bu rus rgyan dar dpyangs 'phur:'ja' sham 'dzum mdzes chags nyams sgeg dbu sgra thor cog pad+mas brgyan pad phreng bkra shis chos dung bsnams zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur nyi 'od 'bar snang stong gnyis su med par bskyed:nub byang 'jig rten gsum rgyal dmar:zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum mdzes bzhad:dar dang rat+na'i rgyan cha rdzogs:dbyug do bhan+ta'i phyag rgya bsgyur:'ja' zer klong du skyil krung bzhugs:'dzin bral sgyu ma'i lha ru gsal:byang shar 'jigs byed lha mo sngo zhal gcis phyag gnyis khro tshul chags:dar dang rat+na rus pa'i rgyan:gzig sham pad+ma'i do shal 'phyang:phyag gnyis ral gri phur bu bsnams:zhabs gnyis gar sgyur 'od phung 'bar:stong gsal 'dzin pa bral bar bskyed0

de rgyab pad+ma 'dab dgu pa'e: mdun du rab zhe chen mo dkar: zhal gceg phyag gnyes 'dzum mjes bzhad: longs sku'i rgyan cha bcu gsum spras shel gyi rdo rje zhags pa bsnams:zhabs gnyis phyed pa 'i skyil krung bzhugs:'dzin bral 'od kyi phung por bskyed:de rgyab rma bya chen po dmar:zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi tshul can:gcer bu rma bya'i thul ba mdzes: pad+ma'i lcag kyu gri gug 'dzin: 'ja' sham rda rje'i gar bsgyur brtse snang dang stong pa gnyes med sgom:de rgyab 'bar ba'i 'od can ma: gur kum mdangs 'dzin zhi zhing 'dzum: gcer bu rus rgyan pad phreng spras: 'bar ba'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro: nyi zer me dpung phyag rgya 'chang: stong gsal 'dzin pa bral bar bskyed:de rgyab gzhan gyi mi thub ljang: zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro tshul can: spyan gsum rab bsgrad rngam pa'i sku:tho chen phur pa'i phyag rgya bsgyur mgo phreng dar dpyangs rin po che'i:phreng ba sum rim mdzes par brgyan: zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur bam gdan brdzis: stong gsal 'dzin pa bral bar sgom:de rgyab dpag med gnon ma spug: zhal gcis phyag

pas gnyis khro 'dzum sgeg: dar dang rat+na seng sham mdzes: thod skam dbu rgyan cod paṇa 'phur: rgya gram gnon pa'i phyag rgya 'chang zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i bro gar bsgyur: 'dzin med 'od gsal phung por bskyed: dergyab gzhan las rab rgyal ma: sngo nag khro gtum 'jigs pa'i nyams: 'khor lo phur ba'i phyag mtshan bsgyur: dar dang rat+na mgo phreng mdzes: sbrul sham 'ja' zer 'od kyis 'khyud: stangs stabs gar gyi rnam rol can: gsal stong chu zla lta bur bskyed: dergyab seng lding lha mo ljang: zhal gcis phyag gnyis zhi ma khro gcer bu pad+ma'i chun 'phyang can: shing lo bkra shis shel phreng 'dren: zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol stabs bzhugs: bde stong sgyu ma'i rol par bskyed de rgyab dgra yi dpung 'joms ma: dmar skrug zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: khro gtum 'jigs rung srin po'i nyams thod dbyug dgra sta phyag na bsnams: zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur khro chas rdzogs: ye shes dngas ma'i phung por bskyed: dergyab khro gnyer can mdzad nag: zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro gtum rngams smad sham dar dang rat+nas brgyan: spu

gro sdegs mdzub phyag rgya bsgyur:me rlung 'khregs pa'i dbus na 'gyeng:gsal stong 'ardzan med phung por bskyed:de ye phye rem 'dab bzha la:shar du me pham rgyal mo dkar:zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum mdzes sgeg:gcer mo rus rgyan pad phreng can:lcag kyu g.yas la dril bu g.yon:zhabs gnyis gar bsgyur dar dpyangs brgyan:ye shes 'od kyi sku ru bskyed:lho ru nor rgyun lha mo ser:zhal gcis phyag gnyis gzi 'od 'bar:longs sku'i rgyan chas bcu gsum rdzogs:gter bum 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams:zhabs gnyis phyed kyis bum gdan brdzis:'dzin bral 'od kyi sku ru sgom:nub tu ri khrod lha mo dmar:zhal gcig phyag gnyis lha mo'i chas:'dzum sgeg lang tsho bltar mi bzod phyag gnyis khrus bum rnga yab bsnams:zhabs gnyis phyed skyil 'ja' 'od klong:sgyu ma lta bu'i sku ru bskyed:byang du 'od zer can ma ser:zhal gcis phyag gnyis lha mo'i chas: khro 'dzum sgeg pa'i lang tsho bkra:phyag gnyis khab dang rkud pa 'dzin:stangs stabs rol pa'i thabs kyis bzhugs:dgra dang bgegs tshogs rdul du rlog:'dzin

gas med dngang ma'i phung por bskyed: bar mtshams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dang sangs rgyas byangs sems rig pa 'dzin: bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho rnams kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa bzhin: gnyis med zung 'jug chen por bskyed: thugs srog haṃ las 'od 'phros pas: rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang bcas: spyan drangs rig lnga'i bdud rtsi'i chus: dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag: o sarba ta tha ga ta oṃ hūṃ tram̐ hrī āX hūṃ:lī:rlu:bye:sno a bhi ṣiñca a kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra slar yang gnas gsum rdo rje yi sa bon oṃ āḥ/ gsum las: 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros: rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa: 'phags ma nyer gcig rnam pa na spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur:de nas spyan 'dren la sogs pa zab don snying po ltar du bya gsum pa rjes kyi ram pa la thugs dam bskul rjes 'dzab bskul ni /: rang nyid 'phags ma'i thugs ka dza pad+ma 'dab drug lte ba dza rig pa hūṃ:yig spus bris tsam: gsal 'tsher gzi 'od ldan par gsal: 'dab drug la ni 'bru drug 'khor: bzlas pas gzung 'dzin sgrib gnyis dag: 'jigs pa brgyad tshogs zhi

zheng byang: tsha dpal nyams rtegs yon tan rgyas rmas bzhe dbang du gyur ba thags: dan gnyas lhun rgyas grub par bsam: e ār+ya tā re sarba sedzha hū: ting 'dzin gsal ba'i rno ldan pas bzlas pa 'bru 'bum tshad 'khyol na nyams da rtogs pa'i yon tan rgyas 'thub pa'i ltas mtshan gsal bo 'byung bden rdzun lag tu long dang gsal nges shes ya mtshan gsal bo 'byung the tshom med do sa ma mā de nas sgrub pa 'ilas sbyor ni sa: rang nyid 'phags ma'i thugs ga'i sgog: sngags phreng 'khor bas 'od zer gyis: rgyal kun mkhyen ba:nus gsum bstim: dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub thob: mar 'phros 'gro drug las nyon sbyangs: dkyil 'khor gsum gyi rol par sad: lha dang rang sems gnyis su med: dbyer med bde ba chen po'i ngang: ma ār+ya tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā: lha sngags ting 'dzin gnad ldan pas yengs med smra bcad dag pa yis 'bru 'bum bzlas pa sa dbang dngos grub ma lus klong nas rdol ba dang nyams rtogs yon tan 'bar bar byed 'phags ma'i zhal gzigs lung bstan gnang phya nang 'ud par sgrub rtags 'byung the tshom med do sa ma yu de nas las la sbyor ba ni sa: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: sngags phreng me yi tsha tsha 'phros: gnod byed

ga sa dgra bgegs 'byung po rnams: sbur ma me dang 'phrad pa bzhin: bsregs gtub rdul du brlag par bsam: 'jigs brgyad ming med zhi zhing stong: snyigs ma'i rgud pa mtha' dag sol: bkra shis snang ba 'phel ba dang snang grags rig gsum bde ba che: lha sngags phyag rgya chos sku'i ngang: yo ār+ya tā re tut+ta re tu re 'jigs tshogs shidhe ku ru ye swā hā: 'bum zer gsum bzlas bar chad zhi phyi na gsang ba'i 'grub rtagasa'abyung nyams rtogs yon tan gong 'phel rgyas dbang dang dngos grub thob par 'gyur the tshom med do sa ma shā las sbyor dmigs pa'i lde kha ni 'phagasama'i thugs las 'od 'phros pas: dbyangs can lha mo'i thugs rgyud bskul chags thogs bral ba'i mkhyen gnyis sgo: rnal 'byor bdag la stsal du gsol: tho ār+ya tā re hrīrnyi sarba pradz+nyā dz+nyā na sirnyi pha la sa: 'bum phrag gcig gis 'grub rtags 'byung 'phags malithugs lasa'od 'phros pas: bsod nams mchog ster thugs rgyud bskul: zas nor long spyod 'dod rgu'i dpal: rnal 'byor bdag la stsal du gsol: snye ār+ya tā re : sarba puṣ+ṭi sirnyi pha la 〉: 'bum phrag gcag gis lasab rtags 'byung 'phags

tsa: aḥn+dho:— a ra ya bsdus bsdus sirnyi pha la sa: 'bum 'phrag gcig gis 'thub rtags 'byung 'phags ma'i thugs las 'od 'phros pas myur ma dpa' mo'i thugs rgyud bskul 'jigs brgyad zhi zhing dbang dngos grub: rnal 'byor bdag la stsal du gsol: o ār+ya tā re hūṃ lo ka sarba duṣ+ṭan phaṭa ma hā sarba sirnyi pha la sa: 'bum phrag gcig gis 'grub rtags wāng 'phags ma'i thugs las 'od 'phros pas: gtsug tor rnam rgyal thugs rgyud bskul: 'chi med tshe yi dbang dngos grub: rnal 'byor bdag la stsal du gsol: ma ar+ya tā re ṇi: tshe sbyo snro:dza sirnyi pha la sa: 'bum phrag gcag gis 'grub rtags 'byung 'phags ma'i thugs las 'od 'phros pas: bkra shis don byed thugs rgyud bskul: phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang dngos grub: rnal 'byor bdag la stsal du gsol o ār+ya tā re cha: maṅga lam ma hā rat+na sirnyi pha la sa 'bum phrag gcig gis lasab rtags lung 'phags ma'i thugs las 'od

can 'phros pas: 'jig rten gsum rgyal thugs rgyud bskul: bar chad g.yul bzlog mthu nus kun: rnal 'byor bdag la stsal du gsol: o ār+ya tā re phaṭa:sarba duṣ+ṭan phaṭa sirnyi pha la /: 'bum phrag gcig gis 'grub rtags 'byung 'phags ma'i thugs las 'od 'phros pas: 'jigs byed lha mo'i thugs rgyud bskul: ma rung 'joms pa'i dpal yon kun: rnal 'byer bdag la stsal du gsol: snyed ār+ya tā re 〉: sarba rū tra sha hūṃ phaṭa ma hā sirnyi pha la sa: 'bum phrag gcig gis 'grub rtags ཿ 'phags ma'i thugs las 'od 'phros pas: rab tu zhi ma'i thugs rgyud bskul: rten 'brel nyes tshogs zhi mdzad dpal: rnal 'byer bdag la stsal du gsol: phyu ār+ya tā re hūṃ: rten 'brel nyes tshogs shidz+nya ku ru sa: legs yon gong 'phel rgyas phyir puṣ+ṭi shrī t+t+waṃ: 'bum phrag gcig gis 'grub rtags yang 'phags ma'i thugs las 'od 'phros pas rma bya chen mo'i thu rgyud bskul: brda byang ḍak+ki'i lung bstan sogs: rnal 'byor bdag la stsal du gsol: slo ār+ya tā re ḍi: dz+nyā na ṭak+ki3)dha ḍi shrī ma hā sidhi pha la sa: 'bum phrag gcig gis lasab rtags ཿnga 'phags

ma'e thugs las 'od 'phres pas: 'bar ba'i 'ed can thu rgyud bskul gzung 'dzan gnyes snang sgol ba'i dpal: rnal 'byer bdag la stsal du gsol: eg tā re re: sarba du na spa shirnyi ku ru hūṃ sidhi pha la sa: 'bum phrag gcig gis 'grub rtags lung 'phagasama'i thugasalasa'od 'phros pas: gzhan gyis mi thub thugs rgyud bskul: pha rol rbod gtong brlag pa' stobs: rnal 'byer bdag la stsal du gsol: yo ār+ya tā re dzaX pha rol rbod gtong mkhan ban bon bsam sbyor ngan pa sarba dus mā ra ya phaṭa ma hā sirnyi pha la sa: khrum phragagaya gisa'agrub rtagasalung 'phags ma'i thugasalasa'od 'phros pas: dpag med gnon ma'i thugs rgyud bskul: thams cad zil gnon che btsan stobs rnal 'byor bdag la stsal du gsol oṃ ār+ya tā re badz+ra ma hā shrī he ru ka dz+nyā na dhartu sarba sirnyi pha la /: 'bum phrag gcig gis 'grub rtags yang 'phagasama'i thugasalasa'od 'phros pas: gzhan las rgyal ma'i thugs rgyud bskul: 'khor ba'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpal: rnal 'byor bdag la stsal du gsol: ma ār+ya tā re nya: sarba du:kha phaṭa ma hā bi dza ya puṣ+ṭi sidhi pha la hūṃ

can 'phags ma'i thugs las 'od 'phros pasaḥ lo ma gyon ma'i thugs rgyud bskul nad yam grib rigs ma lus pa ming tsam med par zhi bar mdzodaX hrī bi sha tsi par+ṇa sha wa ri dz+wa ra pra sha ma ṇi swā hāḥ 'bum phrag gcig gas 'grub rtags 'byung 'phags ma'i thugs las 'od 'phros pas: 'od zer can ma'i thugs rgyud bskulaX dgra gdon bgegs kyi 'jigs tshogs rnamasaḥ ming tsam med par brlag par mdzodaḥ trī ār+ya ma ri rnye rlu swā hāX 'bum phrag gcig gis 'grub rtags 'byung 'phags ma'i thugs las 'od 'phros pas mi pham rgyal mo'i thugs rgyud bskulaḥ mi 'dod mi mthun phyogs rnams kunaḥ ming tsam med par bsregs par mdzod ༷ ma ār+ya dza ya bi dza ma hā sarba sirnyi (ཿ sarba dudzha ma hā sarba sirnyi 〉ཿ sarba dudzha shrī hūṃ 'bum phrag gcig gis 'grub rtags 'byung 'phags ma'i thugs las 'od 'phros pas khro gnyer can mdzad thugs rgyud bskulaX rgyal 'gong dam sri'i spyor ba kunaḥ sbur ma me dang 'phrad bzhin thong ཿtrīḥ ār+ya kri ti dz+nya na de wi sarba durnya mā ra ya phaṭaX 'bum phrag gcag gas 'grub rtags 'byung 'phags ma'i thugs las 'od 'phros pas:

dpagasung raramasamaradabupa/sagyudapasku paX bla bla 8stengapa rasdayipa/sa shu zhaX rapa0dadu padupalipa/paramard0 agayamadultaṇabashayungamarayalaṭaswā1 'bum phrag gcig gis 'grub rtags 'byung 'phags ma'i thugs lasa'od 'phros pas nor ster lha mo'i thugs rgyud bskulaḥ 'khor 'das dpal yon dngas bcud rnamasaḥ ma lus bdag la rtsol bar dmegasaX rdi ma ma bā su rnya ri shrī sarba rarna bā su kha dhe na na sirnyi pha la hūṃ (ཿ 'bum phrag gcig gis 'grub rtags 'byung 'phags ma'i thugs las 'od 'phros pas: nags khrod lha mo'i thugs rgyud bskulaX mi 'dod nyes pa'i phyogs rnams kunaḥ zhi zhing stong par mdzad du gsol trīX ār+ya bi shwa ra de wi ma hā sarba sirnyi pha la 〉ཿ 'bum phrag gcig gas 'grub rtags 'byung sa ma yaḥ e maḥ rgyal dbang pad+ma saṃ bha pa'i thugs bcud srog las phang na'ang dus kyi rgud pa gso ba'i phyir 'brog ban khye'u chung lo tsar gtadaḥ da tung spel ba'i dus min pas mdo khams rdo rje'i brag la sbos klu bdud btsan la gnyer bya gtod ma 'ong snyigs ma lnga bdo' dus nga sprul nusaldan rdo rje dang ཿ 'phrad nas bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel chos bdag dpa' bo dpa' mo yis zab gsang thugs thig bstan pa skyo sa gdul

pas〉 bya 'bum phrag smin grol byedaḥ sa ma māḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgyaḥlja ces pa 'di' lung zin 'gyur med rgya mtsho da pad+ma chasa'aphel gnyis kyis bskul ba dang dharma girnyi rang reg rdo rje chosagasalaḥ ye shesarnams kyis bskul ba dngarasno sar bcas kyas bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nusaldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gas ba'i brda ris las zha' phyes te mdo khams tsa re'i gnasamadun nas shar mar spel ba dge legs sarba maṅga 'a maḥdza yan tu
gas zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:'phags malithugs sgrub byin rlabs gter bcud bzhugs so:

gsacha na mo gu ru dz+nyā na ḍaske ne ye: 6)jud11 mi 'gyur gas ma blo bral dbyings ye shes yon tan lhun rdzogs pa'i rig stong gsang ba don gyi klong kun tu bzang la phyag 'tshal lo lnga brgya snyegs ma'i gdul bya la lhag par gzugasanas ba brgya'i lam mi dmigs ku ru kul+le ma'i thugs sgrub byin rlabs gter bcud bstan sa ma sru spyo ra ni mdo khamasabasam yas su pad+ma nga yis gter bcud bkram khyad 'phags gter no brgya rtsa brgyad gzhan yang zab gter dzos gter sogs rnam grangs brjod mi lang ba rnams nga sprul skyes bu'i dpal du bzhag sa ma mā 'di ni yon tan gter gyi bcud zab rgya' khyad 'phagasabla na med 'grub thag nye la gtang zab rgyas med byung don rgya cho ga dngos bden rdzun zab myur sgrub dang gsal the tshom med do nges pa'i tshig sa ma mā bla med snyeng byung bzab mo' lam lta ba rang grol gnad kyis chings sgom pa ma yengasabab kyisaskyongs spyod pa lhum zhugasalha sku ni 'brasabu rig pa'i rol bar sad mnyam nyid chen po lam kyi gnad sam mā nam mkha' rnam dag sangs rgya rigs me nyid pad+ma lta bu' gdangs chu skyil dri med rdo rje'i rigs sayi dal du rin po che rlung khams dkyil 'khor las kyi lha ma lus rab rdzogs don gyi bab sa ma yu ngo bo ka dag spros mtha' bral skye med brjod bral chos kyi dbyings lhun grub rab rdzogs de bzhin nyid sgru 'phrul 'gags

pas〉 med drwa ba' tshul thugs rje gzod nas rnam par dag gang shar chos nyid dag mnyam rol sa ma yu kun tu bzang po man chad nas srin bu pad+ma yan chad kun rang byung rol ba gnad kyis chings dgu ldan bla ma man chad nas 'byul ba'i skye bo yan chad kun dag mnyam rol ba gnad kyi chings chosasku mum chen man chad nas grong 'dre mo gdon yan chad kun mnyam nyid rol ba gnad kya chings be+e dam rgyu sde bzhi drug nas the'u rang rgyal 'gongs yan chad kun 'ub chub rol ba gnad kyi chings 'das pa'i sangs rgyas zhing khams dang 'khor ba 'brul ba'i chos nyid rnams gnyis med mnyam nyid gnad kyi chings gdengs thob don gyi rnal 'byor legs sa ma mā 'byung lngamum lnga'i dal du dag phung lnga yab lnga'i rol bar dag gzhi lnga sku lnga'i klong du dag gdangs lnga ye shes lnga ru dag sems lnga she rab lnga ru dag sgo lnga grol tshul lnga ru dag chags bral pad+ma'i rol bar smin dag grol las kyi rigs su smin mnyam nyad rin chen dam par smin dra bral ka dag chen por smin ye shes ye sangs rgyas par smin rtog tshogs sgyu 'phrul drwa bar smin ma bcos gnyis med zung 'jug rdzogs kun snang rig par byang sems rdzogs khyab brdal chen po lhun gyi rdzogs rang gnas snang ba chu bo'i rdzogs rtsol bral 'gyu ba chos nyid rdzogs kun rdzogs a ti yo gar rdzogs ye nas chos sku chen por grol rang bzhin rang bab nyid du grol

thugasarje rtsal bral ye shes grol rnga bo 'gyur bral shar gyas grol blo 'das rdo rje rtser bur grol bsam bral dzogs chen mtha' las grol khyab brdal chan por dag mnyam rol lhun grub gzhen nu bum skur dzogs sa ma yā brda don rtagasagasumathel ba yis gnad ldan las la 'jug ram ni ma bcos ra grol klong yangs da po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni na mo mtha' bral dngas ma dbyings kyi lha: rang ngo mthong ba'i skyabs su mchi: 'khor 'das dag mnyam rol ba'i lhum zung 'jug brdal khyab sems bskyed do: lan gsum mthar de nas bgegs bskrad bsrung 'khor ni hrī: ngar 'dzan gdon bgegasa'abyung po rnams ka dag spros bral klong du phaṭa: dbyings las thugs rje'i gar bsgyur ba bdag med mnyam nyid bsrung gur gtams: (sngag tsa ta ya phaṭa: dz+nyā na rak+ṣa t+t+waṃ de na byin 'beb bya ba ni trī mtha' bral ka dag gzhal yas nas: rig stong rgyal yum gsung gi lha: 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: ma rig mun pa drungs 'byin mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar badz+ra sa ma mā dza dza: de nas mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni: trī: dbyings las thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul ba phyi nang kun bzang mchod sprin gyur: ma

pas badz+ra sba ra ṇa sa:de nas ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni trī:brdal khyab ka dag stong pa nyid:rang rig rang gsal kun du snang:'gags med rgyu yi sa bon trī:thabs shes gnyis su med par bsgom badz+ra sa ma ti tsit+ta sne:de nas rten brten bskyed pa ni hrī thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba las: bdag lta'i rū tra yongs bsgral phyir snang ba zhing khams rnam pa ra dag: bdag rtogs rū dra bsgral ba'i phyir srid pa dag mnyam gzhal yas khang: bdag 'dzin rū dra rtsar gcod pa'i: padru nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor steng: rig pa ku ru kul+le dmar zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhi ma khro spyan gsum 'od kyis srid gsum gzir: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs: smar smin me yi tshwa tsha 'phro: khams ser dbu skra gyen du brdzes thod skam dbu rgyan dar sna'i 'phan nyi ma zla ba'i snyan rgyan mdzes:shangs nas /:gi snang glu len zhal gyis ra:tsa:༷ ya:sgrogs: phyag bzhi'i dang pos mda' gzhu 'gengs: 'og gnyis lcags kyu zhags pa bsnams: sku gsum thod pa'i phreng ba spras phar phyin drug rdzogs rus pa'i brgyan: dar dang dur khrod chas rnams

mnyam bzhag bzhugs:shar du pad zla bzhad pa'i khar:bde chen mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal dkar:zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi ma khro g.yas pas thabs mchog ḍa ru 'khrol:g.yon pas shes rab gre gug bsten:nu 'bur gsang ba' pad mo rgyas:dar dang rat+na rus pa'i brgyan:zhabs gnyis gar stabs srid zhi gnon:ye shes 'ja' 'od klong du bskyed:lho ru pad zla bdud dpung khar gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma dkar:zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi zhing 'dzum:g.yas pas mda' dar g.yon tshe bum longs sku'i brgyan rdzogs phyed skyil bzhugs:nub tu pad zla bum bsgol khar bde stong 'phags ma nor rgyun ma:ser gsal zhi 'dzum mtshan dpe'i spras:dar dang rin chen brgyan cha rdzogs phyag gnyis gter bum 'bras snye 'dzin:dgyes pa'i stabs kyis phyed skyil bzhugs:byang du 'jigs brgyad nyi zla'i khar:rje btsun myur dpal lha mo ljang:mdzes

can 'dzum longs sku'i cha byad can: g.yas pa mchog sbyin g.yon pad+ma: zhabs gnyes sems skyil dag gis bzhugs: ye shes 'od lnga'i klong na gsal: sgo bsrung bde chen rdo rje'i king: phyi rim ye shes 'jig rten gyi: gnas yul mkha' 'gro grangs med rdzogs: chos nyid sgyu ma lta bu'i gdangs mngon gsum rig pa lhug par bskyed: de nas spyan 'dren bya ba ni hrī: zung 'jug don gyi 'og min nas: sku gsum mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas: mi 'gyur bde chen skur bzhengs la: mnyam nyid rol bar gshegs su gsol: skyid badz+ra sa ma yā dza dza de nas bzhugasagasol phyag 'tshal ni na mo dbyings nas drangs ba'i ye shes lha: gdan gsum dbyings su brtan par bzhugs: ma bcos lta ba khyab brdal la: dran shes so ma'i phyag 'tshal lo: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: na mo na ma ho de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni hrī rang byung ye shes dam pa'i rdzas: tshogs brgyad sgyu 'phrul 'khor ba'i rtsal phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams: ye shes mkha' 'gro dgyes phyir 'bul: sarba pañca pu tsa ho: de nas bstod pa bya ba na hrī ma bcos stong pa khyab brdal klong rang

gsal sgrib bral ye shes sku: mnyam nyid rig stong mkha' 'gro ma: ngo mtshar yid kyis phyag 'tshal bstod: yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bshags de nas 'dzab kya 'khrul 'bor ni hrī: rang nyidayeshes mkha' 'gro ma'i: thugs shar pad+ma 'dab drug sbubs: rig pa hrī:la sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas dkyil 'khor gsum du sgrub: slo ku ru kul+le trī: 'bum ther nyi khra' daro sa grub thob sgrub pa'i rtags mtshan mngon gsum gsal re dogs mdun pa gzhig pa gnad phyi nang rkyen zhi khams gsum dbang sa ma mā skabs su tshogs kye 'khor lo la brten nas gdams pa zab mo la yo bshad ci 'byor 'tshogs byas nas dang po byan gyis brlabs pa ni trī: gsal stong zung 'jug ka pā la: zag med dmar rdzas tshogs gtor bshams: 'bru gsum nus pas sbyang spel brgyur: ye shes lnga ldan rol bar bsam: o āḥ( ha ho hrī: de nas tshogs zhing spyan 'dren ni / hrī mnyam nyid rang gsal po brang nas: sor rtog dbang gi mkha' 'gro ma: chags bral rigs bzhi yum dang bcas: dbyings las tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs: badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza de nas tshogs phud 'bul ba ni hrī gsang chen rmad byung dam pa'i rdzas: dza gad dpa' bo'i

g.yo 'bru bcud 'das: sku gsum mkha' 'gra' dargyas pa bskangs: bad stang ya shas darngas grub stsal: sarba ga ṇa tsakra pu dza kha nya: de nas bar bshags rim pa ni ha:dpang gyur rig pa dkon mchog gsum: dbyings snang ma dang mkha' 'gro'i dgongs: bdag ni 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur te: so byang sngags kyi bslab sdom rigs: nyams chags nongs pa bzod par gsol: sa ma ya shukhye ā yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bshags de nas bsgral ba' rim pa na hūṃ gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba'i dgra bgegs rnams rig stong ye shes mtshon chas bsgral: rnam shes mnar med gnas su phaṭa: bag chags 'khor ba'i 'khrul rgyun bcad: ru tra pra we sha ya phaṭa: de nas bstab pa bya ba ni hūṃ bdag 'jin du tra bsgral ba las: phung khams skye mched dbang yul bcas ye shes mkha' 'gro'i zhal du bstabs: mnyam nyid rol bar bzhes su gsol: sarba sha hūṃ ma ra ya phaṭa khā hi: de nasalhag ma 4lab ni bh+yo sngon che rdo rje 'chang: pad+ma thod breng gi spyan sngar khas blangs ba'i: gu h+ya dhak+ki ni: dz+nyā na mu dra phernyi sa dhi sa ko sa: yangs pa ye yang 'bod ka pā la yi bcud:

drangs ta bad bar bzhes: phron las rnam bzhe shākyab par mdzad: dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: tha tsu ṭa bā larnya bha k+ṣa se khā cha: ces pa' mthar na gzhan las shes bsngo ba smon lam rgya yis gdab bku shis rgyas pa la sogs byed des ni tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs dam pa sku gnyas mngon du 'gyur gzhi lus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gsal 'tsher 'od kyis sku ru 'pho the tshom med do sa ma yā skab su gtamasapa zab mo btun glud dang grab sel mchod chog dang 'khor lo gsang dbang sman pheg dang lkog yeg dmar byang bcas pa'o dang po glud bsnga'i ram pa ni sbyin bdag rdzas tshangs ngar mi gnyis sngon rgyab g.yas la glud mdog gsum chang bu lan chags 'bras chan da bshos sogs tshangs ba re mig bkod gos mdog sme ba phyag rgya spar lo gza' g.yas la lo bdud g.yon bsngo bya'i chang gsum tshang bar bsags dang po rang nyad snying rjer sad sngags bsgrangs snyang po stong rtsa re de nas bden pa'i 'gugs gzhugs ni hūṃ dbo na mchog rtsa gsum bden pa dang: sngags dang phyag rgya'i byin rlabs kyis 'byung po re zhing chags ma'i gdon: dmigs pa'i rten 'dir mchis gyur cig: tri badz+ra aṅku sha dza: de nas sngags drug phyag rgya drug 'byu gsum nus pas sbyangs spel brgyur hūṃ rin chen ming dang gzugs mdzes dang:

pas 'byams klas 'jigs bral la phyag mtshal: de nas bsngo ba'i rim pa ni dug gsum rtsal snang gdon bgegs regs: 'grog ma khas zhan nyam thag bcas: gnod 'tshe'i 'byung po pho mo la: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi: sha rin khrag tshab tshe glud 'bul saṃ bha ra' sngags bzlas skabs skabs 'ad ltar brjod par bya /: skye med klong las glud gcig 'phrul: 'gags med sgyu ma'i mgron rnams brngan rang snang bde stong zas 'di rol: zhen med mchog gi don rtogs shog: zhes pa dang bcas sbyar ba'i rjes don gyis ngo sprod bya ba ni u sna tshogs snang ba rmi lam bzhin: don la rang rig ka dag dbyings: gzhan gnod spong dang rang sems bde: chos nyid spros mtha' bral ba'i ngang: zhen pa chod la rang sar slod: des ni mnyam pa nyid du grol: de nas bsdu ba'i ram pa ni u snang ba rten cing 'brel 'byung chos: sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor zhig pa bzhin: chos nyid spros bral chen 21ra āX bsngo ba smon lam rgya yas gdab des ni nad gdon rkyen snang bya the tshom med do sa ma yā gnya pa greb sel ram pa ni mdun du glud gcig bzhag byas te g.yas su khrus bum sgrub ldan dang phyogs su bal 'dab

stan dkar dang bsrung bya gdan nag steng du gnas mgo bor bal nag bcas bzhag nas dang po khrus kyas sbyang ba na rte zag med ye rogs chu —1na gyes: slob ma khyod la lnga/sa byas pas: sdo/sa ngag yed kyi grib gdon rnams: ngar mi'i gzugs dang ro gcig gyur: e ye re be le 'byung ba bzhi'i grib thams cad sarba pa paṃ shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā: hrī: sor rtog dbang gi chu rgyun gyis:slob ma khyed la khrus byas pas: nyon mongs 'dod chags las byung grib: ngar mi'i gzugs dang ro gcig gyur: rtsa sngags mthar sngags gong ltar bskyar lo hrī: ye shes bzhi yi chu rgyun gyis: slob ma khyod la khrus byas pas: nyon mongs bzhi las byung ba'i grib ngar mi'i gzugs dang ro gcig gyur: rtsa sngags mthar gong ltar ro hrī rang byung ye shes chu rgyun gyis:slob ma khyod la khrus byas pas: ban bon lha klu sde brgyad grib: ngar mi'i gzugs dang ro gcig gyur: rtsa sngags mthar de nas byab pa'i rim pa ni dang po dug shing sna tshogs thog la ho shing 'di'i pha ni zhe sdang bdud: de bzhin ma ni 'dod chags klu gnyis med rigs las skyes pa yin: slob ma khyod la gnas pa yi: pho mo ma ning grib rig kun: bsdu'o dug

pas shing 'di la bsdu: spo bo ngar mi 'di la spo brgyur ro gnod byed bgegs la brgyur: bzlog go byad ma'i steng du bzlog: rtsasngags mthar o badz+ra ya ya ma phyes phyes khrol khrol: a ra dri phyes phyes khrol khrol: ma ma sting phyes phyes khrol khrol: ru ru dhi phyes du du dhi phyes na phu phu phyes tsa rak+ta phyes sha yak+ta phyes ra ra hu'i bcing ba phyes rā dza'i g.yo ba brgya khri bzhi stong phyes: bse mo sri bye ba sa ya'i dug g.yos thams cad phyes nā ga phe lang gi gnod pa 'i grib gdon thams cad phyes phyes khrol khrol:sa:zhi zhi zhig zhig phyes phyes khrol khrol swā hā: ces bskyar ngar mir spo chul bya de nas rma bya'i sgro zog la ho: dug dang grib rigs bgrangs yas kyis sbyor ba'i 'khrul 'khor ngan pa rnams:lha mo rma bya chen mo 'dis: byab cing byer la dbye bar bgyid snye badz+ra sa ma ya e ye baṃ:le 'byung ba bzhi las byung ba'i grib rigs thams cad sarba a pa na ye swā hā: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i grib gdon thams cad sarba a pa na ye swā hā: bgegs rigs stong phrag brgya bcu'i grib sbyor thams cad sarba a pa na ye swā hā: ces byab de nas ku sha'i

chun po thogs la ha: 'ad na gsang ba zab ma' rdzas: rgyal rnams byan rlabs mardod pa' gtar: slab ma khyad la gnas pa ya: sdo/sa ngag yad kya grab gdan rnams: byab pa ngar mi 'di ru dbab: 31 badz+ra sa ma ya e:yiḥbaṃ:le:'chang ba po'i lus ngag yid kyis grib gdon ma lus pa shidz+nya ku ru swā hā: ces brjod pa sbyin bdag gi kha lag rkang pa sogs brus la gdan nag dang bal nag bcas glud du brdzangs la ho: gzung 'dzin grib kyi gdan nag 'di: spo 'o ngar mi'i gdan byed do: 'khrul ba'i skyon ldan bal nag 'di: sbyin no ngar mi khyod la sbyin:'dzin pa'i byad thag nag po 'di: bsdu 'o ngar mi khyod la bsdu: nag gsum tshang ba'i zas rigs 'di: sbyin no ngar mi khyod la sbyin: ngoms tshim dga' ba'i longs spyod la:zhen med ngo bo mthong bar gyis: sa ma yā: gzhan mi byi yi lo can zhig thal ba' lam zhugs goms brgya'i sar phyan nas slar mi sdog par bya /: sde brgyad phyi nang 'byung po'i sde mi bas glud bzang 'di khyer la: rgya mtsho chen po'i pha mthar dengs: gal te bka' 'das dam nyams na: lus ngag du brlag 'gyur ro: ka hūṃ sa: cesabaskrad rak+ṣarak+ta rak+ṣa: ces bsrung gur

sa /cha bskyed de nas sbyin bdag gdan dkar steng 'dug la mgo bor bal dkar bzhag tshe 'gugs sba bstem gtsug tor ltar bkra shis bsngo smon dag gis brgyan des ni grib rnams yongs byang 'gyur sa ma yā gsum pa mchod chog rim pa ni bkod mdzod ldeng khri gru bzhi pa' lte bar pad+ma 'dab bzhi pa'i dbus su hrī dang phyogs bzhi phu ha ri ni sa bkram par bya de yis phyi rim me tog bkod de rgyab bdug spos snang gsal bcas phyi rims zhal zas chu mchod bskor gzhan yang rtags brgyad rdzas brgyad dang sna bdun la sogs mchod pa'i bskor dngos 'byor de dag bkrams pa la mchod pa'i sprin gzungs lan bdun dang sngags drug phyag drug yid kyis spel 'thu gsum nus pa' sbya sa spel bsgyur de nas spro ba' ram pa ni je che sa dbyings spre sa bral nam mkha'i mdzod: lhun grub mdzad med ye shes gter: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin chen po'i: rgyal ba rgya mtsho dgyes gyur cig: badz+ra spra ra ṇa sa: de nas tshogs kyi zhing gyur ba'i rgyal ba sras bcas spyan 'dren ni sbos bsregs rol mo'i sgra dang bcas mos gus shugs bskyed 'ad skad do hūṃ shrī sku gsum bla ma brgyud pa dgu ldan lha yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug dkyil 'ashesar dang: gnas gsum ma dang mkha' 'a1sna bsam yas sde skad cig gnas 'dir spyan 'dren

gshegs su gsol: dam drig gsang ba'e rten la brten par bzhugs: badz+ra sa ma yā dza dza: dz+nyā na s+t+waṃ teṣ+ṭha badz+ra: de nas khrus gsol rim pa ni hūṃ: bla ma ye dam mkha' 'gro sras bcas la: yid sprul grangs med mkha' 'gro'i bum par bcas: ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni: lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar: lha yi chu ni dag pa yis: de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus dbul oṃ sabo ta tha gā ta a bhi ṣi ga te sa ma ya gri ye hūṃ de nas na bza' 'bul ba ni hrī: srab 'jams yang bde blta na sdug lha gos bkra shis pañca li:rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul: bdag cag tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag 31ga: tshod badz+ra waṣ+ṭa a sa: de nas phyi nang gsang mchod sogs las byang 'bring po ltar du bya:phyag 'tshal bya ba'i rim pa ni na mo: bdag dang 'gro ba sems can rnams: lus ngag yid gsum gus pa yis brgyud pa dgu ldan bla ma la lta ba don gyis phyag 'tshal lo: chos nyid rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: rgyud sde bzhi drug yi dam la: dmigs med sgoms pas phyag 'tshal lo: rig sang rol bar byin gyis rlobs gnas gsum ma dang mkha' 'gro la: 'dzin pa rang

gas grol phyag 'tshal lo ngar 'dzin ldog par byin gyis rlobs: bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag lta dag par byin gyis rlobs: bla ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo: sgrar 'dzin grol bar byin gyis rlobs: bla ma'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo bdag rtog zhig par byin gyis rlobs: na mo brnya dharma sa kro dha ra dza ḍak+ki ni a ti pu ho: pra ti tsato bzlasaram bya ba ni rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sku gsung thugs las 'od zer mkha' khyab du 'phros ba'i khams gsum gyi 'khor ba dong nas sprugs te sku gsum ye shes kyi dgongs klong du grol bar dmigs la: na mo gu ru brnya dharma sa dhe wa ḍak+ki ni sarba pa paṃ shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā: bar med brgya rtsa la sogs bskyal bstod pa bskyal rjes bsdu rim ni sa snang cha thabs mchog rtsa gsum lha rim bsdu 'od gsal ngang la yal: spro bsdu med pa chos kyi sku: ka dag lhun 'byams e ma ho: bsngo smon bkra shis rgya yis gdab des ni tshogs rdzogs sgrab pa dag sku gnyas mngon gyur rgyu ru nges ze tshom med do sa ma shā bzhopa 'khor lo'i sbyor ba ni sman shog dra bzang ldan pa'i ngor gza' skar rgyal phur 'dzoms pa'i dus rang nyid lha mo' nga rgyal ngang dbang gi phyogasasu kha kyu la

mtshal dang li khri rak+ṣe yis mu khyud rim pa bcu ru bkod sto b.rarjedangs rjo hūṃ gnyes par 'de bzhen bkod par bya mo ku ru kuspe rte bcom ldan 'phags ma rag byed dbang mo'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phran las me zad pa rgyan gyis 'khor lo rten 'di la brtan par bzhugs su gsol tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gsum par gcor lo rtsabs bzhi bkod shar nas brtsam te rig bzhi'i srog hrīḥs ཿdz+waḥ bzhi par pad+ma 'dab bzha la shar nasarim bzhin dgod bya na 'phags ma mtsho rgyal lha mo'i sku gsung zugs bstan par gyur cig gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma' sku gsung thugs bstan par gyur cig rje btsun nor rgyun dbang mo' sku gsung thugs bstan par gyur cig sgrol dkar 'jigs brgyad skyobs ma'i sku gsung thugs bstan par gyur cig lnga par 'di bzhin legs par bkod oṃ pad+ma zhiṅka ra pho dza dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las kyis rol gar gsung gsang pa d+ma' snying po'i sku gsung thugs bstan cing rgyal bar gyur cag sa ma mā stum nad gdon rkyen dang bar chad shirnyi ku ru ye swā 1 tshe bsod dpal 'byor pu/ ku ru sto 'khor 'das srid gsum zas nor phya g.yang wa shaṃ ku ru hūṃ 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug mā ra ya phaṭa drug pa ra 'di ltar bri bar bya 'chang ba po la nad gdon 'jigs brgyad sgrib gnyas bar chad mi mthun pa' phyogs thams cad zhi zhing nyams rtogs tshe dang bsod nams ye shes yon tan thams cad rgyas par gyur cig lha 'dre mi gsum 'khor

sa /cha 'das srid gsum zas nor longs spyod dbang du 'du bar gyur cig ting nge 'dzan g.yel ba le lo nyams chags rtog sgrib bag chags mkha' 'gro'i gdug rtsub dam las nyams pa byang bar gyur cig sor chud par gyur cag drung nas 'byin par gyur cig gtan nas bzlog par gyur cig sa ma mā sa ma shā sa ma yu dza dza ja bdun pa ra 'di bzhin dgod byar bya dbyangs gsal dag la gsum gsum bri brgyad pa ra rten 'brel snying po bkod dgu par rtags brgyad rdzas sna bdun bcu par nor 'dzan pa dra bya jos rna bzang drug chos sman dang dri bzang rin chen rnam lnga da 'byu lnga g.yu sogs rnam pa lnga bkod cing byug la dar gyis dril ran chen snod gzhugs nyer spyod bkram zhag bdun sgrub la mgul btags nas nad gdon rkyen ngan bar chad zha tshe bsod ye shes yon tan rgyas khams gsum srid gsum zas nor dbang 'jigs pa brgyad sogs yongs byang 'byur the tshom med do sa ma shā rlung la bskor ba'i 'khor lo ni dbang shing shugs dmar 'jams pa 'i ngor mtshal gyis 'di bzhan bri bar bya pad+masaradzayabu badz+rarat+nang d+ma rma ṭak+kinisamaya/dza 'di ltar dbu can tshag med par phyogs bcu'i sde brgyad kyis 'jigs pa kla klo byad ma'i 'khrul 'khor mthu gtad hom zor mnan pa pho gdon mo gdon klu gdon 'ga' 'dre dam sra the'u ra rgyal bsen dgra jag chom rkun mo rtsis rmi ltas ngan pa ma nad phyug gi god

kha gnam sgo sa sgo phye ba shi 'dre gson 'dres 'tshe ba bslu brid bar chad kyis g.yul ngo mi kha bra mchu lang ba phyi nang 'byung po'i 'tshe ba la sogs pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thamasacad zhi zhi zhig zhig zhig phyes phyes khrol khrol sarba a pa na ye swā snya mā ra ya phaṭa mā ra ya skyo mā ra ya bzlog sarba ro ga sarme shirnye ku ru ye swā hā ces bris rten snyi dag gis gzhug sde mchod grang gtong rlung la bskor des ni phyi nang gsang ba yis rkyen rnams ma lus yongs su byang bden rdzun lag tu long dang gsal ze tshom med do sa ma shā me la bskor ba' tsakra na dbang shog 'doms gang leb sor tshad de la 'ad bzhin dbu can gyis ār+ya ba su ḍak+ka ni sno sad ser gyis gnod pa zhi bar gyur cag ma ma ki bam baṃ 'dus 'dus ma ma ki yi yi nan nan ma ma ki sa ra be sirnyi sirnyi pha la hūṃ bri gdon gnyis byed snang gsal rtser bkod la rgyun chad med par bskor des ni char chu dus su 'bebs lo phyug rtag legs 'byu rnams 'phel the tshom med do sa ma yā chu la bskor ba'i tsakra ni zha shog dri bzang chag chag gdab mtshal lam li khri'i 'di ltar bri ār+ya be+e dza ḍazhi ni sno bdag cag 'chang ba po la 'chi med tshe yis dbang byin rlabs rigs rgyud zas nor longs spyod 'phel ba' phyu g.yang bkra shis dge ba chos spyod kyis las thams cad ga rgyun bzhin 'phel la yun ring bar gyur cig sa sirnyi pha la hūṃ ba ces bskor tshe bsod nams dab thang 'phel zas nor

pa /7 longs spyod phywa g.yang rgyas bkra shis don rnamasam lus 'grub the tshom med do sa ma mā sa la gab pa'i tsakra ni dug shog gri khrag byug pa'i ngor dug snag bong sha mdze khrag bsres des ni 'di bzhin dgod par bya mā ra ya rbad mā ra yu rgyug ma ra ya bh+yo rji che ge mo'i sha la dza srog la rbad rus la rgyugs snying khrag la bh+yo rbad dgra bgegs che ge mo mi phyug 'khor dang bcas pa ming tsam yang mi gnasapar gyur cig rtsad nasachod drung nas phyung ma ra mā spyo rbad dza ces bris 'khor gdan dgra ling bkod snying gar tsakra g.yon ru bskor steng du mchod rten mgo thur bstan dmod bcol nyin rer sngags brgya bsgrangs de 'di'i dgra phung bdag rgyal 'byur the tshom med do sa ma yu lnga pa gsang dbang zab mo na ḍak+ki'i sgrub pa sngon du btang slob ma bsdu zhing khrus kyis sbyangs byin dbab mos gus shugasabaskyed la mkha' 'gro'i snang ba bsnyen btegs byasal yis ma ska' ldan rig kyi bu: ma yengs rang bab ngang la klod: snang srid chos kun gdod ma nas: ma grub stong pa nyid kyi gshis: ci bzhin mngon du gyur ba ni sku yis dbang mchog thob pa yin: bskyed rim lha la gsal snang thob snang ba gsal khyab ye shes su: chos kun ma lus dag mnyam rol yongs su rtogs cing mthong ba ni: gsang ba gsung gis dbang

mtshog thob: dzogs rem theg le gnad du bsnun: gzung 'dzin gnyes su 'phyang ba'i tshos: ye nas ka dag spros pa bral stong chen nam mkha' lta bu'i 1nga: mngon du gyur te mjal ba ni: thugs mchog tshig gis dbang rnams thob: rdzogs pa chen po nyams su longs lta sgom spyod 'bras gnad bsnun pas: bskyed rim gnad kyis sprul skur smin rdzogs pa'i rim pas longs skur 'pho 'od gsal chen po'i chos skur grol: 'khor 'das dag mnyam mngon sangs rgya: gsang gsum brgyan gyis dbang thob shog rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta 55 bhi ༷nga skyed yi /: ces pa'i gnas gsum la gtugs te dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung ba'i mi tshe 'dar mngon sangs ma rgyas tshe pad+ma bdag gis phyi rab bsrus sa ma yā bkra shis bsngo smon bden tshig brjod rgya rgya rgya drug pa sman be+eg zhe bya ba'i tsha grangs rlung mkhris bad gan sogs nad rnams rtsa chu gnyis kyis brtags ngos bzung tsha ba'i rigs rnams la spangs rtsi bong dkar ga bur gsum gtso bo sum sbyor nad der bsngags grangs ba'i nad ni thams cad la pho ril pi ling cung za bltar kun thus gsum po mchog tu bshad rlung ga nad rnams kun la yang dza ti mi sha mar dkar gsum gsum bltar bskal ba gcig chog

pa / yin mkhris pa'i nad rigasagang la yang rtsa mkhris rkyer shun hong len la sum dug btab pa yang zab po bad gan nad la phan pa'i thabs cung zi rgyu shing 'bras bu gsum star bu tsher nag phag mchin dang gred tshil go bo'i zhu dkar mchog byis pa'i nad rnams bcos dka' na kha gul dom khris gi waṃ gsum sman gyi dngas ma yan par bshad dug rags ga da gang la yang chang dang yi ling sha chen mchog grab rigs rnams la phan pa'i thabs sde brgyad me tog yin par bshad gnyan la bcos pa'i thabs ril ni bong nag bo ser bong dmar ro yam sa gya nad ni gang la yang bong spya brag la sogs gzab nad rnams kun la zog ma ru gzhan byung bdun thang de yang gnad de sogs rgyas pa'i rnam bzhag pa'i be+eḍār+ya yi chun po ltar blo gros zab pa shin tu gces brtags thabs lag 'gyu bcos kha'i rigs man ngag ko ṭi ya na bzhin 'gro la phan thog rgya chen 'byung bka' 'di sman gyi lha mor gnyer dgos 'dod don rnams 'byung gyur cig sa ma yā bdun pa skog yig dam ra byang ni ma 'ong bu la kha chem yin lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la skye 'gro log lam dbang du 'khrul mi dge bcur spyod dge bcur spangs bskyed rdzogs mkhan la bar chad brtsams tang 'dzin dgongs pa smag gis bslad khrel med rkun po lad ma shor nga sprul bu la mog par smad rdzun gter 'chang rnams gtsug tu brten de tshe rigs ldan pho

nya rnams rang 'brasabartul zhugs zab mo ni ting 'dzan dgongs pas mngon gyur mdzod rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod pa ni srog la bab kyang mi bya'o yar mar dus mchod rgyun mi gcod nyin mo gu ru bdag nyid bsnyen mtshan mo 'od gsal don la sbyangs skabs su mkha' 'gro chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul la brin las bcol rang tshug rang gis 'dzan pa na seng chen gangs la 'gying ba bzhin 'od tshod mkhan gyi 'dren mi nus lde mig rigs ldan ma gtog pa'i gzhan pa dang du len ma bya 'khor ba' sgrog ste ma rig pa chags pa' chang yang btung ma bya snying rje tshar gcod sha mi za rdzas ngan smon log du ba spang gsang sngags dzos na ma gtogs so lcang lo ma bcos bla ma rten sems nyid ma bcos yi dam rten gos dkar ma bcos sngags pa' rten gsang ba ma bcos mkha' 'gro'i rten rten 'brel ma bcos bka' srung rten de dag gnad la 'bad par bya 'gro la gnod pa'i bsam sbyor spongs dben pa'i ra la sdod tshug zungs bslu byed dkor zas srig zas bor chog shes bsten pa man ngag yin pad+ma'i pha chos gtan la phob rang bzo' blo yis ma bslad cig the tshom sgrog de rtsad nas chod nga rgyal mtho rlom snyi nas sbongs las ldan bu slob gdams pa'i skyongs skal med rnams la phyogs ma ston sems can mgo bskor rdzun gtam bor yi dam la sngags phyag rgyar brtson zab mo'i gter la the ma tshom lta sgom spyod pa zab mo'i ngang 'bras bu lhun

pasa' grub bar du skyol phyi ma rnga yab dpal gyi rir pad+ma'i thugs da ro gcig 'dren ma 'ongs bu la zhal chems yin sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya skabasakyis don rnams yongs su rdzogs ye ma rgyalaba'i dbang po pad+ma ngas phyi rab gdul bya'i don chen du dbul ba sel phyir mkha' 'gro ma'i thugs kyi sgrub pa med byung bstan 'ad la 'bad rtsol sus byas pa tshe 'dar bde skyid dpa la la spyod phyi mar mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas 'thob the tshom med do sa ma mā phyi bzungs asnya nag mo dang nang 'dzin shan pa dme ru rtse gsang ba srod nyul kha mo che rlung sems sgrubs pa' grogs rnams kyis bka' 'di thub par bsrung mdzod la bka' log bstan dgra'i srog la bzor dam ldan bu yi dpal du shog sa ma mā bdud sprul kha dhe'i dbang ma gtong de la bzlog pa' 'khor lo bskor btsan gri yak+ṣa kro dhis rkyen rab bzlog gu ru lha khang bzhengs klu nad dme 'khrugs khol ma'i dbal rab brgyur 'khor lo 'bar ba bzhengs yul gnyis khrag gi char ba 'byung de la khros ma'i sgrub sde btsug mo sri ra dza'i g.yo ba ngoms bdud 'dul phur ba'i dkyal 'khor bzhengs shar na dug phag rab du mkhun khyung chen bcod brgyur byed pa gnad byang nas kla klo 'khrugs pa la ge sar dbang phyug hor sogs bzlog de sogs lkog yag 'phros don gab sa ma yā chosabadag skyesabu drug phrag gis bstan pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur bsgrangs skye 'gro'i rgud mun

mtha' dag sel bkra shisab ma gling khyab gyur cig sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu bye gtad rgya sbasargya gab rgya snying rgya grol rgya dzi ces pa 'di yang mdo khamasatsa ri'iganas kyi lho phyogs yon tan gter bcud 'tshogs pa'i bar skabs bkra shis g.yang du 'jil ba'i zig le bsod nams chu las byung ba'i gter bcud mkha' 'gro'i brda byang zab mo'i shog ser gang las byung ba'i rin chen chos 'di rdo rje drag mo rgyal gyi mdun zur ma sman sna tshogs 'du ba de las bris pa'i dge legs dpal gyi gzhar gyur sangs rgyasabastan pa phyogs bcur khyab nas dz+nyā nas bzhed don phun tshogs shog cig e snye/ dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ sarba ma lam/
pa sa zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: 'phags ma dpag med gnod ma dang:'brel ba'i rdor dril byin rlabs 'khor ba dbyings sgrol zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

/ sgo namo.āruta re shrī ye: rtseskorna 311 rgyal yum 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor la gus pas btud de snyang nas 'dud ma 'ongs las ldan pho mo yis bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa'i tshe nyer mkho'i rdor dral byin rlabs bstan sa ma yu de yang thabasamachog dpa' bo yis rdo rje byin gyis brlabs pa ni oṃ ma hā badz+ra sa ma yā: mtshan ma rdzas kyi rdo rje stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las thabs bde ba chen po dang ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin shes pas brda thabs rnam par bsgyur ba'i rten 'brel gyis 'gro ba rgyud lnga'i bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad bde gshegs thugs kyi dbyings su bsgral bar byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam mo: 31 ma hā badz+ra tsit+ta /: lan gsum brjod la gnas gsum gtugs de nas dril bu byin rlabs ni skyes pradz+nyā dz+nyā nateṣ+ṭha ma hā mu tra sa: mtshan ma rdzas kyi dril bu stong pa nyid du gyur stong pa'i ngang las she rab stong pa chen po dang snying rje 'gag pa med pa'i rang bzhin bde gshegs gsang ba'i 1nga mdzod dril bu'i sgras sems can thams cad ma rig pa'i gnyid las dkrogs shing bde chen chos sku'i rgyal sa mchog la 'god par bya ba'i yon tan dang ldan par

pas bsam la: snye dz+nyā na dhartu pradz+nyā sa: lan gsum brjod la dkur brten bya de nas phyag rgya bzhi ldan gya sa hūṃ g.yas pa thabs mchog dpa' bo yis: 'khor ba chos sku'i klong du bshig bde gshegs thug kyi dgongs klong mchog: ye shes rdo rje mngon du byed g.yon pa shes rab dril bu yis: ma rig mal dub 'gro ba rnams bde chen thar ba'i lam du spyor: rgyal kun brin las nub med 'grub: thabs shes zung 'jug phyag rgya che'i: dgongs pa med byung mngon du byed yo badz+ra garnye dharmā hūṃ āḥ ces brjod 'khyud rgya bya ba'o gnad des bde stong mngon du 'gyur gang snang mi dmigs zang thal grol ga shar chos sku'i dgongs klo 'khyil 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor dbyings su bcol byang chum sems su rgyas gdab po the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma yā ye ma rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs bcud skor rin chen srog las pha na'ang bstan 'gro'i rgud pa gso ba'i phyir grub dbang khye'u chung lo tsār gtad da dung ma spel brda la bstem mi 'byur rdo rje'i rdzong la sbos klu bdud btsan la gnyer byang gtod ma 'ongs snyags ma lnga yi dus nga sprulanu ldan rdo rje dang: 'phrad nas bstan pa 'dzin skyo sa spel chos bdag dpa' bo dpa' mo yis zab gsang thugs thag bstan pa skyongs gdul bya 'bum phrag

smin grol byed 'gro don phrin las sto byang 'byung dus kyi rgud pa cha shes gso yid gnyis mi dgos rdo rje'i bka' sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi ces pa 'di'ang lung zinadapa' bo 'gyur med rgya mtsho dang pad+ma chosa'aphel gnyisakyis sgrub pa'i me tog bcas te bskul ba dang chos la dbang ba'isgormā kairte dang rang rag rdo rje dad ldan chos gsal blo gsal ye shes rnams kyis bskul ba dang / bde stong gar gyi dpa' mo rat+na sa ra yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa 'a bo nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gas ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te/ mdo khams tsa ri'i gnas mdun shar mar spel ba dge legs 'phepa/ sabo ma pam/ dza yan tu/

pa sa zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: 'phags ma 'jig rten gsum rgyal dang: 'brel ba'i rnga dang ḍa ru mkhar rnga rol mo sil snyan byin rlabs grags stong rdo rje'i rang sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

pas na tho ār+yas re shrī ye: rtsertanya 3 mige rgyal ba kun yum 'phags ma la gus pas bayid de snying nas 'dud ma 'ongs las ldan pho mo yis bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa'i tshe nye bar mkho ba'i ḍa ru dang rnga chen mkhar rnga byan rlabs bstan sa ma mā de yang ḍa ru byin rlabs ni oṃ badz+ra bha k+ta sa ma ya khro sa: bcu drug ltag sprod ḍa ma ru mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur stong pa'i ngang las dpa' bo 'bod pa'i rdzas kun bzang yab yum snyoms par bzhugs pa'i bde stong byang chub sems kyi sprin 'khor ba chos skur gzhig pa'i rang sgra 'gag med du sgrogs par bsam la: o badz+ra tsit+ta hūṃ: hūṃ badz+ra sa man+ta bha tra tshe: e a ra li sa ma ya trīng hrīng pho phernyi bcad mtshams can du dkrol bar bya de nas rnga chen byin rlabs ni skyid kro ta shrī sarba duṣ+ṭa phaṭa: rnga chen mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las rnga che mchog yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas bde stong chos nyid kyi rang sgra 'brug ltar ldir bas 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor dbyings su bcom nas 'og min me ri 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nyag gcig gi rol bar sad par dmigs la: ma badz+ra kro ta ma hā dṛ he ru ka hūṃ phaṭa: ma hā kro ti shwa ri snye

gas sa maya pho tiṣ+ṭa badz+ra: ces brjod 'ur zhub sum rngam bya de nas mkhar rnga byin rlabs ni tshong ru lu ru lu sarba shabha a sa: chos rnga mi dmigs pa'i ngang lasayang dag teru ka yab yum thabs mchog gar gyi rol rtsed mdzad pa'i bde ba'i sgras bskul te: gdul bya'i rmongs pa'i dri ma thams cad dbyings su bsgral zhing mi nub chos kyi 'khor lo bde mchog gar gyi rgyal srid la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i sgra rgyun mi chad par 'byung ba'i rabhe bzhin can du gyur: snyed ru lu ru lu shabha dharmā dhartu pho spra ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa (: ces brjod rgyud gsum tog gsum brdung: rnga gshang cang te'u rnams kyang dkrol: de nas rol mo byin gyis rlabs ni: a a ā dharmā dhartu dz+nyā na shasta sa: rol mo dang sil snyan mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang lasadon yod grub pa yab yum dngabanamachog yab yum kyi rol par shes pa'i ngang nas: bde chen rdo rje gar gyi rol rtsed phyag rgya ye shes mchog gi gsang ba gsung gi rang sgra sbir bas dbyings kyi khams gsum 'khor ba chos sku'i dgongs klong du bshigs nas phrin las don yod grub pa'i gsang gsum

la mnga' brnyes pa'e rol mor gyur tsag: ha pra dz+nyā dheg rta badz+ra ra te stu: ma hā su kha badz+ra wa ra haṃ sa ma ya dza dza sharte pra te dza spra ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa kha ces brjod dkrol rdung gsum du bya de nas las kyi dngos grub kun thogs med yid bzhin 'grub par 'gyur sa ma wā mi ma rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs bcud sgor rin chen sgog las phang na'ang bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i phyir grub dbang 'brog ban lo tsār gtad da dung ma spel brda la bstams mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rdzong la bstims snyigs ma lnga ya dus skabs su nga sprulanusaldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nasadapa' bo dpa' mor 'doms gdul bya 'bum phrag sman grol byed 'gro don sto dang byang nas 'byung bstan pa'i don 'byung the tshom med sa ma shā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi cesapa 'da'ang lung zinadapa' bo mched gnyisadang /chosagrog she shesachos gsal rnams kyas bskul ba dang / bde stong gar gyi dpa' mo rat+na ra bskul ba don dang ldan phyirabadag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes mdo khams tsā ri'i gnas mdun nasamakha' 'gro'i gsang brda zab mo dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma lam/ dza yan+tu/
can zab gsang mkha' 'grolithugs thig las: 'phags ma bkra shis don byed dang: 'brel ba'i rgyang grags dung dkar byin rlabs chos kyi char 'phebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

gas name ār+ya tā ri shrī yi: ha rgyud31she 'gro ba dren mdzad thugs rje can 'phags ma tā re la phyag 'tshal ma 'ongs las ldan pho mo yis bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa'i tshe nyer mkho rgyang grags chosakyi dung byin rlabs nyes skyon rab bsal bstan sa ma yu rgyun 'bab chu bo gtsang mas bkru lha shing dud pa'i ngad kyis bsangs rdo rje'i phyag rgya 'dud rol bcas snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do hūṃ maṅga lam dharmā ka dur sarba sa ma ya sa: hrī: bkra shis mi nub dge ba'i rdzas mchog ste chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba'i sgra: dbugs rlung rdo rje gsang ba'i don dang 'brel: gang 'dul phan bde'i dga' ston glu drug dang gar gyi 'byugs gsum ldan pas lha tshogs bskul: kha grags dang po chos 'khor bskor ba'i sgra: rdo rje'i bla ma mi g.yo gdan la bzheng phan bde'i phrin las gdul bya'i dpal du 'gyed: gang la gang 'dul bstan pa'i sgron me sbar: kha grags gnyis pa chos la bsdu ba'i sgra dad dam ldan pa'i rdo rje'i sgob tshogs bskul mos gus dga' spro'i gsang sngags 'du rar pheb: skyon dang dri bral 'du shes phyin drug dang: spyod lam rnam par dag pas chos la 'dud: thog mtha'

gas bar gsum dge ba'i lam la brtson:kha grags gsum pa sgrub la sbyor ba'i sgra:phun tshogs lnga ldan mchog gi gsang lam la rnam par brten nas bsnyen sgrub yan lags bzhis:mchog thun dngos grub rgya mtsho gegs med 'grub:kha grags bzhipa rtsa gsum bskul ba'i sgra:rtsa rgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs char ltar 'bebs:yi dam lha yi dngos grub sprin ltar 'khyugs:ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i bde stong me ltar 'bar:byin chen 'bebs shing dbang bskur rtags mtshan ston:lha dang gnyis med 'grub pa'i skal ba bzang:kha grags lnga pa pho nya 'bod pa'i sgra:ma bdun sring bzhi dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad 'bar ma ging lang pho nya las la myur:lhag gtor mchod pa skyems kyis dgyes bskang nas:phrin las rgya mtsho mi 'gyangs dus su bsgrub:tha tshigs can rnams dam la rnam par gdung:kha grags drug pa dam can bskul ba'i sgra:e ka dzā ṭi dbyings kyi ma drug dang:legs ldan nag po skyes bu ging chen brgyad:drang sgong chen po dmar po lha lnga sogs:las la bskul zhing dgra bgegs rdul du brlag tshe dpal bsod nams

bskul: ka dag kun bzang rtogs pa'i ye shes rgyas gzhon nu bum sku'i dgongs klong byang chub so gar 'khyug gnyis pas 'gags med dngas klong nas longs sku mtshan ma tshag bral dgongs pa bskul: dbyings rig zung 'jug rtogs pa'i ye shes rgyas: kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan mngon byang chub gar 'byug gsum pasartsol med bde 1nga las: sprul sku kun mkhyen 'gro 'dul dgongs pa bskul: lhan skyes gnyug ma rtogs pa'i yon tan rgyas rnam dag dbug chen 'byin zhing mngon du 'gyur: o badz+ra dharmā ka dur shasta pu dza ho: hrī: kha grags bkra shis skad po che: g.yas 'khyil chos kyi 'khor lo'i sgra kun bzang rol pa lha yi dung: rigs ldan dam tshig dag pas 'bud: dgyes bskang dkyil 'khor lha la bstabs: phrin las 'khor ba dong sprugs byed dngos grub gang ga'i rgyun bzhin 'bebs: bla med mchod pa grags pa'i dbyangs: rab 'byams zhing kun

sku yongasakhyab regag: tshig drug rdo rje'i glu dbyangs kyis dkyil 'khor lha rnams dgyes pa bskangs ma rig 'byul ba'i 'khor lo bcom dam chos ma nub yongs la brdal bsod nams tshogs chen rgya mtsho rdzogs don gnyis lhun gyi grub pa ra 'gyur sa ma shā sa ma rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnasangs thugs bcud gsang ba'i mthil zab mo snying las yang yang bstan 'gro'i phyir khye'u chung snying gi bu la sbyin da dung dus la ma bab pas rin chen 'phrul gyi brda la bstims bkra shis mi 'gyur rdzong la gab dus bab las smon mthu 'dzom tshe nga sprul nga dang mi gzhan pa nus ldan rdo rje da 'phrad cing rgyal bstan nub med 'dzan bsrung byed 'gro ba'i bde skyad gsar du spel chos bdag dpa' bo dpa' mo dang rang skal gdams pa 'di sprad nas gdul bya 'bum phrag sman grol byed 'gro don phrin las bsam mi khyab the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sam yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim lha ces pa chos bdag dpa' mo na ratā sa ras dgyes bskang phyir mdo khams tsā ri' gnas mdun nas mkha' 'gro'i gas brda zab mo las nus ldan bzhad pa rtsal gyis phab g.yo rgyu can la 'dzer gyur cig 'dod chen che ba' re bskang shog sarba masgo lam/
pa sa zab gsang mkha' 'gro'ithugs thig las:'phags ma dbyangs can lha tho dang:'brel ba'isnyan 'gyur gleng bu chos sgrar byin gyis rlabs pa dri za'i mgrin glu zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

pa sa nameshār+yahwa re shrī ye: no'i 1 snyagasama'i rgud sel tā re ma bde chen gcor lo' rgyan du rol ma 'ongs las ldan pho mo yis bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa'i tshe nye bar gco ba'i waṃ phye yang rdo rje gsang ba'i glu dbyangs su byin gyis brlabs pa' rim pa bstan sa ma pā de yang snyan 'gyur gling bu nyid rtse gar bsgyur ba drug ldan rgya rdul sprugs nyes skyon sbyangs byas te snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad do trīng ༷nga dz+nyā natsa gye hūṃ sa:hrī: mi dmigs stong pa chos sku'i rang bzhin las: lhun grub 'gags med thugs rje ye shes gdangs: gang 'dul 'gro 'dren chos kyi 'khor lo'i sgra: ka ḍi sto dhi tsit+ta po pho tre: ( hūṃ sbyor ba'i bde stong gsang ba'i glu: dbyings su spros pa'i chos sku mnyam nyid bskul: brda ru ston pa gzugs sku phyag rgyar sad: gang 'dul sprul pa'i sku mchog cir yang 'char: ma 'dres ye shes mtshan ma med pa'i dal: rab 'byams rgya mtsho rdo rje rdul gyi sprin: gnyis med klong rol thig le nyag gcig gi: sku dang zhing bkod bde bar bskang ba'i byir: gsang ba las kyi ḍak+ki'i glu drug bsgyur glu gcig mtshan ma med pa rdo rje'i sgra mngon dga'i zhing khyab badz+ra sa twa bskul: zhe sdang dmyal

can ba'i 'gro khams dong sprugs shing: bde gshegs thugs kye klong du mngon byang chub: glu gceg du ma rang grol chos kye sgras: dpal— ldan zheng khyab ren che na 'byung ldan bskul: nga rgyal las byung lha yi gnas rnams stong bde gshegs yon tan rgya mtsho'i glong du 'khyil: glu gcig so so rang rig don gyi kesung: grags pas bde chen zhing khyab snang mtha' bskul: 'dod chags las byung yi dwags gnas rnams stong: bde legs gsang ba gsung gi dkyil du rdzogs: glu gcig rang dre la rtogs pa mngon gyur sgras: las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing khyab don grub bskul: phrag dog ma rig lha min gnas rnams stong: bde gshegs phrin las rdo rjer e ma ho: glu gcig re dwogs mtshan 'dzin gcod pa'i sgras: stug po bkod khyab rnam par snang mdzad bskul: gti mug rmongs pa'i dud 'gro'i gnas rnams stong: rgyal kun sku yi gsang bar byang chub po glu gcig bdud bzhi gnyis snang gcod pa'i sgras: 'og min zlum 'khyil thig le'i zhing khyab nas: klong grol rgyal ba kun bskul mi yul stong: bde gshegs kun bzang dgongs

par kun kyang grol: byeng byeng byeng: spyo hūṃ a la la ho: ste mtshan ma tsheg bral chos kye dbyengs: grags stong 'gags med rdo rje'e glu: skye med dbyengs las rtsol med shar:kun gzhi'i 'khrul 'khor chos skur bcom: nges pa lnga yi 'khor lor sad: 'di na gnas pa'i rnal 'byor skyid blo bde chos kyi rgyal por grags: mi nub bstan pa'i bang mdzod du gsang ba rdo rje gar gyi bdag: sgyu 'phrul drwa bar e ma ho: 3 badz+ra waṃ phye hūṃ spra ra ṇa phaṭa: se ha ra ṇa sa: ldem drug rdo nge 'i glu dbyangs gis chos sku chos nyid klong las bskul longs sku brda yi ched du bskul sprul sku chags thogs bral bar bskul ye shes 'gags pa med par bskul skosar ba dbyings su rol phyir bskul 'das pa mtshan ma med phyir bskul cir yang gdos po bral bar bskul gang shar rang grol don la bskul bskul dang bskul bya bskul ba po blo 'das rig pa chosaskur lhug phyam brdal dbyings rig zung du 'jug dgongs pa mngon gyur e ma ho 'bud dkrol shes na rgyal ba dgyes rmongs pa sa car cor ngar ba'i rgyu gsang gnad rtogs na chos kyi sgra ngoms 'dod mdzegachos 'khor ba'i mtshang sa ma yā e ma rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs bcud skor snying las phang yang bstan 'argya'i phyir 'brog mi lo tsā'i bgo skal gtad mi 'gyur rin

sa / chen gter rgyas btab mdo khams tsa ri pra ma gab dus bab las smon mthu 'dzom tshe nga sprul nga dang ma gzhan pa khrag 'thung nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan pa 'dzin skyongs spel 'gro ba'i bde skyid gsar du bzhengs dpa' bo bdun dang dpa' bo gsum rang skal chos kyis smin grol nas nges gsang gdul bya yongs la 'doms 'bum phrag g.yu lo can du 'bod 'gro don phrin las bsam ma khyab the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi ces pa 'di'ang chos 'di'i las skal ldan pa rat+na sa ras yang yang bskul ro ra mdo khams tsā ri'i gnas mdun nas mkha 'gro'i gsang brda dag par phab pa'o zog ngo nusaldan rdo rjesamanog chos so/ sarba maṅga lam/
pas zab gsang mkha' 'grolithugs thig las: 'phags ma 'od zer can can ma dang 'brel ba'idung chen dang rkang gling byin gyis brlabs pa phrin las lhun grub bzhugs so:

pas na mo ār+ya ta re shrī ye: rgya ༅30 rgyal ba kun yum tā re ma mi 'bral snying dbus ze'u 'brur rol ma 'ongs las ldan pho mo yis bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa'i tshe nye bar mkho ba'i dung chen dang rkang gling byin gyis rlabs thabs bstan sa ma yu de ya dung chen byin rlabs ni g.yas 'dud g.yon 'dud rdul sprugs bya hrī h+ya ṣ+ṭṛ wa hu ba/ hūṃ lu hūṃ phaṭa: hrī rat+na zangs las shākyab pa'i dung chen ni: thabs mchog dpa' bo gar gyi rang bzhin te: khams gsum zil gnon rta skad dgu bton pas: theg pa rim dgu'i chos char 'gro la 'bebs: 'khor ba'i sgo brgyad dbu ma chos skur bcom: gnyis med she rab rdo rje phag mo'i dal: dug lnga'i gdon 'dul phag skad lnga ru ngur: nges pa lnga ldan mchog gi gsang ba nas dbyings ye zung 'jug bde ba'i btsan srid 'dzin: dze lang hūṃ ka la k+ṣa: shrī shrī ho: ces pas brda glu nga skad gyer de nas rkang gli byin rlabs na hrī: stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug rol pa las thugs rje'i gter chen pad+ma gar dbang sku: bde sbyor rol rtsed bsgyur ba'i ye shes gsang: 'gags med chos kyi 'khor lo'i rang sgra can: dpa' bo 'bod pasasnga gleng 'khyug lnga ldan dang pos

gas lha tshogs rnams la snyan gsan dbab: gnyis pas rdo rje'i tha tshig gnad la bor: gsum pas pho nya dam can las la bskul: bzhe pas bde stong sbyor sgol don la bsre: lnga pas chos dbyings stong par 'dor 'das sbyor: skye med klong las 'gags med dngos grub 'bebs dad ldan sgrub po'i lo 'bras dus su smin: dpa' mo 'bod pa'i me gling 'gyur lnga ldan: dang po sgra tshig mtshan ma bral ba'i glu: gnyis pas ma sring mkha' 'gro las la bskul: gsum pas bde stong dga' bzhi'i rol rtsed bsgyur:bzhi pas mchog thun dngos grub char ltar sdud: lnga pas lha dang rang sems dbyer med bsre: thams cad chos sku zig le nyag gcig klong mtshan 'dzin spros pa'i g.yul rgyal rdo rje'i gsang: don gnyis phrin las rgya mtshos 'gro ba 'dul: bde gshegs kun bzang dgongs par byang chub po snyi dharmā wāka spra ra ṇa phaṭa: dha ka dhak+ki ni pheni saṃ ha ra ṇa sa:sarba sirnyi hrī: ces pas brda glu pho gling mo gling zung bcu ru spros pas 'khor 'das dwangs bcud dril ye shes gsang ba rdo rje'i klong du bsre gnas lugs rdzogs pa chen po' don la gnas sa ma yā yem rgyal ba'i dbang po

pad+ma mas thugs theg shan tu spel phang yang bstan 'gro 'i rgud pa gso ba'i phyer khye'u chung lo tsār gtad rgyas sbyin da dung spel ba'i dus ma yin bdo la bstim nas gter du sbos klu bdud btsan la gnyer bcol dang ma 'ongs snyags ma lnga yi dus nga sprul nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas dpa' bo dpa' mor 'doms gdul bya 'bum phrag smin grol byed 'gro don lho dang byang nasa'abyung mdzad pa rgya mtsho lhun gyis grub the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sam yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi ces pa 'da'ang lung zin dpa' bo dharmā ku mud dang / 'gyur med rgya margyasare kha ma nyams pa' rdzas thabs shes rkya mchen dper shar ba' skyes dang sgrub pa'i me tog dang bcas bskul ba dang / chos bdag rang rag dang / dad ldan chosagasalaganyisakyi shog gu'i mthun rkyen dang bcasanas bskul ba dang/ chos la dbang ba' chos grogs ye shes gnyisakyas zhabs pad brten pa'i skyes dang bcasanas bskul ba dang / bde stong gar gyi dpa' mo rat+na sa ras yang yang bskul ba don dang ldan phyir bdag 'dra dpa' bo nu ldan rdo rjes mdo khams tsā ri'i gnasomadun nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma lam/
gas zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: 'phags ma 'bar ba'i 'od can dang 'brelabalibasangs chu byen rlabs dang chab byung skyems byung spos byung ba'i rim pa bzhugs so:

sa / na lnga ār+ya tā re sarba shrī ye: zu8che47rngomatsho rab 'byams rgyal ba dgyes bskyed dpal 'phags ma tā re'i lha la 'dud ma 'ongs sgrub mchog pho mo yis bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa' tshe nye bar mkho ba' man ngag ni bskrad rlabs spel ba'i thabs zab bstan sa ma yu ran chen sdod du gtsang chu blugs rdo rje slob dpon mdun tu bkod byin rlabs ma/ grub bar du ni reg bskyod g.yo 'gul byed mi rung las kyis rdo rjes phyag gsum bcas bsang chu byin gyis rlabs par zhu cesabadz+rayak+ta sa: lan gsum 33 badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ ram̐ bisne ta krid phaṭa: lanagasum 61 swā bha wa 85) sarba dharma swā bha wa 8)bye3nya:stong pa'i ngang las bsang chu'i nang du hūṃ zhu ba las rdo rje 'jigs byed chen mo 'bar ba'i 'od can gsal ba'i sku las 'od zer rdo rje'i rdul phra rab tu gyur te mchod rdzas la rngam sems rlom sems 'phrog sems 'chang ba'i lus ngag yid gsum bsreg cing gzhom pa dang mi gtsang ba'i dri ma thams cad sbyangs bar byed pa'i nus ldan du gyur: /: dz+wa la re ram̐ bisne ta krid phaṭa: nyer gcag brjod la byin gyis rlabs de nas las kya rda rje yis gtor ma chab byung mdzad pa ra zhu bsangs sbyangs sngags gong ltar la mace da rdzas thams cad mi dmigs pa stong

gas pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ las phyi nyer spyod bdun gyi mchod pa ā las nang 'dod yon lnga yi mchod rdzas (: las gsang ba rdo rje rig ma lnga dang sman gtor rak+ta'i mchod sprin: hrī:dang hūṃ:las spyor ba byang sems kyi mchod pa dang: sgrol ba sha khrag gi phung po ma tshang ba med pa: des 'phags pa kun tu bzang po 'i mchod sprin lta bu: rgyu gcang zhing phud ma nyams pa: bsam pa dag la mtho 'gom dma' bcag ser sna 'jur 'gags kyi dri ma dang bral ba: rgya che la khyon yangs pa: bkod mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba: rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing thams cad la spel khyab byed pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stong gi bar du 'byung ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur: snye su ra su ra a purta a purta ye spra ra ṇa sa bla badz+ra a pakyi shabha sre tits+tsha a hūṃglu hā ru pa dharmā pra tits+tsha a sa: ma hā pañca rak+ta bha lirnyi ta na ga ṇa sto dhi tsit+ta garma mu tru sarba pu dza a 〉: de nas las kyi rdo nge yis bdud rtsi skyems byung mdzad par zhu bas sa sbyangs bsgyur sngags gong ltar la spyo bhaji a sro ta ka pā la hūṃ: yin

yi hūṃ mchod byen rlabs kye rtsa ba bka' rgyud bla ma rnams dngaḥ dngos grub kye rtsa ba rgyud sde bzhi drug gi dkyel 'khor: rten 'brel kye rtsa ba gnas gsum ḍaske: phrin las kye rtsa ba chos skyong bsrung ma dam can rgya mtsho rnams kyi zhal du: bdud rtsi a dṛ ta yi mchod pa: girti gu h+ya rak+ta'i skyems phud: ro brgya nus ldan bā ling ta yi mchod pa: phyi nang gsang ba med byung ting nge 'dzin gyi mchod pa rnams bzhes la ma hā rak+ta rab ku ru ye swā hā de nas las kyi rdo rje yis mchod rdzas spos byung mdzad par zhu ram dz+nyā na dz+wa la ram: spos dang bzang shingage dud sprin 'dod yon lnga yi phung po: grib dang rmang rtsog ngan pa thams cad sbyong byed kyi nus pa dang ldan zhing: rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gsung thugs su brlabs pa'i ye shes kyi rdzas su gyur: sne trī tsan dan a dkar si ma'i dri mchog dang: bdug sbos ci mchis yongs su sbyar ba'i dud: mchod rdzas mi bzhed gzung 'dzin dri bsang zhing: 'dod rgur spel ba'i dud sprin mtha' yas pa: rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing rnams yongs khyab gyur: sang sa le sang nge ye swā hā badz+ra dhu baṃ pra ti tsa pu dza sa ma ya hūṃ ces brjod mchod

pa /〉 rdzas bsangasasbyangs byin gyis rlabs bar bya'o mi gtsang dri ma'i nyes skyon dag gtsang la nus ldan rgya chen spel tshogs chen mtha' yas rdzogs pa'i thabs sla bas don chen 'grub 'gyur ro sa ma mā am rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs thig nyid bstan 'gro'i gsos su rnams par spel ma 'gyur rin chen gter du sbas dus bab las smon 'dzom pa'i tshe nga sprul nusaldanado rje dang 'phrad nas bstan nga 'dzan skyong spel las can dpa' bo dpa' mo la ra skal gdams pa sbyin byas te 'bum phrag dag pa'i zhing la 'god 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa 'byung the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi ces pa 'di'ang mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda gsal bar ma mthong ba bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin gyis bskul te ji bzhin gzigs pa' snang cha brag rim rdo rje'i rdzong nas ji snyed yi ger bkod pa 'o/ nus lan rdo rje' mjog chos so sarba masgo lam/
gas zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las 'phags ma myur dpal lha mo dang: 'brel ba'i bye nang gsang mchod byin rlabs dang bskang rdzas byin rlabs thugs dam dgyes bskang zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

/ sgo name.ur+ya tā re shrī ye: zu ra rngorjes) rgyal ba kun mum tā re mar mthon mthing ral bas ga de 'dud ma 'ongs las ldan pho mo yas bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa'i tshe nye bar mkho ba'i phyi nang gi mchod rdzas bskang rdzas byin rlabs bstan sa ma yu de yang phyi mchod byin rlabs ni hūṃ be+esno ta krid phaṭa: skyid swā bha wa haṃ stong pa'i ngang las zhing khams rnams par dag pa pad+mo bkod pa'i rang bzhan du shar ba'i dbus su: ma las rin po che'i snod phun tshogs pa rnams su tre: las rdo rje'i mchod yon kun bzang zhabs bsil mdzes pa'i me tog dri zhim sbos dud gsal byed mar me bde ba'i dri chab ro ldan zhal zas snyan 'gyur rol mo la sogs pa: rgyu gtsang zhing spus dag pa phud ma nyams pa bltar legs pa ngo mtshar yid du 'ong ba kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i rnam rol du rgyas par gyur cig: o badz+ra arnya pahūṃ shabha spa ra ṇa phaṭa: se ha ra ṇa sa: de nas nang mchod byin rlabs ni hūṃ bisno ta krid phaṭa: re ye sa: dngos 'dzin bag chags thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ:las bhardze ka pā la stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du: 'dzin pa dag pa'i gzugs:

gas grags stong 'gags med na dwa'i sgra: tshul khrim rnam par dag pa'i dri: zhen 'khrul bral ba dga' bzhi'i ro: chags bral bde chen gtum mo'i reg bya: cho sa can chos nyid du rol ba'i bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa dpag yas nam mkha'i khyon dang mnyam pa zag med rdo rje'i rol rtsed cir yang 'gags med du 'char bar gyur cig: o badz+ra rū pa dharmā pu dza spra ra ṇa phaṭa: se ha ra ṇa /: de nas gsang mchod byin rlabs ni hūṃ bisne ta krid phaṭa: re ye khe: skye med stong pa chos sku'i ngang las 'gag med rgyal kun dgyes bskyed kyi dza na mo rdo rje'i rig ma lnga sgeg pa'i rnam 'gyur can 'khril sdem mnyen lhug mdzes pa'i lang tsho du mas 'khyud pa: dngos kun gyi dngas ma bcud du dril zhing sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin rigs lnga yab yum kyi ngo bor dag smin rdzogs pa: brin las rgyud lnga'i sems can sgrol zhing dug lnga ye shes sbyor bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi sman: chags pa rang sar bsgral zhing rten 'brel dbyings su dag pa gsang ba girti dmar mo'i mkha' 1nga las dbab pa'i rak+ta'i rang bzhin gyi 'khor ba dbyings su stong bar byed pa'o: rat+na

yangs pa'i gshad pa ru gtor ma 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa'i longs spyod: dpal gye mchod sdong zad pa med pa'i gter: 'dod pon lha mo'i spro bsdu dang bcas te ngo mtshar rang byung gi bkod par gyur: gzhan yang bkra shis pa'i rdzas rtags brgyad rgyal srid sna bdun gyi bkod pa: ngo mtshar zhing gi bkod pa'i rnam rol bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnyug ma de bzhin nyid kyi klong las rdo rje gsang ba'i rgyan phun sum tshogs par gyur cig: o ma hā pañca pu dza a mṛ ta rak+ta bā lirnyi rat+na maṅga lam badz+ra sba ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃḥ de nas bskang rdzas byan rlabs ni sarba dharmā gag na tsos stong pa'i ngang las mkha' dbyings rnam par dag pa'i klong du: rat+na lnga las grub pa'i sa gzhi rgya che la khod snyoms pa'i dbus su: rang byung thod rgyed kyi khar ka pā la stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du: bskang bar 'os pa'i rdzas rnams kyi dngos zhen mtshan ma'i dri ma thams cad sbyangs te lha dang mi yi longs spyod bza' bca' btung ba ldag gzhib kyi rigs dang: ri dwags g.yung dgas chu gnas bya gcan la sogs pa thams cad ma tshang ba med pa: ngo mtshar sgyu 'phrul

pas gyi bkod pa: gzugs mdzes shing blta na sdug pa: sgra snyan zhing dri zhim pa: ro mngar la reg bya 'jam pa: mthong pa tsam gyis yid 'phrog pa lha dang lha mo'i spro bsdu 'gyed pa: mgron rnams gang la gang mkho ba'i longs spyod: ci la ci dgyes pa'i yo byad: dpe 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i rnam rol: dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stong gi bar du: yul bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi spyan lam du: sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams bskang bar byed pa'i mchod sprin rab 'byams nam mkha'i khye1na dang mnyam par shākyar cig: nam mkha' maro da sngags rten snyi nga gis dpa ga yas nam mkha'i khyon bkang spel sa ma wā sa ma rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs thig skor snya las phang yang bstan 'gro'i phyir grub dbang khye'u chung lo cwar gtad da du ma spel brda la bstim mi 'gyur bkra shis rdzo la sbos ma 'ong snyigs ma lnga yi dus sprulanusaldanardo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan pa 'dzan skyongs spel las ldan dpa' bo dpa' mo yis bstan pa lho bya phyogs nas spel 'bum phrag smin zhing grol bar byed phrin las nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya gu h+ye snyi ces pa 'di'ang lung zin chos bdag rnam gnyis dang / dpa' mo rat+na sa ras
yangayang bskul rngar bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes mdo khams tsā ra' gnas mdun nas spel ba dge legs 'phel sabo maṅga lam/
gas zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las rje btsun 'phags ma nyer gcig dang 'brel ba'i skyabs yul bskyed pa phan bde'i 'byung gnas bzhugs so:

ga sa nama.ār+ya ta re ye: mil shā 1 dus pha 'jigs skyob lhag pa'i lha rgyal yum sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal ma 'ongs las ldan pho mo rnams bsnyen cing sgrub la brtson pa'i tshe nye bar mkho ba'i nam ngag ni skyabs yul bskyed pa'i thabs zab bstan sa ma mā de yang mos gus tshad med pas thal sbyar snyan pa' dbyangs dang bcas yis rang mdun nam mkhar 'ja' 'od thig le'i 〈snang: pad+ma 'bul brdal nyi zla zung 'jug khar: 'gro ba'i mgon po pad+ma 'byung gnas la: rtsa rgyud rig 'dzin bla ma rnams kyis bskor: g.yas su rgyal ba shākya thub pa la: rnam 'dren rgyal ba 'bum phrag 'khor dang bcas: rgyab tu yum chen shes rab phar phyin la: lung rtogs dam chos sde snod glegs baṃ bcas: g.yon du byang chub sems dpa' kun bzang la: nye sras brgyad sogs byang sems 'khor gyis bskor: mdun du rgyal yum rje btsun sgrol ma la: 'phags ma nyer gcig 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i bskor: bar mtshams dpa' bo dpa' mo ging laṅka dam can rgya mtsho nyi rdul 'khrigs ltar gsal kun gyi gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las 'od 'phros zhi khro rdo rje dbyings kyi lha: kha ba bu yug 'tshubs

gas pa ji bzhin du: spyan drangs gnyis med skyabs yul rnams la bstims: kun kyang mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gzi 'od kyis: rnal 'byer sgrub mchog rnams la dbodangs par dmigs: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yan bdun maṇ+ḍal phul de nas tshogs zhing bsdu ba'i rim pa ni trī dad 31sa lcags kyus bskul te lha tshogs zhu byam brtse'i zhags pas bdag dang gnyis med 'dres: dga' ba'i sgrog gis 'pho 'gyur med par gyur: btang snyoms dril bus byang chub sems rdzogs gyur: ces brjod phyi nang phyag rgyas dbyer med bstem skyabs yul ye shes rang rgyud la 'phos nas mkhyen gnyas ye shes me ltar 'bar ba da nyams rtogs yon tan mkha' ltar 'phel rgyas 'gyur sa ma yā chagam rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs bcud nyid bstan da 'gro ba'i gsos sman du rin chen gter du sbas pa 'i bcud dus 'khrug rgud pa gzeng sa lang tshe sprulanus ldan rdo dze+edang 'phrad nas bstan pa 'dzan skyongs spel las ldan dpa' bo dpa 'a mo da 'phrad nas gro don bsam yas 'byu rma smar phyogs na gdul zhing che 'bum phrag rnam 'dren lam la 'god the tshom med do sa ma yā bka' 'di bsrungs shig klu bdud btsan skal med lag tu ma shor cig sa ma rwa rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi ces pa 'di'ang rten 'bre' gyi che ba bsgrub
pa' maṇ+ḍal gye bskul nas khrag 'thung nu ldan rdo rjes dpal ldan brag lha mgon po'i gnas mdun nas spel ba dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga lam/

pas〉 zab gsang mkha' 'a144thugs thig las: 'phags ma bsod nams mchog ster dang: 'brel ba'idakar skyems spel bsgyur zhes bya ba bzhugs so:gas na ma ār+ya ta re shrī ye: me11 rgyal kun dargyasapa bskyed pa' dbyings bsod nams mchog ster la phyag 'tshal las ldan sgrub la zhugs pa'i tshe mchod gtor byin rlabs rim pa bstan sa ma yu de yang rin chen snod kyi nang bzang drug bsres pas dkar gtor dang ran chen brda ba'i ja chang skyems bshams la bsang sbyangs byin rlabs na snyenaswā bha was sbyangs rin chen sbyo/da du gtor ma ni: dkar gsum mngar gsum bdud rtsi sman: myong grol ye shes bskyed pa'i rdzas 'dzad med kun bzang mchod sprin gyur tho āḥshā: lan gsum dang niya ka ros 'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod du spel dza dza: spyodan (1rgyal ba'i bka' tha tshig la gnas pa'i dkar phyogs skyongs ba thams cad badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: ces pas bkug cing gzhung bzhin phul de nas 'dod don gsol ba ni to sdon tsha dpal chen po dang: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis bka' yi gnyer byang gtad pa bzhin du: rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi 'gal rkyen zhi zhing: chos mthun gyi

bya ba gegs med yed bzhen du 'khru1ba pa'e sdong grogs rgya chen po mardzad cag: ces brjod skyems gtor gtsang sar phul phrin las gang bcol gegs med 'grub bsnyen cing sgrub pa byed pa'i tshe nye bar mkho ba'i cha lag tso gu ru pad+ma bdag gis bkod thugs kya srasadang 'phrad par shog sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyi ces pa 'di' bsnyen thub ting 'dzan gyis bskul nas dpa' bo nusaldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod 'brong mdun nas spel ba dge legs 'phel sarba maṅga lam

ga sa zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thug thig las: 'phags ma nor ster lha mo dang: 'brel ba'idamar skyems 'bul ba phrin las lhun grub bzhugs so:gas na 31 ār+ya tā re shrī ye thu rnapa'iḥ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi phrin las pag pa'i mo la las ldan sgrub la zhugs pa ri tshe nyer mkho' dmar skyems 'bul thabs bstan sa ma mā de yang rin chen snod kyi nang sha khrag brgyan 'i dmar gtor bsham sa bsangs sbya sa byin gyis brlabs pa na ra nyid la yi rgyal gyi 31swā bha wasasbyangs cha: las rin chen snod du oṃ yig las:byung ba'i gtor ma sha khrag 'dod yon gter mi zad nam mkha'i khyon dang mnyam pa la: myong grol ye shes bdud rtsir rnams par dmigs: cha ā /: lan gsum dang ni nam ma kha' mdzod kyis spel thabs dang she rab 'brel ba'i phyag rgya yis dza / 11na gyi spyan sngar khas blangs tha tshag la gnas pa'i pho nya dregs pa sde brgyad sha khrag dmar la dgyes pa thams cad badz+ra sa ma ya ja dza: gtor ma 'bul la phrin pas bcol ba ri to rdo dze+egasang ba'i pho nya dregs pa dam can rgya mtsho: sha khrag dmar la dgyes pa 'i sde tshogs khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi

gtar ma dam pa 'ad bzhas la: sangs rgyas rkya bstan pa srungs sems can la bad skyad spol: sgrub pa rba'i phron las stsal: 'gal kyen dgra brgags rdul du brlag pa'i phron las ma10da cig ces brjod skyems gtor gtsang sar phul phrin las thogs med yad bzhin 'grub sgrub pa'i cha lag dam pa nyid las ldan bu yi bgo skal du pa d+ma saṃ bha bdag gis bkod thugs kya sras dang 'phrad pa ra shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya bdo thim snyi drag bshad jol ba'irdo rje yis gang sha rang gro brda byang nyid da la ldan brag lha'i ma'u na nas spel sarba make lam/

pas zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las 'phags ma ri khrod lha mo dang: 'brel ba'i mtshams lha bskyed pa dang bden brjod bsrung 'khor gyi dmigs rim rnams bzhugs se na mo ār+ya ta re shrī ye: 43 1 rgyal ba kun lum tā te ma bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du rol ma 'ongs las ldan pho mo yis bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa'i tshe bdud bgegs zil gyis gnod pa dang phrin las gegs med 'grub thabs bstan sa ma mā de yang mtshams la bskyed pa ni skad cig gis rang nyid gnyug ma'i lha mchog dbang chen h+ya skṛ wa sku mdog dmar nag: khro gtum bzod par dka' ba nyi ma 'bul dus gcig la shar ba'i gzi mdangs can: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dkar gyi mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa: spyan gsum bsgrad cing shangs nas drag po'i sa glu len pas sde rgyad dbang du sdud cing bran du bkol ba: smar smin kha spu las me yi tsha tsha tho ro ro 'phro bas bdud bgegs bsreg par byed pa dbu skra khams nag gyen du brdzes shing thod skam lnga yis rnam par brgyan pa: dur khrod dpal chas kyis sku la spras shing g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa: zhabs gnyis gyad kyi

'dor thabs su bsgrad pa ye shes kye me dpung 'bar ba'i slong du che btsan 'gran zla dang bral bar gsal ba'i sku las khro chung rang 'dra dpag med spros pas 'byung po bdud bgegs thams cad bkug gzir brngan bsgrad kyi las mdzad par bsam la: bgegs gtor byin rlabs 'gugs pa sogs legs par gtong la gnyen po 'i lha rang nyid dbang chen rta mgrin gnas su gyur ba las gnyen po ye shes kyi lha: dpal chen rdo rje gzhen nu sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon lcags phur gdengs ba: dur khrod kyi chas rdzogs shing zhabs gnyis gyad kyi 'dor thabs su bsgrad pa ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du che btsan 'gran zla dang bral ba'i sku yi klong du 'phags ma nyer gcig: gnas bzhir snyigs dus skyobs pa'i lha bzhi ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs pa: rdo rje me yi 'od zer dang khro chung gi tsha tsha 'byed pas bdud bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad thal ba rdul phran bzhin du brlag pa'i nus mthu dang ldan par bsam la las byang gzhung gi bka' bsgo dang chang glud bsngo ba grub pa'i rjes bden brjod bya ba 'di ltar ro na

gas mo drin chen rtsa ba brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang sangs rgyas kyi chos gyi dge 'dun gyi bka' gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi dus na 'jigs skyobs kyis lha lnga mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul thugs rje brin las mdzad pa bsam kyis mi khyab pa rnams kyi don dam chos nyid ngo bo gdod nas rnam par dag pa'i kun rdzob rten 'brel rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa chen po de dag gi mthu dang nus pa la brten nas: deng 'dir phun tshogs yon tan 'byung gnas lnga yi gzhi bzung zhing: bsnyen sgrub yan lags bzhi'i gzhung bsra nas: mi 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin: mi 'da' ba'i dam tshig mi ral ba'i dam bca': mi nyams pa'i mchod tshogs: mi yengs ba'i dran pa sogs: yongs su ldan pa'i bskyed rdzogs lhur len byed pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs tshogs che 'bring chung gsum gyi sde tshogs rnams la: mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di ster ba yin pas dga' zhing mgu nas

tshams par rgyas la sa yi byegs 'dar ma gnas par byer tsag: dengs sheg gal ste mi 'gro zheng 'tsha bar gyur na khye rba ye shes kye rda rje mi rab tu 'bar ba 'ad rnams rkyas:bgegs tshogs 'byung po'i tshogs bya sgro me la bsregs pa dang ardza ga'i tog so bzhin du brlag par 'gyur ta re hūṃ bzhi'i drag sngags rab tu brjod thun rdzas sna tshogs char ba phab de nas bsrung gur bsgom pa rne ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i: steng thams cad 'khor lo'i bla bre: 'og thams cad rin po che'i sa gzhi: bar snang thams cad rdo rje'i ra gur ye shes kyi me rlung gi 'du 'phro: bskal ba'i chu yi rba rlabs 'khyil ba'i dbus su: ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal med khang yangs shing rgya che ba'i klong du bdag dang bsrung bya thams cad yi dam lha yi nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i ngang la gnas par bya: bsrung ba'i gur khang la dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mi shig mi 'gyur ba'i rgyas gdab par bsam la: rten snying shes brjod rab tu gnas mi shag rdo rje'i don la gnas sgrub pa' 'bras bu dus su smin the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma mā yi ma rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs thig skor snying gi brag las phang na'ang
