pasacha bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i phyir grub dbang khye'u chung lo tsār gtad da dung ma spel brda la bstims mi 'gyur bkra shi rdzong la sbos ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus skabasasu nga sprulanus ldan rdo rdze dang 'phrad nasadapa' bo dpa' mor 'doms gdul bya 'bum phrag smin grol byed 'gro don lho dang byang nas 'byung don gnyis lhun gyisagrub par 'gyur sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya dzi cesapa 'di'ang lung zin dpa' bo mched gnyis kyis bskul ba dang rang rig chos gsal grogs grags ye shes rnams kyis bskul ba dang bde stong gar gyi dpa' mo rat+na sa ras bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bonusaldan rdo rjesamakha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda risalas zhal ngas1bsate dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma lam/ dza yan+tu/

pas zab gsang mkha' 'a144thugs thig las khams gsum dbang sdud rigs byed lha mo dang 'brel ba'i lhag pa'i lha lasnyan gsan dbab pa dang dbang bskul rgyas gdab bzhugs so na mo ār+ya ta re shrī ye 4 zerna mi//1/ khams gsum dbang sdud 'bar ma ltar ku ru kul+le nyid la 'dud ma 'ongs las ldan pho mo yis bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa'i tshe rtags mtshan rmad byung 'byung ba'i phyir snyan gsan dbab pa 'ad nyid gal sa ma yu de yang mos gus tshad med pas thal mo sbyar la 'di skad do dad ldan sgrub pa po rnams kyis dad pa mos gus gdung shugs drag po bskyed pa dang chab gcig snying ga nas 'od dang 'od phung dpag tu med pa 'phros pas: lho nub rnga yab kyi gling dbus nas o rgyan chen po la 'khor rig 'dzin lo paṇa rgya mtshos bskor ba dang:khyad par ri bo gru 'dzin gyi zhing nas 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug sems dpa' sems ma rgya mtshos bskor ba dang: gnas mchogagayu 'i can nas rgyal yum rje btsun sgrol ma la 'phags ma nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa'i tshom bu dang: gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad sku phyag rgya:

gsung leg 'bru thugs phyag 'tshan: pon tan dang phren las thams cad 'ja' dang 'od phung theg le phra mo'i rnam par byung nas bdag dang bsgrub rdzas sgrub pa po rnams la tham pas gnas zhing khams rnam par dag pa: sgrub khang gzhal med khang yid du 'ong ba: sgrub rdzas myong grol ye shes kyi bcud chen po sgrub pa po rnams rje btsun 'phags ma'i sku gsung thugs rkya bkod pa chen por dag smin rdzogs par bsam: la rol mo sna tshogs kye sgra dang bcas la byen dbab po de nas dbyer med bsre bstems ni hūṃ hūṃ sa: dbyings nas drangs ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo thams cad bdag gnas sgrub rdzas yo byad rnams la thim pas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi gter chen po thob par bsam mo de nas dbang bskul rim pa ni rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad bde gshegs rigs lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs: steng gi nam mkhar byon nas rin po che'i bum pa thogs nas dbang bskur sgrib gnyis bag chags sangs kyi dag par byas: sgo gsum rnam par smin zhing yongs su grol bar byas bdud rtsi yar 'khyil ba

gas las 'phags ma tā re 'jigs byed chen mo g.yin gyis mi thub khro gnyer can mdzad gzhan las rab rgyal myur dpal lha mo nags kyi sgrol ma rnams la don grub bdag por gyur bas dbu brgyan par gyur: ha rta ma le: swā thu: e bye: shā hūṃ: a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ: sgra dbyangs lha mo mi pham rgyal mo gtsug tor rnam rgyal rab zhi chen mo bkra shis don byed rnams la rdor sems gtso bor gyur ba'i rigs lngas dbu rgyan par bsam hūṃ hūṃ oṃ le: swā thu e bye: hā rta a snyi ṣiñca hūṃ: bsod nams mchog ster nor rgyun lha mo 'od zer can ma dpag med gnon ma rnams la rin 'byung gtso bor gyur ba'i rigs lnga'i cod paṇa gyis dbu rgyan par bsam: swā thu: cha le: ka hūṃ e bye: hānywa a bhi ṣiñca s+t+waṃ: rigs byed lha mo 'bar ba'i 'od can 'jig rten gsum rgyal dgra dpung 'joms ma rma bya chen po ri khrod lha mo rnams la snang mtha' gtso bor gyur ba'i rigs lngas dbu rgyan par bsam: e bye: yo le: swā hūṃX : hūṃ: hā hūṃ: a snyi shi ༅gru srog ye shes sems dpa' la rnam par snang mdzad bdag por gyur pas dbu rgyan par gyur:

la: hū sgru swā mu: a pya: hā tā: a snye ṣañca hūṃ: de nas rgyas gdab pa la bskyed pa'e lha tshogs kye gnas gsum du sku rnam par snang mdzad 'khor lo 'dzan pas rgyas gdab par bsam la oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: gsung snang ba mtha' yas pad+ma 'dzin pas rgyas gdab par bsam la āXtiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: thugs rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje 'dzin pas rgyas gdab par bsam la hūṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: slar yang rdo rje'i sa bon rnams dang sgog gi yi ge las 'od 'phros te dbyings nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ye shes rdo rje'i rnam par bskul zhing bzhengs nas dam tshig pa la thim par bsam: la spyan 'dren zhing bzhugs gsol sogs mthar phyin ba ra bya ba'o gnad des nyams rtogs 'phel zhing rgyas tshe bsod yar ngos zla lhar 'phe la sgrub 'bras mngon du 'byu bar 'gyur the tshom med do sa ma yu ye ma rgyal dbang pad+ma 'byung gnas kyas bstan dang 'gro ba'i gsos sman du thugs thig gdams zab rmad byung ba 'brog mi lo tsā'i bgo skal bzhag rin chen sa yi gter du sbas gnyer byang klu bdud btsan la bcol ma 'ongs snyigs ma' dus skabasasu nga sprul nus ldan rdo rje yis rnyed nas dpa' bo dpa 'a mor spel 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa 'byung gdul bya 'bum phrag smin grol byed the tshom med do sa ma

ga zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las 'phags ma gtsug tor rnam rgyal dang 'brel ba'i ril bu sgrub pa dngos grub bang mdzod bzhugs so:na mo ār+ya tā re shrī ye: rte 45 rgyal ba kun mum tā re la snying dbus mi shig thag le rol ma 'ongs las ldan pho slo yis bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa'i tshe tshe dpal nyams rtogs yon tan kun rgyas phyir ril bu'i sbyor ba bstan sa ma pā de yang sman sna nyi shu gcig bsags la zhib btags ril bu dril che chung sran ma'i rdog po tsam kha dog dkar ser dmar ljang mthing sna tshogs ji ltar 'tshams par bya rin chen shel gyi bum par gzhug rnam lnga nyer spyod mdzes par bkram de nas lha ru gsal ba ni tso ma hā shu bye ril bu snod dang bcas mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur stong pa'i ngang las lhun grub rang byung gi gzhal med khang sgo gru rta bab chos 'khor rnams yongs su rdzogs pa: phyi gsal nang gsal 'od 'bar ba'i klong du: ril bu rje btsun 'phags ma nyer gcig: sku mdog dkar ser dmar ljang mthing sngon gyi rnams pa: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mdzes 'dzum blta bas chog mi shes pa: gcer bu pad phreng rus rgyan dang dar dpyangs brgyan pa phyag

mtshan mda' dar dang bhan+ta bdud rtse bsnams pa: zhabs gnyes rdo rje'e rtse gar bsgyur ba: tshom bu re re dang 'dra ba bsam gyes mi khyab pa tel rgang phyul ba bzhen du gsal bar bskyed do: de dag rnams kyi spyi bor sku mi 'gyur ba'i ngo bo oṃ gyi rnam pa: mgrin par gsung mi 'gags pa'i rdo rje ā yi mtshan pa: snying gar thugs mi 'khrul ba'i dbang rtags hūṃ gi rnam par gsal ba las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dpag tu med pa 'phros: phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams mu mtha' med pa na bzhugs pa'i bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba sras bcas yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs nas rgya mtsho chen po la kha char bab pa ltar ril bu lhar gsal ba rnams la rgyun mi chad par sib sib thim par bsam la: ma u( badz+ra gu ru dhe wa ḍak+ki ni brnya dharmā sa dharma kā ya sasto kā ya nirma kwa ya bho dhi sa twa dz+nyā na dhartu sarba sa pa ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: a we sha ya a ā spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag mchod bstod bya bzlas pa 'dzab kya 'byul 'khor na bsnyen pa' dus su 'ad ltar ro bum pa gzhal yas khang yangs shing rgya che ba'i

gas nang du ril bu rnams 'phags ma'i lhar gsal ba rnams las 'od zer 'phros te 'khor 'das kyi dwangs bcud thams cad bsdus te seb sib thim par bsam la bzlas pa bya: nye bsnyen dus su 'di ltar sbyar: 3 ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i dal dbus su ril bu rnams rje btsun 'phags ma'i skur gsal ba rnams las rang sgra dpag med 'phro ba dang 'khor 'das 'byung ba'i dngas bcud thams cad bsdus te bar ma chad par yang yang bstim pas gzi brjid nus stobs 'bar bar bsam: la bzlasapa bya sgrub pa' dus su 'di ltar sbyar gi snang srid kyi khams thams cad yongs su khyab pa'i gzhal med khang gi nang du ril bu rnams rje btsun 'phags ma nyer gcig gi skur gsal:de dag re re las kyang brgya stong khri 'bum bye ba sa ya dung phyur grangs med pa 'phros te kun gyis 'dzab dbyangs ti ri ri sgrogs par bsgom la: bzlas pa' sham bu 'di gdag go snyena.a ra pa tsa mi da trī da ye swā hā: bsgrub pho dus su 'di ltar sbyar bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i sku las 'od zer 'phros te bum pa gzhal yas khang gi lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul stong

khams rab 'khyams gang ba'e lha sku spros pa rnams rkyas 'dzab dbyangs de re re bsgrags pas snang sred g.yo 'gul byed par bsam la: sgrub sngags sham bu 'ad bzhin gdab yisgo a rasnyi hrīng hrīng hūṃ ya ral+li pho phernyi las sbyor dus su bzlos dmigs ni hūṃ ril bu yi shes lha yi sku ru gsal ba rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas: gzung 'dzin gnyis bsdus kyi las nyon bag chags thams cad thul gyis bsreg pa dang: phrin las rnam pa bzhi gegs med yid bzhin du bsgrub par bsam la: bzlas pa'i sham bu 'di gdag go pañca sirnyi shedz+nya wa shing mā ra ya phaṭa swā hā: de nas las bzhi'i 'dod gsol ni nad gdon 'jigs brgyad sgrib gnyis bag chags thams cad shidz+nya ku ru ye swā hā zhi ba'i brin las rab 'byams thogs pa med par lhun gyis grub par gyur cig: tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams rtogs yon tan thams cad puṣ+ṭi ku ru ye swā hā: rgyas pa'i brin las khams gsum srid gsum 'dod rgu'i dpal yon sarba wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dbang gi phrin las gnod byed dug lnga dug gsum las byung ba'i log par blta ba thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa swā hā: drag pa'i phrin

ri sa las yangan sharnya puṣ+ṭa wa shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa swā hā: phron las rab 'byams thams cad rjags pa mod par lhun rgyas grub par gyur tsag: dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten 'brel snying gsum gsum bzlasal lhag chad bskangs de nasa'adod don gsol gdab ni sa dus ngan 'jigs skyobs kyi lha: rgyal yum 'phags ma'i lha tshogs thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs su gsol: bdag gis dka' ba dang du blang nas yi dam 'phags ma'i lha tshogs bsnyen cing sgrub: ngal ba khyad du bsad nas 'gro don 'ba' zhig la brtson: lus sgog 'ben du btsug nas rang snang g.yu lo can gyi zhing khams mngon du byed pa la lhag pa'i lha mchog khyed rnams la thugs mkhyen pa'i ye shes: brtse ba'i thugs rje: mdzad pa'i brin las skyobs pa'i nus mthu: 'dren pa'i dpa' shugs: sgrol ba'i gru gzings: mdzad pa'i phrin las rgya chen po mnga' ba lags pas bdag cag bsgrub pa po rnams la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa dus da lta nyid du stsol bar mdzad du gsol: ces brjod mchod bstod dge bsngos bya phrin las rab 'byams gegs med 'grub sa ma shā e ma rgyal dbang pad+ma'i

thugasathag skor snyeng lasaphang yang bstan 'gro'i gyer grub dbang khye'u chung lo tsār gtad da dung ma spel brda la bstems ma 'gyur bkra shas rdzong la sbos klu bdud btsan la gnyer byang gtod ma 'ongs snyags ma lnga ya dus nga sprulanusaldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan pa 'dzin skyongs spel chos bdag dpa' bo dpa' mo yi bgo skal gdams zab nyams len nas 'bum brag sman cang grol bar byed 'gro don sto dang byang nas 'byung don gnyisalhun grub the tshom med sam pā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya lha cesapa 'di'ang lung zin dpa' bo zung dang grogs rang rig chos gsal rnams kyis bskul ba dang / grogasarat+na sa rasanan tan gyis bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bonu ldan rdo rjesamado khams tsa ri'i gnas mdun nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam/

ga yo zab gsang mkha' 'dros/thugs thig las: 'phags ma dgra dpung 'joms ma dang: 'brel ba'i tshogs bsgral rim pa bzhugs so:can na ma.ār+ya tware shrī ye: rna sgo rgyal kun dargyasabasnyed rta re ma bde pho 'khor lo'i rgyan du rol ma 'ongs las ldan pho mo yas bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa'i tshe nye bar mkho ba' tshogs bsgral kyi dmigs rim zab pa'i rno mde'u bstan sa ma yu tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe bsgral 'gugs bya ba'i rim pa ni mdun du lcags snod bsgral rdzas bshams phur dar phyar la hūṃ mdzad rgyas zungags snangad ske las grub pa'i gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom kha dog la mthil yangs pa'i dbus su tshogs rdzas dṛ:dang tri:las byung ba'i dgra bgegs thams cad nyam thag pa'i gzugs can gyur: na ma dpo/na mtshag gsum la phyag 'tshal lo mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa ba gsum dang bden gnyis basmu ba med pa'i bden pa dang: dus ngan 'jigs skyobs kyi lha rdo rje rdzong dgu bdud 'dul rigs lnga'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang: bden gnyis bsgru ba med pa'i nus stobs kyis: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'tshe ba'i

bdud sde: ches byang chub bsgrub pa la bar du gcad pa'i dam sra: nyams teng rnga 'dzan la nye bar 'tsha ba'i rgyal bsen: sa lam rgya pon tan bsgob par byed pa'i 'byung po: tsha bsod dpal 'byer chos srid bde skyid la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs smon log: gzugs can gyi dgra: gzugs med pa'i bgegs tshe len gyi bdud: bar chod kyi rkyen byad ma rbod gtong lha srung dang bcas pa thams cad skad cig rang dbang med par khra kyi li li: nag sga ra ra: byis chung khra yis ded pa ltar rang dbang med par tshogs tha ma dmigs pa'i rten 'di la myur du khu/ga cig: dza shā baṃ ho: gsum bdun dgu sogs gang skabs brjod de nas bsgral 'dren gzhung ltar bya dgra dpung rdul du brlag pa sogs drag po'i phrin las thogs med 'grub sa ma shā ye ma rgyal dbang pad+ma' thugs bcud skor grub dbang 'brog ban lo tsār gtad bstan 'gro'i rgud pa gso ba'i phyar mdo khamasatsā rir rgyas su gdab ma 'ongs snyigasam lnga yi dus nga sprul da ma gzhan pa nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas gdul bya 'bum phrag smin grol byed chos bdag dpa' bo dpa' mo dang 'phrad nas lho byang 'gro don 'byung ze tshom med do rdo rje' bka' sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi ces pa 'di'ang chos
sa kyis ba rna

pas zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: 'phags ma khro gnyer can ma dang 'brel ba'i lhag gtor zhu brlabs phrin las bcol ba rdo rje'i tha tshog bzhugs se na mo ār+ya re hṝ ye: zhes rgyal kun dgyesabaskyedatwa re ma bde chen 'bor lo'i rgyan du rol ma 'ongs las ldan pho mo yis bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa 'i tshe nye bar ma kho ba' pho nya la lhag gtor 'bul ba'i ram pa bstan sa ma mā de yang gral mjug lding khri'i khar stag lngags gzhi steng khrag thag bkram rnam lnga'i longs spyod bkram nas su lag ma gtsang rtsog thabs kyis bsre sman dang rak+ta'i skyems phud bshams rdo rje rgyal por zhal 4 zhu las rdor 'dud pa'i rnam 'byur gyis hoḥ rdo rje gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: brin las rab 'byams thogs pa med par 'grub pa'i slad du: shugs 'chang dam tshigs can gyi pho nya rnams la: lhag gtor 'dod rgu'i dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa ru spel zhing 'bul ba la thugs gtad par zhu de nas kun gyas 'di skad do maswā bha wa stong pa'i ngang lasa.āḥyig yongs su gyur te bhañja ka pā la stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du lhag gtor sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga gtso bor gyur ba'i bza' bca' btung ba ldag

gzheb 'dod yon lnga ye phung po zad mi shes pa'i gter chen po nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur: o u/: ha ho trī: lan gsum brjod la byan gyi rlabs e a ra le steng t+t+waṃng pho phernyi lhag sdud kyi pho nya rnams dam tshig gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs shig: byon cig badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: zhing chen g.yab 'dor bzhug glus bskul rol mo snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas te gzhung ltar lhag gtor 'bul bar bya de nas phrin las bcol ba ni ma hā pañca a mṛ ta khā hi: ma hā rak+ta ma hā bā ling ta ho: rdo rje gsang ba'i pho nya ma mo bdun sring bzhi dbang phyug nyer brgyad king chen bco brgyad ma bcu drug 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma tshogs rnams kyis gsang mchod lhag ma'i gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs: sems can la phan bde spel gsang sngags kyi 'du ba bskyed: nyams rtogs dang yon tan sbor: bshad sgrub kyi 'du sgo tshug: nad mug dang mtshon 'khrug sol: rdzogs ldan gyi snang ba yar ngos zla ltar gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las dam pa rgya chen po yongs su grub par mdzod cig: ces brjod las kyi rdo rje yis tshogs

pa /me rdosalhag gtor dkyil 'khor gyi byang shar mtshams su spungs bar bya gnasakyis phrin las zogs med 'grub sa ma mā e ma rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugasathig skor snying nas phang pang bstan 'gro'i phyir khye'u chung lo tsār gtad rgyas sbyin da dung ma spel brda la bstims mi 'gyur bkra shas rdzong la sbos ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga yi dus nga sprul nga dang mi gzhan pa nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas gdul bya 'bum phrag smin grol byed chos bdag dpa' bo dpa' mo dang 'phrad nas 'gro don lho byang nas bsam mi khyab pa 'byung bar 'gyur the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya lha ces pa 'di'ang chos bdag dpa' bo mched gnyis dang /dpa' mo rasno sa ras bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nusaldan rdo rjes mdo khams tsā ra' gnas mdun nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda zab mo dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma lam/

cas zab gsang mkha' 'dros thugs thig las: 'phags ma gzhan gyes me thub ma dang: 'brel ba'imachod gtor byin rgyas brlabs pa nam mkha'i gter chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so na mo ār+ya tā re shrī ye: 241gro/ rgyalamuma'aphags ma'i dkyil 'khor la gus pas brtud de snying nas 'dud ma 'ongs las ldan pho mo yis bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa 'i tshe nye bar mkho ba'i mchod gtor rnams byin rlabs nam mkha'i gter chen bstan sa ma yu de yang rdo rje chos skyongs ba'i srung ma mnyes bskang mchod gtor rnams bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs pa ni ro yo kho: — nga pa'ingang las rlung me 'thabs pas thod pa'i rgyed pu gsum kyi khar milas ka pā la stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga gtso bor gyur ba'i bza' bca' btung ba ldag gzhib 'dod yon nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur: yina.unyu ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūṃ trī 'i: lan gsum oṃ āḥ/ ma hā bā ling ta hūṃ hrī:tha: lan gsum: snyed u: ma hā rak+ta hūṃ hrī ja: lan gsum gtor ma dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag gi rang bzhin la ngo bo bde stong zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'dod yon nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur: rgo āḥka ha ho

ste: lan gsum rang nyed lhar gsal ba'i thugs sreg las 'od zer sna tshogs glegs 'khyug pa lta bur 'phros de: rdo rje ches skyongs ba'i srung ma bka' sdod pho nya'e dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la phog sngon gyi bka' tha tshig dran nas chos kyi sku las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs nas phrin las rab 'byabs thogs med bsgrub par bsam la:rol mo sna tshogs sgra sbir zhing: gzhung bzhin gsol mchod rgyas par bya: de nas brin las bcol ba la: ho rdo rje gsang ba'i tha tshig la gnas pa'i dbyings kyi ma drug: pho rgyud ging chen bcu gsum: las mdzad klu bdud btsan gsum: bka' yi lha srin sde rgyad: dkar phyogs skyongs ba'i pho nya 'khor tshogs sprul pa dpung dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la: mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che spyi dang bye brag thams cad bsrung zhing skyobs par mdzod la: phyogs bcu nam mkha' yangs pa'i khams kun tu dar zhing rgyas par mdzod cig: bstan pa'i dgra sde ma lus pa thal ba rdul du rlog cig bshad dang sgrub pa'i bya ba yar ngos zla ltar bskyed cig: bstan

can 'dzin gyi 'dus sde spel la sku tshe bsrengs shig: skye 'gro sems can la bde skyid kyi snang ba spel cig: nad mug mtshon gsum gyi rgud pa sol cig: dgra la mtshon thob cig bgegs la thun phob cig: dpa' ba'i ru dar phyor cig: chags che dang nyam nga bzlog cig: rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i 'dod pa'i don zhi rgyas dbang drag gi bya ba gang brtsam pa thams cad thogs pa med par grub pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i 'gal rkyen du gyur ba'i nyes tshogs thams cad stongs pa dang nyams rtogs yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel te rang snang dag pa'i zhing la dbang bsgyur nus pa'i phrin las dam pa rgya chen po yongs su grub par mdzod cig: ces brjod rdo rje'i chos skyongs brngan phrin las rab 'byams thogs med 'grub sa ma yu de nas bskul gtor byin rlabs ni a las bhan+ta lcang ma can yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: gtor ma bde stong zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod du spro ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur: yo āḥ( ha ho trī lan gsum brjod la bskul ba bya de nas chad tho dam can gya gtor ma byan rlabs bya ba

ni eḥlas bhasnyo gru gsum yangs pa'i nang du: gtor ma dri:dang tre las dgra bgegs dngos su gsal la: na mo mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa ba gsum dang bden gnyes baspu ba med pa'i bden pa'i mthus sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'tshe zhing sems can gyi bde skyid bcom pa rnal 'byor pa'i bka' tha tshig la ma gnas pa'i dgra bgegs thams can sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cig: lan gsum dang: dza hūṃ baṃ hoḥ dbyings nas thun mtshon sna tshogs kyis char bab pas sha ri khrag gi rgya mtsho nam mkha'i gtos dang mnyam par gyur te: ma rung dgra bgegs kyi sde stongs nas pho nya mnyes pa'i mchod gtor 'dod yon phun sum tshogs par gyur: slo ā hūṃ ha ho hrī lan gsum brjod pa dpag med spel chad tho gzhung bgo bsgrags par bya de nas brtan gtor byin rlabs ni re ye kho: rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bshal chu'i gtor ma zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'dod yon nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur: tshe āḥshā: lan gsum gyis spel brtan ma brngan de nas phrin las bcol ba ni ho: bod khams skyongs ba'i g.yar dam can ma sring

ga sa brtan ma bcu gnyis dpon g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis: bshal chu'i gtor ma dam pa 'di bzhes la gangs can bod khams dkar chos kyis 'tsho zhing: legs tshogs yar ngos zla ltar 'phel la: mi mthun rgud pa'i tshogs thams cad zhi zhing stong la ming gi lhag mar gyur ba'i phrin las dam pa rgya chen po gegs med yid bzhin du dza/ba par marngesad cig: ces brjod pho nya dam can brngan gnad kyis phrin las thogs med 'grub sa ma yā chagam rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs zig skor snying gi khrag las phang na' 'brog mi mo tsā khyod la sbyin da dung ma spel brda la bstems mi 'gyur bkra shis rdzong la sbos ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga ya dus sprul nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan pa 'dzin skyongs spel gdul bya 'bum phrag sman grol byed chos bdag dpa' bo dpa' mo yas bstan 'gro'i bde legs spel bar byed 'gro don lho dang byang nas 'byung dus kyi ru 'dzang cha shes gso baspu ba med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi ces pa 'di'ang lung zin dpa' bo zung gis thabs shes kyi rdzas sna tshogs dang bzhed sgrub 'chad bsgom gyis me tog dang bcas nas bskul ba dang grogs rat+na sa ras nan tan gyis bskul ba don dang ldan phyir bdag 'dra dpa' ma nus ldan rdo rjes mdo khams tsā ri'i gnas
mdun nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang brda dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo lam/

cas zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: 'phags ma gzhan las rgyal ma dang: 'brel ba'i dam sri zil gnonabadud 'dul rdo rje'i rdzong zhes bya ba bzhugs so:na mo ār+ya ta re hṝ ye: rinaḥ(de rgyal ba kun mum tā re ma dran pa 'dus pa'i 'bor lor rol ma 'ongs las ldan pho mo yis bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa'i tshe bar chad dam sri zil gnon phyir rdo rje zo yi las rim bstan sa ma mā de yang las byang bskang tshogs 'bul chad tho brtan ma 'bul ba'i rjes gtor gzhong sbubs la bden brjod sogs 'gugs bsnyims rim pa 'di ltar ro e spyo: gtor ga13 kha sbubs pa dang mnyam du mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nub par gyur na mo sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro: chos sku longs sku sprul sku: mdo sgyu sems phyogs rgya mtsho: bka' dgongs phur pa la sogs: bden gnyis basmu ba med pa'i nus stobs zab mo'i mthus: sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod pa'i gnod byed dam sri pho mo 'gab 'dre bsre rag the'u rang 'byung po: bdag cag rnal 'byor pa'i bka' la 'khu ba: dam las log pa: dbang du mi 'du ba: phrin las mi bskrub pa mgo g.yog mgo

bskor rjes snyegs phyer sdang byed pa'e ya ma dam sre'e regs su gtogs pa thams cad pho brang re rab 'bar ba'i 'og rol tu khug tsag lan gsum brjod dza dza dza dza hū ba he tri tri hur thum dza: bse mo sbun dgu'i srog la ram̐ ram̐ tri tri hur thum dza rasmo spun dgu'i snying la dza dza: tri tri khur thum dza: yasmo spun dgu'i snying la rbad rbad tri tri khur thum dza shā na mo spun dgu'i srog la ram̐ ram̐: tri tri hur thum dza: gson 'dre mo sbun dgu'i snying la dza dza: tri tri hur thum dza: bse rag spun dgu'i srog la rbad rbad: dam sri sbun dgu'i snying la ram̐ ram̐: tri tri khung thum dza: bdud btsan the'u rang stong 'khrug gi sgog la dza dza: tri tri khung thum dza rgyal bsen 'gab 'dre'i snying la rbad rbad: sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod pa'i gnod byed 'gab 'dre khug: 'gab 'dre'i snying la dza dza: gnod byed 'byung po thams cad dran pa nyams nas 'gyel te gru gsum ting nge 'dzin gyi khang sgrom 'bar ba'i nang du tshud nas pho rnams kha sbubs: mo gan skyal du gnas pa'i rkang lag lcags gzer gyis theb te 'phar ldang 'gul bskyod mi nus par bskal ba'i bar du brgyal bar

pa cha bsam la: gzhung gi bro mnan bya'o: de nas gtor gzhong yar btegs pa 'a tshe bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams rtogs yon tan thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngos bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig: hūṃ a yu mkhye puṣ+ṭi ku ru ye swā hā me tog sna tshogs sam ma bkram dge ston bya zhang rol mo 'khrol gnad gyis bar chad g.yul las rgyal don rnams gegs med yid bzhin 'grub sa ma mā am rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs thig skor rin chen srog las pha nga na yang bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i phyir 'brog mi lo tsā khyod la gtad da dung ma spel brda la bstims mi 'gyur bkra shis rdzong la sbos gter bdag klu bdud btsan la gnyer ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga ya dus nga sprul nga dang mi gzhan pa dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan pa 'dzin skyongs spel las ldan dpa' bo dpa' mo 'doms gdul bya 'bum phrag sman grol byed 'gro don lho dang byang nas 'byung dus kyi rgud pa cha shas gso phrin las ya mtshan bsam mi khyab the tshom mi mnga' rdo rje'i bka' sa ma shā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi ces pa 'di'ang lung zin rdarma ku mud dang / 'gyur med rgya mtsho rang rig rdo rje dharmā garti dad ldan chos gsal rnams kyis bskul ba dang / bde stong gar gyis dpa' mo rat+na sa ras yang yang bskul ba don
dang ldan phyer bdag 'dra dpa' bo nusaldan rdo rjes mdo khamasatsā re'i gnas mdun nasamakha' 'gro' gsang brda zab mo dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam/
ga sa zab gsang mkha' 'gro'ithugs thig las 'phags ma rab tu zhi ma dang: 'brel ba'imachod bstod bzod gsol dang shes brjod rnams kyi dmigs spro thugs dam dgyes bskang bzhugs so:

— 11 nameshār+ya tārishrīyi: ra ma ) rgyal ba kun mum tā re ma bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du rol ma 'ongs las ldan pho mo yis bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa' tshe nye bar mkho ba' mched bstod skabs dgyes bskangs bdud rtsa'i bum bzang bstan sa ma mā de yang las gzhung bsrang ba'i rjes gsol mchod tshogasabaskang grub pa' tshe bka' drin gso phyar gtang rag gi ma31da pa'i dmigs 'asdon 'di ltar bya mchod rdzas bshams pa'i dngos po rnam par dag pa'i dbyings las 'phrul rtsed bsgyur ba'i: rdo rje'i lha mo ut+pal mdangs 'dzin ma dang: spos kyi sprin lding bdug pa mo: dbang gi gsal khyab sgron me ma bde mchog bsil ldan dri chab 'gyed sogs phyi nyer spyod kyi lha mo bdun dang: gzugs rdo rje 'char byed ma: sgra rgyud mang na dwa'i gsung:dri bzang po'i ngad bsung 'thul: ro dga' bzhi'i bcud 'bebs ma reg bya za byed gtum mo'i gos 'gyed pa'i nang gi lha mo 'dod yon lnga yi sprin spro ba mo dang: dngos kun bdud rtsir bsgyur ba'i a mṛ ma dang chags pa rab bsgral bde klong girti ma dang 'dod yon gyi zhen 'dzin grol ba'i ro brgya ma ste gsang ba sman gtor rak+ta'i lha mo dang:

can bcu drug rdo rje gar gyis byang chub sems bcud 'gyed pa mo dang ma rig bag chags kyi rten rigs drug gi sa bon kun gyi snying la rnam par brten pa bsregs bcom bsgral ba'i mthu mo che dang: dbyings las ma g.yos pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sprin mchod dang: chos can chos nyid du rol ba'i rol mnyam chen po dang: dbyings rig zung 'jug chen po du ma rang grol de bzhin nyid kyi mchod pa ste: gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i pu dza spro ba'i lha mo rnams kyis dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan brin las rnams kyi dgyes pa bskang bar bsam la: mchod pa rgyas par 'bul de nas bstod pa'i dmigasa'adun la bdagamadun las spros pa'i lha mo nam mkha' yangs pa'i khyon dang mnyam pa rnams kyis sku mdzes pas gar bsgyur byed cing: gsung snyan pas bstod dbyangs tir tir: thugs lha tshogs rnams kyi yon tan la rnam par 'dud pa'i ting 'dzin phyag rol mo sna tshogs sgra snyan gyi shugs dang sbrel nas dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi sku gsung la bstod pa rdo rje gla yi mchod pa phul bar bsams la:

bstod pa rgya par bya de nasasprosapa'i lha mo bsdu ba ni slar rde rje'e lha rma rnams bdag mdun rgya gnas so sor them pas mthu stobs nus pa gza rgyan dbang dang darngas grub bsam gyas mi khyab pa 'phel bar bsam mo: de nas gzhung gi bshags pa bya bzod gsol rim pa 'di ltar ro ho: rgyal yum rje btsun sgrol ma gtso 'khor sprul pa dang bcas pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol: deng bdag cag gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyan po'i sgo 'dir zhugs nas bskyed rdzogs ting nge 'dzin yal ba dang: sngags gsum phyag rgya bzhi ya bral nas don ma spyod pa dang rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa dang mchod gtor chung zhing dri mas bslad zhugs pa dang mi dge ba bcu spang ma thub pa dang: dge ba bcu dang du ma lon pa dang bka' bzhin du gzhung ma bsrang ba dang: le lo dang rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi'i dbang du gyur nas tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i 'gal rkyen du gyur ba ci mchis pa thams cad mi 'chab po: mi sted do: lhan chad srog la bab kyang mi brgyid na dag cing tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol oṃ u〉 badz+ra sa ma yā yid yige

gas brgya pas lhag chad bskangs de nas sha brjod bya ba la rang dzagasnying ga'i'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa bskul nas: thugs ye shes chos sku'i ngang las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengs nas mdun gyi lha lam yongs su gang bar byon nas: zhal nas bkra shis dge mtshan gyi glu dbyangs di ri ri brjod cing phyag nas me tog man+ta ra ba'i char chen po brnyil nas: skye rgu rdzogs ldan gyi snang ba la spyod pa'i phan bde'i dpal 'byor ster bar bsam la shis brjod rgya chen po byas la rol mo'i sgra yi dge mtshan yid 'ong du bya'o gnad kyis bde legs yon tan rgyas don gnyis gegs med yid bzhin 'grub sam mā:sa ma rgyal dbang pad+malithugs thig skor snying las phang yang bstan 'gro'i phyir grub dbang khye'u chung lo tsār sbyin da dung ma spel brda la bstims mi 'gyur bkra shis rdzong du sbos klu btsan bdud la gter byang gtod ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga yi dus nga sprul nga dang mi gzhan pa da 'a bo nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan pa 'dzan sbyongs spel las ldan dpa' bo dpa' mo yis 'gro don phrin las lho byang 'byung gdul bya 'bum phrag smin grol byed don gnyis rgya mtsho lhun gyas grub the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi ces pa 'di'ang lung zin dpa' bo

rnam gnyasadang rang reg ches grogs chesagasal rnams kyesabaskul ba dang dpa' rma rat+nas bskul ba don dang ldan phyer bdag 'dra dpa' bonu ldan rdo rjesamado khams tsā re'e gnas mdun nasamakha' 'gro'i gsang brda dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba ma le/ dza yarnya/

can zab gsang mkha' 'dros/thugs thig las 'phags ma nags khrod lha rmo dang 'brel ba'i mtha' rten smon lam rnam dag bzhugs so:/ ཿ( ār+ya tā re shrī ye 'i chisgo81// rgyal ba kun yum 'phags ma la gus pas bayid de snying nas 'dud ma 'ongs las ldan pho mo yis bsnyen sgrub lhur len byed pa'i tshe nye bar mkho ba'i smon lam ni bkra shis rol mo thub rjes sbyar sa ma mā de yang blo sems dwangs ba yi 'gro don lhag bsam rnam dag gis na ཿda mtshangag gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden pa dang bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i nus stobs kyis: phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa rin po che: phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas gyur cig: bstana'ardzan 'dus sde dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams: thugs mthun khrims gtsang dam tshig rnam par dag: 'gro phan bsgrub la snying rus spob pa mtho: bslab gsum mi nyams sgog gi gtar 'dzin re ga: nam mkha'i mthar gtugs sems can rgya mtsho yi las nyon bag chags rgya mtsho kun bcom nas smon lam rgya mtsho dri ma med pa'i mthus ye shes yon tan rgya mtsho rab tu thob par shog: spyodapargya mtsha rnam par

dag pa yas bskal pa rgya mtsha mo skya spyid byed cang sangs rgyas rgya mtsha rab tu mnyas par rgyad: phron las rgya mtshas 'gro khams rdang sprugs shaṃg: bstan pa ma nub sbyon bdag mnga' thang rgyas: der 'dzin rnams kyi sku tshe zhabs pad brtan: 'gro ba ma lus dge ba bcu la spyod: rtag par rdzogs ldan snang bas mdzes gyur cig: rje btsun bla ma gu ru pad+ma yi thugs bskyed phrin las mtha' rgyas mi mjed zhing: bdag gis phan bde chos kyi bya bas skyongs: gang la gang 'dul mdzad pa mthar phyin shog: nam zhig skye 'chi'i gar sgyur ston pa'i tshe: pad+ma'i pho nya mkhar chen mtsho rgyal kyis mngon sum lag pa'i mdzub mo nas drangs te dpal ri pad+ma'i zhabs drung 'khod par shog: thugs brtses rjes bzung 'phags bod lo paṇa gral: rmad byung theg mchog bdud rtsi'i dpal la rol: gang 'dul sprul pa mi nub rab 'gyed nas gdul bya ma lus zhing der 'dren par shog de ltar smon lam rnam dag bstan yan lag dge ba'i spyod pa skyongs phrin las 'gro pha na 'od dkar 'gyed don gnyas gegs med yad bzhin 'grub sa ma yu ye ma rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugasathig skor gces pa 'i sgog las

pas phang na yang bstan 'gro'i rgud pa bsal ba'i phyir grub dbang khye'u chung lo tsār gtad da dung ma spel brda la bstims mi 'gyur bkra shis rdzong du sbos klu bdud btsan la gnyer byang gtod skal med lag tu ma shor rgya ma 'ongs snyigasam lnga yi dus nga sprul nusaldan rdo rje dang: 'phrad nas bstan pa 'dzin skyongs spel chos bdag dpa' bo dpa' mor 'gyed 'gro don lho da byang nas 'byung gdul bya 'bum phrag smin grol byed don rnams gegs med yid bzhin 'grub sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya gu h+ye snyi ces pa 'da'ang lung zin dpa 'a bo'agyur mad rgya mcho dang /pad+matshas 'a la rgya mtsho gnyas kyis bskul ba dang / chos bdagarang reg rdodzo dharmā kirti dad ldan chos gsal nye gnas ye shes rnams kyis yang yang bskul ba dang / bde stong gar gyi dpa' morat+nas ra yang yang bskul ba don dang ldan phyir bdag 'dra dpa' bonusaldan rdorjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te mdo khamasatsā ri'i gnas mdun nas dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam/
ca na zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las rje btsun 'phags ma nyer gcig gi:bsreg blugs las bzhi lhun grub zhes bya ba bzhugs sa:

canacha name.ur+ya shrī ye: ru rngo ma rjeri mi'imi rnya ta che rdoko/ gdod na rnam dag yi shesadabyings 'gro ba 'dul mdzad tā re ma 'phags ma nyer gcig gtso 'bor bcas bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du mchod bdag 'dra pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig skor bsreg blugs las bzhe lhun grub bstan sa ma yu de yang thab dkyil 'dom gang ba gru bzhi khod snyoms yangs pa ru thab rgya mthing ga 'khor lo'i mtshan mi khyud gi gzhi mthing pad+ma dmar mdzes pa'i ku mud nyer gcig bri kha khyer dkar po rdo rje'i ris kha bad ser bo ratā dmar mchu ljang ral gri sngon po mdzes mu ran me yi ra mo bkra 'phyangs rgyab zla byed rdo rje bri tshom bu lha grang ji bzhan bkod thab rgya zur brgyad zha shing gis brgyad brtsig sor brgyad brgyad cu'o kha khyer dbang shing 'om bu yis zla gam drug cu sor bco lnga kha bad rgyas shing shug pa yis bzhi brtsig bzhi bcu khru gang ngo mchu steng drag shing tsher ma yis sum brtsig sum cu khru ga ga sor mo bcu gnyis tshad du bya mu ran las bzhi'i shing tshogs kyis brgyad brtsigs khru gang brgyad cu'o me dar sna lnga 'bar me dang rlung g.yab ljang sngon lho nub 'god rdzas rnams gzhung dang mthun pa ru stegs gyi khar 'god gtsang ma bya de nas las kyi gzhungs bsrang nas 'dzab bzlas mchod bstod bya ba'o de nas las

pas la lajug pa ni rnam grangs lnga bcu dag ga bstan dang po bsreg rdzas byin rlabs ni snyen ā shāX thabs dang shes rab gnyis med ngang: rang byung ye shes chen po'i rtsal: rnam par shar ba'i bsreg rdzas rnams: ngo bo ye shes bdud rtsi la: rnam pa 'dod yon lnga ldan gter: rmad byung kun tu bzang po'i sprin dpag yas nam mkha'i khams gang gyur: 67 āḥshānam:sarba thegags khaṃm dz+nya puṣ+ṭi mā ra ya ku dza ye swā hā: tsan loḥ( hūṃtshosna rmā:e byesatā rtu:badz+raspra ra ṇa sa: sngags dang phyag rgya drug dag gis byan gyis brlabs par bya ba'o gnyis pa me sbar rim pa ni shā: mi yi ngo po snang mtha' yas me yi rang bzhin so sor rtog me yi las ni mtshan rtog bsreg me la ye shes gzi byin bskyed: sa alhoyibadz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ gsum pa rlung gis g.yab pa ni nyu: mine+e steng 'bar lha rnams tshig: 'og tu 'khyil ba'i klu rnams bsreg: phyogs mtshams la g.yos sde rgyad sbar: de bas gdug pa'i me dbal zhi: las bzhi 'grub pa'i kha dog dbyibs: lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol: ye shes bsil yab ldan pas g.yab: 'dod pa'i don rnams grub par mdzod tsos badz+ra hūṃ ye: ku ru

phyibye swā hā: bzhi pa thab khung bskyed pa ni e swā bha wasasbyangs me thab me dmegs stong par sbyangs da ye ngang las skad tsag gas: ye shes mi dpung dmar ser 'khrugs: da dbus ram̐9)ga 'phro 'du las: me lha drang sgong dkar ser 'dzum zhal gcig phyag gnyis gzi 'od 'bar bgrang phreng spyi blugs phyag na bsnams: smad sham rus rgyan mdzes pas spras: drang sgong cha lugs rdzogs pa la: ra skyes dkar po'i gdan la bzhugs: thugs sgog 'od kyis shar lto nas: ye shes me lha spyan drangs bstim: lnga pa snyan gsan dbab pa ni hoḥ drang grong chen po sngon lha'i dus su sbyin bsregs 'tshal ba ltar: deng 'dir rnal 'byor ba bdag gis bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa bla na med pa 'bul lags na: skad cig da lta nyid du ma g.yel bar byon par mdzad du gsol drug pa spyan 'dren bya ba ni /: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: tshur gshegs me lha'i rgyal po ni: ḍak+ki ra tsa 'khor dang bcas:ma thogs spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol oṃ asne dhe wa ṛ ṣi sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya dza dza: bdun pa bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ni /: ye shes me lha 'khor dang bcas: dam tshig pa

gas dang gnyis med bzhugs 'bar ba las kyi 'khrul 'khor gyis phrin las sgrub phyir gus phyag 'tshal: snye asnedz+nyawa ṛ ṣi sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan glu asnodhe wa ṛ ṣi sa pa ri wā ra a ti pu ho: pra ti dza ho: brgyad pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni hūṃ trī: milha asner tsa la me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo gzugs sgra dang: dri ro reg chos sman gtor raka: ga ṇa tsakra la sogs pa'i: byi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: tshogs rdzogs don gnyis lhun grub mdzod: ma asnedhe wa ṛ ṣi sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṅge dhupe sogs shabha pra ti tsa ye swā hā: slo asne dhe wa ṛ ṣi sa pa ri wā ra du pa sogs dharma pra sa asnoye dhe wa ṛ ṣi sa pa ri wā ra ma hā pañca rak+ta ba lirnyi ga ṇa tsakra la kha ram khā hi: dgu pa byon skyems 'bul ba ni hūṃ trīḥ rtsiyimar dang 'bru yi mar: byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin 'dis: asne ra tsa mnyes gyur cig tshogs rdzogs don gnyis lhun grub mdzod: snyen asnyegayiga.a mṛ ta khā hi: nyer gcig dag gis phul bar bya bcu pa rdzas rnams 'bul ba ni hūṃ trī thabs shes dbyer mad bdud rtsi mchog dam rdzas rmad byung

bsreg rdzas rnams: asne ra tsa'i zhal du 'bul: tshogs dzogs don gnyes lhun grub mardzad: e asne ye bho dhe sbyo k+ta a pra ta badz+ra sedzha sa bha de puṣ+ṭa be ga be dza ye ghasma ba lwa a yu ṣe pra ti ha ta gha gha ni sarba pa shā da ha na ye shirnyi puṣ+ṭi wa shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa swā hā: brgya stong la sogs ci 'grub 'bul bcu gcag bstod pa bya ba ni hūṃ trī: me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha drang sgong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag: shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la: mchod cing phyag 'tshal bstod par bgyi r+sā gnyis bzod gsol bya ba ni ho: rme lha asne ra dza dgongs: bdag rmongs ma rig gti mugs pas: sku gsum thugs dang 'gal ba'i las: 'dzin byed me lha nyid la bshags: yi ge brgya pa sa nongs pa bshags bcu gsum 'dod gsol gdab pa ni he me lha drang srong gi rgyal po khyod la zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa phul ba'i mthus: rnal 'byor ba bdag gi las bzhi lhun gyis grub par byed pa la bar chad bdud bgegs dam sris glags mi rted cing ye shes me yi bya ba mthar byin pa'i phrin las mdzad pa dang: bdag gis phul ba'i bsregs rdzas rnams rje btsun 'phags ma'i lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal

can du bstabs pa'i phrin las mdzod cig milha yishas kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur ba'i klong du r+sā bzhi bsreg lha bskyed rga ni zabagrub ltar du tshang bar gtong spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'chal dang phya nang gsang mchod sman gtor raka zabadag snying poltar du bya bco lnga byon skyems 'bul ba na hūṃ hrī: zugabacud snying bo mar khu ni: byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin can: rje btsun 'phags ma'i lha la 'bul: dgyes bzhes phrin las grub par mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar asgota' tī: nyer gcig dag gis 'bul bar bya mchod tshogs 'di ru spron na legs bcu drug bsregs rdzas 'bul ba na hūṃ trī snang ba brdal khyab yangs pa na lhun grub 'dod rgu'i bsreg rdzas spungs: rje btsun 'phags ma'i lha la 'bul tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa na las bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar bhodhogrek+ta a dṛ ta badz+ra sirnyi saṃ bha de puṣ+ṭa be ga bi dzā ye ghasma ba lwa a yu ṣe pra ti ha ta gha gha ni arja sarba pa shā da ha na ye shiṭ+wāṃ pudhe wa shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa swā hā: brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs 'bul bcu bdun skyabs kyi 'dod gsol ni sa rgyalayum rjodabatsun 'phags ma'i lha tshogs rnams la

zhal zas bsreg blugs rkya mtshod pa rgya tshan po phul ba'e mthus: rnal 'byar ba bdag cag dpon slob r+yan mched 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kye nad gdon 'dzags brgyad zhe zhing tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor ba gdul bya phrin las thams cad rgyas pa dang: khams gsum srid gsum mos pa rnam bzhis 'gro ba rnams dbang du sdud pa dang:gnyis snang log 'dren bstan pa'i bdud sde bar chad dam sri rnams thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod cig rol mo sgrogs shing dmigs rim bskyangs bco lnga dbyangasacan lha mo la bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i rim pa ni dkar gsum mngar gsum zas sna bteg snyan pa'i dbyangasakyas 'di skad do hūṃ trī: dag mnyam ye ro|sa rol pa'i rtsal zas mchog dkar gsum mngar gsum dang: 'bras bu ro brgya nus pa ldan: zas mchog bdud rtsi dam pa 'dis: dbyangs can lha mo'i dgyes pa bskangs: she rab me ltar 'bar bar mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar oṃ sarba saṃ bha di ye swā hā: brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bskyar 'dod don gsol ba' ram pa ni 11 rgyal yum dbyangs can lha mo' sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams dgyes

pa/ pa'i phyir du zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byer pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la chags thogs dang bral ba'i shes rab phun sum tshogs pa stsal du gsol: bcu dgu bsod nams mchog ster ma bsreg blugs 'bul ba'i rim pa ni mar khu phul la 'di skad do hūṃ hūṃ: 'bru bcud snying po mar ni: thabs shes dgangs blugs sbyar bas drangs: ljags dang re yig 'od sbu gu'i rten 'brel 'dzom pas bcud drangs te: gsol bas tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar khyeda.asgota ye swā hā: brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bskyar 'dod don gsol ba' ram pa ni 'o 'phags ma bsod nams mchog ster gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams dgyes pa'i phyir du zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol: nya shu rigs byed lha mo la bsreg blugs 'bul ba'i rim pa ni rdzas gsum phul la 'di skad do hūṃ hūṃ: tshan

khre mtshal chen dbang ge rdzas: nyon rmangs nad sel smad rgya mtshog: ye shes bdud tsu 'bar ba yes regs byed lha rma' dargyas pa bskangs: bdag cag tshags dzogs sgrab dag nas khams gsum dbang du sdud par mdzod rtsa sngags mthar e haṃ gha yi swāhā: brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bskyar 'dod don gsol ba'i rim pa ni 'o: 'phags ma rigs byed dbang mo'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams dgyes pa'i phyir du zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la khams gsum srid gsum lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdud pa'i dngos (1ba dam pa stsal du gsol: nyer gcig myur dpa la lha mo la bsreg blugs 'bul ba'i rim pa ni sngags byang phul la 'di skad do hūṃ hrī: gsang ba'i snying po ye shes sngags: rig pa grub pa'i dam rdzas kyis: myur ma dpa' mo'i dgyes pa bskangs: bdag cag tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag: 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod rtsa sngags mthar na ma ya sa shrī ye swā hā brgya stong bra 'bum la sogs bskyar 'dod don gsol ba'i rim pa ni 'o 'phags ma myur dpal lha

gas mo'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams dgyes pa'i phyir du zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol: nyer gnyas gtsug tor rnam rgyal la bsreg blugs 'bul ba' rim pa ni dur wa phul la 'di skad do hūṃ trī: 'gyur ba mid pa rtsi yi bcud: dam rdzas dur wa'i mchod pa ni: 'chi med tshe bskyed bdud rtsi yis: gtsug tor rnam rgyal dgyes pa bskangs bdag cag tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag: 'chi med tshe thob phrin las mdzod rtsa sngags mthar tsanabadz+ra a yu 〉swāhā brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bskyar 'dod don gsol ba'i rim pa na sa 'phags ma gtsug tor rnam rgyal sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams dgyes pa'i phyir du zhal zas bsregs blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'chi med tshe yi dbang dang dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol: nyer gsum bkra shis don byed la bsreg blugs 'bul ba'i rim pa ni 'bras dkar phul la 'di skad

do hū ste bkra shes phun sum tshogs pa'e rdzas: 'bras dkar 'bru mtshog mched pa rna: rgyal yum bkra shes don byed ma: 'khor dang bcas pa'e dgyes pa bskangs: bdag cag tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag: bya ba mthar phyin phrin las mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar 61 badz+ra puṣ+ṭa maṅga lam swā hā brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bskyar 'dod don gsol ba' rim pa na 'o 'phags ma bkra shis don byed kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams dgyes pa'i phyir du zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor ba bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa'i bya ba mthar phyin pa'i dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol: nyer bzhi 'jig rten gsum rgyal la bsreg blugs 'bul ba'i rim pa ni rdzas gsum bsres pa'i zan gyas ni bā ling bsags la 'di skad do hūṃ hrīX dug gab ma gdug 'joms khams gab ma g.yul rgyal phyir lcags zangs til nag bsreg pas bā ling ta: 'jig rten gsum rgyal dgyes pa bskangs: rbod gtong sbyor ba ngan pa bzlog: bdag cags tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag: brtul bzhugs mthar phyin

pa sa phrinalas mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar bla badz+ra a su ḍi sarba sha hūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa swā hā: brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bskyar 'dod don gsol ba'i ram pa ni 'o 'phags ma 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams dgyes pa'i phyir du zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor ba bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la khams gsum gdug pa'i g.yul ngo las rnal 'byor rgyal ba'i dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol: nyer lnga 'jigs byed mo la bsreg blugs 'bul ba' rim pa ni sran ma phul la 'di skad do hūṃ hṝ bar chad gdug pa'i tshogs 'joms rdzas: 'bru mchog sran ma'i mchod pa yis: 'jigs byed lha mo'i dgyes pa bskangs bdag cag tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag: bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar yin mahā ba lā ye swā hā: brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bskyar 'dod don gsol ba'i rim pa ni 63'phags ma 'jigs byed lha mo'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams dgyes pa'i phyir du zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor ba

bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la bar chad gdug pa'e tshogs 'joms sheng sangs rgyas kye bstan pa ren po che dar zheng rgyas pa' dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol nyer drug rab tu zhi ma la bsreg blugs 'bul ba'i ram pa ni til rigs phul la 'di skad do hūṃ trī: rten 'brel nyes pa'i phyogs 'joms rdzas: 'bru mchog til gyi mchod pa yis: rab tu zhi ma'i dgyes pa bskangs: bdag cag tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag: bde legs rgyas pa'i brin las mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar sa sarba pa paṃ da ha na ye swā hā: brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bskyar 'dod don gsol ba'i ram pa na 'o: 'phags ma rab tu zhi ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams dgyes pa'i phyir du zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor ba bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la rten 'brel nyes pa'i phyogs thams cad 'joms pa dang legs pa'i yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol: nyer bdun rma bya chen mo la bsreg blugs 'bul ba'i rim pa ni yam shingaphul la 'ad skad do hūṃ hrī ma rig las nyon dri

gas 'joms shing: dpal bskyed yams shing mchod pa yis: rma bya chen po'i dgyes pa bskangs: bdag cag tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag: las nyon dri bral phrin las mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar snyed ste rnyidzhai k+ta ye swā hā: brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bskyar 'dod don gsol ba' rim pa ni 'o 'phags ma rma bya chen po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams dgyes pa'i phyir du zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor ba bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la las nyon ma rig pa'i dri ma mtha' dag dang bral ba'i dngos shākyab dam pa stsal du gsol: nyer brgyad 'bar ba'i 'od can la bsreg blugs 'bul ba'i rim pa ni rdzas bsres rdu rdum ra phul nas snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do hūṃ hrī: gzung 'arin dri ma bsreg pa'i phyir: tsan+tan dkar dmar bzang po drug: sbyar bas mar gyi rdu rdum ras: 'bar ba'i 'od can dgyes pa bskangs bdag cag tshogs dzadags sgrib pa dag: ma rig dri bral phrin las mdzod rtsa sngags mthar tsan tsan+dan se shā ra e haṃ gha swā hā: brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bskyar 'dod don gsol ba'i rim pa na 'o

'phags ma 'bar ba'i 'od can gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phren las rnams dgyes pa'i phyer du zhal zas bsreg blugs kye mched pa rgya chen po phul ba'e mthus rnal 'byer ba bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gzung 'dzin dbyings bsreg ye shes kyi sgron me rab tu 'bar ba'i dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol: nyer dgu gas gyi mi thub la bsreg blugs 'bul ba'i rim pa ni tsher ma ro bsregs phul nas su snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do hūṃ trī phas rgol sbyor nganabasal ba'i phyir: dam rdzas drag po'i yams shing ni: sha khrag brgyan pa'i mchod pa yis gzhan gyis mi thub dgyes pa bskangs: bdag cag tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag: gdug pa tshar gcod brin las mdzod rtsa sngags mthar sarba sha hūṃ mā raya phaṭa swā hā brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bskyar 'dod don gsol ba'i rim pa ni 'o 'phags ma gzhan gyis mi thub kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams dgyes pa'i phyir du zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor ba bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la phas rgol rig sngags rbod gtong gi sbyor ba

can tshar gcod cing bde legs kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol: sum cu dpag med gnon ma la bsreg blugs 'bul ba' rim pa ni shing tog phul la 'di skad do hūṃ trī 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sgo gcod cing: ma rung gdug tshogs dpa' skongs phyir dam rdzas shing tog mchod pa yis dpag med gnon ma'i dgyes pa bskangs bdag cag tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag: 'khor ba dongs sprugs phrin las mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar glus gha gha ni ga ga ni bi lo shi te ye swā hā: brgya stong bra 'bum la sogs bskyar 'dod don gsol ba'i rim pa ni 'o 'phags ma dpag mid gnon ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams dgyes pa'i phyir du zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor ba bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'gro drug 'khor ba'i du: kha gnon pa dang ma rung gdug pa 'dul ba'i dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol: so gcig gzhan las rgyal ma la bsreg blugs 'bul ba'i rim pa ni ku sha phul la 'di skad do hūṃ trī pha rol gdug chogs las rgyal phyir: dam rdzas ku sha'i mchod pa yis: gzhan

las rgyal ma'e dgyes pa bskangs: bdag cag tshogs dzogs sgob pa dag: bsrung ba phun tshogs phren las mardzad rtsasngags mthar 1— a pra te ha da badz+ra ye swā hā: brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bskyar 'dod don gsol ba'i rim pa ni 21 'phags ma gzhan las rgyal ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams dgyes pa'i phyir du zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor ba bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la bar chad gdug pa'i skyen snang mtha' dag las rnam par rgyal pa'i bsrung ba phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol: so gnyis nags kyi sgrol ma la bsreg blugs 'bul ba'i rim pa ni so ba phul la 'di skad do hūṃ hrī: bde chen ye shes rgyas pa dang: thugs rje bsil ldan dam pa'i rdzas: rmad byung so ba'i mchod pa yis: nags khrod lha mo'i dgyes pa bskangs: bdag cag tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag: bde legs phun tshogs phrin las mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar zlog ma hā bi dza ye swā hā: brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bskyar 'dod don gsol ba'i ram pa ni lnga 'phags ma nags khrod lha mo'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin

pas las rnams dgyes pa'i phyir du zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor ba bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la nyon mongs pa'i tsha gdung gi dri ma bral thugs rje bsil ba'i bde ba mchog dang ldan pa'i dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol: so gsum dgra dpu 'joms ma la bsreg blugs 'bul ba'i rim pa ni li ga phul la 'di skad do hūṃ hrī: zhing bcu tshang ba'i dgra bo rnams: bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus gsum gyi mchod pa med du byung ba yis: dgra dpung 'joms ma'i dgyes pa bskangs bdag cag tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag bar chad tshar gcod phrin las mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar: sarba sha hūṃ dṛ:tri:kha kha khā hi khā hi brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bskyar: 'dod don gsol ba'i rim pa ni 'o: 'phags ma dgra dpung 'joms ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams dgyes pa'i phyir du zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor ba bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra sde thal bar brlag cing nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos

grub dam pa stsal du gsol: so bzhi khro gnyer can ma la bsreg blugs 'bul ba'i rim pa ni sha khrag zhun yul 'di skad do hūṃ ste gsang sngagabasabastan pa dar ba dang: bar chad rgol ba 'joms pa'i phyir: sha khrag tshil zhun mchod pa yis: khro gnyer can ma'i dgyes pa bskangs bdag cag tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag: bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar skyid badz+ra sha sa ko e haṃ phaṭa swā hā: brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bskyar 'dod don gsol ba' rim pa ni 'o 'phags ma khro gnyer can ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams dgyes pa'i phyir du zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor ba bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gsang chen gnyis ldan sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa'i dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol: so lnga mi pham rgyal mo la bsreg blugs 'bul ba'i rim pa ni: tshogs mchod phul la 'di skad do hūṃ hrī: rmongs pa'i blo las rab rgyal zhing: tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir zad med gter ga ṇa tsakra'i mchod pa yis: mi paṃ rgyal mo'i dgyes pa bskangs: bdag cag tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag:

gas nyams rtogs rgyas pa'i brin las mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar snyen ga ṇa tsakra khā hi swā hā: brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bskyar 'dod don gsol ba'i rim pa na 'o 'phags ma mipho rgyal mo'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams dgyes pa'i phyir du zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol: so drug nor rgyun lha mo la bsreg blugs 'bul ba'i rim pa ni nas phul de nas 'di skad do hūṃ gi dpal 'phyor 'odangs spyod 'phel rgyas phyir 'bru mchog snying po zhun mar bcas: rmad du byung ba'i mchod pa yis nor ster lha mo'i dgyes pa bskangs: bdag cag tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag: dpal 'byer rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar tsang mahā pog ye swā hā brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bskyar 'dod don gsol ba'i ram pa ni shā 'phags ma dor stor lha mo'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams dgyes pa'i phyir du zhal zas bsregs byugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po

phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor ba bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la zas nor longs spyod 'dod rgu'i char chen po 'bebs pa'i dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol: so bdun ra khrod lha mo la bsreg blugs 'bul ba'i rim pa ni gro dkar phul la 'di skad do hūṃ hrī: nad yam rims sogs zhi ba'i phyir: dam rdzas gro dkar mchod pa yis: ri khrod lha mo'i dgyes pa bskangs: bdag cag tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag nad rim 'joms pa'i phrin las mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar skyid badz+ra ghasma ri ye swā hā: brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bskyar 'dod don gsol ba' rim pa ni 'o: 'phagasam ri khrod lha mo'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams dgyes pa'i phyir du zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la rims nad grib yam gdon bgegs 'byung po'i rdzas sbyor ngan pa mtha' dag zhi zhing stong pa'i dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol: so brgyad 'od zer can ma la bsreg blugs 'bul ba'i rim pa na yungs dkar phul la 'di skad do: ( hrī: bar chad jag chom 'joms pa'i phyir: bgegs 'joms

gas yungs dkar sha ru ram: dam rdzas mchod pa chen po yis: 'od zer can ma'i dgyes pa bskangs: bdag cag tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag rkun jag bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar sa sarba atho sidhi ye swā hā: brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bskyar 'dod don gsol ba' rim pa ni 'o: 'phags ma 'od zer can ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las rnams dgyes pa'i phyir du zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor ba bdag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la dgra rkun jag gsum gyi gnod pas mi tshugs par phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol so dgu bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs phyi nang mchod pa sna tshogs bsham snyan pa'i dbyangs kyas 'ad skad do hūṃ trī: yi shes klong yangs 'byil ba'i snod nang du: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i sbyin bsreg bshams: 'dod yon lnga yi 'od zer 'phro ba ni: rje btsun 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bdag cag tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa kun dag nas don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i mthu thob bsam rtsa sngags ma thar sarba pañca a

prata la kha ra khā hūṃ: brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs bskyar 'dod don gsol ba' rim pa ni 'e rje btsun 'phags ma nyer gtsag 'khar dang bcas pa rnams rkya sku gsung thugs r+yan tan phrin las rnams dgyes pa'i phyir du zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor ba bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la mchog dang thun mongs gnyis kyi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol: gzhung gi bstod pa rgyas par bya de nas bskang tshogs gsol kha sogs ci 'grub legs par bya ba'o de nas so rtsi 'bul ba ni sa badz+ra te bu la ye swā hā: de nas gos zungs 'bul ba ni ces badz+ra waṣ+ṭa yeswāhā: bzhi bcu bsregs lha'i gtang rag ni rnam lnga la sogs bsregs rdzas rnams lan grang bdun res rdzogs par bya zhe gcig gshegs skyems 'bul ba ni hūṃ hrī: zag rmed bde ba'i sgod nang du rtsi bcud snying po 'bri yi mar ye shes zhun gyi snying po 'di: rje btsun 'phags ma'i tshogs la 'bul dgyes bzhes rang gnas btagags nas kyang: zhing der bdag cag khrid du gadresal rtsa sngags mthar 55 mṛ ta khā tī: nyer gcag phul la dgyes pa bskangs zhe gnyas gtor ma 'bul ba na 'das gtor bsangs sbyangs

pas byin gyis rlabs de nas phul ba'i rim pa ni oṃ.āḥ/ sarba rat+na e rda bha lirnyi khā tī: lan bdun gyas phul la hūṃ hrī 'dod yon lnga ldan phung po ni: phyi nang gsang ba'i bkod pa rdzogs: dpag yas nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam pas rje btsun 'phags ma'i dgyes pa bskangs: rnam bzhi'i brin las kun 'grub cing: 'phags ma'i zhing du grol bar regag:zhe gsum bstod pa bya ba ni rgyas bsdus ga byed skabs dang bstun nongs pa bshags pa'i rim ba ni ha rgyalayum 'phags ma'i lha tshogs dgongs: bdag ni ma rig dbang gyur te: thugs dang 'gal ba'i las bgyis pa: gnong zhing 'gyod sems drag pos bshags: badz+rasam ya bhishukhye āḥ yig brgya gsum gyis lag chad bskangs zhe bzhi bsngo ba smon lam ni nyuste dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba dang bsreg blugs phul ba'i bsod nams kyis: 'gro kun tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang zung 'jug sku gsum 'grub par shog: lan gsum zhe lnga gshegs gsol bya ba ni āḥ snang cha thabs rkya 'khor lo rnams shes rab yum gyi mkha' la bsdu: slar yang ye shes rol ba'i rtsal snang srid dag pa rab 'byams dang: a ā mi

shesapachosakyi dbyings su gshegs dam tshag pa rang gi snying gar bsdu zhe drug me lha'i gtang rag ni cas asne ye badz+ratsa la ra ra: mar khu thigs pa gcig gis me gsosal rnam lnga la sogs mchod pa 'bul bsreg rdzas phul sngags gsum mam bdun byon skyems mar phyung gshegs skyems bya sngags mchod nyer gcig dag gsaphul zhe bdun gtor ma 'bul ba la 'jig gtor bsangs sbyangs byin gyi rlabs skyon yi sne yi 31 gsarba e dam bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā tī: lan bdun gyis phul me lha asne ra tsa la: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'bul: bzhes nas 'jigs brgyad zhi ba dang rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i don rnams kun: gegs med yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod: bstod pa dang na bzod gsol bya yi ge brgya pas lhag ga bskang4zhe brgyad gshes bsdu bya ba na hūṃ me lha aste ra tsa ni: rang 'azhin gnas su gshegs su gsol: slar yang 'dod pa sgrub pa'i phyir: sbyin bsreg mchod bstod brtsam pa'i tshe: gnas der byon la phrin las sgrubs: ye shes me yi las mdzod cig badz+ra mu ye shesakyi me lha rang gnas su gshegs dam tshag pa 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur zhe dgu bkra shis bya ba ni hūṃ hrī: chos dbyings rnam dag nam mkha' la: sku gsum nyi zla shar ba'i mthus: gdul bya'i pad

gas tshal rab rgyas pa'i: rje btsun 'phags ma'i bkra shis shog: gzung 'j-in gnyes snang rab bsregs cing bde stong 'dod yon mchod rdzas bkrams: ro mnyam ye shes sbar byed pa'i: 'bar ba me yi bkra shis shog 'dzogs brgyad dbyengs su zhi ba dang: tshe bsod dpa la rgyas khams gsum dbang: dgra bgegs rdul brlag drag po yi: las bzhi lhun grub bkra shis shog: nyin ma bdelegs mtshan bde legs: nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa: bkra shis yon tan rgya mtsho yis: 'dzam gling ma sdo/sa khyab shākyar cig: ces sogs shis brjod rgya chen bya me tog sil ma kun tu bkrams gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag phran las rnam bzhi gegs med 'grub ze tshom med do sa ma mā lnga bcu ra bsrung zab mo ni hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ rang lus rdo dzornal 'byor ma: dkar mo rus pa'i rgyan drug spras: rgya gram thod khrag dku la brten: phyed skyil gyis bzhugs bsrung ba'i khrab rdo rje 'bar ba'i bsrung gur gtams: dbu la sangs rgyas pad 'byung bzhugs thugs gar ye shes rab 'bar rdzogs: ba spu bye ba sa ya'i klo : rab 'byams rgyal ba'i spro bsdu 'gyed: ye shes

gsang ba' grwa gur gtams: bar chad gdon tshogs rdul brlag shākyar: hū hū hū: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: ces pas rdo rje'i gur khang phub 'gyur ba med pa'i rgyas theb 'gyur shin tu zab pa'i bsreg blugs sgo tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i thabs skal ldan 'dzag pa'i shing rta'o dad dam ldan pa sa nyams su longs sa ma yu rme ma rgyal ba' dbang po pad+ma ngas ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis snying dang 'dra ba'i man ngag mchog khye'u chung swo tsā khyod la gtad da dung spel ba'i dus ma yin ma 'ongs snyegs ma lnga ya dus nad mug mtshon cha'i g.yul ngo 'brug 'jig rten mi bde'i zug rngus mnar de tshe nga sprul snyi gi bu nus na rdo rje' dpaladu shog chosabadag dpa' bo bdun dang ni dpa' mo gsum la yongs su bstan 'gro don lho dang byang nas 'byung gdul bya 'bum phrag byang chub thob bskal ba'i rgud pa 'khrug slong na rtags dang rten 'brel phun sum tshogs rdzogs ldan lang tsho gsar bas mdzes bstan pa gang dar der bkra shis the tshom med do sa ma yu skal med lag tu ma shor cig snyang gi bu dang 'phrad par shog bka' gsang srung mdzod spu gri gsum sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya snyi ces pa 'di'ang chos kyi bdag po pad+ma chosa'athel rgya mtshos ya yang bskul ba dang / chos bdag ra sar nan tan gyis bskul ba dang / chos bdag 'byur thed rgya mtshog

sa / thab shes kyi dzos 'ga' re dang bcas nas bskul ba dang slob bu dad ldanacasagasal rgyas bre gzha shog bu sdeb ma stong dang lnga brgya phul nas yang yang bskul ba rnams rtags dang rten 'brel bzang po ru mthong nas/ bdaga'adra dpa' banus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o legs so/ sarba maṅga lam/

can zab gsang rdo rje'i snying po las: ḍak+ki'i yan lag gi tshogs bsags zab mo bzhugs so:can na mo dz+nyā ni ḍak+ki ni ye: 241sa/ bdochen yinasamakha' 'gro mchog lhan skyes ku ru kul+le la brten pa' sgrub pa zab mo yiḥ nyer mkho yan lag bdun pa ni na mo rig dang dkyil 'khor yongs 'dus dpal ye shes mkha' 'argor phyag 'tshal lo: 'dod yon sna tshogs mchod pa 'bul: tshe rabs bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags: dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rang: thegs gsum chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs dge tshogs ma gyur 'gro la bsngo: phyam gcig rdzogs sangs rgyas gyur cig:ces brjod tshags zhing 'od zhu bstam tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag dngos grub 'byung the tshom med do sa ma yu las can bu da 'phrad pa ra shog sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi ces pa 'di ya chos kya bdag po pa d+ma chos 'phel gyis bskul ngor bdag 'dras ldan rdo rjesamakha' 'gro'i brda ris las zhal bshus te dag par pha ba pa dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o/ sarba ma sgolam/
dpa dag snang greshes rol pa las zhus len gyi gab don rje btsuna'aphags ma tā re'iphyi sgrub maṇ+ḍal dang 'brel dngos grub kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

dz+wa na me dz+nyā na tāriyi sa sgorwa10〉stetsā 'jigs thegs kun lasarab sgrol zhing tshe dang bsod nams dpal spel ba'i rgyal ba kun mum tā re la gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo rje 131 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas gsang gsum mnyes pa'i phyir maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i cho ga ni dngosagrub kun 'byung zhesapa bstan sa ma yu de yang dkyil 'khor mda' gang ba gru bzhi nam mkhar 'domasagang dpag khod snyoms 'jam dang ldan pa la dri bzang ba byung rnam lnga dang bzang po drug gis chag chag gdab dbusasu pad+ma'i 'od 'khor la rdo rje'i ra ba'i rnam par mdzes phyi rim pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi lte bar nor bu mdzes pas brgyan de rgyab pad zum nyer gcig dang rdo rje 'od dang pad+ma'i phreng phyi nang mchod pa dag gas mdzes dbus su sding khrir sku gzugs dang phyog bzhir mdzes pa'i maṇ+ḍal re rnam lnga bzha skor mchad yon bya snang gsal brgya dang bdug sgosabya zhal zasabargya stong phyi nang gi mchod pa bsam mi khyab pas bskor khrusadang gtsang sbra sngon du gtong de nas rnal 'byor bzhi sde yang bde ba' stan la bag phab gnas semasabaskyed dmigs 'dun dag pa yis 'di nyin rtag tu bo da par bya sa ma mā de yang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las dang po skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni na ma dre gas bcu'i bde btagags sras dang bcas:rje btsun 'phags ma'i

sgo dkyil 'khor la: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: dmus long mar gyur 'gro ba rnams rdzogs sangs rgyas phyir sems bskyed do: lan gsum de nas mchod dzos byi( dīr+shas ni oṃ unyu: dngos por 'dzin pa'ichos rnams kun: dmigs med stong pa'i rang bzhin las: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa'i sprin: kun bzang nam mkha'i khams gang gyur: tsho(yisahūṃ na ma sarba ta tha ga ta bh+yo sogs swā hā: lan bdun dang ni mchod sprin gzungs ci rig par ni brjod par bya gnyis pa bskyed chag rim pa ni skyes su bha wa haṃ: sdi: chos kun mi dmigs gzhi rtsa bral: rang rig byang chub sems kyi mdangs: nya yig ljang gu'i 'phro 'du las: zhing khams rnam par dag pa ni: sa gzhi thams cad rin po che: yangs shing 'jam la khod snyoms brdal: dri bzang sman gyi ngad pa 'thul: me tog sna tshogs sil ma bkram: bya rigs ri dwags rtse 'jo sgeg: yan lag brgyad ldan chu mtsho rgyas: rin chen gser gyi phye ma brdal: g.yu yi ne+e sang rab tu bzhad: 'ja' 'od zer gyi mu khyud mdzes: 'dod don bdud rtsi'i sbrang char 'bebs: lha mi'i bkod pa phun sum tshogs de

dbus chu skyes bzhad pa'i khar thabs shas nya ma zla ba'i steng ta:yig gnas su gyur pa las rja btsun 'phags ma sgol ma ljang zhal gcag phyag gnyas 'dzum mdzas bzhad: rin chen dbu rgyan snyan cha dang: mgul rgyan phreng ba se mo do phyag zhabs gdu bu do shal 'phyang: dar gyi stod g.yog smad sham dang: zi sdir cod paṇa phu dung sogs:longs sku'i rgyan chas bcu gsum spras: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil dag gis bzhugs: 'ja' 'od zer gsum phyogs bcur 'phro phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin phyag rgya mdzad: g.yon pas pad+ma thugs gar bkan 'dab ma snyan thad gyes pa'i steng: 'dod 'byu gter bum nor bu'i mtshan: rigs bdag sangs rgyas snang mtha'alas phyi rim sgrol ma rigs bzhi dang: de rgyab 'phags ma nyi shu gcig: bar mtshams sangs rgyas byang chub sems: sras bcas ma lus lam mer gsal: gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas: spyan drangs rigs lnga'i rnam pa yis: dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag: rmi hūṃ swā e hā: rludzashātshoXthu rta: kwa ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba a snyi ṣiñca oṃ a bhi

dza/ ṣiñcasto: de nas spyan 'dren bya ba ni o: rang snang rnam dag g.yu lo can: bde chen 'od 'bar 'og min nas: rgyal yum rje btsun sgol ma dang: ār+ya tā re nyer rgekhyed rnams gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sa ār+ya tā re dz+nyā na sarba sa ma ya dza dza: de nas bzhugs su gsol ba na trī: ma chags dri bral pad+ma'i gdan 'gyur med yangs pa'i gdan khri la 'phags ma nyer gcig 'khor dang bcas: dgyes shing mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs: lo ār+ya tā re dz+nyā na sa ma ya tisgo lhan de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni tram̐ rin chen maṇ+ḍal gser g.yus brgyan: stong gsum rab 'byams bkod pa sprin lha klu mi yi rgyan rnams rdzogs bla ma sprul pa'i sku la 'bul: rang lus maṇ+ḍal dbang pos brgyan: phung khams skye mched bkrag mdangs ldan: rtsa gsum mchod pa'i lha mo 'phro: bla ma longs spyod rdzogs la 'bul sems nyid maṇ+ḍal rig pas brgyan byang chub sems kyi 'od zer 'phro 'gag med ye shes rgyan rnams rdzogs: bla ma chos kyi sku la 'bul: tshogs rdzogs sgrib gnyis dag pa dang: don 'grub sku gnyis mngon gyur shog:

dra rat+na badz+ra maṇ+ḍal su rtsa te shā: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni hū ste teng nge 'jen las sprul pa ye me tog bdud spos mar me dre: zhal zas sel snyan yed 'ong sgra: lha rdzas las grub gzugs sgra dri ro dang reg bya chos dbyings e: dug gsum rnam dag sman gtor raka: sbyor sgrol byang chub sems kyi sprin: yid 'ong rdo rje'i rig ma lnga: pad phreng glu gar dbyangs dang bcas: khams gsum gang ba'i mchod sprin gyis: 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyes gyur cig: dgyes nas bdag la dngos grub stsol: yi(ma hā sarba pañca putsa ho: de nas tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni o sa(: bde skyong bhasto yangs pa dza gtam pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs 'dod yon lha mo'i gar bsgyur bcas: dngos 'dzin rnal par dag pa yis: 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor dgyes pa bskangs bdag la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: 31ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pu tsa la khā hi: de nas yan lag bdun pa ni hrī: rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang: phyogs bcu'i skyabs gnas thams cad la bdag dang 'gro ba thams cad kyi: sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal 31: phyi nang kun bzang mchod pa

tshaX 'bul: sgo gsum mi dge'i las nyon bshags: dus gsum dge la rjes yi ring: 'gro ba gang 'dul chos 'khor bskor: rgyal rnams mya ngan mi 'da' dros sa dge tshogs mar gyur 'gro la bsngo: phyams gcig kun bzang sa thob shog: lan gsum de nas phyag 'tshal rim pa ni na lnga yesangs rgyas pa chos sku las: thugs rje ye shes 'gro ba'i dpal ma bcos rang rig 'du ma byas 'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo: be+eḍār lhun po lta bu'i mdangs: byams brtses 'gro ba skyob pa dang: btang snyoms gru la nye ring bral: 'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo: spyan ni skad cig glog 'dra zhing: 'jigs tshogs ma lus gzhom par byed: 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal skyob par mdzad:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo: srid pa gsum gyi mgon gcig ma: lha mi'i thor gtsug cod paṇa gtug: ngan song gsum gyi 'dams las skyobs: 'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo: āt+pal la yi dri bsung 'thul ge sar bye ba'i sbubs las byung: chags pa'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i: 'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo zhe sdang seng ge'i

dpa' skongs sheng nga rgyal glang po' rgol ba 'arngams:'bar ba'e me ye tsha zer 'dul:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo phrag dog sbrul dug rab gsod cang:'jab 'phrog rkun jag ring bar byed:sdom byed lcags sgrog zhi mdzad pa'i 'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo:tsha grang dmyal ba'i 'jigs pa skyob bkres skom yi dwags gdung ba zhi:rmongs pa dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal sel:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo rgya mtsho che las skyob pa'i gru:sha za srin po'i gdug rtsub gzhom:dus kyi rgud pa sel mdzad dpal:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo:kla gle'i 'tshubs ma bzlog pa dang:nad yam rdzas sbyor ngan pa dang:mi 'tshams nyes pa'i la yog gzhom:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo:btsa' sad ser gsum 'bu srin dang:phyugs la god kha gtong ba sogs:'phral gyi mu ge zhi mdzad dpal:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo:steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar sde:bar gdon lha srin sde brgyad dang 'og gdon sa bdag klu nad bzlog:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo dmag zhabrug mtshon cha'i g.yul ngo dang:

sgo phu nu nang 'khrug nye ba 'thab:thams cad khyed zhal dran pas bzlog:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo:nam mkha dug spren dmar nag dang:bar snang mkhyerno cha sa rdo'i char:sa gzhi'i nad yam zhi mdzad pa'i:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo gang sku lha lam yangs pa nas:thugs rje'i gru char rab 'beb cing:'gro ba'i ge sar rab rgyas pa'i 'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo:gang gsung dri za'i rgyud mang las:nyer byung 'dzam gling chos sgras khyab:bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde'i gzhi:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo:gang thugs dri bral 'od stong gis 'gro ba nyon mongs 'dam las skyob:rdzogs ldan lang tsho gsar ba'i mdzes:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las ma 'phags mchog thugs rje'i spyan las sprul:rta:yig ljang gu'i 'phro 'du can:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo:skugadza la chos sku kun bzang mo:lhun grub longs sprod rdzogs sku yum:ma 'gags ye shes zung 'jug 'phrul:'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo rnam 'phrul ma 'gags nyi shu gcig:yang

sprul bye ba sa ya 'bum: gang thugs mkhyen brtse'i zer las 'phos: 'phags ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo: rje btsun thugs rje'i mnga' bdag la: zheng rdul kun gye grangs snyed kyis lus brtud gus pas gsol gdab bcas mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni 31 po ṭa la yi gnas mchog nas: rta:yig ljang gus 'phro 'du yis: 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig 'phags mar shar: rgyal ba kun yum nyid la 'dud mtshungs med blta ba'i chog mi shes be+eḍūr lhun po lta bu'i sku: ma chags tshul gyisngakhyal bsnams: 'phags ma yum la gus pas 'dud: 'gro la skyabs spyin phyag rgya mdzad: thugs rje'i gru la nye ring bral: phongs rgud 'gro ba'i dbul ba sel: yid bzhin nor bu ma la 'dud mtshan thos ngan 'gro'i g.yang las skyobs: gsol btab 'jigs brgyad skad cig zhi: dran pas sdug bsngal mtha' dag sel: myur ma dpa' mo mchog la 'dud: mjes pa longs sku'i cha lugs can: mkhyed brtse nus pa'i 'od stong 'bar: dad ldan gdul bya smin mdzad pa'i bka' drin mnyam med nyid la 'dud: rgyal ba'i

dza ༷ spyan sngar mchod sprin stobs ngan song sgo brgya gcod par byed: dmus long 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig pu: snyegs ma'i skyabs mgon mchog la 'dud: tshad med rnam r+shazhi'i rang gdangs las: rje btsun sgol ma dkar mar dang: nyer gcig lha mo'i spro bsdu 'gyed rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab la 'dud skyabs med 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon dbang med sdug bsngal 'dam las sgrol: tshad med lcags kyus 'gro rnams 'dren: 'phags ma lha mo nyid la 'dud: lus ni gus 'dud phyag rgya dang: ngag gis gdungs dbyangs glu dang bcas: sems ni dad brgya'i 'od zer gyis: sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas la bstod: de nas bka' las byung ba yi phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcag da 'di nyid yang yang brjod par bya yo: 'arigs pa brgyad skyob tā:re ma: 'dod rgu'i mchog stsol tut+ta re: nad yam kun bzlog tu re yum: swā hā sgrib gnyis dri 'joms dpal: 'phags ma lha mo khyed mkhyen no ngan 'gro'i 'phrang las skyab tu gsol: nyer gcig la sogs ci 'grub brjod de nas dad pas gsol gdab ni thal mo sbyar la 'di skad do kyi: rgyal ba kun yum rje btsun ma: bdag

la mkhyen btsu nus pas dargangs: 'khar ba'e 'dam rdzab rnyags ma'i khrod mun gleng sred pa'e brtsan khang la: dbang mid spyod pa'e zug rngu can: marga rmengs log pa'i lam la gol na bas gzir la tsha bas bcom bkres skom gdung ba drag pos mnar: sngar ma grags pa'i nad gdon rgod: mi 'dod sdig pa'i las la g.yengs: dus ngan snyigs ma'i mar gsham 'dir: bsam pa chos la mos na yang: mi dge bdud kyi bar chad che 'di las skyobs shig thugs rje can 'jigs tshogs kun bzlog 'phags ma yum:thugs rje skyob mdzod bka' drin can: byin gyis rlobs shig nus mthu can: sgrib kun spyongs shig thugs rje'i gter: bdag gzhan re sa gzhan na med: skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang: 'gro ba'i mgon po khyed mkhyen no: 'khor ba srid pa'i btson khang las: da lta nyid du bde chen zhing: g.yu lo can gyi pho brang dbus: rje btsun 'phags ma'i zhabs drung du: 'bum phrag tshom bu dang bcas par skyes nas phyir mi ldog par re ga: lan gsum de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni rje 'atsun ma'i thugs gar pad+ma'i dal dbus su rta:la rtsa

43 ba'i sngags kyis g.yon du 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros: sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa sbyangs 'gro ba rigs drug gi las tordo rdog: snod bcud ma dag 'khor ba'i snang ba thams cad dbyings su gzhig: dngos 'dzin gyi dri ma bsregs stong gsal 'od kyi zhing khams su gyur: skye 'gro sems can thams cad dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i rol par sad: thugs rje chen po'i skyabs 'og tu bdag dang sems can thams cad dzad par bsam la o tā retut+ta re tu re swā hā: brgya rtsa la sogs ci 'grub brjod de nas snyeng po bsgrangs ba ni snyenatā re tā re zhes pa stong rtsa bsgrangs gnad des 'grub pa'i rtagasamatshan 'byung tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag dngosagrub thob bden rdzun lag tu long dang gsal phyi nang gegasasel 'dod rgu 'grub the tshom med do sa ma yu gsum pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni dkar gtor 'o phud bshams nas su snyen āḥ/: rin chen snye da du gtor ma ni 'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod du dmigs snyen a ka ro trī: dzobatsun 'phags ma nyer gcig la: gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'bul mnyes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol tshe gcig sangs rgyas sa ru

drangs: a.ār+ya tā ra sa pa ri wā ra rat+na yo dam bā lang ta kha kha khā ha khā nya lan bdun brjod la phul bar bya de nas bka' srung dam can la gtor ma 'bul ba' rim pa ni byin rlabs la sogs grub nas su mo badz+ra dharmā pā la k+ṣe ṭa bā la lo ka pā la badz+ra sa ma ya dza gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rnams: bka' srung dam can rnams la 'bul dgyes bskang phrin las rab 'byams bsgrub: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung du gsol: skyid badz+ra dharmā pā la k+ṣe ṭa pā la ma ka pā la sarba sa ma ya e dam hi: lan bdun gyi ni phul bar bya de nas bgegs la gtor ma bshams sa ra yis byin gyis brlabs skyid sarba be+esto badz+ra.aṅku sha ya dza dza: 'dod yon lnga ldan phung po la sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma ni: bgegs rigs lan chags ma1 na la 'bul ngoms tshim byang chub sems ldan gyur: skyirngo sarba be+esde e dam hi: lan gsum kyis na phul bar bya de nas rigs drug mgron rnams la gtor ma byin rlabs sngags phyag drug oṃ a:rji:su:tri:bre:du:badz+ra sa ma dza dza: gtor ma 'dod yon lnga ldan 'di: rigs drug snying rje'i mgron la 'bul: ngoms tshim las snang sdug bsngal bral bde ba mchog dang

sgo ldan par bsam: rgo yi zlo tsanyiprotsudza e dam rat+na bā hi: lan gsum gyis 'bul bar bya de nas 'dod don gsol ba ni nyo rgyalayum rdobatsun sgrolam: 'phags ma dī shu rtsa gcig: mkha' 'gro bye ba sa ya 'bum sde dang bcas pa rnams la zag med ye shes gyi bdud rtsi 'dod pa'i yon tan tshang pa mi zad gtor ma'i mchod pa rgya chen po 'bul lo: thugs dam bskang nas bdag la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub rgya chen po stsol ba dang: gnas skabs nad gdon 'jigs tshogs zhi zhing tshe bsod dpal pyor nyams rtogs yon tan thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo'i bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: tsā r+yashasapa'ichos skyong dpal mgon bdun cu:dregs chen bco rgyad: sde dpon sum cu sogs bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams la sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'dod yon gtor ma'i mchod pa rgya chen po 'bul lo:sangs rgya kyi bstan pa bsrung ba dang sems can la bde spyid 'byung ba'i phrin las mdzod cig: lto bgags regs stong phrag brgyad cu sogs dug gsum las kyis bskyed pa'i

gdon bgegs 'byung po' tshogs rnams la mtshod snyen rgya gtor ma 'dod pa'e pon tan lnga dang ldan pa ru dmogs nas 'bul lo: thams cad rngams sheng tshom nas gnad gdug gi bsam pa bral smon pa byang chub kyi sems rin po che dang ldan pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: ho: 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can las nyon sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i pha ma rnams la zag med 'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod du sprul ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'bul lo: rang rang so so'i las snang sdug bsngal bag chags rgyu 'bras thams cad dang bral nas bde chen chos kyi dbyings la mnga' dbang bsgyur: khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po byed cing gzhen nu bum skur grol ba'i brin las mdzod cig:de nas bshags pa bya ba ni ho: rje btsun 'phags ma'i lha tshogs dgongs: bdag ni ma rig dbang gyur te rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig la: nyams chags 'gal 'khrul gyur ba dang 'phags ma'i spyan sngar 'byor tshogs chung: ting 'dzin ma gsal rmugs 'thibs byang: dag par ma bltas bden par bzungs: tha mal rang gar 'khrul ba rnams: gnong zhing

sgo 'gyod sems drags po bshags:dag tshangs sor dzad dngos grub stsol:yin badz+ra sa ma ya bhi shud+dhi uyig brgya lan gsum bzlas pa yis lhag ga nor wal byang go dag (1 1 de na bsngo ba smon lam ni ho'adas dang ma 'ongs da lta rtsabasags dang bsags gyur bsags pa yi:zag dang zag med dge ba rnams:bsdus te ma gyur 'gro la bsngo phyam gcig kun bzang sa thob shog:lan gsum de nas bsdu rim bya ba ni ho'aphags ma gco 'khe gzhal yas rnams:'od zhu bdag dang 'gro ba la:thim pas 'phags ma'i dgos par 'dres ye rdzogs ga ga ma'i rang ngor sad:dag mnyam sgyu ma'i spyod lam bya:a a āphaṭa phaṭa phaṭa:de nas bkra shis bya ba ni na mo sreg grole dbang byen 'byung ba'i gnas:rtsa rgyud bla ma'i bkra shis shog:mchog thun dngos grub gter mdzod che:yi dam lha yi bar chad sel zheng bde stong bskyed:gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i 'jigs brgyad zhi zhing tshe bsod 'phel:'phags ma tā re'i phrog las rnam bzholhun grub pa'i:dam can rgya mtsho'i skye 'gro'i bde legs 'byung ba'i gzhi:zab gsang chos
