kye nyen yang bde legs mtshan bde legs: rtag par dge ba'e bkra shes regag: ces brjod bsngo ba smon lam sogs gzhan las byung ltar mtha' rgyas bya gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sel tshe dang bsod nams zla ltar 'phel bar chad bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal 'jigs pa brgyad las bskyob par byed the tshom med do sa ma yu bdag 'dra pad+ma saṃ bha wa ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse sems kyis snying bcud gdams pa rmad byung ba rin chen grog las phang na yang nga sprul nga dang dbyer med nga nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel snyigs ma' rgud pa 'ga' re gso las can 'bum phrag grol bar byed chos bdag dpa' bo bdun dang ni dpa' mo gsum yang 'byung par 'gyur sgod ldan de dag rnams la spel gzhan du ma yin a tham rgya bka' gsang srungs shig tshe ring ma ma ral cig snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya lha ces pa 'di'ang bskal pa shing khyi'i lo' zla 8 tshes25 bzang por 'phags ma'i zhing khams kyi mthong snang las 'phags ma nyid dang zhus len gyisagab don zur du bkod pa grangasabacu' bar du gsang rgya bsdamasanas mthar rten 'brel dus la bab tshe chosakyi bdag po pad+ma chosa'aphel rgya mtshogayang yang bskul ba dang / chos la dbang ba'i ḍak+ka rat+na sar bskul ba dang /
—11 slob buchosagasal yeshe sogs kyis yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dradapa' bo nusaldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris las zhal bsas te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/sarba maṅga lam/
bsgotshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las shin tu zab pa'i bka' rgya can mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i dril sgrub bde stong rang 'bar ye shes lto stor zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

gas tsho na mo gu ru kro dha ra dza ye smo 13 bdezhesheshesa'agyur med gsang ba gsum lhan skyes rang byung nas ma'i spros mtha' bral kun tu bzang po gdod ma' sangasargyas la blo bral zang thal rjen pas phyag 'tshal lo skal bzang skyes bu tshe gcig sangasargyasaphyir thug kyi thig le sprosamed nyams len mchog rlung semasating 'dzin zab mo'i nyams len thabs rgyun sgom bde chen ye shesarab 'bar bstan ma mā de pang spyor dngo rjes gsum rim pa las dang po gshams kyi rim pa 'di lta ste mtshan ldan lcang lo dum gcig ka pa wā yid dga' dwang spro rten 'brel 'dzom pa btsal nang kun bzang po drug gis chag chag gdab rdo rje ma reg shes rab mtshal chen dang thabs mchog snyi haṃ she rab li khri yis mkha' 'gro'i sku gzugs legs par bris la bkod thugs srogab yig mdzes pa'i mtshan par bya de nang bla rdo gamu byang mig med pa bam dang nyarini 4 bris pa 'bru sman rin chen sna tshogasabasags pa bkang phyi rim dar tshon sna lngas legs par dkris khrusadang bsangs gsol da la'i lding khar btegs rnam lnga nyer spyod sman gtor ram dang ga ṇa tsakra dza gad spos dud 'khrigs mkha' 'gro'i sgrub gtor gri gug mtshan can bkod skye 'gro'i rgyu 'grul med par gsang bsgrub bya gnas dus yo byad lha sogs gzhan la rba sdig zas dad zas gshin zas dkor zas spang sgo gsum dben

ri rdo tsho bcug gdan la ltod der gnas bla mar gsol ba gdab cing dbang bzhi blang thugs yid bsres la ci gnas bar du bzhag dngos grub 'byu gnas yi dam 'tshol 'khros sgrub bsnyen pa bzla zhes dmigs pa'i 'od zer spro sgrub pa'i rkyen bzlog srung ma gsol zhing mchod phyi nang bar chad bzlog pa'i phrin las bcol de nas thun gya snga rol thams cad du rlung ro lan dgur bsal la dug gsum sbyangs dag pa'i ye shes rlung bcud lan brgyar len ye shesarang sar gnas pas rlung sbyor 'grub bde stong 'bar 'dzag sgom la smin grol byed sbyor ba sngon 'gro rim pa3nargya sa ma yu gnyis pa dngos gzhir 'jug pa'i las ram la yis smra bsam brjed bral chos dbyings stong pa nyid: rang gdangs ma 'gags 'od gsal ye shes che: zung 'jug rdo rje'i sa bonarba mthing shar: 'phros 'dus sbyor bas sgod bcud yum lnga'i slong:rnam dag 'og min mkha' spyod bde chen zhing: lhun grub ye shes gzhal yas rnam par dag: tshad dang mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs pho brang dbus ma chags pad+ma thabs shes nyi zla'i steng: rig pa'i ngo bo rgyu yi yi ge bab: don gnyis byas te 'khor 'das dngas bcud bstem: yongs gyur bdag snang rdo rje phag mo mthing: zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro

zla'i snyan cha rin chen mgul rgyan 'phyang: dar dpyangs rus rgyan gzig sham g.yang bzhi bgo: mgo phreng sbrul chun do shal glang go klubs: phyag g.yas dug gsum rtsad gcod gri gug dang: g.yon pas rten 'brel rtsa ba rak+ta bskyil: zhabs gnyis gar bstabs rtog med ro la brdzis: ye shes me dpung dmar nag 'bar ba'i 1nga: snang stong 'dzin bral rgyu ma'i sku ru bskyed: gnas lnga rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga yi 1nga ma chags dri med thig le dwangs dbus: bde chen 'khor lo sangs rgyas phag mo mthing: gcer bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod bsnams: sku dbyings khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad rdzogs: longs spyod 'khor lor pad+ma phag mo dmar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis chags 'dzum bshad pa'i nyams: dwangs 1nga sku la brgyud gsum rig 'dzin rdzogs: chos kyi 'khor lor rdo rje phag mo dkar: gcer bu lang tsho'i dpal 'byud gri thod bsnams sku dbyings

ra tsho gsang bar bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis rdzogs: sprul pa'i 'khor lo rin chen phag mo ser: zhal 'dzum sgeg bzhad 'dzum dgyes gri thod bsnams 'od gsal sku dbyings gnas gsum mkha' 'gro rdzogs: bde skyong 'khor lor las kyi phag mo ljang: mdzes 'dzum gcer bu gar bsgyur gri thod bsnams: 'od gsal sku dbyings dam can rgya mtsho rdzogs rdo rje phung po'i grong khams gnas nyer bzhi: tshogasabargyad rang gol dur khrod chen po'i gnas: kun byed g.yo rtsal 'brel ba'i yul so gnyis: nyon mongs rang grol he ru ka yi zhing: gdan gsum tshangs pa lha yi rol bar rdzogs: ba spu bsam yas 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i dal: lus ngag yid kyi bkod pa'i cho rol la: dag pa dbyings gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'gyed kun kyang rgyan med gcer bu 'od phung 'bar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis chags 'dzum sgeg pa'i sku: dar dang rat+na rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras phyag gnyis gri gug bde chen bhasno brten gar bsgyur rol stabs ye shes me klong bzhugs: rangagospyopor pad+ma 'dab stong bzhad: ma chags dri bral nyi zla bshad

pa'e khar: regs rkya bdag po pad 'byung a tsar+ya: dkar dmar mdangs ldan bcu drug lang tshos mdzas: phyag g.yas ḍa ru dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sdud g.yon pas dral bus chos kyi sgra dbyangs sgrogs he ru ka pa'i cha lugs mdzes pas brgyan: sbas yum gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum brten: ye shes lnga ldan 'od kyi klong du bskyed gnas gsum rdo rje'i snying po gsal ba las: 'od 'phros rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang bcas: sku gsung thugs mchod byin rlabs nus stobs bsdus: rigs lnga'i rnam par byon nas sku dbyings gang: sgrib gnyis bag chags dri ma kun dag nas: chu bo yar 'khyil rgyal bas dbu brgyan gyur: slar yang phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i bde gshegs rnams: phyag rgya yig 'bru phyag mtshan rnam par byung: bdag mdun sgrub pa'i lha la sib sib thim: ( trī: 'og min bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas: rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: bde chen ye shes mchog rtsol phag mo ni: sgrub mchog byin gyis rlabs phyir gshegs su gsol: ma badz+ra wa ra ni sarba sa ma ya dza dza: bye: gdod nas rnam dag gdan gsum tshang ba'i lhar

58tsho dbyings nas spyan drangs dam ye ro gcig bzhugs:lhan skyes gnyug ma bde chen don gyi lha:rang rig ngo bor shes pas phyag 'tshal lo:tshod dz+nyā na s+t+waṃ:na mo ho:hūṃ trī:chos nyid 'gags mid nam mkha'i gter mdzod las:sna tshogs yo byad phyi nang gsang mchod rigs dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la gus pas 'bul:ma spang ro mnyam ngang bzhes dngos grub stsol:snyedam hā puts+tsha ho:shā trī:lhan skyes bdochen 'bar ba'i phyag rgya che:bcu drug mchog gi yon tan mthar phyin nas:dga' chen ye shes dngos grub 'dzad med gter:rnal 'byor grogs mo khyed la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥskye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du:thegs chen chos dang mi 'bral snying po blangs:nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel rgyas dbang mchog thob:lha mchog ḍak+ki khyod dang dbyer med shog:bdag nyid rdo (phag mo' thugs gar sangs rgyas rigs kyi phag mo:de yi snying gar kun bzang yab yum:de yi thugs klong rnam par snang mdzad yab yum de yi thugs gar rang dang 'dra ba'i phag mo tshon gang ba rgyan med gcer bu 'od zer 'bar ba'i thugs

klong peḍūr+ya yi rda rje nas 'byu tsam rgya lte bar nye zla ga'u kha sbyor ba'i nang khong ye shes lnga ldan dga' 'byel mdzas pa'e 1nga du thugs srog ba: sngon la rtsa ba'i sngags kyes 'khar bar bsam: de las 'od zer 'phros dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul: thugs rje'i byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub thams cad bsdus te bstim: mar 'phros gang 'dul gyi 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag thams cad kyang ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sku gsung thugs kyi rol bar sad: 'byung ba lnga yis dwang bcud bsdus nas rang la bstims: tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas: slar yang thugs sgog sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros rtsa khams kyi lha tshogs rnams la mnyes mchod 'bul: thugs rgyud bskul: thams cad kyang bde stong chags pa med pa'i snyom zhugs mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis byang chub sems zag med ye shes kyi rgyun dkar na ra ra bab: lus kyi rtsa khams thams cad khyab 'chi ba med pa'i tshe: 'gyur ba med pa'i srog nub pa med pa'i

52 tsho bsod nams zad pa med pa'i dbang thang: rgud pa med pa'i slung rta chad pa med pa'i nyams rtogs 'gag pa med pa'i ye shes: rdul ba med pa'i blo gros:ldib pa med pa'i shes rab: zag pa med pa'i dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam la lan gsum: snyen badz+ra wa ra hi baṃ ha ri ni sa sarba sirnyi pha la sa: ci nus bzla zhing gsal dag brtan pa'i blos ting 'dzin mi g.yel spro bsdus bzlas pa bya dbang dang dngos grub gong 'phel tshe bsod rgyas phyi na gegs zhi mchog thun dngos grub thob sa ma yu skabs su yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed bhan+ta'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul: de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dbang gi kha dog lcags kyu'i dbyibs can dpag tu med pa 'phros pas snang srid khams kyi skye 'gro'i blo yid sems gsum zas nor longs spyod: 'dod rgu'i dpal yon: srid pa'i phywa g.yang: ci 'dod pa'i dmigs yul de nyid rang dbang med par lcags kyu'i sna la drangs nas bhasto ltems gyis gang: bdag la 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos grub stsol bar byed pa'i yid bzhin nor ltar bkra zhing rgyas par

bsam la rtsa sngags mthar ces dhu ma gha ye na ma sarba rat+na bā ༄ kha dhe sedhe pha la sa: brgya stong khri 'bum bye ba la sogs bskyar gnad des mchog thun dngos grub thob par 'gyur sam mā bdag dang snang ba spro bsdus thams cad gang shar chos nyad kyi rol ba smra bsam brjod pa bral ba snang tshad sku sgra grags sngags 'gyu 'phro ye shes chen po'i rol bar blta zhin nyams len snal ma'i don la ci gan bzhag de nas ldang tshe lhag chad kha bskang dang mchod ca bstod pa smon lam yongs rdzogs bya tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag dbang dang dngos grub 'phel dngos gzhi nyams len rim par3)rgya sa ma yā de nas rjes rim tshogs kyi 'khor lo la dza gad me sa la sogs ci 'byor zhing lhan du bsdum la ka pā la ru spungs de nas byin rlabs 'bul ba'i rim pa na hūṃ dum gcig bharnya yangs pa'i sgod mchog tu dam rdzas 'dod yon bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs: sha khrag la sogs bkod pa'i yo byad rnams: sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis rlabs zad med nam mkha'i mdzod du dmigs byas nas: rtsa gsum lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul: lus ngag yid kyi dam tshig nyams chags bshags gzung 'dzin dgra bgegs dbu ma'i dbyings su sgol: mnyam nyid rig stong bde chen klong

rim tsho du bstabs mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mo thugs dam bskangs: las byed dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dgyes pa bskangs: myong grol dam rdzas rnal 'byor bdag gis spyod: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro lhag sdud 'khor bcas mchod: bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs rtsa rlung rgud sol sgrub pa'i 'bras bu stsol: dpal mgon dregs can rgya mtsho'i chad mdo bzhes: bstan ma bcu gnyis dam rdzas bshal chu longs: dam sri 'gab 'dre 'od gsal mkha' la brub: gsang gsum mi 'gyur bde chen dngos grub stsol: ma rig bag chags dri ma dbyings su bshags: zag dang zag med dge rtsa ci mchis pa: 'khor gsum yongs dag chen por bsngo bar bya: snang cha thabs kyi 'khor lo ci byung yang: she rab spros bral dbu ma chen por āḥ lha snang gang shar rang grol he ru gas: 'dod yon mi spang lam khyer e ma ho: snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos sku'i ngang: dag mnyam ye rdzogs rig pa'i bkra shis re/ga bsngo ba smon lam mthar rgyas byas pa yis phyi nang sgrib sbyangs tshogs rdzogs dngos grub thob sa ma wā mkha' 'gro sgrub pa' dam tshag

gtong ba la rlung gi rnal 'byor 'bar dzag sgom pa gces de la smin byed sngon du 'gro ba gal de yang zan gyi rkong bu rus gong tsam mi zhun blugs la dal gyi dbus su bzhag skye med bapag bzlasapas bsgrub par bya de nas slob ma 'tshogs la rlung chas bsgrags slob dpon rdo rje phag mo'i rgyal gyis khrus dang bgegs bsgrad srung 'khor bsgom byas nas maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba gdab pa ni kye rigasakun mngosa'adus bla ma dgongs su gsol bdag la bde chen ye shes rgyas pa dang rtsa rlung thag le las su ru ba yi smin byed dbang mchog dam pa bskur du gsol lan gsum de nas gnang ba sbyin pa 'di lta ste kyiho la ldan khyed cag tshogs dang bsod nams bsags gsang sngags bla med 'phrad pa shin du dka' 'phrad kyang dam tshag bsrung na sangs rgyas thob nyams na dmyal bar lhung ngo las ldan rnams de phyir dam tshag rim la rtag byas mdzod de nas dam tshag bzung ba'i gsol gdab ni kye bla med mchag gsum ngo bo bla ma dgongs srog gi phyir yang bla med don mi spang rtsa ba yan lag dam tshag rnam dag bsrung yi dam khyod ni byang chub bar du brten bde stong phyag rgya chen po'i brtul zhugs bsgom skal ldan sman pa'i thabs la brtson legs kyis spros bral bde stong dbang mchog rtsal du gsol lan gsum zhu slob ma rnam snang chos bdun gyi gnas la ye shes pa ru gsal la lha bskyed bya dbyengasanas nibazhen gshegasapa

ri rdo rnams spyan drangs la bstims ye shes dbab pa'i la de dag brtan par bzhugs su gsol de nas rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro rdo rje pha ga mor gsal ting sgron rig pa'i ye shes su mod zhal chos nyid kyi rol pa chen por blta me ye shes lnga'i 'od zer 'phro ba de nyad ste ba'i gtum mo la thim de'i rkyen gyis bskul nas byin rlabs ye shes kyi rlung ro rkyang nas brgyud de gtum mo la zim pas cher 'bar gnas lnga'i rtsa 'khor khyab nyon mo sa pa dug lnga'i mtshan rtog bag chags dang bcas pa bsregs spyi bo'i ha la phog yab yum reg pa 'phrod pa'i byed las kyi bdud rtsi bya chub sems kyi rgyun dkar na ra ra bab par bsam la hūṃ trī bde chen ye shes byang chub sems kyi rgyun mu tig dkar po dri bral ltar bab nas khrag 'thung rig 'dzin zhi ba mkha' 'gro dang dam can rgya mtsho'i sku gsung thugs mchod nas sgrib pa bzhi dag dbang mchog rnam lngas smin rig 'dzin bzhi nod sku bzhi'i rgyal sa zin dga' bzha rab 'bar stong bzha' 'od gsal rgyas ye shes lnga rdzogs lan skyes dpa' bo mjal don dam rdo rje phag mo' ro bor blta rang lus rtsa rlung thig le cher rgyas nas khams gsum sgod bcud brtan galnga'i bkod pa rnams ye shes mes bsregs zag med bdud rtsis bkrus byin rlabs rlung gis spros bral mkha' la brdal byang chub sgrub pa' bar chad kun bral nas bde stong a haṃ mchog gi dbang thob shog rtsa sngags mthar a haṃ

sto dhe tsit+ta sa ma ya ho sa ma ya sto a nu ra sto haṃ a nu ra ga ya skye dza hūṃ baṃ ho sto dhi tsit+ta spra ra ṇa phaṭa saṃ ha ra ṇa hūṃ zhes brjod la rol pa chen po'i 'bar 'dzag bsgom mtha' rten gtad dam tshag bshad dga' ston bya tshogs la rol bkra shis la sogs pa'i mtha' brgyan par bya'o dngos grub 'byung gnas dbang bskur thob nas slar g.yel med mkha' 'gro'i nyams len rnams la 'bad bde legs dpal rgyas mchog gi dngos grub thob ze tshom med do badz+ra sa ma yu mtha' rten rjes kyi rim pa3nargya sa ma yu me ma rgyal ba' dbang po pad+ma 'byung gnas ngas thugs kyi yang tig gdams pa zab pa'i sgo ma 'ongs 'gro la phan pa'i man ngag bstan lnga brgya' ded dpon nusaldan rdo rjes rted bstan pa' 'gro don lho byang phyogs nas 'byung chos kyi bdag popad+ma chosa'agel 'byung mdo khams rtse shod gsham nas bka' 'di rnyed bdud sprul bcu gsum 'khrum nas bstan don 'byung the tshom med do rgyal dbangapad+ma'i bka' dbang drag yak+ṣa nag mos thub par srungs dam nyams lag tu ma shor sa ma mā skal ldan rag 'dzan rnams kyi dpal du shog sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi ces pa 'ad yang bdag 'drasang rgyan nu ldan gling pas gter nas bton te mo lo brgyad la bka' rgya byas mthar rten 'brel dus la bab tshe chos kyi bdag popad+ma chos 'ayil rgya mtshosasgrub pa'i mitog bkra shis lha reg ran chen dang po dbang lnga cod paṇa dar ser 'od zer rgyas pa

52 'i gzha shog dkar rdo rje'i gsung dang bcas te yang yang bskul ba dang /nye gnas gakyi grags pas zhabs pad brten pa'i skyes bcas bskul ba dang /grogasamo rat+na sar mos blos bskul ngor mkha' 'gro'i bdo ris las dag par phab pa phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dge zhang bkra shis par gyur cigasarba maṅga lam/bi dza yan+tu me/
bye /dh+ra
